title: Shield Shifter
description:
Shield Shifter is a homebrew Atari 2600 game developed by John Reder / Tactical Neuronics. It was given a limited cartridge release by Good Deal Games. Shield Shifter was later included on the Atari Flashback series of plug-and-play consoles, starting with the Atari Flashback 5 in 2014, and most recently on the Atari Flashback X Deluxe in 2019.

The player controls a turret at the bottom of the screen, firing up at three shield layers that loop horizontally. The goal is to create an opening in the third layer and hit the insectoid hiding behind it, which continuously fires at the player.

Euro Truck Simulator 2 reveals another upcoming map expansion, the Nordic Horizons, taking players through the captivating landscapes of northern Europe!

The expansion features expansive fjords of Norway all the way to the Arctic Ocean, challenging bridges, underwater tunnels, and narrow roads, complete with encounters with reindeer and coastal fishing villages. Drive through Sweden’s Norrland, offering a diverse environment, from settled regions along the main E4 road to the barren hills of the Scandinavian mountains. Finland’s Lapland, with its dense coniferous forests to the expansive barren tundra, presents a stark contrast to the southern part of the country

The DLC includes tens of cities and towns, showcasing typical Nordic architecture and delving into Viking history. Additionally, Nordic Horizons promises a seamless blend of nature, history, and trucking excitement, offering players an unforgettable Nordic adventure. description: Project Hot Tub was an open-world action-adventure game that combined the open-world gameplay of Uncharted 4: A Thief's End, the combat of Batman: Arkham Knight, and the family-friendly vibes of Ratchet & Clank. The game was being worked on by PopCap Vancouver in around 2015 and was planned to be released in early 2017. According to sources gathered by IGN, in the second half of 2016, the game was ready to show off to EA executives, but little did they know, EA would trash Project Hot Tub a few days later in order for them to get more working hands on the now-canceled Star Wars game codenamed Project Ragtag.

description:
Japan, 1863. After three centuries of the Tokugawa Shogunate’s oppressive rule, the Black Ships of the West descend upon the nation’s borders and the country falls into a state of turmoil. Amidst the chaos of war, disease and political unrest, a nameless warrior forges their own path, holding the very fate of Japan in their hands.

As a masterless warrior – a Ronin, your destiny is your own. See the story unfold in different ways depending on the choices you make and the characters you ally with along the way. Face critical mission decisions – like whether to assassinate or protect key figures, and shape the course of history through a rich multi-choice system.

title: Wings of Endless
description:
Wings of Endless" is an action RPG that captivates with its platforming elements and a rich, pixel-art visual style. The game unfolds the story of Hariku, a confident bounty hunter whose routine mission evolves into an expansive quest, revealing the layers of a long-forgotten war. Accompanied by Owly, his mysterious talking owl, and a cast of unexpected allies, Hariku's journey spans across diverse and vivid landscapes filled with secrets, from desolate deserts and lush forests to icy expanses and marshlands​​​​.

The gameplay is dynamic, emphasizing a combat system that allows players to control three distinct heroes, each with unique abilities, and switch between them in real-time to unleash powerful combos. This system, alongside a vast world ripe for exploration, numerous side missions, a variety of challenging enemies, and intricate puzzles, ensures a gameplay experience that is both engaging and rewarding. Additionally, the game features a crafting system for consumables, further enriching the gameplay with strategic elements​

Although the avian descendants of the dinosaurs are much smaller, their fury has only gotten more concentrated. A generational grudge so powerful it can be harnessed and weaponized as devastating laser beams.

title: Mushroom Collection

title: The Three Kingdoms: The Story of Seeking Generals
description: The Three Kingdoms: The Story of Seeking Generals is the only real-time strategy game of the Three Kingdoms that does not draw cards. The Lord can experience the most exciting experience, the most pure strategy and the most sincere feelings of the Three Kingdoms!

description: Xialuo: Kill All Flowers is an innovative turn based adventure RPG that combines the commonly used "dice elements" and "big map exploration" in board games. In the game, you will gradually uncover various monsters in this dark and mysterious world, achieve your mission.

title: Geometric Force Field
description: Geometric Force Field is a relaxing and minimalist 2D puzzle game.

description: When you live alone at home, you suddenly encounter all kinds of strange things, such as hair in the water pipe, strange figures on TV, eyeballs in the refrigerator, and so on. What's the matter?

title: Sertorgina
description: Welcome to explore the unknown world with Sertorgina together. You will face various enemies, from ordinary soldiers to powerful boss.

title: 100 Cats Singapore
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Singapore! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Cats Belgrade
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Belgrade! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Cats Beijing
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Beijing! Can you find them all?

title: Carrot Survivors
description: Protect your factory from the wrath of nature and the greed of pacifying forces with the help of your coworkers and the strength of your professional skills. Fight against waves of enemies before the end of your work day: Extra hours will not be compensated.

title: Case 32
description: A series of mysterious murders takes place in a small provincial town. Detective Cooper must unravel a tangle of mystical, chilling events to get to the bottom of the mystery.

title: Castles on Clouds
description: A Roguelike Tower Defense game set on a user controlled procedurally generated island. Select unique cards and relics that enhance your towers abilities, crafting powerful builds to defend against the growing hordes of enemies.

title: Catacomb Rogue Clawsaders
description: Welcome to Catacomb Rogue Clawsaders! In this deckbuilding roguelite you'll embark on an dark journey alongside a fearless band of kitties as they claw their way through hordes of monstrous adversaries lurking within the corridors of a strange catacomb.

title: Bladerite: Retribution
description: Bladerite offers action game enthusiasts a unique opportunity to polishing gaming skills like never before on cross-platform. Not only can you earn rewards based on defeating opponents in each match, but you can also acquire upgradeable patterns that enhance your game experience. Immerse yourself in a world where the in-game economy is supported by cryptocurrency.

title: Eyes Of Memes
description:
One day you had the bad luck to fall through from your reality into some otherworld. Such incidents sometimes happen and now it has happened to you. From now on you have only one task - to find 8 pictures and leave this strange place.
In terms of gameplay Eyes Of Memes is a classic indie horror in which you have to explore the location in search of pictures. You don't have any weapons, you are always defenseless against the inhabitants of the place and if you encounter them, running away is the only way to escape.

title: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Gotopazu Story - Complete Set
description:
The Complete Set includes:
- The Game
- All 5 Illustration Art Books
- Gotopazu Story Soundtrack
- Complete Quintuplets Set Box

This set was exclusively sold at Maji-Get Stores.

title: I'm Counting to 6...
description: Turning onto an old road, the main character gets into an accident due to thick fog. Now he's trying to find someone who can help him. Forced to enter an old house, the main character finds himself trapped, from which it is not so easy to get out.

title: Surveillance Work
description: Surveillance Work is a horror spot-the-difference game where you monitor surveillance camera footage to discover and report anomalies.

title: Black Gunner Wukong
description:
Black Gunner Wukong is a Rougelike type shooting game.
In the game, the player takes on the role of Wukong , who enters a U.S. military base to rescue his master who has been captured by Diden.
In the game, all creatures are identified as armed helicopters and supermarket shopping bags, not as female and male!

title: Half-demon Kamia
description: Half-demon Kamia is in a 3D single-player game, set in an expansive boxed world. Embark on a journey as a being torn between humanity and demonic heritage.

title: Barn Runner 1: The Armageddon Eclair
description: Barn Runner: The Armageddon Eclair is a full-sized game in two chapters that will set you (as Detective Prick Peckard, head of the Robot Crimes Division) hot on the trail of a missing robot as you follow the trail of clues from the Food Courts of your domed city all the way to the untamed green forests of a land that does not officially exist. THRILL to the chase!

title: Empty Skull
description: "Empty Skull" is a pixelated indie puzzle game with RPG elements that revolves around a skeleton trying to recollect its life.

title: Sphere Game Colours
description: The Sphere Game is about to enchant its loyal fans and win over new enthusiasts. With a complete revitalization, the game offers a completely renewed experience, standing out for stunning visuals and innovative mechanics. Overcome challenging obstacles and dive into an exciting journey, where each stage presents new and thrilling challenges. Your mission is clear: cross the portal to advance to the next level, facing a series of intriguing challenges along the way. Be prepared for an engaging experience where triumph is rewarded, and excitement is always on the horizon.

title: Sonic Megamix Mania
description: Sonic Megamix Mania is a fan-made mod of 'Sonic Mania Plus' that recreates the levels of the original 'Sonic Megamix' Sonic 1 Rom-Hack, as well as re-imagines them in a new mode!

title: Historion: ... und Geschichte wird zum Abenteuer
description: The player is a time traveller with the mission to save the classical era. To do this, he has to solve history-based puzzles, fight enemies and collect four magic gems. The player collects items and stores them in the inventory for further usage. The game takes place in Greek towns, harbors and four of the seven Wonders of the World. An in-game knowledge base is included.

title: Planet Zoo: Console Edition - Ultimate Edition
description: The Ultimate Edition includes all Deluxe Content, plus a Season Pass granting access to 14 future console DLC packs

title: Planet Zoo: Console Edition - Deluxe Edition
description: For players looking to expand their zoos with even more animals, scenery and gameplay scenarios, the Deluxe Edition includes 16 additional animals and two additional scenarios, which transport players to both the heart of the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia and rich, vibrant wetlands.

title: Chemicus II: Die versunkene Stadt
description: A famous professor disappears during an accident in a chemistry laboratory. As his assistant, it is the player's job to find him and solve the mystery around this accident. The player has to find solutions to puzzles with the help of chemistry. The necessary ingredients are stored in the inventory. The game includes a knowledge base.

title: The Science of Staying Awake
description: You ever sit in class sleep deprived to all hell and wonder how long before you start going insane? You ever come home to find some some unidentified disheveled creature-guy-thing in your bed? College is tiring enough. You really don't need this. Unfortunately, this already got attached.

title: Kind Donations
description:
It's a late night at the _____ Museum. The island representative has come in to donate today's haul of insects.

Explore a museum warped by the perspective of its humble curator, burdened with the task of homing his worst nightmare.

A short Animal Crossing horror game about insect donations.

title: Mime
description:
Once upon a time, there was harmony and balance in the world. Four kingdoms of humans have watched over the four elements. But then a traitor appeared, who has angered the Goddess with his selfish deeds. The balance was destroyed, the elements were no more in harmony, and the world plunged into chaos...

Twelve thousand years later, a young knight named Eagle Windeed has been having a strange dream. Maybe there is still salvation for the human race. Maybe it is still possible to make peace with the higher beings. Eagle arrives at a tavern near the Tree Dungeon, determined to find out what his dream meant...

Mime is a dungeon crawler: the entire game is set in a maze-like dungeon environments (with auto-map). There are no "safe" areas; random enemies can pop out anywhere (the random encounter rate is however quite low). Eagle starts alone, but later in the game three other heroes join him. The battles are turn-based, utilizing the standard "attack/magic" formula. There are a few explicit sex scenes in the game.

title: The Jumping Alphabet Soup
description:
Sharpen your senses and prepare to dive into the tasty world of words! The Jumping Alphabet Soup takes you through three delicious cuisines, each with its own unique levels and charm.

With 15 challenging levels, this video game will put your word skills to the ultimate test!

title: Worm War
description:
Experience the excitement of "Worm War", where strategy and speed combine in a colorful, candy-inspired world. Navigate your worm with fluid 360-degree movement and outsmart AI opponents in this engaging single-player adventure.

Enhance your gameplay with special skills: Dash to surge forward, Shield for collision protection, and Magnetic to attract food effortlessly. Grow your worm, unlock diverse maps, and personalize your journey. With each game, challenge yourself to beat high scores and master the art of Worm War!

title: Dasha Vasilyeva: The Personal Case of Catwoman
description:
“Dasha Vasilyeva: The Personal Case of Catwoman” is one of the brightest projects in the quest genre of 2009 from CreativeDream Studio. A fascinating detective story, based on the work of the same name by the most popular Russian writer Daria Dontsova, well known to players from her literary bestsellers and numerous television adaptations.

A request for help from a desperate friend becomes the beginning of the incredible adventures of Dasha Vasilyeva. On the eve of the New Year, she will have to unravel a mysterious family intrigue. The unexpected return of deputy Mikhail Medvedev's daughter, who disappeared more than 10 years ago, leads to the most unexpected consequences during Dasha's private investigation.

Will you save the Heavens, or will you see them fall?

description:
You are a Spy Balloon floating in enemy airspace. A fighter jet has been scrambled to intercept and shoot you down! Worse, surface-to-air missiles are aiming right at you!! Fly! Fly for as long as possible, and see how long you can stay aloft!!

"Saddle up, airman! We've got a bogey at Angels 40!" -Someone, Somewhere

title: Sky Balloon Freakout DX
description:
A highscore game, where you play as a balloon avoiding a fighter-jet and bullets.
"Saddle up, airman! We've got a bogey at Angels 40!" -Someone, Somewhere

title: Sonic X Shadow Generations
description: Shadow the Hedgehog is back with Classic and Modern Sonic in Sonic X Shadow Generations, an all-new collection featuring two unique experiences! Play as Shadow in a brand-new story campaign featuring never-before-seen abilities that prove why he's known as the Ultimate Life Form! Speed through iconic stages from Shadow's history, discover hidden secrets in an expansive hub world, and unlock new powers to take on Black Doom and save the world. Sonic X Shadow Generations also includes a complete remaster of the highly acclaimed Sonic Generations, a time-traveling adventure featuring a greatest-hits collection of 3D and 2D Sonic stages, now with upgraded visuals and new bonus content.

title: Foamstars: Season 1

Season One: Starry Pop

Combine small "fruits" together to make them larger, creating big "watermelons" without overflowing the container, and enjoy the challenge.

title: Clown Around
description: An immersive simulator where you play as a clown.

title: Arsonate
description: Outwit the HOST in a death game where fire spreads with each flip of a card. Be the last to burn. Do you fear death?

title: Galactic Gauntlet: The Ultimate Interstellar Challenge
description:
In a post-apocalyptic world where Earth is on the brink of collapse, humanity's last hope lies in finding a new habitable planet. The remaining population resides in the last "green" city, a sanctuary shielded from the desolate wastelands that cover the rest of the planet.

To select the most skilled and resourceful individuals for a crucial space mission, the city's leaders organize an intense competition known as the "Galactic Gauntlet: The Ultimate Interstellar Challenge." This competition consists of a series of grueling obstacle courses designed to test the physical abilities, problem-solving skills, and mental fortitude of the participants.

As a promising candidate, you enter the Galactic Gauntlet, aiming to prove yourself worthy of joining the elite team of explorers who will embark on the interstellar journey to find a new home for humanity. The obstacle courses are not only physically demanding but also simulate the challenges and dangers that await in space, such as zero gravity zones, asteroid fields, and complex puzzles.

Throughout the competition, you'll face fierce rivals, uncover hidden secrets about the mission, and make critical choices that will determine your fate and the fate of humanity. Only the most skilled and resilient will earn a place on the space mission, where they will venture into the unknown to secure a future for mankind.

In this intense competition, players will navigate through treacherous obstacle courses, each designed to test their agility and quick-thinking. You'll need to dodge, jump, and strategize your way past various hazards that threaten to send you back to the last checkpoint you passed. Your ultimate goal? To ascend the leaderboards, outpace your rivals, and etch your name in the annals of the Galactic Gauntlet as the fastest, most cunning competitor in this ultimate interstellar challenge. With each run, you'll hone your skills, learn the nuances of each course, and strive for that flawless run that will secure your place among the stars.

The game's controls are designed to be intuitive and responsive, giving players a sense of agility and precision as they navigate the courses. You can run, sprint to gain speed, slide under obstacles, leap over gaps, and even master the art of wall scaling by deftly jumping back and forth between surfaces. These mechanics not only add depth to the gameplay but also allow for a wide range of movements that make each attempt at a course a thrilling and unique experience. Mastery of these controls is key to making swift progress, avoiding setbacks, and ultimately dominating the leaderboards with grace and style.

title: Hazardous Materials
description:
You are Gordon Freeman...

It was a normal working day. Scattered Xen aliens were hiding even in the rear corners of the Black Mesa research facility.
It slowly return normality in everyday work. The old not been destroyed buildings have been modernized slowly.

You return from a normal disposal order, as in parts of the institution the power goes out. Power generators to keep running on the main equipment and and your mission is to restore the energy supply. On the half way you notice more and more Xen returnes to Black Mesa and the military is back ...

Uncover a new, exciting plot in the Half-Life universe!

title: Goodbyes
description:
Alex hasn‘t seen her best friend Naomi in weeks until she suddenly gets a text message inviting her over. Naomi‘s moving. Tomorrow. And this will be Alex' last chance to see her.

But there‘s still so much left unsaid…

description: With the Year One Complete Edition of Session: Skate Sim, you get the base game and lots of additional content. Ride the most iconic spots, explore unique maps, meet and play as professional skaters.

description: Hook, Line. and Sinker is a fishing game. You catch fish while fighting them on the water. You can collect gold, collect weapons, and strengthen them.

title: Lion Simulator Survival: RPG Animal Battle
description: Roar through the savannah, hunt prey, and lead your pride in Lion Simulator Survival—an immersive RPG animal battle experience.

title: Borzoi Adventure

description: A Danmaku Shooting Game.

In a world where the oceans are burdened by humanity's neglect, Clean the Sea! challenges you to pilot a lone vessel on a noble quest: cleanse the waters, rescue marine life, and turn the tide on pollution. As you navigate through tranquil yet troubled waters, your mission is not just to collect refuse but to catalyze change—one scoop of trash at a time.

description: Clicky is a level-based computer simulation puzzle game heavily inspired by the technology, games, software and online world of the 1990s and 2000s.

title: Climb Challenge: Find Items Cyberpunk

If you fall, your progress is lost and you start over. Keep your balance on this challenging climb and compete with your friends to reach the top.

title: Cloudy Valley
description: Join the summer camp at Cloudy Valley! Dive into exploring the archipelago to find the camp's pins or relax peacefully by the seaside with a cozy and soothing atmosphere

title: Clocked
description: Two worlds coexist, but one of them didn't exist yesterday. That's why you, an automaton, and your calculator sidekick, are looking for a way out of the Great Clock, searching for answers, but above all to find a way out of this place that's gathering dust.

title: Code Alpha: The Final Frontier
description: In "Code Alpha" battle alien invaders with advanced tech armor. Explore from cities to dungeons in mixed third-person and first-person views. Collect alien tech to upgrade gear and confront massive enemies and bosses. Your ultimate goal: defeat the alien mothership. Brace for a thrilling adventure!

title: Dark Memories: Prologue
description: Rent a cabin for a serene weekend, only to face a series of eerie puzzles in 'Dark Memories: Prologue'—an FPS thriller where every clue is a step towards escape.

title: Year3055

description: No boy has never had a superhero dream, now it's your turn to save the human world.

title: Economia: Millennium
description: Dive into economic and strategic mastery with Aporia Interactive's innovative game, Economia: Millennium. Lead your nation as a visionary, navigating the complexities of the 21st-century world in this engaging real-time strategy and economic management experience. Will you lead your nation to unparalleled prosperity, or will you succumb to the challenges of the new millennium?

title: Will The Man Get Frog
description: Will The Man Get Frog is a chill little game about composing silly or sweet haikus (short poems) and sharing them with the world! Don't worry about the blank page, the game will provide words for you. Just arrange them the best you can!

title: WitchGhost
description: A spooky adventure through a weird and wonderful land. Boost your powers and change the world as you help Ezme, the WitchGhost, collect her memories so she can remeber how to go home.

title: Witching Stone
description: Witching Stone is a puzzle game matched with a deckbuilder! Customise your spellbook and weave spells with coloured stones.

title: Monster Scout
description:
Monster Scout is a football game.
You scout players to make a strong football team, but can't check their ability status. You have to judge the ability from the player's characteristics. Since the players move automatically, you can only command the operation in games.

title: Bara to Tsubaki to Fata Morgana
Under A Star Long Cold
description: You have 30 minutes to loot this place and pay your debts before the planet is destroyed. Intense stealth-action with permadeath. An exploration of agency and hope.

title: Sleeping With Sakuya Izayoi
description: In this small visual novel, lay down and relax with Sakuya Izayoi. Talk to her, kiss her or just simply enjoy each other's presence! Chose between 3 different locations featuring stunning artwork in this Touhou Project Fangame.

title: A-Ressha de Ikou II
description: The second iteration of the A-Train series was released in July 1988 for the NEC PC-9801 and X68000. In the US, it was released under the name Railroad Empire.

title: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth - Deluxe Edition
description:
Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth is a turn-based role-playing game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. It follows dual protagonists Ichiban Kasuga and Kazuma Kiryu, with the narrative set primarily in Japan and Hawaii. The game uses a party-based combat system that builds on previous Like a Dragon entries, incorporating positioning and environmental interactions. Players engage in main story missions alongside a wide range of optional activities and side content. The title combines narrative-driven progression with exploration, character development, and minigames typical of the series.

The Deluxe Edition includes the base game and the Master Vacation Bundle.

title: Hitman World of Assassination: Part One
description: Step into the shoes of Agent 47 and explore the six iconic locations from HITMAN (2016) in Part One of HITMAN World of Assassination.

title: War Hospital: Supporter Edition
description: Take charge of a WW1 field hospital on the Western Front, and make all the decisions necessary to help the soldiers recover and to support the war effort. This edition includes the X-Ray DLC, the original soundtrack and the exclusive artbook.

title: Beautiful Sakura: Volleyball Club
description: A visual novel focused on mental health and personal identity.

title: SnowRunner: 4-Year Anniversary Edition
description:
The ultimate off-road experience!

Drive over 70 powerful vehicles and overcome extreme open environments. SnowRunner's 4-Year Anniversary Edition includes the base game as well as the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 and Year 4 Passes.

title: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth - Ultimate Edition
description:
Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth is a turn-based role-playing game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. It follows dual protagonists Ichiban Kasuga and Kazuma Kiryu, with the narrative set primarily in Japan and Hawaii. The game uses a party-based combat system that builds on previous Like a Dragon entries, incorporating positioning and environmental interactions. Players engage in main story missions alongside a wide range of optional activities and side content. The title combines narrative-driven progression with exploration, character development, and minigames typical of the series.

The Ultimate Edition is the most comprehensive version, bundling the base game with four major DLC packs: the Master Vacation Bundle, Assorted Outfit Bundle, Sujimon & Resort Bundle, and the Yakuza CD Collection Set.

title: Knights of Braveland: Ultimate Edition
description: Epic adventures & co-op battles in a Braveland universe

title: Connected Hearts: Cost of Beauty - Collector's Edition
description: Brand new story, same old techniques. Have you heard that the evil stepmother is a witch? Oh, sorry, now you know, and she'll want to get rid of you. Be careful!

title: Devil's Deck: Polar Night Falls
description: This content requires the base game Devil's Deck on Steam in order to play.

title: Karos Classic
description: The living legend returns in his original form! The Сlassic version of Karos, untouched by years and updates. Maximum level, sharpening level is limited.

title: Minion Masters: Mountain Song

The Mountain Song DLC is a great +300% value bundle to empower your clan of Stoutheart! You also get a headstart in the Season Pass!

Includes:
- 3x Urclaw, Protector of the Peaks (Legendary card)
- 20x Frostberry Bearer (Supreme card)
- 20x Snap Freeze
- 40x Highland Huntress
- 40x Woodsman
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 3x Season Pass Tiers

title: Capital Fire
description: An action RPG that combines exploration with dynamic combat. Estrela is a young defender of democracy who searches for the Book of the Greater Law to put an end to a terrible threat from patriotic zombies.

title: Industry Giant 4.0
description: Build an industrial empire from scratch in Industry Giant 4.0. Produce goods, build up your industries, construct transportation networks, plan production, manage finances, and navigate global events. Become the next business mogul and write history!

title: Incursion2D
description: A fast paced action RPG where you will fight increasingly difficult waves of enemies, each with unique abilities! You will be fighting various bosses, work on your secondary skills, collect cosmetics for your character and work on your very own island!

title: Soul of Butterflies
description: Soul of Butterflies is a point-and-click adventure game with a unique worldview. Players will take on the role of Anders and explore an extremely enigmatic world. Amidst indescribable struggles and fears, they will gradually piece together the truth of this world.

title: Soul of Butterflies: The Lobby
description: "Soul of Butterflies: Incubation" is a point-and-click adventure game with a unique worldview. Players will take on the role of Anders and explore an extremely enigmatic inn as they unveil the world's hidden reality.

title: Master of Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles - Cat Family Christmas
description: Experience the pure magic of Christmas through the eyes of a lovable family of red fluffy kittens in this enchanting tale of festive joy and heartwarming discovery! 34 picture!

title: Snezhinka: Sentinel Girls 2
description: A high-tempo shooter with simple controls. Enhance your character with cards and defend various targets as an employee of a private military company.

title: Loop Frogs
description: Guide two froggy friends through a pixelated, time-warping adventure. This 2D platformer will require you to master the time loop and leap your way across 30+ levels of hazards and puzzles.

title: Mr. Mueller's Grand Experiment
description: Live as the assistant to one of history's most remarkable figures: George Mueller, a man who witnessed orphans dying young in the streets of 1830's England and decided he would care for them, no matter the cost.

title: The Prisoning: Fletcher's Quest
description: After a visit to the psychologist that went horribly wrong you’re trapped in the mind of a game developer on the brink of physical and emotional burnout during the last stages of an intense project. Experience a metroidvania drenched in anxiety based on a very true story.

title: Junklands
description: Embark on a journey to transform a polluted world shackled by its toxic overlords. Explore the lands, brave the environment, battle polluting foes and clean up a dying world in an epic 3D action-adventure metroidvania.

title: Requiem Reverie
description: Requiem Reverie is an immersive cooperative fantasy RPG that invites players to embark on an epic journey through a rich and expansive world filled with mysteries. The game places a strong emphasis on teamwork and strategic party mechanics, offering a deeply engaging and social gaming experience.

title: Project Moonborn
description: Unleash werewolf fury in an ultra-violent 2D roguelike action platformer while seeking to rescue lost pups and escape interstellar prison.

title: Helix: Descent N Ascent
description: Helix is an adventure game taking place in a melancholic disembodied world. Combine your powers to solve puzzles and explore further and deeper.

title: College Kings 2: Episodes 4 & 5 "Moving Out"
description: Continue the story of College Kings 2, a radically raunchy choice-driven Adult Visual Novel. The SVC administration is furious about the increasingly wild activities of the college fraternities, and the boot comes down hard in Episodes 4 & 5 "Moving Out".

title: My Confounding Cat is Criminally Cute!
description: A cute, wholesome yaoi / boys love visual novel about a grumpy wizard and... a black cat? Wait, what?

title: Edge of Soul: Ragnarok
description: Echo of Soul is a free-to-play Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game with a fast-paced action combat, various character customizations and no subscription fee required. Travel the vast open world, compete in PvP modes, and explore EoS.

title: Resident Evil 4: Gold Edition
description: The Gold Edition includes the main game, the additional story mode Separate Ways, as well as the Extra DLC Pack, and is available February 9, 2024!

title: Healthy Hero: Tower Defense
description: Healthy Hero is a Tower Defense game with roguelike elements, where the player protects a hero from attacking junk food. You need to build and upgrade defensive towers to stop the enemies. The levels become increasingly challenging with new types of junk food and waves

title: The Complex Tragedy
description: The Complex Tragedy is a single-player horror game set in a massive living complex. While exploring different areas, you will feel the fear as you uncover the creepy and deserted side of the complex. Brace yourself for spine-chilling experience within The Complex.

title: Battlefield 1942: The Complete Collection
description: Gear up and head out for the most explosive firefights online. From the opening battles of WWII to the brutal jungle conflicts of Vietnam, this is all-out war like only Battlefield can deliver.

title: Children of the Sun
description: Burning with anger, The girl wages a one-woman war against the cult, taking them down cultist by cultist, bullet by bullet, until she reaches her true target: the leader. Along the way she will unravel the dark truth about this mysterious order and the atrocities committed by them in the name of their master. In this tactical third-person puzzle-shooter you assume control of one bullet, guiding it through increasingly complex and challenging levels to kill cultists, trigger traps, and reshape the environment. Every shot counts and ruthless precision is rewarded. Taking down the cult is deeply satisfying; doing it with style even more so.

title: Akiya
description:
A wholesome game about exploring an abandoned traditional Japanese house with a new friend.

You play as a high school student, and your first summer job is to photograph an Akiya—also known as "empty house"!

Well, it looks like you've arrived... And a cute guy wants to tag along?

title: Highway Drifter: Hajwala Simulator
description: Hajwala isn’t typical drifting, it’s a vibe straight from the Gulf streets. Drift the Arab way, go into high speed and lose control on the highway. It’s all about sliding sideways with style on highways and open roads, showing oﬀ your skills while staying in full control. It’s loud, wild, and a lot of fun. In Highway Drifter: Hajwala Simulator you get to feel all that energy. Whether you’re cruising the desert or speeding through mountain roads, Customize everything during gameplay, your car is all about your style. Pick your favorite shade of color and choose your tint level, switch up the rims, and mix and match front and back bumpers to match your style. You can even customize your license plate to make it totally yours.

title: Arcade Archives: Silk Worm
description:
A soaring threat!
Excitement that runs through the earth!

description: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all

Upgrade your standard taxi or indulge in a sleek new ride, each with unique enhancements. Earn coins to buy additional cars or customize your current one, creating the ultimate cyberpunk taxi fleet.

title: Hentai Girls: Hot Police
description: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Horse Racing
description: Welcome to "Horse Racing," the thrilling game where two players compete to reach 1000 coins first. Place bets on your chosen horses, watch the race unfold, and strategically use your winnings to stay ahead.

description:
The 10th character to join the TFH roster is Nidra the Tapir, a dream-eating stance character with nightmare mix-ups.

A lone Hunter stands against

title: SnowRunner: Year 1 Pass + Year 2 Pass + Year 3 Pass + Year 4 Pass
description: Upgrade your game and get ready for the ultimate off-road experience! SnowRunner’s Year 1 Pass + Year 2 Pass + Year 3 Pass + Year 4 Pass grants you access to 16 seasons of content - including 4 expansions - from the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 and Year 4 Passes.

title: Lingjing
description: Lingjing is a fantasy themed single player game developed based on Unreal Engine 5 with an open world 3D realistic art style. The game is currently under development and only open for testing applications. In the beta version, we only offer some content for players to experience.

title: Circular Defense
description: ”Circular Defense" is a real-time tower defense game in which you intercept enemies by placing circles around them to prevent them from hitting the planet in the center of the screen. Strengthen your turrets and defend your planet from the endless enemies!

title: Chess Twist
description: A game of chess set on a procedurally generated board, where tiles can have 3 or 5 diagonals and straight lines bend around your opponent's defenses. Same rules, different battlefield. Opportunities for new strategies are hidden in plain sight. Will you see them before your opponent does?

title: Chick'n Mushroom Soup
description: Chick’n Mushroom Soup is an anime styled Visual Novel which you've been accepted into a culinary academy with sweet girls. Although you were a total asocial in the past, you now have an opportunity to change this.

title: Chompania
description: A 2D platformer that immerses you into the space adventure of Eddie, stranded on the quirky planet Chompania. It's time to jump, fight, solve, and conquer your way out of this pixelated space jam!

title: Citadelum
description: Citadelum is a city builder set in legendary Ancient Rome. Build your own settlement, gather resources and evolve it into a magnificent city. Explore the world, trade and lead your mighty legions in epic tactical battles. Earn the favor of the Gods or challenge them, if you dare.

title: City Defense Z
description: City Defense Z blends fast-paced survival and base-building in a roguelite experience. Strategically use cards to strengthen defenses and expand your base, then face massive zombie hordes when the night falls. Adapt every run, unlock meta upgrades, and see how long your city can survive.

title: City of Graves
description: As a soldier in a lifeless city after a disease outbreak, fight creatures and hunt for what will save the city.

title: Classic Arcade Fishing
description: A masterpiece of classic arcade fishing shooting game with many expanded ways to play! Picture upgrade, explosion rate upgrade, welfare upgrade, everything upgrade! Super high gun magnification, super many bosses, super high magnification, super explosive, and make you rich in one shot!

title: Cloaked Protocol
description: Dive into Cloaked Protocol: an electrifying retro stealth-action game. Outwit elite mercenaries with strategic stealth in a world of espionage, where every move weaves a gripping narrative.

title: Crystal Breaker
description:
Shoot the enemy at close range! Crystal Breaker is a vertically scrolling shmup that focuses on close range attack.

This game is an aggressive shmup where close range attacks and quick destruction are important for both stage clear and score attacks.

title: Crystal Heroes
description: A Fantasy RPG game using Match 3 for game mechanics instead of Dice.

title: Cubebam
description: Is an exciting 2D physics game where the player has to help grandfather in a barrel break cubes and get to the coin. The goal of the game is to use the available projectiles, which can be obtained by breaking colored cubes.

title: CubeCubeRubik
description: CubeCubeRubik is a casual Rubik's Cube game with a simple and classic gameplay. If you are interested in the Rubik's Cube, want to challenge the limits of your speed or logic, or want your children to learn about the Rubik's Cube, you might as well give it a try.

title: Cube War
description: An action game in which we try to survive by killing enemies in space.

title: Crazy module
description: This is a classic stand-alone casual puzzle game

title: Crazy Candydish
description: Crazy Candydish is a match -3 style puzzle game where colored pieces fall onscreen from 365 degrees and form shapes using 2D Physics. You must make matches and combos to earn bonus points. Earn points to move on through 75 levels.

title: Crazy Animal Choir
description: A casual game where you create music using various animal sounds. You can compose your own music, perform yourself, and manage your own choir.

title: Crayon Computer
description: Crayon Computer is a 2D physics-based open-ended programming puzzle game. (if you call that programming)

title: Crimson wind
description: Stephen, having inherited a sawmill, decides to sell it to fund a documentary about an unpunished murderer from his city. Little did he imagine where this decision would lead.

title: Crop and Claw
description: Crop and Claw is a classic-style JRPG centered around dragons in a lush realm known as the "Garden". The plantlife has gone awry, bringing a time of decline and stress across the realm. Return to the era of simple questing, dungeons, and progression.

title: Cursed Order
description: Indie story-rich RPG game in a world where humor and mystery intertwine.

title: Damn it!
description: Climb to the top with the help of marshmallows.
