title: Yumpr
description: Yumpr has crashed in hostile enviroment! Filled up with dangerous creatures and obstacles. Help him survive this crazy world!

title: Zahak
description: Zahak is a roguelike action RPG set in the captivating world of Persian mythology. Battle relentless waves of enemies and navigate the magical landscapes of Mount Damavand. Unleash the ancient power within your cursed bloodline to challenge the dark legacy of the Serpent King.

title: ZiDouQianWen
description: I am a destiny question and answer game based on Zi Wei Dou Shu, a Chinese astrology system. Come and explore the mysteries of destiny with me!

title: Zero Hero
description: Zero hero is an endless roguelike, each wave of enemies and unique combinations. Collect Waboshi to buy new weapons and upgrades outside the game and get further and further in the challenges with the number of kills and waves. Challenge yourself with new weapons, new powers and challenges!

title: Zomb Bomb
description: A fast pace retro arcade shooter. Fight waves of zombies and dragons with a great gun collection. Battle five wild bosses all while trying to keep the high score.

title: Zombies!!! Board Game
description: Zombies!!! puts you in the middle of the action in this video game adaptation of the hit board game. In order to escape the ever advancing zombie horde, players must use a combination of wits and brawn to be the first to the heliport and certain escape.

title: Wizard War Online
description: Wizard War Online offers a P2P game mode and a game mechanic you are not used to. While flying with the sweeper, you will experience a different flight experience thanks to the customizable maneuver settings. Make strategic moves and pay attention to timing while fighting your enemies.

title: Wizarducks and the Lost Hat
description: Have daily adventures in dungeons and exploring unmapped areas, some far away, some hidden in your own home. Cast spells to fight enemies and to solve puzzles blocking your way. Befriend the villagers, help them decorate the town. Oh, and pet your dog, he likes it.

title: Wizard Realm
description: Wizard Realm is a dynamic game with rogue-like elements set in a fantastic 3D world. It enables players to develop various battle strategies using a multitude of magical skills to survive. It enriched with an advanced item system.

title: W.I.T.S: Initiation
description: A puzzle game where you are the newest recruit to a government agency dedicated to stopping cyber crimes. You must prove yourself and level up in the system by solving puzzles, at the same time there is a mystery to uncover at the agency. Who can you trust?

title: With in the Obscurity
description: A first-person perspective mystery puzzle-solving game where players immerse themselves in the role of characters involved in each episode's abnormal event to uncover the truth. The plan is to release 2 episodes per month, totaling 6 episodes per season.

title: Wizzerd Quest
description: Wizzerd Quest is a bite-sized open-world RPG with full split-screen co-op. Its aesthetic is straight out of the mid 1990's, and it's designed to be a fun little excursion without wasting your time. Play the entire game for free with zero microtransactions or DRM!

title: Wonderway
description: Wonderway is a puzzle game where the direction of gravity can be changed. Get to the goal by moving and manipulating items which interact with gravity.

title: Magic Card: CZ12
description: This is a very casual strategy card game that is very easy and simple. The goal is to win more coins and become the richest man in the world. The original intention of the game is to activate the brain and turn the tide against the wind.

title: Woodsy Whatnots
description: Quest across a mysterious wooded kingdom, full of wacky creatures, and spin-smash your way through even wackier monsters! Meet colourful companions in this Party-Based RPG, and use their abilities to face villainous overlords in the name of adventure.

title: Wiblu
description: Wiblu: The Search for the Fire Tea, is a captivating video game with German mythology, following Wiblu's quest to find the legendary Fire Tea to save her sick grandmother.

title: Wildlife Rescue Simulator
description: Get to the chopper and fly to isolated places to rescue terrified animals from man made disasters. Take photos of your adventures and share it with your loyal supporters to get donations. Upgrade your equipment in order to rescue even more animals.

title: Willy's Wonderland: The Game
description: Willy’s Wonderland: The Game is a 2.5D beat ‘em up game based on the cult film of the same name, in which a group of Animatronics come to life and slaughter people who dare visit Willy’s Wonderland.

title: Winter Night
description: "Winter Night" presents a story inspired by beliefs in Thailand. Players will experience the atmosphere of an ancient, mysterious mansion.presented through 2D PixelArt.

title: West Town Defense
description: Gunslingers and bandits are storming the town! You must stop the crimes and rescue the town! This is a tough mission Sheriff, be careful. A classic, wave based survival game.

title: Where Is George
description: George is a sneaky little cat that loves to hide. Can you find him? In this free to play game you need to find 100 cats in beautiful hand drawn levels. Are you able to find them all?

title: White Cat Town Mystery
description: White Cat Town Mystery is a visual novel/adventure game about an anthropomorphic cat named Lumi. Help him explore atmospheric and magical town, meet old friends again, make hard choices, and go through supernatural challenges. What you choose decides the fate of the town—and Lumi himself!

title: Whispers in the Void
description: The main hero John Eikts wakes up in a mysterious room for supernatural creatures. Anomalies escape, wreaking havoc. Eikts must navigate the chaos while uncovering his dark past. As he approaches freedom, a shocking twist reveals that he is not a victim, but one of them.

title: Whisper Of The Curse
description: "Whisper of the Curse" is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror game where you and your team will perform various rituals and spells to eliminate the curse and fend off cursed entities. At the same time, you'll need to avoid being hunted by these malevolent entities.

title: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
description: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

title: Whispers of Prague: The Executioner's Last Cut
description: Classic first-person point-and-click adventure game set in contemporary Prague. As a programmer and treasure hunter, you embark on a long journey to uncover the secrets of the infamous Executioner. Your task will be complicated by a sect of fanatic cultists and your own unexplained heritage.

title: The Twilight Witch
description: The Twilight Witch is a 2D pixel art RPG where you play as Mael, a young man from the village of New Larton. After your home-town is attacked and ravaged by a mysterious figure, you venture forth to tell of what happened and maybe, just maybe, find a way to stop the hooded aggressor…

title: Never wake up
description: psychological survival horror

title: Echolight
description: Echolight ist ein actionbasiertes Roguelike-Spiel, in welchem du die Welt vor dem Chaos gefährlicher Monster, mit Hilfe der Waffen der Götter des Tages und der Nacht retten musst.

title: Palm Sugar: A Village Story
description: Embark on a pixel RPG journey in 'పల్లెటూరు - PalmSugar.' Battle drug lords, wield unique weapons, and immerse yourself in South Indian culture. Telugu & English localization. Will you save the village?

title: Dwarfs Delight
description: Join the adventure of Dwarfs Delight, an explosive multiplayer game where dwarves battle in a tavern for glory and beer! Face off against your friends in this couch game, where every mug counts. Get ready for laughter and unforgettable moments. Ideal for nights with friends!

title: Panda
description: A 2D momentum based platformer.

title: Shotengai 10
description: Suddenly, I realized that I was in a Japanese shopping district that I was unfamiliar with. An unusual shopping street where even if you proceed blindly, you will end up returning to the entrance. Let's exit from this shopping street by relying on the hints left behind.

title: Shoomer Booter
description: An unexpected find at an antique shop, a soy boy stumbles upon an ancient beard ointment. Each night, he slips into a dream where he embodies a Sumerian warrior, tracing his lineage to Gibil. In this fantastical realm, he courageously confronts demons that lurk within the mystical attics of Irkalla.

title: Plants in Rush
description: Plants in rush is a multiplayer and single player game. Its fun, fast paced, and simple. You have to chose between 4 fruits throw projectiles spawn lasers turrets and more! it has 3 modes deathmatch team deathmatch and soccer!

title: Artificial Life Simulator
description: Artificial Life Simulator is a relaxing and colorful simulation game where you create artificial life forms based on particle interactions. The particles interact with each other through forces, resulting in unique emergent behaviors.

title: Legend of the Nine Colored Deer
description: "Legend of the Nine-Colored Deer" is an adventurous third-person puzzle game filled with Chinese mythology. Seeking the trail of the Nine-Colored Deer, solving puzzles, and unraveling the legend's mysteries. Explore a charming and fantastical world of adventure.

title: Tomorrow's Love Puzzle
description: Play as 'Ming Tian' in a romantic game, where you meet six unique women. From dominant to innocent, mysterious, dignified, cheerful, to clingy, your choices determine Ming Tian's love story. Who will he choose? You decide.

title: Feeling Death
description: A Game Where You're Killed for Becoming a Couple.

title: Trap for the Heir
description: Gwen is an experienced werewolf mercenary. One day, she comes across a simple and very monetary order. But who is her mysterious customer? And will it be so easy to get to destination alive? New friends, old enemies and maybe a meeting with love...

title: Quallet
description: Quallet is a game where you are a criminal in the land of Qualle, but be careful to not get caught by the police of Qualle!

title: Node: The Last Favor of the Antarii
description: NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii is a 2.5D puzzle platformer about a robot navigating a Cold War nuclear complex. Execute timeline-based commands to control NODE. Unravel mysteries, explore the unknown. Your commands decide the outcome.

title: Full-Scale Invasion
description: Full-Scale Invasion is an armchair general RTS that puts the player directly in the battle as they command ground-to-space armies from the bridge of their very own capital ship.

title: Save the Villainess
description: What if you woke up as a villainess in a romance novel where someone wants you dead? Guide your villainess by solving mysteries and making choices that lead you closer to romance, revenge… or death. In this mystery/horror otome isekai game, can you Save the Villainess?

title: Édgimon
description: Catch wild Égdimon, dig, build, craft, and explore an infinite world, in this open-world creature-taming and role-playing game.

title: Mechanophagia
description: Mechanophagia is a challenging bullet hell shooter with roguelite elements, set in a dark and gritty sci-fi world. Blast through waves of fleshy aberrations and defeat monstrous bosses. Can you outmaneuver the relentless enemy onslaught and save the robots from their inevitable extinction?

title: Out Of Mind
description: Out Of Mind merges psychological thriller and puzzle genres, allowing players to confront their fears. Get lost in labyrinthine environments, solve mysterious puzzles, and unveil dark secrets. The game stands out with atmospheric design and a unique storyline.

title: Ukraine War 2022
description: Ukraine War 2022 is a real-time, tactical land and air warfare simulation game focusing on the ongoing war between Ukraine and Russia.

title: Surveillance Simulator
description: Using surveillance equipment to complete a series of tasks, or lighting up a cigarette and gazing at the real-time footage from various cameras on the screen.

title: Mr. Akun's Jump
description: This game is a casual adventure game where players use the mouse to click on Akun to generate a parabola, allowing him to jump from one platform to another. The goal is to guide him to the highest peak to retrieve the lost basketball!

title: The Last Rose
description: Kuri Rose was dead, until she wasn't. Now she stands in defiance to a world that is slowly disappearing in this apocalypse adventure visual novel.

title: Njuma
description: Njuma is a 2D narrative driven pixel game with multiple endings. Be the difference your family needs as they draw their final breath.

title: Kuudere Funk
description: With the city overrun with supernatural beings and occurrences, it is up to two women to restore the city to its former state. In order to accomplish such a task, sexual rituals must be performed by these women at the shrines scattered throughout the city…

title: Tiny Battles
description: Tiny Battles is a tactical action auto-battler where battles take place automatically in the arena.

title: Tale of the Seas
description: It is a classic gem elimination game, a gem exchange elimination game that exercises eyesight.

title: Stack Slayer
description: Stack Slayer is defense builder where you stack cards to harvest material, craft equipment, build structures, and upgrade structures for fighting and protect ancient core from the invade monster.

title: Starters Orders Touch Horse Racing
description: Starters Orders Touch now on desktop from ! A brand new GUI and improved game play and the most advanced simulation engine to date cement Starters Orders as the No.1. horse racing management series. Available here on Steam once out of beta.

title: Rockit!
description: Rockit! is a difficult arcade game about trying to not crash rockets. Duck and weave around progressively challenging obstacles to be crowned the ultimate rocket pilot.

title: Gun Gladiator
description: Brutally defeat your enemies, upgrade your equipment, influence the crowd, master the arena and become the new champion in a gory and fast-paced retro FPS set in a post-apocalyptic world.

title: HamSumo
description: BONK YOUR FRIENDS in this action-packed, roly-poly, multiplayer action game! Choose your favorite hamster to duke it out with your friends in the most adorable (and explosive!) PvP arena! Unleash unique and powerful Star Moves to blast away the competition!

title: F.I.T.
description: Challenge your spatial awareness and reflexes in F.I.T. An addictive puzzle game where you are the master of your own geometric shape, and must skillfully fit into falling blocks of various sizes and shapes to survive and thrive in this captivating arcade style game to achieve the highest score!

title: Dragon of Steelthorne
description: Rule a mighty city, fight battles and go on adventures as the Ardent or Ardessa of the city of Lake Steelthorne. Find love, power, and a secret that could change the world.

title: Prank Heart
description: Phantom Theif vs. Detective slapstick online battle action!!! Enjoy lively and funny PvP with multiple items such as Rocket launcher, Invisibility cloak, Bananas, Soccer ball bomb!

title: Legend Of Apophyxis
description: Embark on an epic journey filled with mystical enemies and powerful allies in this action-packed game. Harness your strength, defeat foes, and rise as the true hero of Myrr

title: The Bit's Escape
description: Bit's is a small machine built in a underground factory, his dream is to escape and discover life beyond what is below the earth.

title: Lexicon
description: Lexicon is a word based puzzle game wrapped inside a strange abandoned computer system. You explore forgotten terminals, sift through corrupted files, and solve linguistic challenges that twist familiar rules into something unsettling. Every puzzle reveals a fragment of a larger story that hides beneath the interface, waiting for you to notice the patterns that are not supposed to be there.

title: Fire and Rescue
description: Fires have broken out all over the city! Use your portable water tank to extinguish raging fires and carry innocent civilians to safety. Play by yourself or simultaneously with a friend to see who is the best fire-fighter in FIRE AND RESCUE!

title: Commandos Pro Simulator
description: Superfast action-packed shooter to play in single mode or multiplayer with your friends! Play from first person view or switch to third view at anytime during this hardcore game. Select to play for special commandos forces or for bad terrorists criminals. No time - start shooting left and right!

title: Pigeon's Mission
description: Enjoy a whimsical pixel-art adventure crafted from a 6-year-old's art & vision. Navigate Pepper Pines as Archie, a pigeon with clever attacks & CRAZY power-ups, on a dangerous quest to save his parents. Experience a blend of nostalgia & fresh, fun gameplay in a world ruled by imagination & wonder.

title: The house of the missing hands
description: A first person flat/VR survival horror game where you have to escape the dark farm where you are being kept against your will after finding out the package you were delivering contained a human hand. Use stealth to avoid The hand collector while unraveling the reason he collects hands.

title: Pay Me In Colors
description: Pay Me In Colors is a 2D platformer game with multiple mechanics, six different worlds and over 40 challenging levels. Face meteors, gravity changing, spikes falling and missiles coming in your direction while you try to recover the colors back to your world. A game inspired by the classics of the past.

title: Easy puzzle: Streets
description: Is a logic game in which the goal of the game is to rearrange the tiles to get the final picture

title: Hyperspace Deck Command
description: Hyperspace Deck Command is a sci-fi card-battler roguelite. Deploy spaceships that operate on individual turn timers, combine a wide variety of cards into powerful decks and use dual-use status effects to defeat the hegemonising swarm intelligence.

title: The Return of the King
description: This game tests hands-on ability and brain thinking.

title: Forge Front
description: Defend magical orbs from goblin invaders in 'Forge Front.' Build and upgrade structures strategically across diverse landscapes in this FPS tower defense adventure!

title: Dino Dino
description: Playfully extend your knowledge about dinosaurs in a collection of mini games. Created in cooperation with the German Paleontological Society, featuring voice recordings and hand-drawn illustrations, Dino Dino sets out to awaken your kids's interest in complex topics while being a lot of fun.

title: Red Snow
description: Experience the ultimate fusion of snowboarding and combat in RED SNOW! Navigate perilous slopes, battle enemy forces, and execute stunning tricks to earn cash in this epic board-n-sword adventure.

title: Node Farm
description: Node Farm is a game about building a fully automated farm using nodes. Connect nodes, harvest and sell veggies, buy new islands, discover new nodes, and automate the process - all in a cozy farm simulation formula!

title: Realms of Arcana
description: Realms of Arcana is an engaging RPG set in a mysterious world shaped by the legacy of a fallen empire, featuring deep exploration, crafting, strategic combat with melee, magic, stealth, and a storyline where every choice impacts the game's rich narrative.

title: BoboInvasion
description: BoboInvasion is a classic spaceshooter game. Face waves of aliens with increasing difficulty, dodge their attacks, and choose a ship upgrade that suits your style to win

title: Deep Scanner
description: Due to your debts, you have been sent to the BAORA9 production facility. A quiet place, if it weren't for the raids by local creatures. Will you be able to complete your work and leave BAORA9 safe and sound?

title: Mushroom Moonrise
description: Mushroom Moonrise, it's a delightful blend of strategy, art, and serenity. Inspired by the theme 'It's Spreading!', it transforms the subtle art of mushroom growth into an enthralling strategic conquest.

title: Scape
description: Scape is a growing platform of multiplayer games. It begins with Gravity: a vertical platformer where you climb alongside up to 100 players in the same broken world at once, with no checkpoints or health bars, just physics and consequence. Reaching the top is not the end.

title: Traveler's Refrain
description: Wield your magical instrument and defy the mecha-goddesses of fate in this Song-Casting Story Driven Action-RPG. Explore a forbidden forest as Traveler, and help him reunite with his long lost love as you fight through abominations and solve mysterious puzzles, all while an ancient conflict unfolds.

title: Iron Line
description: Iron Line is a tower defense game where you are one of a few, train conductors capable of traversing on the Iron Line. Will you survive the onslaught, or get an express ticket to the afterlife?

title: Warfare Legacy Collection
description: Warfare 1917 and Warfare 1944, updated for modern hardware, join forces in Warfare Legacy Collection. Experience the intense tug-of-war of WW1 and WW2 and engage in strategic battles that defined an era. Command waves of troops, unleash tactical prowess, and even customize your own battlefields!

title: Plague Doctor
description: Plague Doctor is a Gritty, Dark and Gory replication of the Medieval Black Plague. You play as a somewhat anti-villain, a plague doctor. Immerse yourself like never before in an open world Medieval Kingdom - Riddled with the plague.

title: Legends of the Round Table
description: Lead the Knights of the Round Table through King Arthur's legend in a unique RPG, full of honor, magic and romance. Plunge into a colorful world inspired by medieval art, tales and music. Undertake perilous quests and fiercely defend your kingdom to make the flower of chivalry blossom again.

title: Cura
description: This game is a 3D puzzle game where you control the box-shaped character ``CURA'' to conquer stages and reach the goal.

title: TDS
description: TDS - Tower ▪ Defense ▪ Strategy. Control Vessels. Utilize their uniquely deep, yet simple set of towers. Create an everchanging defense. Protect your Basin at all costs. A Tower Defense, Real-Time Strategy Hybrid

title: Slime, Fire and Soul
description: You enter the DUNGEON and try to get as far as possible.

title: Dudelings: Arcade Sportsball
description: Dudelings: Arcade Sportsball is a fast-paced sportslike. A cross between Pong and Foosball, this title brings high-energy local mutiplayer fun to the table!

title: Gravity Pro
description: In this arcade game, use your paddle to strike the ball and shatter bricks. Gravity and physics are both your allies and challenges. Master skill and precision to navigate dynamic levels and get high scores. Every hit, every angle, and every rebound plays a crucial role in determining your success.

title: The August Before
description: The August Before is a meditative narrative 3D puzzle about cleaning up, sorting out and packing up your life before moving on. Clean up and don’t forget your old belongings on your way to the new life!

title: Voidsayer
description: The world has fallen into darkness, cursed by the Abyss. You are one of the many hapless survivors at risk of being consumed. Unlike others, you have a chance to fight back. Voidsayer is a dark monster tamer jRPG. Assemble your monster team, take on eldritch horrors, and return hope to the world.

title: Superstore Simulator
description: Develop your store, order goods, and sell, sell, sell. Hire employees and take care of customers. Enjoy a rather humorous approach to trading and running a store where you can look forward to hours upon hours of great entertainment.

title: Octameta
description: A 3D-styled puzzle-solving burning brain indie game, using the Pocket Cube to restore objects. A story about AI's journey to recreate the history of human science

title: Time Machine Bronzeville
description: A storytelling game that explores the stories, cityscape, and legend and lore of Chicago's South Side ca. 1940. Encounter both heroes and scoundrels in 3D interactive scenes that transport the visitor into detailed recreations of this vanished community as it was between the World Wars.

title: The Quantum Conflict
description: Jump into action-packed space dogfights with up to 8 players (or AI's) locally or over Remote-Play-Together. Use outlandish sci-fi weapons, including the wormhole maker and time altering munitions while avoiding asteroids, wormholes, planet gravity, and other hazards.

title: CapitalismCraft
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of capitalism! Exploit your workers to earn money! Hire managers to crush their spirits and drive them harder, then fire them once you’ve achieved your ends! Be agile, ruthless, merciless, become the richest CEO in the world, winning in rapid clicker management!

title: Shlemo
description: Action-packed stories of 3 different guys who kill people to get to a briefcase with supposed wealth. The question is which of them will get it, will it solve their problems, which of them will die and what is in the briefcase?

title: Gun vs. Zombies
description: Gun vs. Zombies is a thrilling showdown where precision meets undead mayhem. Take control of a dynamic gun affected by physics as you fend off waves of zombies hungry for a brain feast. Compete against others on the global leaderboard by showcasing your shooting skills.

title: Moyu world
description: This is an exciting game with very simple rules and high degrees of freedom.

title: Eye of death
description: This is a parkour game.

title: Greedshot
description: Greedshot is a first-person rogue-lite shooter with procedurally generated locations. Play alone or with friends in co-op mode, facing merciless enemies and environments

title: Strange Hunting Grounds
description: A casual hack and slash game that conquers hell by creating a powerful expedition through a variety of skill & weapon combinations

title: FawnRun
description: The only level 2D casual mini-game there is please keep moving.

title: Mysterious prophecy
description: This is a parkour game that is not just about running, but about climbing, jumping, and crossing all obstacles, constantly running forward.

title: Enci's Solution
description: “Enci’s Solution” tells the story of Ji’we who leaves his home behind to go on a journey to the surface of planet Regalia. Living underground his whole life- with the help of Enci and other characters he meets on his way, Ji’we uncovers challenges in a world governed by an AI.

title: Poroto
description: Poroto is a chaotic arcade adventure - blast red pegs in action-packed platforming! Jump and run across vibrant levels, strategically bouncing and shooting to eliminate all the red chaos. Pinball-style mechanics, bite-sized levels, and a pumping soundtrack make this an unforgettable experience.

title: Don't Be Afraid 2
description: Descend deep into the nightmare that seamlessly blends with reality in this uncanny horror escape room game. Can you find your way out of the horrid mansion or will you succumb to your fears? Can you face and overcome your past, or will it break you?

title: Golf with Guns
description: Mini golf with a twist... GUNS! Shoot your own golf ball to move it closer to the hole or shoot an opponent's ball to mess them up. Compete with friends and/or randoms to shoot the lowest score. Enjoy playing your own custom maps or ones made by the community on the Workshop.

title: Rock Tetrus
description: Place the rocks, make a solid line, make the line crumble and fall! There are an infinite amount of strategies! Made by 1 person, inspired by a fake mobile game ad. Enjoy!

title: Welcome to Ukraine
description: A puzzle game through which you will discover Ukraine.

title: Timber
description: Build and manage your industrial empire unlike ever before. Dive into Timber: where strategic resource management meets city-building excitement.

title: Monsters & Mortals: House of Ashes
description: House of Ashes is a new Chapter for Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals.

title: Resistance: Retribution
description: Fueled by vengeance, former British Marine James Grayson intends to destroy the Chimeran conversion centers at any cost. Enlisted by the European resistance, The Maquis, he soon learns the Chimera have evolved a new method of converting humans. Set after events in Resistance: Fall of Man, the war for Europe continues….

title: The Incredible Shrinking Character
description: An cancelled action-adventure game that was developed by Go-Go Interactive Studios and Cyberdreams studios, taking inspiration the novel/film The Incredible Shrinking Man, and is set in a universe reminiscent of 1950's science-fiction and horror movies. The player would have controlled a private investigator looking for a wealthy young woman named Julia Caldwell, who vanished after visiting the castle of a mad scientist named Dr. Warren Franklin, who would use a shrinking ray on the hero. The gameplay would have had the hero venturing through Dr. Franklin's castle, fighting dangers such as animals and heights along the way, of which grow smaller and smaller after each level.

title: Our Fantastic Wonderland
description: A fantasy-adventure visual novel following the adventures of Ignatius the mild-mannered cleric as he tries to return the Jewel of Happiness to the Sacred Altar and restore happiness to the world. Along the way, he recruits a team of allies to his cause, from a foul-mouthed knight, to an imp assassin, to a stubborn prince, and an axe-happy berserker.

title: NarcotizeDR
description:
A short game made in RPGmaker MV, minus the RPG elements. Pronounced as Narcotized.

Investigate Octia’s home and help her complete the goal she’s had tunnel vision over for the last month– Reviving her girlfriend! “I can't seriously be blamed for this...”

Use any means to save her. Cleaning supplies, demonic rituals, unethical medical practices that lead to terrible consequences? No problem! “Don’t worry, it’ll be okay in the end.”

Just make sure to keep her sanity in line. Even the smallest of things will cause more stress to her, and it won't look good if it gets too high. "I can't be left behind..."

Octia has one goal, so help her no matter what. "This time it'll work for sure..."

title: Was/Were
description: Murdering a person that hurt you is hot, right?

title: A 2nd X Thing Episode 2: Digital Groove
description: The sequel to A 2nd X Thing Episode 1: Analog Funk. Demo, Iris, Raocow, Kood, and Sheath are tasked with repairing the universe they broke, and with the power of "jumping real good", travel across time to recover Super Leeks.

title: Ender Magnolia: Bloom in the Mist
description:
Decades after the Rain of Death, a new journey begins in the Land of Fumes, where mystical powers lie beneath the earth. The kingdom’s desire for conquest led to the creation of the Homunculi, machine-like artificial life forms prepared to execute the king’s will. A recent resource-harvesting mission gone awry caused toxic vapors to emerge from underground, driving both man and machine to feral madness.

As the Homonculi devolve into dangerous creatures, guide Lilac –- an “Attuner” with the power to purify those infected by the fumes — on a quest to save the kingdom. With the help of friendly machines and spirits who fight in Lilac’s stead, fend off mechanized legions of lunging carcasses, cannonball-firing corpses and chainsaw-wielding goblins terrorizing the land.

Turn foes into friends by exorcizing corruption from enemy bosses. Wield their powers to add 30 different abilities to Lilac’s combat repertoire in an enhanced battle system where she can equip up to four special abilities at once. Improve Lilac’s odds of surviving this hunt for lost memories by leveling up attack strength, HP, and armor.

Explore the depths, heights and far corners of the kingdom for lore-filled relics. Collect and trade gold for upgraded items at the Blacksmith’s storefront. Combine story fragments from the kingdom’s fleeing inhabitants with Lilac’s forgotten memories. Seek the truth in an atmospheric hand-drawn setting set to the soothing serenades of returning musical group Mili (Ghost in the Shell, Goblin Slayer) with a brand new original soundtrack available for purchase at launch.

title: Arranger: A Role-Puzzling Adventure
description: Find your way in a world of breezy, thoughtful puzzles, along a charming journey of self-discovery.

title: Monster Hunter Stories
description: The first installment of the Monster Hunter Stories series is back and coming to Nintendo Switch, PC, and PlayStation 4! Become a Monster Rider and hatch, raise, and battle with your favorite Monsties in this epic RPG adventure.

title: Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
description: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance
description: Embark on this definitive version of the critically acclaimed Shin Megami Tensei V, massively expanded with a brand-new storyline featuring new locations, demons, and choices to make that will dictate the fate of all existence.

title: Star Wars: Battlefront Classic Collection
description:
Fight in iconic battles from across the STAR WARS galaxy!

Play the classic STAR WARS Battlefront games on modern consoles, online and offline in this complete classic collection.

This Classic Collection includes:
STAR WARS Battlefront (Classic)
-Includes Bonus Map: Jabba's Palace
STAR WARS Battlefront II
-Includes Bonus Maps: Bespin: Cloud City, Rhen Var: Harbor, Rhen Var: Citadel, and Yavin 4: Arena
-Includes Bonus Heroes: Asajj Ventress & Kit Fisto

Key Features
Traverse the Galaxy in Campaign Mode & Galactic Conquest
Galactic Conquest: Devise your strategy, recruit your troops, and execute your tactical vision for conquering the galaxy.

description: Dont just survive a zombie apocalypse, thrive in it! Blast hordes of Zeds as you gain experience and cash to buy better gear and see how long you can survive in a fun, low-poly setting.

title: The Witch Veils: The Mansion
description: When two witches and an apprentice are kidnapped in a mansion, only Star, the apprentice, can save them and uncover what is happening.

title: The WereCleaner
description: Kyle is a Janitor. He's also a Werewolf. And now he's got the night shift. Fight for your life - and your paycheck - in a stealth-comedy game with surprises around every corner.

title: The Warehouse
description: A simple horror collection game set in a warehouse outside of space and time

title: The Wandering Demon Blade
description: An quick paced action story game drowned out by silence. Cut through with the demon blade all the while surrounded by the quiet of the world. Experience the short story following death.

title: American Truck Simulator: International LoneStar
description: This is a free update for American Truck Simulator that adds the LoneStar truck by International.

title: American Truck Simulator: Mack Anthem
description: It's time to discover an American legend. As one of the most significant new trucks in Mack’s 117-year history, the Anthem combines the latest innovations with more than a century's experience in truck-building.

title: American Truck Simulator: Volvo VNL
description: Reliability, performance, and absolute driver satisfaction. This is why the Volvo VNL is an embodiment of excellence in the trucking world, and we are excited to let you know that brand new models have arrived in American Truck Simulator as a free update!

title: American Truck Simulator: Western Star 49X
description:
Debuting as Western Star’s latest model, the Western Star 49X brings together the latest in safety, technology, and driver comfort, as well as the brand's legendary build quality. Built to thrive in the most rugged of environments, on a heritage of toughness, the Western Star 49X will easily take on any challenge it comes across. See and drive this new legend first in American Truck Simulator!

The Western Star 49X for American Truck Simulator is now available with a huge number of chassis options, in both Set-Forward and Set-Back variants including 8x4 and 8x6 for heavy haul applications. The 49X also offers a choice of 12 engine and 7 transmission options (including the Detroit DD13/15/16 and DT12 transmissions), 3 cabin/sleeper sizes, and a large variety of customization options.

title: Dinostria
description: Dinostria is a currently lost old Scott Cawthon Game also released in around 2003. From the few screenshots available, the game appears to be some sort of overheard dungeon crawler where you play as some sort of gold and silver knight.

title: Phantom Core 2
description:
Phantom Core 2 is a lost game made by Scott Cawthon sometime in 2003.

The only information about this game existing is an archive link that shows Phantom Core 2 next to the original Phantom Core. The game was labeled as beta, and it is unknown if a full game was ever made or released.

title: War
description:
WAR, Grow's famous strategy game, now has 2 boards for you to play in electrifying battles!

Classic Game: Feel like a real general. Aim for your goal and carefully define your strategy. Attack at the right time, protect your borders and defend your territories. Dominate entire continents, invade and conquer opposing territories. But make sure you evaluate your moves carefully because, just like in great wars, poorly planned attacks can bring down great powers while the right strategy can turn small armies into great empires!

Roman Empire Game: With internal conflicts and barbarian invasions on the increase, the time has come for the CAESARS, the Roman Emperors, to rise. Be a true strategist in command of entire Roman legions and conquer the greatest empire the world has ever seen.

Gather your friends and play the digital version of this classic game. The app makes the game much faster and more dynamic, making the matches last much less time than in the board version.

title: Ships of Chaos
description: Ships of Chaos is a lost old Scott Cawthon game made in 2003. It seems to be quite similar to Gunball and Stellar Gun, all being space shooters, except instead of it being a top-down shooter it seems to be left-right.

title: Elemage
description: Elemage is another lost old Scott Cawthon game that was made on February 10, 2003. The game actually has quite a few old screenshots available and from them, the game shows to be an RPG revolving around a blue-cloaked wizard fighting beasts in a medieval land.

title: Flannville
description: Flannville is one of scott cawthon's many lost games. It was released in 2004 and is a action type of game.

title: Flannville 2
description: This game is a spin-off of the Legacy of Flan game series and sequel of Flanville.

title: Metroid: Ripped Worlds
description: Metroid: Ripped Worlds is a fangame created by Scott Cawthon on August 28, 2005.

title: The Misadventures of Sigfreid the Dark Elf on Tuesday Night
description: The Misadventures of Sigfreid the Dark Elf on Tuesday Night is an action game created by Scott Cawthon in 2006.

title: Light from Above
description: Light from Above is a canceled Christian MMORPG made by Scott Cawthon in 2006.

title: Weird Colony
description:
Weird Colony is an online multiplayer game which players will choose a race, then build a city, join a community, and wage a long term war against players of opposing races.

There are three races to choose from: Robot, Flan, and Scarecrow. Robots are the technological race (of course). Flans are the magical race, and Scarecrows are the dark race. Each race has their own unique structures and attacks. Robots specialize in combat against other players and against monsters. Flans specialize in monster growing and are strong against enemy bases. Scarecrows specialize in base defenses, such as powerful turrets and traps.

title: Doomsday Picnic RPG
description: It's seems that your old childhood friend Josh has been holding a grudge against you for quite some time now. It has something to do with the fact that you pummeled him in video games as a child! Well now he's back for revenge! After crashing your picnic with some of your closest friends, not only has he created evil clones of them and you but he's always designed several twisted worlds designed after classic and torturous video games!

title: F1 24: Champion Edition
description: Join the grid and Be One of the 20. Drive like the Greatest in EA SPORTS F1 24, the official video game of the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship

title: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree - Collector's Edition
description: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree - Collector's Edition includes the Elden Ring - Shadow of the Erdtree expansion code, a 46cm statue of "Messmer the Impaler", one of the key boss characters in Shadow of the Erdtree, an art book, and a download voucher for the original soundtrack.

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends - 2024 Monster Energy Supercross Edition
description:
MX vs ATV Legends - 2024 Monster Energy Supercross Edition:
Compete like the pros on 16 official tracks from the 2024 Monster Energy Supercross Championship! All tracks are launching before the real world events.

title: Super Monkey Ball: Banana Rumble - Launch Edition
Dragon's Dogma II: Deluxe Edition
description: Dragon's Dogma 2 is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges the players to choose their own experience - from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more - in a truly immersive fantasy world.

title: Mighty Action Heroes
description: Mighty Action Heroes is a real-time multiplayer Battle Royale with an emphasis on fun, skill, and chaos! Collect weapons of varying strengths and duke it out in a cityscape inspired by classic action movie classics from the silver screen and beyond! Outmaneuver your opponents to be the last one standing in this fast and frantic isometric shooter.

title: Mountain King Return
description:
"It is tell than deep inside the Mountain lies the Golden Crown of a long forgotten king. No one knows the glory that awaits to the one who achieve to retrieve the crown to the peak of the Mountain.

But beware, the Mountain won't let anyone bring its darkest secrets to light."

Mountain King Return is a non-official sequel to the 1983 game by E.F.Dreyer, Mountain King released by CBS Electronics.

title: MediEvil: Resurrection
description:
A port of MediEvil: Resurrection, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

MediEvil: Resurrection is a 2005 action-adventure game for the PlayStation Portable and is the third installment in the MediEvil video-game series. It is a reimagining of the first installment in the series, MediEvil, with many alterations to the original structure and content, such as the addition of the "Anubis Stone" sub-plot which never appeared in the original. Many things such as level design and characters were changed drastically, and some levels from the original were removed altogether. New levels and characters were introduced, the cutscenes are completely original, and the game was given a much more comical, cartoon-like style as opposed to the Gothic horror-comedy of the original. The soundtrack is completely orchestrated, and half of the themes from the original were removed while new themes were created to fit with the new levels. Unlike the original, there is no alternate ending; Dan still goes to the Hall of Heroes regardless of whether he collects all of the chalices. The game also features a variety of voice talent, including Tom Baker as the narrator and the Grim Reaper.

title: Atta: Spot the Oddities in the Strange Hotel
description: Welcome to Room 1028 of the Despair Hotel! An attraction where you search for mistakes in the supernatural space Even if you suffer injuries so severe that they might kill you, it's okay You'll wake up in Room 1028 as if nothing happened Please enjoy to your heart's content until you're satisfied

title: Feathered Escape
description: Soar to freedom in Feathered Escape, a platformer where you, as a trapped bird, navigate challenging environments, overcoming obstacles and adversaries to reclaim the open skies.

title: Bureau of Contacts
description: Bureau of Contacts is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players where you confront insidious ghosts and the paranormal controlled by advanced generative AI technologies.

title: Genshin Impact: Blades Weaving Betwixt Brocade
description:
Version 4.5 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New character: Chiori
• New banner type: Chronicled Wish
• New character quest for Chiori
• New hangout event for Lynette
• New main event: Alchemical Ascension
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: Moon Buggy
description:
Moon-buggy is a simple character graphics game where you drive some kind of car across the moon's surface. Unfortunately there are dangerous craters there. Fortunately your car can jump over them!

The game has some resemblance of the classic arcade game moon-patrol which was released in 1982. A clone of this game was released for the Commodore C64 in 1983. This ASCII art version of moon-buggy was written many years later by Jochen Voss.

title: The Powermon Adventure!
description: The Powermon Adventure! is a Pokémon fangame made by Scott Cawthon.

title: Slumberfish!: Catching Z's
description: In Slumberfish: Catching Z's, your objective is to get the red beach ball to its goal by clicking the sea life around it. Orange and green fish can knock the ball back and forth, starfish throw the ball in different directions, ocean currents will carry the ball from one place to another, and eels and pufferfish can bounce it while granting access to new areas! Collect golden Z's while you navigate levels, as they can be used to purchase shortcuts and items!

title: Snap-A-Game: Classic RPG
description: Make your own game! With Snap-A-Game RPG, you can snap together your own classic RPG within minutes! Put together your own enemies and NPC's using over 60 body parts and over 1,000,000 possible character combinations! Build your own customized weapons and weapon shops; draw your own overworld maps using tiles for grass, snow, sand, stone and lava; and interlink as many overworld maps as you want for almost unlimited game play possibilities! NOTE: This program is for entertainment purposes only and is not for professional game development. These games cannot be sold and contain copyrighted material.

title: 8-Bit RPG Creator: Zombies Attack!
description:
Put together your own enemies and NPC's using 90 body parts and over 10,000,000 possible character combinations! Build your own customized weapons and weapon shops; draw your own overworld maps using tiles for grass, snow, sand, stone and lava; and interlink as many overworld maps as you want for almost unlimited gameplay possibilities!

This Zombies Attack edition includes an additional 60 body parts plus the original 90!!! These 60 parts are of the undead variety (mostly)! In addition to the new parts, there are new tiles for the overworlds (INNs, shops, zombie medics), as well as animated tiles for water and snow! This pack also includes four new heroes- A baby, a smiley, a zombie, and a mage! You also get four new songs for customizing your game!

title: 8-Bit RPG Creator: Cuddly Creatures
description:
Put together your own enemies and NPC's using 90 body parts and over 10,000,000 possible character combinations! Build your own customized weapons and weapon shops; draw your own overworld maps using tiles for grass, snow, sand, stone and lava; and interlink as many overworld maps as you want for almost unlimited gameplay possibilities!

This Cuddly Creatures edition includes an additional 60 body parts plus the original 90!!! These 60 parts are of the cute and cuddly variety (mostly)! In addition to the new parts, there are new tiles for the overworlds (INNs, shops, medkits, ice cream), as well as animated tiles for water and snow! This pack also includes four new heroes- A baby, a smiley, a zombie, and a mage! You also get four new songs for customizing your game!

title: Squeen's Adventure: Definitive Edition
description:
A complete remake of the best game ever made! (don't look that up)

After Squeen's beloved spaceship suffers an oil leak, his ship loses control and crash lands onto the planet of Earth. Now while that wouldn't be so bad on its own, Squeen also realizes that his phone's battery is dangerously low! Help Squeen in finding parts all around the globe to repair his ship so he can get back to his home planet and charge his phone!

Remade from the ground up in the same engine that brought Squeen's Adventure 2 & 3 to life, Squeen's Adventure: Definitive Edition is a complete remake of the original Squeen's Adventure. Featuring brand new original assets, brand new sound effects, complete level remakes and reworks, a full achievement system, an original soundtrack, and a whole bunch more, this is the absolute definitive way to play a Jupitr Entertainment classic!

title: Grombcross
description: A picross game for the Dallas Society of Play! Each of the standard puzzles is a different piece of DSOP lore. There are also a variety of bonus puzzles included that are completely random.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Laugh Floor
description: The 9th free update for Dreamlight Valley brings the Monsters, inc Realm, Mike Wazowski and Sulley as Villagers, the Lovely Monsters Star Path, an expansion to Scrooge's Shop and new items on the Premium Shop.

title: The Devil's Route
description:
Its late at night and you are driving a bus.
What could possibly go wrong...

This game features a total of 6 endings.
Collecting all endings can take between 30 and 45 minutes

title: Trivia Beta64 Party
description: A Modification of Jackbox Games' Trivia Murder Party 2 - Inspired by the lore and community of Beta64, featuring overhauled voiceovers, music, trivia, and graphics.

title: Ratchet & Clank: Premature Release
description: A vertical slice of an unofficial and unfinished PS2 era-styled Ratchet and Clank fangame that will likely never reach completion.

title: MacGolf
description: A golf sport simulator on the classic Macintosh.

title: Egg RTX
description: Experience one of the games of all time like never before with Egg RTX. Fully remastered for next gen performance, Egg RTX includes raytracing and advanced shadows, never before seen in a game about eggs!

title: Erdluitl: Legends of Below
description: Erdluitl - Legends of Below is a 2D RTS inspired by Dungeon Keeper and old school titles from childhood. Dig and build dungeons, attract new creatures, manage population, train warriors and wizards, discover spells and assault your enemy !

title: Jimmy's Fruity Adventure
description: Mom is out shopping and Jimmy is about to lose his shit.

title: Arcanum Fortuna
description: Arcanum Fortuna is a tarot-inspired roguelike deckbuilder set in a mystical world of wonders. Explore various enchanting regions, meet a compelling cast of characters and keep an eye on your fate during card battles with a unique karma mechanic.

title: Octopus Goulash
description: Explore a futuristic metropolis, interact with a population of NPCs, and experience a unique narrative. Engage in dynamic missions, battle between flying cars, and shape your story in this interactive world where every choice is an opportunity, every moment an unparalleled adventure!

title: Conquering Ciros
description: Conquering Ciros is an action rogue like with a dash of strategy. You play as Nilvor, a reborn lich learning about what happened to his kingdom and his place in this new world. Fight off hordes of enemies while unlocking new crystals, synergies, and upgrades. Regain what is rightfully yours.

title: AC Sailing
description: Experience high-tech sailing with AC Sailing. Foil and maneuver the latest generation yachts in fast-paced online multiplayer races against top sailors worldwide. Master your skills for victory in this thrilling game.

title: Lost in Translation: Silly
description:
Lacking memories and a purpose you take control of a recently awakened Resident inside Traumathos, the hereafter world. Your goal: fight your inner demons and face your past. Investigate the Sorrow's Polis, find your way through The Shyness Forest, and mostly important: unveil a mysterious language known as Murmure. Remember, you will die, true redemption requires sacrifice.

Lost in Translation: Silly is an investigation game with turn-based combat and bullet hell elements. Despite being an RPG at its core, the game has different mechanics depending on which plane of existence is being explored.

title: G-Mode Archives 13: Rinji Shuuden
description:
The third entry in the Senbazuru series. A strange event that attacks a passenger on a mysterious train...

"No... I remember seeing the last train running leaving me behind.

After that... That's right... The next train of the last train came into the platform. On the destination panel ... it said "Temporary last train."

A few passengers boarded the last train on a certain line at midnight. The scenery wrapped in darkness. A strange unmanned station. Hydrangea flowers that emerge on the night after the rain in early summer.

The mysterious atmosphere and the fear of not being able to reach the original world are there...

The third game of the Senbazuru series. Can you get through this fear...!?

title: Anime Girls: Sun of a Beach
description: Brave beach girls battle crab-like monsters! Choose your anime girl, arm up, and defend the shores by shooting down crabs in epic battles against the deep sea!

title: Divine Journey 2: The Five Books of Moses
description: Embark on an immersive journey through the foundational stories of the Bible in "The Five Books of Moses," the captivating sequel to Divine Journey: The Life of Jesus. Explore the epic tales of these ancient texts, encountering miracles, laws, and the divine guidance that shaped a nation.

title: My Adventure Book
description: Join the amazing adventure! Explore a magical world, solve puzzles, find objects and help local creatures. You will complete this game in 5 minutes!

title: The book by the blue
description: in this First-person horror game you will be discovering what's going on with missing persons and a corrupt scientist. Find items littered around to access locked doors and secret passages.

title: The Book of Good
description: Play as Yvonne in this first-person, single life horror adventure. There are no second chances. Complete the tasks her mother started and be careful--stay alive! Find the Book of Good and what it means. Get out of the house as soon as possible!

title: 1000 Cuts: Jomaku
description: A samurai-inspired pixel-art side-scroller with simple-yet-satisfying combat, deeply consequential choices, and lore-rich storytelling. Hack and slash your way through the infamous Army of One-Thousand and reclaim your rightful place as daimyo, one cut at a time.

title: 100 Aliens Cats
description: 100 Aliens Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Aliens themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of aliens places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 Istanbul Cats
description: 100 Istanbul Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Turkiye themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Istanbul places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 March Cats
description: 100 March Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Lovely themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of romantic 8 march places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 Dino Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 Dino Cats. Get an extra level with 100 more adorable cats!

title: 100 Robo Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 Robo Cats. Get an extra level with 100 more adorable cats!

title: 100 Pirate Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 Pirate Cats.

title: 100 Ninja Cats: Extra Content
description: An extra level with 100 more adorable cats!

title: 3D Puzzle: Old House
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house

title: 3-byou Banana
description: This is Banana!

title: Abyssal Reflections
description: Abyssal Reflections is short Atmospheric depressing "non-jumpscare" game where you go through a total of 8 different time periods. You'll have to take care of your owners and how you relate to them is up to you.

title: Abyss Seeker
description: Recipient of the RPG Maker FES Official Event Grand Prize. This RPG involves character growth and quest progression as you seek treasures hidden in the 'Grand Labyrinth,' aiming to reach the deepest part of the dungeon.

title: Abyss Signal: Expedition
description: Since ancient times, there have been legends about an underwater civilization hidden from the eyes of people in the abyss of the Ocean. The stories would have remained legends until a strange artifact fell into the fishermen’s net, indicating that we are not the only intelligent beings.

title: 8AM
description: "8AM" is a suspense game where you find yourself trapped in a room, watching a family through cameras. Without explanations, you must decide if strange events occur night after night. Being correct extends the time, seeking your release by 8:00 a.m.

title: 9 Kings
description: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

title: Absolute Insanity
description: Armed with a diverse arsenal of weapons battle through ever-changing mazes and confront eerie, evolving enemies in a pulse-pounding survival horror action-packed experience.

title: Action Fubuki
description: Action Fubuki is a beat'em'up with a fast paced gameplay. You are Fubuki Goro, a kunoichi which use both martial techniques and special techniques to fight. The game is accessible to all as it require only a keyboard and a mouse.

title: Aeris
description: Complete challenges or fly freely all around the world!

title: Afterworld
description: Lead a tribe of survivors, rediscover ancient technology, manage wasteland settlements and wage wars of conquest and political struggle in Afterworld, an original post-apocalyptic survival grand strategy game from Paradox Development Studio, the creators of Crusader Kings III and Hearts of Iron IV.

title: AkeriaTD
description: Classic tower defense game where you upgrade your towers. Get proficient in fighting specific mobs and make your heroes stronger.

title: Alchemy of the Earth
description: Explore the dreamscape of an alchemist. Uncover his attempts to use alchemy to bring back the dead. Survive in a doomed world, where the alchemist's failed experiments linger behind, guarding his abandoned secrets.

title: Alian
description: This is a normal shooting game. There is nothing extra in it.

title: Alex Hill: Whispers at White Oak Inn
description: Ever since a young woman died near the White Oak Inn, strange things have been happening. Now, her spirit roams the inn, and an employee is receiving strange letters. What dark secrets wait to be found? The clock is ticking and you, as Alex Hill, must uncover the truth before it’s too late.

title: Terminus: Ultiverse
description: Terminus introduces a cast of AI-powered Non-Player Characters (NPCs) unlike any before. Each character possesses a fully integrated worldview, allowing for deeply meaningful interactions and conversations that branch into multiple paths, each influencing the game's progression and possible endings.

title: Rise of the Eternal
description: Rise of the Eternal is a 2D-side scroller developed in Unreal Engine 5. It has beat'em up aspects and boss battles. In Early Access players have access to the first level of the game as well as one enemy type.

title: Manzaka
description: Manzaka is a fun action rpg focus on melee combat and interesting mechanics! Customize your character with different passive skill tree options and blast enemies through levels...

title: Quantum Void
description: Lost in an unexplored star system after a dimensional anomaly dispersed your fleet, you pick up signals scattered throughout the system. Explore the wrecks of your fleet vessels, collect useful modules for your ship, discover the secrets of the anomaly, and try to escape from this star of doom!

title: Street Totochèr
description: Street Totocher aims to showcase Reunion's culture and rich cultural diversity through a fighting video game.

title: Car Detailing Cleaner Simulator
description: Become the ultimate car detailing expert! Meet customers with dirty cars and transform their vehicles into sparkling clean havens. Are you ready to make every ride shine? Take on the role of a car cleaning guru! Dive into a realistic car salon cleaning simulation on Steam.

title: Pyrocast
description: An exciting 2D adventure game in which the player takes on the role of a pyromancer who has the powerful ability to create and control fire.

title: Collect Call
description: Hoard plastic, spill blood. Inhabit the mind of an android and ply your steel to shred flesh and snap wires. Evolve, adapt, and scalpel away your limitations in this cyberpunk deckbuilder.

title: Melon Madness
description: A relaxing and engaging fruit merge game! Combine fruit without spilling any out of the box, and try to get the highest score! Play alone or with a friend, in coop mode.

title: Minute Fighter
description: A first-person shooter controlled entirely with the mouse, with a focus on the granularity and minutia of interaction.

title: Aliosso
description: Combine tiles and run-changing cards to unleash power-packed combos and crush your enemies. Fight your way through the scorching desert of Samsara and stop the Djinn!

title: I Know Your Address
description: A collection of five short, silly games, following in the footsteps of those cheap games you impulsively gift to a friend and then immediately forget about. Speaking of which, I think I found the perfect gift for anybody whose address you know...

title: The Otter Ways
description: Humans left this place long ago. Now you, an inquisitive otter, must survive there, among the ruins of their kingdoms.

title: Kudamono Party
description: Get ready for a fruit-fueled adventure! In this fast-paced puzzle game, launch and align fruits to rack up points and rise in the global ranks. With vivid graphics and engaging gameplay, it's a race against time to become the top fruit master. Dive in and challenge the world!

title: Project Scar
description: Project Scar is a platform game and Endless Runner, enemies and platforms are randomly generated. Control Scar in his endless escape and quest to escape the Goblins grand jungle.

title: Dungeon Settlers
description: A colony sim based dungeon crawler where you manage your clan to build a settlement in barren land, provide food and shelter for your people, lead them deep into the merciless dungeon, overcome challenging combat by your strategy.

title: I Commissioned Some Snails
description: I paid artists to hide snails and lettuce in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: OG Memory: Winter 2K23
description: OG Memory: Winter 2K23 is an casual memory game with cute dog images. You have to find all of the correct pairs to complete the game. your best round will be count and always be displayed in game, to compare your rounds. try to reduce your turns every game and set up your new record.

title: Opaldune
description: A scifi third person survival horror. Stranded in the farthest reaches of space, Dr. Belica Gale boards the Opaldune seeking help. But in the bowels of the ship, monsters are prowling. Slip through dark hallways to scavenge for supplies, solve puzzles, and evade enemies long enough to get back out.

title: OG Puzzlers: Synthwave Cars
description: OG Puzzlers: Synthwave Cars is an hardcore puzzel game with cars in an stunning synthwave style. You have to assemble a single image from random generated indivdual pieces. Combine all of the smart singel frames into one big image and unlock the next level.

title: Pryzm
description: A survival adventure mystery with turn-based combat and escape parameters that change with every new 1 to 2-hour run. A visual novel that can be played like a speedrun.

title: Rock Climbing?
description: It's a difficult game but it should be easier than real rock climbing.

title: Dawn of Gray
description: Dawn of Gray is a single-player visual novel with a distinctive style, in which you play the role of a young man discovering himself and his feelings.

title: Chicken Tale
description: Platformer game Chicken Tale with a touching story and pixelart graphics three difficulty levels so that both beginners and experienced players can enjoy

title: Dreadweave
description: Immerse yourself in a horror extraction shooter where you must escape a Soviet ghost town with a monster from an upside-down world tracking your heartbeat. Arm yourself, gather resources, and fight to survive. Death is just the beginning—it's your gateway to an inside-out reality.

title: Factory Islands
description: Organize the blocks on this island correctly to complete the factory and ensure that the ores reach their destination. Relax as you use your logic to create a functional path using conveyors, tunnels, splitters, presses and furnaces.

title: Folie Fatale
description: All capture targets are mentally "Jirai"(landmine)!? Meet these eccentric boys, reveal the truth beneath in this Psycho-love-horror VN!

title: Evostrike
description: A Roguelike tactics game where you fight hordes of aliens. Your Units evolve and learn new skills as the fight goes on. Manage your squad of 5 specialised mercenaries, and fight a never ending war against the infestation.

title: MechDrachen
description: Dive into non-stop action in a movement-based arena shooter, blending some of the most familiar gameplay elements of the genre into a completely new experience, build around the idea to have the most fun with your friends you could possibly have with a movement shooter.

title: The Backrooms: Unseen Tapes
description: "The Backrooms: Unseen Tapes" is a first-person survival horror game where you navigate a maze-like, ever-changing procedurally generated environment. With stealth, speed, and strategy, evade monsters and conserve limited resources to maintain your sanity and escape this nightmarish dimension.

title: Shotgun Chicken
description: Shotgun chicken is a Foddian Precision Platformer Where you use your trusty old shotgun to make it back to the chicken coop but just one wrong move can send you tumbling down to the bottom.

title: DinnerDinnner
description: "DinnerDinner" is a horror adventure game set in the modern era. You become a diner staff member and encounter strange events - customers with bizarre stories, engaging in trivial conversations, and discussing incomprehensible matters.

title: Horse Racing Manager
description: Build your legacy in the horse racing world. Breed the next champion, making key decisions on training the horse and choosing its diet. Every choice counts, and every race tells a story. Create your own rags-to-riches journey, from being a stablehand to owning the greatest racing stable in the game.

title: Ducks in a Row
description: Help Mama Duck navigate parks, factories, and more in this super cute puzzler, and bring all her baby ducks home!

title: Kill AI
description: An RPG with multiple endings written by AI. All interactions with the player that are in the game show the real attitude of the evil AI towards a person.

title: Theory
description:
(This project was made in 48 hours for Ludum Dare 49, "Unstable".)

You are Erwin, a cat that has been captured by a race of alien robots, the Drexl'erin. After weeks of experimentation on you, you've developed the ability to shift between a living and dead state, but only when not being observed. You must use this power to escape your captors.

title: Death's Web
description: "Death's Web" is a challenging "Rogue-lite" platformer where you explore an ever-changing 2D world filled with enemies ready to slay you. Numerous curses are waiting to be discovered; they may lead to your demise, but perhaps they're valuable.

title: Medieval Questionnaire
description: Medieval Questionnaire is an educational game that tests your knowledge of medieval times with true or false questions.

title: Loop Theory
description: Loop Theory is a horror game in which every minute spent in the game changes your idea of the story. Take on the role of a character with a mysterious past and find out about what happened.

title: Dump The Corpse
description: It's a puzzle game, an action game, and a dark humour game that mixes a lot of gameplay. The game focuses on a housewife who is oppressed by life, since she married a husband who can't make money, her life is incredibly bad, so she can make the choice to kill him.

title: The Bathrooms
description: You awake near a foggy, deserted school with no memory of what happened. You soon discover a horrible secret and descend into a realm of cold, endless halls. Beware—The Custodian is watching you. Your escape from this nightmare depends on your wit and skill.

title: Forsaken Frontiers
description: Step into the frozen unknown in Forsaken Frontiers, a cooperative analog horror adventure set in the unforgiving embrace of an everlasting winter.

title: Soulivion II
description: ​Soulivion II is an immersive fantasy role-playing game with an in-depth demonic companion. Dominate the afterlife and decide the fate of everything.

title: Nightcrawler
description: A neon arcade about road and music. Ride your motorcycle on an endless highway and pass clipping zones to keep the rhythm: the road speeds up, the gaps get tighter, one mistake ends the run. Meditative yet challenging.

title: Pixel Puzzles Trivia
description: Pixel Puzzles Trivia is an informative question questing puzzle game.

title: Rat Race
description: Here you come to be the toughest rat in the sewers, where every delivery can end on the correct delivery point... or you can be crushed into the pipes. Do you dare to be the fastest rat in town?

title: Loong
description: "LOONG" is a dragon as the theme of the snake game, you will choose different styles of dragon civilization, through the snake to create the dragon totem.

title: Neon Runners
description: Select a runner with special abilities, create a power-up deck, and race! Craft your custom tracks using a user-friendly map editor. Explore various game modes such as Co-Op, Boss Battles, Floor is Lava, and Puzzle Rush. And it's free! Play cross-platform on PC & Mobile.

title: Ommatophilia
description:
Ommatophilia is a surreal RPGmaker horror game. It draws inspiration from classics like Mad Father and OFF, as well as newer titles such as 8:11 and re:curse. It is about motherhood, friendship, and the impermanence of stasis.

You play as Angel Cakes. Your friend is leaving soon. Life isn’t great, but you do your best to navigate through it. There's nothing in life more important to you than your friendships, even if it seems like everyone is evolving without you.

title: Real Estate Simulator
description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey to build your real estate empire in "Real Estate Simulator," a deep and dynamic business simulation game. Begin as a small-time property investor and strategize your way to become a tycoon in the cutthroat world of real estate. Navigate market trends, negotiate deals, and outsmart competitors in this immersive simulation experience.

Interactive NPC Negotiations: Engage with a range of NPC clients, from cautious first-time buyers to wealthy investors. Understand their needs, negotiate terms, and close deals that shape your path to success.

️ Property Development and Management: Purchase, renovate, and sell properties across the city. From cheap living areas to luxury skyscrapers, each property brings unique challenges and opportunities.

Intuitive Controls and UI: Whether you're a seasoned tycoon or new to business sims, intuitive controls and a clear user interface make managing your empire accessible and enjoyable.

Unique Challenges and Achievements: From market crashes to VIP clients, face unique challenges that test your strategic prowess. Unlock achievements and make your mark in the world of real estate.

title: Dice Blaze
description:
Dice Blaze - 1v1 Turn-based Combat game

Immerse yourself in strategic battles, unleash powerful abilities, and master the art of the dice.

Dive into a world of strategy and chance, where epic battles, cunning tactics, and thrilling adventures await.

description:
Welcome to We Are Foorball 2024 – the new football management experience from the creators of the legendary On the Ball and EA Sports FIFA Manager Series! Dive into the world of football like never before. Choose an existing club or start your own. Manage either men or women, lead your club to new heights, and become the following manager legend!

Be there with your team on the pitch. In our immersive 3D game engine, you can directly influence the action on the pitch through instructional shouts. Simulate the same game a thousand times over, witness matches 50 years into the future or switch between games in conference mode on match day. Relive highlights, analyze goals, and enjoy a comprehensive season summary.

title: Return of the Slimepires
description: An action-adventure platformer where you play as a human that must get to the safety of the underground bunker. There are multiple endings depending on the path you take.

title: Infinite Mario 64
description: What if you could play Super Mario 64... forever? A random level generator for Super Mario 64, using libsm64 and Godot Engine as a base.

description: Turn-based fantasy RPG that takes place in Lastia, the last piece of land on a world that survived a great war and is now facing a new threat: strange creatures named Xempts.

description:
No company is without a rival.
Freddy Fazbear's New Pizzeria has closed for good. And so, another restaurant is going to take its place in the world of entertainment.
What could go wrong?

description: Manage the race from the stands, drive legendary cars and enjoy a genuine endurance race experience. As both driver and engineer, in this unique simulation victory can only come through teamwork.

title: Tour de France 2024
description: Win a Grand Tour and claim the yellow jersey in the official game of the Tour de France 2024. Beat your opponents, push yourself to the limit and show what you're capable of in the new multiplayer mode: Criterium.

title: Pro Cycling Manager 2024
description: Become a sports director, take part in the world's top cycling races and lead your riders to victory. Set race objectives, negotiate contracts, find new sponsors and build your team season after season.
