title: Dating Simulator 2025
description: Dating Simulator 2025 is a dating simulator that offers you the skill of seduction and improving your dating skills. This game allows players to immerse themselves in a world where they can meet, socialize and win the hearts of virtual girls.

title: The 6-Digit Computer
description: The 6-Digit Computer is a programming game in an alternate past. You, Deam Mead, just got hired at Farworks as a programmer for their new operating system, HTaeD / O6. However, it's not as simple as you might think! The computer operates on bijective senary, which means that it only has the digits 1-6. So 7 becomes 11, 24 becomes 36 and so on.

title: SurvivalScape
description: Venture into SurvivalScape, an exhilarating auto shooter bullet hell! Choose your hero from a roster of exciting characters, each with their own special abilities and playstyles. Battle through waves of enemies, collect crystals to level up your hero, and confront unique bosses. Can you survive?

title: Action Unreal Tournament 2004
description:
Ever watched a John Woo flick and said 'I wish I could do that' as a guy dived down the stairs, akimbo pistols blazing? Just seen Bruce Willis blow away a room of bad guys and wished it was you?

Now you can. And why watch a movie when you can play it?

title: Party Hard 2: Alien Butt Form
description: Something has been very wrong with parties in the city of Aho Bay recently. Who really controlled Party Hard Killer? Why it took so long for the police to catch him? Where are those tentacles grown from, for Christ’s sake? Find out in this brand new DLC, fueled by booze and hilarity.

title: Basic Replicator
description:
Boot up your replicator console, and get to coding!

In this game you are tasked with writing BASIC code to generate voxel objects. Each challenge presents you with a new object to replicate.

Attempt to optimize your solution to minimize program size, or executed instruction count.

title: Super Squishy Square Stacker
description:
Inspired by the likes of Not Tetris and C4D4U's "Satisfying Softbody Tetris" animations; this game sees you controlling jelly-like tetrominos, arranging them in such a way that clears rows, and draining the remaining residue with the two vents at the bottom of the field. Play ends once you've collected enough jelly to fill a container of variable size, depending on which mode you've picked.

The available containers hold a pint (~17 lines), a quart (~33 lines), and a gallon(~133 lines) each. Upon completion, you'll be shown your final time and score, allowing you to decide which to focus on.

title: That's Not My Neighbor
description: 'That's not my Neighbor' is a 2D Indie horror game based on the job simulator genre with an unique twist created by Ignacio Alvarado Monge AKA NachoSama.

title: Center Station Simulator
description: Inherit an abandoned shopping center. Make it functional and produce many products yourself in your underground laboratory! Get rich by selling them to your customers. Develop and expand your center with many features!

title: FNaF: Project Lockdown
description: Dock to a space station with deadly animatronics and try to get out alive.

title: GachaPon!
description: Embark on a whimsical journey of physics-based puzzle-solving in the delightful world of GachaPon! Discover the art of relaxation as you immerse yourself in this charming game, where the goal is not just to solve puzzles, but to enjoy the process of being yourself.

title: Pincrediball
description: The Automata Pinball Wizard game! YOU design the machine and the Automata Pinball Wizard plays it to get a High Score. Earn medals to advance levels and build ever more extensive machines!

title: Project O.R.C.S.
description: Project O.R.C.S. is a multiplayer Collaborative Storytelling RPG where you work together with your party to create characters, craft quests, and tell stories. Building upon the magic of telling a story around a table with a group of friends, and evolving that experience into the online world. You can generate and start your session within minutes rather than hours. Whether you choose the role of Guide to facilitate the group’s journey or you join as an Adventurer and craft your dream character, you and your party collaborate to play a story only limited by your imagination.

title: Soul Shifters: Online
description:
This is an exploration-focused game, so there's no predefined path to follow or a specific sequence of missions to complete; you are free to explore and discover its mysteries.
Face and absorb various daemons, open mysterious chests on the map, talk to NPCs. While there's no set mission sequence, some of them will open up new possibilities and paths for you.

title: 18titans
description: 18Titans game - Robin is the leader of the Teen Titans. He was abducted by Slade, who is one of the most dangerous enemies in the game. Slade takes a syringe and injects something into Robin's veins that have followed by a cryptic message. The teen superheroes find themselves in a difficult situation where they must save themselves if they hope to rescue society from Slade and his band of evildoers. It all begins with the abduction, but it doesn't have to end with the injection that very well could put an end to Robin's life.

title: Cucumber Champion
description: Embark on a journey as the valiant Cucumber Champion! Wield a cucumber as your mighty weapon and navigate through a fantastical world filled with quirky cats, humorous encounters, and epic battles. Can you prove yourself as the champion and save the day in this delightful and eccentric adventure?

title: Hours After Midnight
description: Dive deep into a roguelike survival quest against Rettam'diov, the Consumer of Worlds. Progress, earn experience, refine characters, and uncover potent tools. Face relentless hordes alone or amplify the thrill, teaming up cross-platform in our distinctive co-op mode.

title: Transpile Girl Rescue Operation!

title: Sex Faculty
description: Sex Faculty is a visual novel for adults, where immersive storytelling and a sense of realism are complemented by a variety of scenes and elements intended for players over 18.

title: Evil Beneath
description: In this retro PS1/PSX style game. Play as a reporter (Rosa Salinas) investigating strange phenomenon regarding people mysteriously disappearing after visiting a particular mansion located deep inside a forest. During your investigation you will encounter horrifying creatures ready to tear you limb from limb and devour you alive. Traverse your way through these monstrous creatures and discover the terrifying truths about the mansion in the forest, while trying to make your escape before it's to late.

title: Terrorformer TD
description: Terrorformer TD is a tower defense roguelite where the map erodes and grows as the game progresses -- but the player gets terraforming tools to shape it! Every round, fortify your defenses to survive against waves of enemies; then cash in for new towers, upgrades, and other rewards. Gain XP and level up to unlock new abilities and components after each run and try again to make it even further!

title: Sex Campus
description: Welcome to the exciting world of SEX Campus, where freshman Nick embarks on an incredible journey through real student life. But in this college, every day is a new stage in the game 'Hot Pie,' where real-life quests are intertwined with fun and intriguing tasks.

title: Rockin' Racket
description: Rockin’ Racket is a narrative driven, fast paced, pop punk band management game with an undercurrent of teenage angst as you try to hold together a band of rowdy younger siblings, keep the crowd happy, and manage your frugal earnings while booking larger venues to rocket your band to stardom!

title: Punk
description: PUNK is an open world bullet hell action roguelike. Fight vicious creatures, explore diverse biomes, hone your movement skills, manage resources, tinker with weapons and gadgets to upgrade your tiny ship until you become the apex predator of this strange, alien world.

title: Sunflowers and the Goddess of Death
description: A retro-inspired turn-based RPG of faith, loss, and rebellion. Overcome the designs of a dread goddess, liberate your people, and shatter the chains that bind you.

title: Chrono Recorder
description: "ChronoRecorder" is a 3D puzzle game. Players can manipulate time and gravity. And you have to use that ability to solve problems. You might think this game is difficult if you don't use your brain.

title: Diamonds Collector
description: The pursuit of wealth - How it feels?

title: Nono's Quest
description: Nono's Quest is a short casual 2D JRPG were you fight monsters and get in all types of trouble.

title: MR 333 II: Planetbirth

title: Isoland4: The Anchor of Memory
description: ISOLAND4 is the fifth installment in the ISOLAND series by CottonGame. The game continues to feature the distinctive hand-drawn style of CottonGame, with point-and-click gameplay. The game also features a second playthrough mode, which allows players to gain a deeper understanding of the game.

title: Tokyo Mafia Simulator
description: Tokyo Mafia Simulator is an simulation action-adventure game where you experience the thrilling and dangerous life of a yakuza in Tokyo. You can extort, steal, hit, protect, date, and more, as you rise through the ranks of the underworld.

title: Clockwork Ambrosia
description: Clockwork Ambrosia is a compelling steampunk fusion of metroidvania and a 2D shooter. Players pull on the boots of an airship pilot to combat an army of deadly robots and monsters. Experiment with a range of rule-breaking weapons modifications and armors to prevail through this wild adventure!

title: Drowned Memories
description: Drowned Memories is an upcoming narrative-driven game taking place in the late 1950s, when the federal capital of Brazil, Brasília, was being built. Based on real events, the game tells the story of one of the largest workers' villages called Amaury Village, which was flooded by the waters of the artificial lake Paranoá.

title: EXR
description:
Row your way, train with friends and join the world's biggest 3D rowing community.

Discover your passion for indoor rowing with EXR: row in virtual worlds, join events and race rowers from all over the world. Channel your inner rowing champion and grow stronger with every workout!

title: The Roottrees Are Dead
description: A genealogical mystery straight out of 1998. Scour the early Internet for clues, uncover hidden connections, and piece together the family tree behind the secretive Roottree Corporation.

title: Doki Doki Storm
description: Doki Doki Storm is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club intended to be a character study of Yuri, told entirely from her point of view, showcasing her struggles with fitting in, her feelings of self-loathing, her escapism into fantasy, her attempts to overcome her self-harm habit, and her eventual descent into madness. Don't let that screenshot above fool you; this is a very dark mod, rather different from my previous work, in that it deals with deep emotional pain and gets quite bloody. Even if you enjoyed my previous work, please use your discretion when playing. Be safe and pace yourself if you need to.

title: Soliopop
description: High speed, airborne, arcade action! Bounce the ball off platforms to gain score, hit targets to multiply incoming score, and avoid falling off the map.

title: Runonce
description:
RUNONCE (remember_me) is an existential desktop friend that knows you have doomed it by running it.
You can only run it once, and then never again.
Be a friend while they are here.
Whatever you save will be all that remains.

title: Massacre at the Mirage
description: For less than the price of a movie ticket, experience your very own horror-fueled slasher flick in Massacre at the Mirage. Step into The Mirage cinema and face a chilling nightmare, where staff and patrons must survive a masked killer's rampage.

title: The Witch's Night Watch
description:
Your nightly duty awaits you...
Guard the graveyard from mischievous ghosts that rise every night and make it until sunrise.

Use magic spells, your broom, quick dodges, and summoned allies to help you survive the one-minute onslaught, with random nerfs and buffs being applied between every level.

title: Cul-De-Sac
description: Cul-De-Sac is a ghost hunting game about finding a cursed item and destroying it.

title: The Secret Atelier
description: You are the advisor of the art club and the only other person in there is Ichijou Erika. She offers to be a model for the club but your eyes begin to wander towards her erotic body. Something she is very aware of. How will you maintain your composure in front of her lascivious invitation?!

title: DNF Duel: DLC 5 - Nen Master

title: Just Cause 2: Monster Truck DLC

The usefulness of an oversized monster truck when destabilizing small countries is clearly evident.

Grab this Monster Truck DLC for use in Just Cause 2!

title: Just Cause 2: Bull's Eye Sniper Rifle
description: More powerful than the standard assault rifle, this lightweight and lethal automatic rifle features increased accuracy in close combat and a higher magnification scope.

title: Just Cause 2: Rico's Signature Gun DLC
description: Customised by the Agency and adapted for Rico’s shooting style, this deadly accurate and powerful pistol packs a punch with precision, power and flair.

title: Just Cause 2: Chevalier Classic
description: No agent should be without a hot set of wheels and with an increased top speed and superior handling, you can arrive at your destination in style or make a guaranteed quick getaway.

title: Just Cause 2: Agency Hovercraft
description: The ultimate in amphibious transport, the Agency Hovercraft is the most flexible form of transport in the game. Steered by a thrust-based engine for smooth and agile movement, the vehicle is as comfortable on land as off. Equipped with a turret-mounted grenade launcher, you’re guaranteed to blow your opposition out of the water.

title: Payday 2: Legacy Collection
description:
More than five years of DLC content in one massive bundle!

Whether you’re a new player itching to dive into the PAYDAY 2 experience for the first time, or a blooded heister looking for new adventures in crime, the PAYDAY 2: Legacy Collection will provide many hours of intense and exciting action. The content in this pack includes a massive amount of heists, characters, weapons, mods and cosmetic items, for an ever richer PAYDAY 2 experience.

PAYDAY 2: Legacy Collection includes the base game and all paid DLC released up until December 2018, with the exception of the h3h3 Character Pack (a charity item which is sold separately).

title: Dragona: Fireborne
description: A PC free-to-play MMORPG set in the cursed realm of Bartan. As a Dragona warrior, transform into mighty dragons to face Jurtan's influence. Immerse in rich lore, landscapes, and battles against darkness. Unleash the Dragona within and rise in this dark fantasy adventure. Bartan's fate awaits.

title: In a Detective's Mind
description: In a Detective's Mind is an investigation game that seeks to put you in the role of a detective, who needs to solve cases and deal with obscure problems from his past.

title: Fable II Bonus Game Content
description:
This pack contains:

- The Wreckager legendary cutlass weapon
- The Hall of the Dead dungeon
- Otherworldly Bonus (Hal's Armour and Sword)

title: Rama's Quest
description: Embark on a legendary journey in "Rama's Quest," a captivating rogue-lite bullet hell rooted in the rich tapestry of Indian mythology.

title: DrawBall
description: DrawBall is a fun puzzle game where the aim of the game is to complete levels by drawing ink to guide coloured balls into a correctly coloured hole. DrawBall includes over 30 in built levels and a level editor so you can create and export your own levels and even import levels made by others!

title: Middle-earth: Shadow of Mordor - The Power of Shadow
description: Strike terror into your enemies as Sauron's most fearful Servant, the Black Hand, and upgrade your Sword, Dagger and Bow to be weapons of renown with the Runes of Power bundle.

title: Example Block Game
description:
Example Block Game is an open source implementation of basic block stacking in Lua/LÖVE. Featuring its own standardized kick table, the game has over 7 modes in total to use as reference for implementing your own gamemodes in its extensible engine.

In most modes, gameplay continues until you top out. High scores are saved per mode and can be viewed at any time from the main menu.

title: Pixel Fixel
description: Pixel Fixel is a soothing game where players match tiles of various colors to form satisfying gradients. Arrange chaos into beautiful mosaics of colors!

title: Touhou Genso Wanderer: Foresight
description:
A new dungeon-crawler RPG game in the Genso Wanderer series.
Embark on an adventure with Reimu and friends to solve incidents.

title: Terminal 69
description: Prequel to TERMINAL64 - the hypnotic dive into our hero Mario's troubled heart, now, years later, the gang comes back to continue the operatic tragedy nightmare extravaganza that takes you right up the moment Mario gets on his horse, hits that country road, and leaves the Mushroom Kingdom for good.

title: I Just Wanna Land!
description: You play as a bird with a baseball cap on a search to find a new floating island after their first one crumbles. Instead of jumping off platforms, you flap your wings in mid air to propel yourself in the direction you're aiming.

title: Galaxis
description: A simple shmup reminiscent of the arcade era. Your mission is to fly into enemy space and destroy the aliens that pose a threat to all life on Earth!

title: Crimson II
description:
Years have passed since the evil Crimson was defeated. Peace was restored, and humanity enjoyed an era of prosperity. But a new demonic being has arisen, ending the peace in the world. Five heroes must find each other and unite in order to vanquish him.

The sequel to Crimson retains the basic gameplay of its predecessor and is a medieval-themed role-playing game with overhead exploration and first-person turn-based combat against randomly appearing enemies. The first part of the game is broken into chapters, each dedicated to one of the five heroes; afterwards, they are united as a party and continue the quest together, similarly to Dragon Quest IV.

title: The Funeral of Sachertorte
description: Congratulations on landing the job at the funeral home you've been longing for. Let's satisfy customers seeking end-of-life services.

title: Aren't Grim Reapers Supposed to be Scary
description: You woke up with no memory intact and greeted by two girls claiming they're Grim Reapers. What's more, they tell you you're currently in their world and you're no longer human.

title: Lunic: Possession
description:
Somehow you managed to get trapped inside a school that has been abandoned since one terrible accident. Looks like in order to unlock the exit you need to put certain pictures inside frames. But who came up with this kind of challenge?

You need to find pictures that are hidden behind locked doors for which you need to find keys. Every playthrough everything is spawned differently.

title: Iwakura Aria
description: The Iwakura mansion holds a dark secret. Ichiko the new young maid joins looking for nothing but safety and security, but would soon find herself entangled with the beautiful daughter of the Iwakura household. Unravel the secrets of the Iwakura mansion in this gripping suspense visual novel.

title: Barkley 3: Shitpost Version
description: A short shitpost that was made in week, made after the announcement that the Barkley 2 project had collapsed. Heavily inspired by stories from the Barkley 2 devs about what went wrong mid-development.

title: Barkley Gaiden 2: The Son Of Dark Draker - Barkley Shut Up and Jam: Gaiden, Gaiden Episode 1
description: A fangame based on Barkley: Shut Up and Jam Gaiden and the unfinished Barkley 2.

title: Organized Neatly
description: This bundle contains Cats Organized Neatly, Dogs Organized Neatly and Birds Organized Neatly. Together, they have 240 unique puzzles!

title: ZIIAOL
description: A remake of Zelda II - The Adventure of Link by HoverBat, created in GameMaker 1.4 for the PC.

title: Elevator Experience
description: Embark on a one-of-a-kind journey of exploration in "Elevator Experience". Step into the elevator and prepare to be transported to a world of mysteries, where every floor holds a new adventure waiting to be unlocked.

title: Dayshift at Freddy's: Doggo Location improved
description: Almost 1 year after Jack and Dave made Freddy's Bakersfield location close down, A new location was opened. Apparently, Freddy Fazbender's decided to bring the Idaho location (#45) back. Now, this is where the fun begins.

title: Dave the Diver: Anniversary Edition
description:
Dave the Diver is an action-adventure and management simulation game developed by Mintrocket. In the game, players control Dave, who spends his days diving into underwater environments to catch fish and gather resources, and his nights managing a sushi restaurant. The gameplay combines real-time underwater exploration and combat with restaurant management mechanics.

This edition, released exclusively in Japan in physical format, features an exclusive Guilty Gear: Strive crossover with content including boat skins of the various fighters, cosplayers appearing as customers at Bancho Sushi, May's theme song The Disaster of Passion in the rhythm mini-game and May's anchor appearing as a melee weapon during dives.

title: The Tragic Loss of M. Slazak
description: Miroslav Slazak - a Polish immigrant who fled to Britain shortly before the outbreak of the Second World War. His only possessions were the clothes on his back, his passport and a large antique ship’s chest. It was chained shut.

title: The Troopers' Playground
description: The Troopers' Playground is a single-player episode replacement for Doom II. It was created by Matthias Worch and uploaded to the idgames archive on March 29, 1996. The Trooper's Playground contains nine regular levels in TTP.WAD, one bonus level in TTPBONUS.WAD, and two deathmatch-only maps in TTPDEATH.WAD. The episode features a custom status bar and new textures.

title: Material Sniper
description: Japanese Flash game where you control a sniper girl as you complete missions. The game simulates bullet physics such as velocity and wind effect.

title: Nope Nope Nurses Melee
description: The unbelievable spinoff off Sakusei Byoutou! You might not believe it, but it's now a 2D fighting game! It's kill or be killed, and either way you're getting sucked dry!

title: Hazard Course
description: Using Black Mesa assets as well as much of our own custom made content, Hazard Course features a complete re-creation of Half-Life's training level, including new dialogue and voice acting, HD models, textures, and detailed environments.

title: Serious Duke 3D
description:
Serious Duke 3D is a reimagining of the first episode of Duke Nukem 3D. While the main idea is to recreate the classic Duke 3D experience, some modern elements are added to the mix, such as redesigned and expanded level areas, occasional enemy waves/arena fights and new weapons.

Also features redesigned enemy and weapon models from DNF with custom animations, as well as a selection of sounds and voice taken from several official Duke games and beyond that lots of custom assets and music tracks made exclusively for this mod.

The mod supports virtual reality gameplay if it is installed with the VR edition of Serious Sam 3.

title: Crystal Wish: Dwindle Hearts
description:
Three girls, a storm and a deck of cards.

Join Mughara, Meg and Rosalyn as they enjoy a game of Hearts to pass the time as a storm rages outside the hotel they are staying at.

Hey, don't you think the room is getting bigger?
It's called Dwindle Hearts for a reason after all~

title: A Haunted House
description: A Haunted House is a game inspired by classic survival horror. You play as paranormal investigator Eerie Grey who has been summoned to a remote house under suspicious circumstances.

title: AM
description: Hop into the driver's seat and prepare for anything as you navigate a vast network of rural roads in search of salvation. AM is a high-speed horror game that keeps you on the edge of your seat—and your foot on the gas—as you race to leave the nightmares of an abandoned world in your rearview.

title: Don’t Face Up
description: Don’t Face Up is a first-person horror game. Never make eye contact with them. They may appear and disappear. They may be standing in the direction you suddenly turn your eyes. Even in such a situation, you must proceed with your search for the building. Therefore, "Don’t Face Up."

title: Project Hornet
description: With a procedurally-assisted open world full of dynamic events, secrets, and encounters with multiple factions and entities, the game will offer you an immersive simulation combined with the best experience of survival games.

title: Killer at the Shop
description: Take your groceries and leave the shop without dying.

title: Do Not Take This Cat Home
description: You find a cute cat all alone in an alley. What will you do?

title: Rail Rampage
description:
As someone of skill, working in a dangerous but high-level position, it's no wonder why you're up to the task. Unfortunately, we can't always expect luck to be on our side. Fight through a train, prison, and your own employers to finally take back your title of being a 'high value asset'. Features several levels, a built in level editor and player and more.

After all, your skills are worth a lifetime.

title: Kitty Kart 64
description: The light's green and it's time to race! Aim for the checkered flag and don't slow down! Get the adrenaline pumping, only 1,2,3 laps and you win! Easy to pick up, yet impossible to put down! Do you have what it takes to get first place?

title: Battle For The Crystals
description: Prepare for a relentless battle in "Battle for the Crystals," a homage to the classic full-scale retro warfare games that demand skill and strategic prowess. Take control of a mighty hero and strategically command your troops in minimalistic yet challenging battlefields.

title: Pinball Blitz
description: Pinball Blitz combines arcade pinball with a fast-paced action roguelike. Shape each run with selectable themes, flipper setups, and table upgrades to defeat bosses and achieve high-scores.

title: Ancraophobia
description: Ghost hunting survival game where you identify and catch ghosts. Play alone or with friends this horror game is sure to be enjoyable.

title: Touhou Danmaku Kagura: Phantasia Lost - Digital Deluxe Edition
description: This bundle contains the game Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost together with Additional Song Packs 1 to 4 and the Digital Soundtrack

title: Vindictus: Defying Fate
description:
is a new high-speed fantasy action-RPG inspired by Celtic mythology.
Jump into the fast-paced medieval fantasy adventure that combines exciting combat.
Enjoy various distinct characters with unique abilities and combos to face fearsome creatures.

title: MordeTwi Magic
description: MordeTwi Magic is a Friday Night Funkin' mod based on the MordeTwi fanship and 2012 fanart by joeyairplanes02 featuring the ship which would later become a meme. The mod features a full song mapping of the song Airplanes.

title: Road Bustle Online
description: Road Bustle Online is a competitive online game for up to 8 players on the road in real-time, set in the streets of the Road Bustle world. Bright graphics and pulsating rhythms set the stage for adrenaline-filled sessions. Navigate your way through increasing traffic, dodge vehicles, and outsmart your opponents to reach the finish line. Ready? On your marks!

title: Dabman: When The Haters Dab Back Remastered
description: Relive this 2018 classic from Kimulator's Films in a remaster of one of their first game ever!

title: Night Shift at Fazclaire's Nightclub
description:
Night Shift at Fazclaire's Nightclub is a 3D freeroam FNAF parody NSFW game and does contain nudity, sex and suggestive themes. Your aims are :

1. Complete all the tasks you will get during the night, such as entering rooms or finding lost items.
2. Keep up the energy in 3 generators located in the nightclub.
3. Watch your sanity and energy.
4. D̶o̶n̶'̶t̶ get caught by animatronics/h̶a̶l̶l̶u̶c̶i̶n̶a̶t̶i̶o̶n̶s̶.

title: Lustful Desires
description: A homoerotic visual-novel and rpg by Hyao.

title: Aqua Mundo
description: Inspired by classic theme park games, Aqua Mundo allows you to build the waterpark of your dreams! Design pools, lazy rivers, and water slides while sculpting an immersive thematic world. Keep guests entertained and maintain your infrastructure to keep the park afloat financially.

title: Crusader Kings III: Legends of the Dead
description: What good are grand accomplishments and heroic deeds if no one sings of them after you have gone? A royal legacy is only useful, after all, if it can provide cover and legitimacy for those who come after you. Live on in the memory of your subjects and rivals in Legends of the Dead.

title: Betrayed
description: Enter Betrayed, a 3-16 player party shooter where trust is scarce, and deception is paramount. Navigate diverse maps, use proximity voice chat to strategize, and earn currency for traitorous tools. Will you prove innocence or master deception? Gather your friends for suspense and laughter!

title: Abstêmia
description: An endless chime, each second bringing you closer and closer to an imminent end. Embark on an adventure inside the familiar corridors of Eduardo's house and watch his residence slowly transfigure into something grotesque and terrifying. Good luck on your adventure, may they have mercy on your soul. And remember: the C.G.C. is watching you.

title: EmyLiveShow: Anime Puzzle Game
description: As the "story unfolds" between unique puzzle-like images, Emy, Nia, Uma and Six will appear before the player for the first time in more innocent and yielding forms.

title: Good Guys
description: What do your pets do when you're not at home?

title: Arcade Archives: War of Aero
description: "WAR OF AERO " is a shooter released by ALLUMER in 1992. The aircraft can be fitted with pods on either side, which can be turned around to shoot up and down. In addition, when the 1P and 2P aircraft are stacked on top of each other, they merge to create a powerful attack.

title: Greed Series
description: Discover mysterious secrets and attempted sabotage in the Greed Series bundle!

title: Sculpt People
description: Mold the head, carve the details and decorate your work with different sprays and accessories!

title: Spot The Difference: Fantasy Edition
description: Introducing Spot The Difference Fantasy Edition, brought to you by the original creators of the globally renowned Spot The Difference amusement machine game.

title: Twisty Pals
description: Twist and spin really fast!

title: Virtual Girlfriend Dating Simulator
description: Navigate the complexities of young love in a vibrant college setting. Every choice shapes your destiny in this captivating dating simulation game!

title: World War II Shooting Simulator
description: Do you have what it takes to survive the onslaught and rewrite history?

title: Headbangers: Feeling Peckish
description: Your Headbanger has never looked so good! Grab the Feeling Peckish DLC and show off your new drip to all your friends or dazzle the competition.

title: Mommy's Warm Hot Spring: Poka-poka Mama Koi Onsen
description:
"I'm the one who discovered the hot spring. Let's enjoy this together."
Refresh your daily fatigue with a soothing hot spring!

title: Beauties Unveiled 2
description: Beauties Unveiled 2 is a continuation of the mesmerizing journey from Part 1, that pairs the familiar excitement of classic arcade games with manga-inspired, and hentai-inspired art.

title: Become The Wild
description: Survive in the wilderness and become the wild

title: Chip and Charge
description: Chip and Charge is an arcade-style tennis game with a fully customizable character and equipment and dozens of new cosmetics!

title: DIY Fashion Star
description: Refresh your wardrobe with stylish DIY projects and put your clothing design skills to the test!

title: DIY Fashion Star: Arts & Crafts
description:
Redesign your new clothes and decorate them with new patches and accessories!

With this DLC you will unlock:
- new DIY summer top
- new stylish DIY skirt
- new elegant DIY dress
- skull patch
- lips patch
- eye patch
- blue bow accessory
- orange button accessory

Use your designer imagination and create new DIY projects that everyone will love!

title: DIY Fashion Star: Glow Up!
description:
Give your doll a unique look with new stylish hairstyles and a new face-painting option!

With this DLC you will unlock:
- 2 different hairstyles with beautiful braids
- face-painting tab with 10 different colorful designs ranging from butterflies and stars to lovely flowers

Dye your new magical hair and paint your face using the new feature!

title: DIY Fashion Star: Stylish Outfits
description:
Change your doll's style with cute and brand-new clothes!

With this DLC you will unlock:
- beautiful dress in red, green, pink and orange colors
- stylish glasses in blue, aqua blue, orange and pink colors
- baseball sweatshirt in red, blue, orange and purple colors
- denim shorts in blue, aqua blue, red and orange colors
- fashionable heeled shoes in blue, pink, orange and green colors

title: Picross S+: Picross e3
description:
Play puzzles from Picross e3 on the Nintendo 3DS in Picross S+.

・Picross 150 puzzles
・Mega Picross 150 puzzles

New bonus puzzles will be added to your Gift Box .
・Picross 6 puzzles
・Mega Picross 6 puzzles

description:
Play puzzles from Picross e4 on the Nintendo 3DS in Picross S+.

・Color Picross 1 puzzles

title: Picross S+: Picross e5
description: Play puzzles from Picross e5 on the Nintendo 3DS in Picross S+.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II - Gold Edition
description: Pre-order the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 Gold Edition to receive the Macragge&rsquos Chosen DLC and play up to 3 days before release.About the early unlock:The early unlock is not guaranteed for Canada territory.Please make sure to check the shipping time when you place your order to ensure delivery before the release.Day one delivery is not guaranteed with standard shipping option.The Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 Gold Edition includes the base game Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, the Season Pass and an exclusive Steelbook.Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine. Unleash deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid swarms. Defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or co-op modes.

title: Uradrasill
description: "Mahjong" x "Battle" A mahjong battle game that can be enjoyed like a puzzle!

title: Madoromi Travel
description: If you fall asleep, the game ends immediately. Slumber Travel" is a death-memory type simulation. Enjoy a mysterious trip through various troubles in the city of sleep, which governs sleep.

title: Overworked Alice
description: This is a precise platform game modeled after the King of Jumps.

title: Promise with My Sister
description: A story centered around sisters, and as their brother, I must protect them. My mission is to find and reclaim the memories of time spent with my sisters. Numerous adventures filled with challenges are just beginning. This is my very own RPG life!

title: Investigator Trials
description: In the game, you will play the role of an intern examiner and participate in a trial to become an official examiner. Strive to defeat one mechanical guard after another and powerful enemies through trial and error, in order to unleash one's true strength and transform into various combat postures.

title: Backrooms: Beyond One Year
description: One year after the existence of backrooms was announced, a large number of enterprises, groups, and individuals wanderers are rushing into this world. Danger, terror, and even death could not stop humanity's desire for benefits!You are a wanderer who is going tomake some money with them....

title: Fumo
description: "Fumo" is a 3D immortal MMORPG, set against the backdrop of ancient Chinese mythology, fairy tales, allusions, and history, depicting a magnificent and imaginative painting for players.

title: Ultimate Fatal Octopus
description: A Touhou Project fan-made STG, also a collab game with Vtuber Syrena. Some day a random suspicious pink UFO showed up in Gensokyo. This must be an incident! As a result, Reimu and Marisa went on a journey to solve the incident.

title: Lang Ops: Greek
description: The road to efficiency leads through repetition. Lang Ops allows you to get accustomed to Greek language at your own pace! Features a lot of different tests to guarantee success!

title: GuluGuluLand 3D
description: A classic action-style, 3D game from the NES era! Unity-chan keeps running and can't stop. Use the actions of grabbing the stick with one hand to turn, and grabbing the stick with both hands to jump, and lead her to clear the stage.

title: Lone Lamp
description: A point-and-click puzzle adventure

title: Right or Die!
description: Navigate an ever changing maze where every turn could be your last...

title: Pacific Minesweeper
description: Dive into the Pacific's depths in a submersible, navigating through different areas to defuse mines and score points. Aim for precision with limited shots. Avoid errors to keep your lives. Experience high-stakes, strategic gameplay in this free singleplayer adventure!

title: Ludicrous Leap
description: Fast-Paced, Level-Based 3D Platformer - Jump, Dodge, Climb, and Run! Try to beat the Bronze, Silver, and Gold times for each level (if you can even beat the levels at all)!

title: GMH: Good Morning Human!
description: In a synthwave-inspired universe, achieve the best possible scores by avoiding obstacles in your path. Control and skills will be necessary to complete each level.

title: Just Dodge, LOL
description: When you have no weapon, no magic and no help - just dodge. Complete a set of trials to prove that you are a Dodge Grandmaster!

title: Is it different or not?
description: Your task is to scrutinize every corner of a schoolroom for differences. If the room is perfect, you can safely move forward. However, if you notice even the slightest difference, you must step back. Your primary weapon in this game is a keen eye and quick reaction time.

title: Skateboard Gravity
description: Skateboard Gravity: A Journey into the Gravitational World

title: Ghost legend
description: This is a racing simulation game with a bicycle themed gameplay,

title: Five elements for 24!
description: On that day, mankind remembered the fear of being dominated by the math Olympiad in primary school. 4 random numbers, 3 operations, get 24 points!

title: The Hell: City Builder of the Dead
description: Welcome to the city-building game set in the depths of Hell. Assume the role of the Hell Governor and embrace the challenge of welcoming souls who perished in major, historically accurate human catastrophes. Are you ready to build and govern your own infernal city?

title: StoicScape
description: Recruited by a mysterious wanderer named Marcus Aurelius, you will embark upon a series of "Stoic Trials," where you will gather philosophical insights for his unfinished book, "Meditations." Extract resources, defeat enemies, and confront epic bosses to become a master stoic.

title: Escape From Amexs-137
description: A sci-fi first person view point and click adventure game

title: Next King
description: RPG. Play with mouse only. A screen resolution - 1280*720 or 1920*1080

title: Sugardew Island: Your Cozy Farm Shop
description: In this cozy farming game, you have to run your own farm shop. Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade the island and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the island with life again.

title: MailRabit
description: You are a diligent rabbit whose job is to put mail in the post box. You and the moon love carrots. You will go crazy dancing if you don't keep eating carrots. So use your special skill to make carrots from mochi and keep working.

title: Fruit Slice by Motion Capture
description: This is a very classic fruit cutting game, but it is not controlled by a mouse or touch. Instead, it uses a camera to capture the trajectory of your arm and control the knife light to cut through the fruit . So,You only need a regular camera to experience the joy of real-time motion capture games.

title: Dispatch Madness
description: Manage the flow of a fresh produce warehouse ! Place orders with suppliers, handle incoming pallets, and dispatch them from the loading bay to your customers. Stay cool under pressure ! Deal with the increasing pressure and unexpected events.

title: Soulbind: Prologue
description: Soulbind: Prologue is an action platformer in the Roguelike genre. The hero is a common skeleton and an outsider. But there is one special feature - you can replace your body parts with parts of your opponents' bodies. Learn the backstory and start your journey in the world of Allaar.

title: Retro Mystery Club Vol.2: The Beppu Case
description: The stage is set in Beppu, Oita Prefecture, for the latest installment in this retro mystery series! There, hearts that pass each other by can’t help but grow twisted… Uncover the truth behind a mysterious death with your junior detective, Ken!

title: De3amy
description: "Players, please break the chains of Amy's nightmares with DR3AMy!" Break free from nightmares with the lovely DR3AMy android and Amy. This game contains visual and auditory horror elements. It is not recommended for the elderly or those with a weak heart.

title: Sergei and the Tax Return
description: Sergei and the Tax Return is a small Indie project, it uses a simple design and is mostly text based. At its heart it is a small business / tycoon style game where you delagate work and keep on top of the paperwork.

title: Final Apex
description: Get ready for the ultimate adrenaline rush in "Final Apex," an arcade racing game set in the near future where speed knows no bounds! Step into the driver's seat of seven unique and powerful cars and it's time to unleash the full potential of futuristic racing!

title: Cafe Rosa
description: Cafe Rosa is a cafe management simulator. Serve food to unique customers and earn coins. Manage your own cafe by upgrading the facilities and changing the interior. Dive into the world of cafe ownership and watch your business flourish!

title: Simple Mosaics: Nonogram Puzzles
description: Solve logic puzzles!

title: Nexus PI
description: In a reality stuck in a technologically unadvanced society stricken with the negative impacts of a worldwide climate disaster, you are a uniquely powered private investigator tasked with uncovering advanced technology from another reality with the potential to save your whole world.

title: HeroStory
description: 《HeroStory》 is a card battle game that does not contain numerical or random elements.

title: Sushi Bar: Moebius
description: A physics puzzle game. When you put sushi on top of sushi, the sushi you make will flow down the lane. Feed the customers and keep them full! When they are full, the next customer will come. The game is over when the sushi is out of the box! Aim for a high score!

title: Bakaru: Lendas Indígenas Brasileiras
description: Bakaru: Lendas Indígenas Brasileiras is an interactive CD-ROM that contains eight stories about Brazilian folklore, as well as some mini-games.

title: MyMustache
description: "My Mustache" is a narrative game that tells a story about childhood.

title: Captain CoinCoin
description: Help CoinCoin, the farm duck, defend the old farm where he and his friends were born. Construct buildings, harvest resources, train fighters and plan tricks to repel, in turn-based battles, the strange machines that want your land.

title: Mischievous
description: This is a simple and fun classic game in a cartoon style.

title: There Is No Sleep
description: Everyone has nightmares every now and then... but what would you do if a demon trapped you in a nightmare and you couldn't wake up?

title: Hexseeker
description: Combine hexagons in the quest to find the "F". Discover tons of hype unlockables. Compete on numerous Steam leaderboards and enjoy over 20 achievements in this innovative "increaser" style puzzle game. With mouse, keyboard, and game controller input!

title: Slot Fever
description: Slot Fever is the new and realistic slot game on Steam. Play the classic slot, trade your winnings or unlock bonuses. It's fun, addictive and challenging. Download it today and see for yourself!

title: Paranormal Home Invaders
description: Turn the undead restless as you recklessly disturb their place of rest. Invite yourself and your friends into the homes of scary ghouls is hope that you can return safely and earn your minimum wage ghost hunting reward to feed your loved ones.

title: I'm a Rocker!
description: You are playing a metalhead in a post-apocalyptic point&click adventure game. Your wish is to go to one last metal concert, because who knows what tomorrow will bring. But to do that you need to create the conditions in the form of some equipment and a car.

title: Reblica
description: Reblica is a cyberpunk-style action platformer shooting game. In Ark, a city full of chaos and crime, become the mercenary Bianna, defeat various enemies and complete quests.

title: Clash Of Empires
description: "Clash of Empires" is a real-time strategy game where you start from scratch and build your empire into a superpower. Make strategic decisions to overcome other empires. Manage your resources, grow your economy, and expand your country.

title: Hexaflip
description: Dive into a world of retro-futuristic aesthetics and high-voltage gameplay in this innovative turn-based strategy game. Every turn unfolds with intriguing possibilities as players combine moves, creating unique and complex strategies on the electrifying hexagonal battlefield.

title: Challenge N°1
description: The hardest platform game ever. Climb to the top before you drown

title: The Legend of Sebb Linus
description: Slip into the role of Sebb Linus, a former NCF agent, and sneak into enemy bases undetected. Stay undetected so as not to raise the alarm. Experience the old-school stealth genre.

title: BlinDead
description: Step into the darkness of "blindDead," a first-person horror game where you play as a blind person trapped in a haunted mansion filled with malevolent plush dolls. Use sound to navigate and survive, uncovering the mystery behind the dolls while evading death at every turn.

title: Pinballtoon
description: Pinballtoon is a Pinball game.

title: Panik
description:
Don’t panic!
PANIK is a puzzle game where you have to guide different characters to the goal. Sounds easy... but, can you manage it without panicking?

The panikers are scared and can’t move!
Find out how to calm these creatures and guide them to safety. Complete over 100 levels spread across 8 unique worlds and uncover all the challenges.

Meet the panikers!
Have you seen the one wearing a crown? What about the one with the magician’s hat? Or the robot? There’s even a ninja! Each one has unique abilities to help (or not) you solve each puzzle.
