description: This is a indie runner game based on geometry dash, in the game are 7 levels, Feel good, Firefly, My heart and more. The most of the levels have ncs songs so if you are a youtuber you wont have any probrem wirh the songs. In the game you have to collect coins in all levels.

title: Cubethon
description: This is a puzzle game

title: Dark Color
description: This is a casual game where players use directional keys to control character movement

title: Color Splash: Predators
description: Color Splash: Predators is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable predators and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful predators paintings.

title: Area 19
description: First Person Sci Fi Horror Game. Set within a confidential Underground Facility, Navigate through this Abandoned Complex, Discover Government Experiments, Alien Beings, and the haunting aftermath of the Roswell Crash.

title: Astral Vangard
description: Pilot your Vangard and battling against various enemies and bosses. Astral Vangard is a casual game with rogue-like elements in a futuristic world filled with Mecha. You can choose their own Vangard with different start weapon and characteristics, improving their abilities as they advance.

title: LiveMeat
description: This is a first person single player horror adventure game. You need to sneak or run in the scene to avoid monsters, search for resources to survive, and find a way to leave.

title: Cracking the Stone
description: Enter the life of a boy experiencing tragedy for the first time, the burden of his parents' hopes & dreams, and the struggle to let his emotions in. Deflect the negative emotions coming from outside forces while trying to juggle the ins and outs of childhood, puberty, and relationships.

title: Space Survivor
description: Space Survivor is a space-themed rogue-like game. Piloting and upgrading spaceships, recruiting crew members, recruit wingmen, constructing space station defense systems, and defending the space station.

title: Gas Gas Rocket!
description: Gas Gas Rocket! is an action-packed game that puts you in control of a rocket hurtling through space on an unusual and dangerous route

title: Bump in the Night
description: You are trapped in a terrible dream. Observe your surroundings carefully and discern whether you are truly in your own home, or if you are experiencing a waking nightmare.

title: The Outlast Trials: Deluxe Edition
description: Experience the mind-numbing horror of Outlast, this time with friends.

title: Classified: France '44 - Deluxe Edition
description: Command an elite team of allied special operators in Nazi-occupied France wreaking havoc in the run up to D-Day in this ambitious turn-based tactics game. Take on the might of Germany's war machine and launch daring raids in occupied territory. Can you do enough to ensure Allied victory?

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Supporter II Upgrade
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed
description: Embark on an pizza-fueled journey with Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello and Michelangelo to battle an all-new wave of havoc-wreaking mutants as you join forces with familiar faces in thrilling missions across the streets of NYC!

title: The 257th Element
description: In 2032, Tokyo scientists unveil Araraginium, the 257th element, capable of materializing matter and bringing back the deceased as Araragi Humans. Masakazu Tokimune, a Japanese high school student, grapples with daily life's blend of humor, intrigue, and love.

title: Colorful
description: Minimalistic 2D shooter

title: Pokémon: A Farfetch'd Story
description:
Farley the Galarian Farfetch'd is lost after an unexpected storm!
Will Farley solve this weather problem in the Alto region and perhaps find his way home?...

title: Ascii Sector
description:
Ascii Sector is a free space combat/exploration/trading game for Windows, Mac OS X and Linux. You start with a simple spaceship and can then accept missions or trade goods to earn enough money to upgrade your ship or buy a new one.

You can engage in deadly fights both in space, on the ground and on board spaceships, and using the Ascii Sector scripting language, you can create your own quests for the game or have fun with other players' quests.

title: Yewdow
description:
Place the arrow, change the direction of the car, and pass all the flags to clear the game.

If the car goes off-screen or hits a rock, it is a failure.

If the car hits a wall, it will flip, but the wall will disappear.

title: Harmonia: Full HD Edition
description: Set in a war-torn world in the distant future, the sci-fi kinetic novel "Harmonia" follows a mechanical boy and a human girl as they find their way to each other's hearts. Key's 15th anniversary title is back with full voice and FHD resolution, including the main character!

title: The 7th Circle: Endless Nightmare Update
description:
Endless Nightmare was an update released with Gamera Interactive as part of their ReLaunch publishing program for indie games.

Along with bug fixes and quality of life improvements the update added the inferno difficulty mode and 4 post-game dungeons. The additional dungeons offer unique challenges like random dungeon modifiers or an endless mode.

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Legends of the Zone Trilogy
description: A bundle of the first three S.T.A.L.K.E.R. games released on consoles for the first time.

title: Orion Haste
description: Run and gun through 7 levels of alien-infested mayhem to save mankind from annihilation! Shoot enemies with powerful weapons, defeat colossal bosses, and even race to beat your best time in this nostalgic platform shooter. As a human soldier stationed on a military fort in outer space, you must answer the distress signal emanating from a nearby planet. It’s time to channel your inner heroic retro game commando and obliterate the alien horde!

title: Focus Tower
description: Are you brave enough to climb the Focus Tower?

title: Halo 3: Combat Evolved
description:
Halo 3: Combat Evolved is a mod for Halo 3: ODST that re-creates the Halo: Combat Evolved Multiplayer and Campaign experiences within Halo 3: ODST.

The goal of this project is to remake every single Campaign and Multiplayer level from Halo: Combat Evolved.

title: Home of the Yokai
description: Home of the Yokai is a creature collecting Eastern fantasy RPG featuring an expansive world filled with rich stories and unique Yokai. Tasked to uncover a mysterious evil, you embark on a journey with your Yokai, forming new friendships, engage in intense battles, and face countless challenges!

title: Goals
description: GOALS is a fast, responsive football game built for pure skill, real competition, and a global community. Gameplay first, free to play, crossplay and unique players. No excuses - just football.

title: Zerlizan: The Shadow of Crime
description: On a barren planet, lacking resources and marked by harsh living conditions, you find yourself in the role of a young intelligence officer on the outskirts of civilization. In a disciplined society, rooted in a feudalistic system of government and deeply committed to the concept of honor, you are assigned the mission to investigate a possible murder in a impoverished and desertic village...

title: Hearts of Iron IV: Trial of Allegiance
description: Explore alternate WWII histories in "Trial of Allegiance" for Hearts of Iron IV. Lead South American nations like Argentina, Brazil, or Chile. Build a superpower or join global blocs, using regional resources and manpower for a unique, glorious future.

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 28
description:
The map service has been updated to closely reflect regional preferences.
Introducing PUBG's first electric vehicle. Ride the new 6-seater Pico Bus and discover the unique charm of electric vehicles as you hit the roads of Rondo! Explore new ways to jump, strengthen teamwork, and have a bit more fun with our new vaulting features.

title: Pipe Escape
description: A 2D puzzle game with a spin! Make your way through obstacle courses of pipes, water streams and bats as fast as you can whilst spinning out of control.

title: Idle Fairy Fantasy
description: Class dark brush game, equipment driven, there are combat AIDS, liver can be placed

title: Eldritch Climb: A Cursed Ascent
description:
Get to the heart of a mysterious mountain by swinging and climbing in this Roguelike Platformer. Gain eyes through your journey to reveal the horrifying and challenging altered versions of levels. Keep on trying with the aid of crazy items that both help you navigate and fight your way to the top.

There are Lovecraftian Horrors waiting to be unveiled... Will you chose to keep your sanity or will you accept the Mountain's lure...

Can you hear the calling?

title: Let's Patiti!
description: "Let's Patiti!" is a multiplayer party game that supports 2-4 players and can be played online or locally. In the game, you take on the role of an adorable little cat, engaging in a game of chase and cunning competition with your "Meow Meow" friends or AI in the "Meow Meow Forest".

title: Panzer Corps 2: Frontlines - Bulge
description: Bulge introduces players to the first downloadable content, immersing them in a dynamic and engaging narrative battlefield that unfolds during the epic Battle of the Bulge, starting a few days before the fateful date of December 16th, 1944

title: Super Math Saga
description: Super Math Saga is an educational platformer game that combines adventure and math, designed to help players improve their math arithmetic in a fun way. Work your way through levels dodging enemies, climbing platforms, and solving math questions. Beat all the levels to face the final boss!

title: The Dream Within
description: A pixel-graphics open world survival craft RPG, where players are locked in a deep dream world, survive and rescue yourself in this unstable world, forage, hunt, mine, and build up shelters. Find a way to escape.

title: Firespike
description: How many Waves can you survive? Firespike is an wave survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements. You play an rifleman and defeat the hordes of skeletons that come each wave. Each Wave gets progressively more difficult.

title: Endless Halo
description: This is a military competition experience game with a super large realistic map

title: Blue Rain
description: This is a casual game with a beautiful appearance in the game background.

title: Everloop
description: You are trapped in an endless hallway. Observe your surroundings carefully to reach your destiny.

title: DriftCE: Toyota Supra MK4
description: The Toyota Supra MK4 is the first DLC released in DRIFTCE - bringing into the game one of the most iconic and remarkable drifting cars ever created by Toyota. Now it's time to show off the world what you're made of - see you on the track!

title: Dusty the Lazy Cat
description: Dusty the Lazy Cat is a puzzle game where the main character Dusty goes through different worlds and levels. He must also deal with enemies and solve puzzles.

title: AfroCobra
description: A side scrolling action love letter to Kung Fu Master / Spartan X. Jump, dodge, and kick your way through a flood of increasingly challenging enemies and stage bosses.

title: The Devil is in the Details
description: You're trapped in hell, and the only way out is to beat the devil at its own game. With the help of a mysterious entity known only as 'The Arbiter,' navigate through ominous surroundings and place talismans on cursed objects while trying to survive the many traps and foes lurking in the shadows.

title: Cubix
description: Cubix is an exciting game with challenging jumps and puzzles. Embark on an adventure where every step is taken with deliberation, and every level is filled with incredible challenges. Relive the thrill of this platformer!

title: Lobby 2
description: Play as Fallenshadow by taking on the form of 12 girls and access 70 perks to help you fight off your husbands.

title: Exit the Museum
description: Exit the museum is a game highly inspired by "Exit 8". You are the security guard of a museum and have to go through nine appearingly similar rooms. There is a ~30% chance of nothing beeing wrong in comparison to the first "Showroom".

title: Barbotine
description: An atmospheric horror micro-game that touches on topics of anxiety, isolation, body image and obsessive habits with a surreal PSX aesthetic.

title: Buckshot Arena
description: Play Russian Roulette in western setting with a shotgun loaded with live and blank shells. Use items to gain a tactical advantage. Fight against friends or random people at the same table of up to 8 people and become the last survivor with full pockets of money.

title: Backrooms: The Exit
description: Backrooms: The Exit is a single-player adventure game based on theme of backrooms.Inside the game you will need to avoid all threatening entities and find the cutscenes (exits) for each level, and perhaps many unexpected ways out of a level.

title: Brick Breaker Pro
description: Brick Breaker Pro offers classic arcade fun with a modern twist! Break bricks, set high scores, and unlock achievements in this vibrant and addictive game.

title: Sword of the King: The Classic of Mountains and Seas
description: This is an action adventure game set in the context of Chinese classical mythology. The game incorporates a unique mechanism of sword flight, allowing players to freely soar in the air. Players need to master various sword techniques, attack accurately, and move flexibly to defeat enemies.

title: Looper Tactics: Tower and Sea
description: In Tower and Sea DLC, you will unlock the Human race cards, featuring the new hero , along with new cards, treasures, keywords, and challenging dungeons. Explore exciting gameplay elements in this expansion!

title: MedCom Origin
description: MedCom Origin is a story about russian city in which the pathogen outbreak occurred. PMCs shoot people right on the streets of the city, parks and squares are turned into warehouses for corpses Welcome to the city, welcome to the hell.

title: Burning Ass
description: It is a multiplayer platformer set in a post-apocalyptic world full of mysteries, where water is the most valuable resource. If you are an hardcore player, bypass all the traps and be the first to get it! Blood, Gore, Fun!

title: Street Cleaner Simulator
description: Have you ever dreamed of cleaning the streets? This game is for you

title: NoName
description: NONAME is a strategy, puzzle battler with tons of tactics to win once and for all. We invite you to enter a unique game world that requires logic and wits!

title: Jusfaslex
description: JUSFASLEX is a short kinetic visual novel about a dreamy boy who strives to create a society in a different dimension while struggling to connect to others.

title: Sigils
description: Sigils is a stylized Action Strategy Magic Cards adventure where you create powerful sigil guardians and grow stronger as you progress through the treacherous environment.

title: Super Kye
description: **Super Kye** is a puzzle adventure with unique challenges and a level editor. Navigate mazes, solve puzzles, and unlock levels in a game where strategy meets creativity.

title: Marie's Travel
description: "The Traveller: Maries" is a highly interactive search and puzzle development game.

title: Beware the Depths
description: Get in. Get Loot. Get out. Countless misguided souls have delved into the unknown Depths. Some seek riches, others, long-lost arcane secrets, and for a few: heroic glory for the sake of mankind. No matter what it is that you seek - if you want to stay alive, always remember to Beware the Depths.

title: Phenom Overdrive
description: A space adventure across colorful and abstract environments with simple controls and mechanics. Featuring precise, physics based, action. Sometimes a fast-paced thrill. Sometimes a slightly methodic thinker. Sometimes, even, a rage inducing dread. Always exhilarating.

title: Hidden Cats In Breeze Village
description: Find cute cats in Breeze Village. Can you find them all? Meow Meow...Kittens are calling you！

title: Platformer
description: Explore a new world, traverse randomly generated landscapes, fight monsters, dig for materials, craft equipment, find treasure and trinkets to increase your strength, build a house to protect yourself at night, dig deep to find greater challenges, unique weapons, and more!

title: PixelCaves
description: A Game where you need to run as fast as you can.

title: Deepwell
description: Deepwell is a story-driven adventure game, about a small town surrounding a giant mystery hole.

title: Beats of Betrayal
description: Beats of Betrayal is an adventure game with roguelike mechanics and rhythm-based combat. Explore dungeons, gain skills and grow stronger to defeat challenging bosses and unlock the secrets surrounding the 'Power of the Waves'!

title: Hidden Clues 2: Miami
description: The murders are rampant in Miami! Follow the clues to crack the cases and arrest the killers!

title: Outflow
description: Experience Atlas’s journey in the future world to save his planet. Beat the enemies with unique mechanics and explore a huge open world in this action RPG.

title: Backrooms: Last Room
description: Experience the unknown world of utility rooms through a VHS camera, you will have to feel all the fear and anxiety of loneliness, plunging deeper and deeper into the world of utility rooms behind the scenes In search of that very, cherished, last room

title: FoxyRush
description: FoxyRush is an exciting and exciting adventure that will appeal to all fans of foxes, platformers, runners and puzzles!

title: Repterra
description: Repterra is a base-building survival game set in a world overrun by dinosaurs. Fend off massive hordes while building your colony. Manage resources and grow your army to survive in this dino-infested land.

title: Statecraft: Corrupted Democracy
description: Statecraft is a game that adds humor to political party management. In the atmosphere of the 70s and 80s, shape your country, defeat your opponents, come to power. Fight, stage a coup, make allies. Statecraft invites you to the exciting and corrupt world of politics.

title: Crypt Crawler
description: Descend 16 monster-filled levels to close the gate to the Underworld in this top-down tower defense dungeon crawler. Gather resources, discover blueprints, and build defensive towers to slice, dice, zap, and explode undead hordes. Play solo or 2-4 player local co-op.

title: All You Can Take
description: Ever dreamed of becoming rich overnight, but don't fancy doing all that pesky hard work? You have one night to loot as much as you can from a house - just don't wake the owner! A 1-4 player physic-based stealth-robbery game.

title: Tomboy: Sex in the Forest
description: You are an ordinary programmer John. Your life revolves entirely around computers, but today, your favorite tomboy invites you to spend a weekend outdoors with her. How lucky?!

title: Summonsters
description: Summonsters is a roguelike auto-battler game where you buy summons and combine artifacts to survive against oncoming enemies. Utilize summons that fight on your behalf to defeat bosses and elites. To ensure survival, strategically combine artifacts to forge powerful legendary artifacts.

title: Astral Arena
description: Create & Combat mystical creatures known as Astrals in this Monster Tamer Roguelike with unique Real Time Combat!

title: Grid Warriors: Battles
description: Roguelike auto-battler where you manage a shared grid inventory, equip heroes, and forge uniquely shaped gear. Adapt your loadout to maximize bonuses, explore diverse modes—including friend challenges—and face evolving, handcrafted enemies in auto-combat.

title: White Redemption
description: An adventure game that can be played with a picture book feel, without text in the game.

title: Relationship Anarchy
description: Investigate procedurally generated hidden relationships in a casual mystery game. Explore, find clues, deduce, infer, solve the puzzle, and unravel the true meaning.

title: Fancyland
description: After breaking in to an abandoned indoor amusement park, finding clues and solving puzzles, you soon realize that your investigation is not just a search for answers, but a desperate struggle for survival against a sinister force that lurks within.

title: Rubbings
description: Rubbings is a Chinese folklore horror puzzle game. Four unbelievable topiaries follow each other like shadows, and four creepy stories come to mind in the middle of the night.

title: Aurans
description: Aurans is a kinetic visual novel, meaning it is linear and with no choices. It is a story about coming of age, learning to believe in yourself, and finding out what really matters to you. Everything is fully hand drawn, and is the first visual novel project of Pixelsplosion Studios.

title: Pixel Pete
description: Pixel Pete is an action-packed platformer game where you play as the intrepid Pixel Pete. Armed with a trusty FISH GUN, additional weaponry, and a talking cardboard cutout that only he can see and hear, as he embarks on a mission to collapse the multiverse and find his way back home.

title: Cats of the Ming Dynasty
description: Explore the ancient city of Suzhou during the Ming Dynasty and find the delightful cats!

title: This Is No Cave
description: A one-click parkour game in space. Zoom through intricate levels using your suit's thrusters and grapple hook, all while evading colossal alien worms.

title: Asteroid Drift
description: Asteroid Drift is a challenging spaceship piloting arcade game. Success is all about controlling your momentum and inertia. Don't explode, and go faster and faster to earn higher medals.

title: The Lord of Time
description: You find yourself on a strange planet known as Earth and must follow the orders of the Zenti.

title: Crab Attack
description: Hop on a flying crab and go on an adventure that blends exploring intricate branching stages with blistering shoot 'em up action. Gather upgrade materials, escape with the goods, discover hidden areas, and take down 15 unique bosses to save Crater City.

title: My Grandpa's Haunted House
description: My Grandpa's Haunted House is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a girl named Emily who has returned to her grandpa's house from abroad only to find out that her grandpa passed away and his spirit got trapped in the house by a Demon.

title: I am the Law
description: A brutal blend of turn-based tactics and roguelike. Take on the role of an executioner, grab crime by the throat with the hand of the law... and smash it! Because you are the law!

title: Korga's Arena
description: We combined a Roguelite Deckbuilder, a Turn-Based RPG, and a bloodthirsty orc battle-mage, to create Qrena! Craft your Deck, enhance your Weapons, and forge your Gladiator Emblem to customize your playstyle.

title: Xetanon
description: Xetanon is a short puzzle game, where you are testing the soon to be released Electricity 3.0.

title: Up & Down
description: Navigate through a limitless survival challenge, "Jump or Fly" to avoid the never-ending obstacles to beat your personal high score in an unlimited and exhilarating gaming experience!

title: Cubon
description: Cubon is a casual platform and puzzle game where you have to find your place in the world. Jump, open doors, and find your way through each level. But watch out! Everywhere you go, you'll leave a trace behind you, making it impossible for you to go back to the same place again.

title: Sea and Adventure
description: sea and Adventure is a game with platform jumping adventure and strategic sea battle gameplay as its core. It has some difficulty getting started, but it can really improve your abilities

title: Cryptic Escape
description: Monsters are taking hard earned dwarven treasure, and the dwarves have had enough. You are chosen are their champion, and are sent into the dungeons to recover your treasure, problem is... No one taught you how to fight the monsters, so your best option is to sneak by, and hope they don't catch you.

title: Eden Crafters
description: Eden Crafters is a solo or co-op open-world survival, crafting, and factory-building game where you transform a hostile planet into a habitable haven for humanity. Build, automate, and terraform. Control the climate, create a breathable atmosphere, and turn toxic lakes into water: shape a new world!

title: Jigsaw Puzzle World: Asian Food
description: Add 20 new puzzles to your Jigsaw Puzzle World game.

title: Sleight of Hand
description: Infiltrate a hardboiled, rain-slicked city of taboo, where ritual magic and cursed artefacts set apart those with power from those without. Sleight of Hand is a 3rd-person Stealth-Action Deckbuilder about taking down the coven you used to run with.

title: Creatures of Ava
description: Let your empathy guide you as you play an exciting action-adventure, creature-saver game. Understand and tame the creatures of Ava and let them lead you through a variety of ecosystems – all in the hopes of saving the planet from a life-consuming infection.

title: The Sinking City 2
description: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

title: Monster Jam Showdown
description: To deliver the feeling and excitement of mastering 1,500 horsepower mechanical machines, Monster Jam Showdown will feature arcade gameplay endowed with comprehensive and customisable driving aids.

title: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 4 Golden EX BGM Set
description:
Persona 3 Reload: Persona 4 Golden EX BGM Set is exclusive to the Persona 3 Reload: Expansion Pass and contains additional content that allows you to listen to background music from Persona 4 Golden.

Tracks include the dungeon BGMs: "Backside of the TV", "Game", "Junes Theme", "Heaven" and "Long Way" along with the battle BGMs "Revelations: Mitsuo", "The Almighty" and "Results."

Results will automatically be applied as the battle result theme when you set one of the tracks in this pack as your battle BGM. It cannot be applied individually.

title: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 5 Royal EX BGM Set
description:
Persona 3 Reload: Persona 5 Royal EX BGM Set is exclusive to the Persona 3 Reload: Expansion Pass and contains additional content that allows you to listen to background music from Persona 5 Royal.

Tracks include the dungeon BGMs "Life Will Change", "Beneath the Mask", "Kichijoji 199X", "Gentle Madman" and "I believe" along with the battle BGMs "Keeper of Lust", "Blooming Villain" and "Victory."

Victory will automatically be applied as the battle result theme when you set one of the tracks in this pack as your battle BGM. It cannot be applied individually.

title: Persona 3 Reload: Episode Aigis
description:
After unravelling the mysteries of the Dark Hour, fighting epic battles through Tartarus, and all the unforgettable events of Persona 3 Reload, the S.E.E.S. members find themselves trapped in a never-ending March 31st.

When an unfamiliar android, Metis, suddenly appears at the dorm along with the mysterious "Abyss of Time", the team works together to uncover the cause of this strange fate..

title: Persona 3 Reload: Expansion Pass
description: Dive deeper into the world of Persona 3 Reload with this expansion pass featuring new costumes, BGM, and extended story content Episode Aigis -The Answer-.

title: A-Ressha De Ikou 4: Map Construction & Power Up Kit
description: Adds the Map Construction mode as well as some new locations.

title: Abyss X Zero
description: Explore an expansive world in this 3D Metroidvania with enormous dungeons and stylish combat. Take control of two different characters, fated to battle each other: Codename A and Codename Z, both legendary heroes with unique abilities that change how you fight and interact with the environment.

title: H Girl 3
description: Swap tiles to reveal 5 characters with NSFW jiggle physics images. Relax with easy puzzles or challenge yourself with expert difficulty level. Completed puzzles can be viewed later in the gallery. Swap, match and have love!

title: Search All: Tools
description: Is a hidden object game in which you need to find all the tools (mainly construction tools) in a large location. The tools will be located in a variety of places, from the most prominent to the most barely noticeable places

title: Search All: Lollipops
description: is a hidden object game in which you need to find all the lollipops in a large location. The lollipops will be located in a variety of places, from the most prominent to barely noticeable places

title: Search All: Snakes
description: This is a game in the “search for objects” genre, in which you need to find all the snakes in a large location. Snakes will be located in a variety of places, from the most visible to barely noticeable places

title: Search All: Dogs
description: This is a game in the "search for objects" genre, in which you need to find all the dogs in a large location. The dogs will be located in a variety of places, from the most visible to barely noticeable places

title: Search All: Mouses
description: Is a hidden object game in which you need to find all the mice in a large location. The mice will be located in a variety of places, from the most prominent to barely noticeable places. The entire game location looks lively because of the animation elements

title: Bubballs
description: Click on bubballs to pop them. Get your pop-streak high to earn a medal. Clear stages to level up and get more bubballs. Alternatively, use the main bubball to pop the rest and clear stages to earn medals.

title: Fox Golf
description: Do we do a “little” activity? The Fox Golf game opens up a new vision of the sport of golf.

title: NodeRunner
description: Jump from Node to Node while surviving the Chasers onslaught. Keep moving, Keep Upgrading, and don't get terminated.

title: Spliti
description: Play as a scientist who is the victim of a failed experiment. Free his soul trapped inside an energy cube in this puzzle platformer. Experience the adventure in local co-op with the scientist's young granddaughter.

title: Love and Crime
description: Visual romantic anime novel in the otome genre - a thriller with an exciting detective plot. Take up the investigation! Find your love! Your choices influence the plot and actions of the characters! 7 novel endings!

title: Taser Gun
description: Take out the enemies with the taser gun

title: Hexa Puzzle Block
description: Heхa Puzzle Block is an engaging puzzle that will impress all lovers of logic games and brain teasers!

title: Highway Getaway: ZigZag Blocky Car
description: Highway Getaway: ZigZag Blocky Car is a straightforward Infinite Runner game where you must collect money and drive your truck as far as possible.

title: Escape from Andromeda
description: Escape from Andromeda is an overhead 2D sci-fi spaceship looter shooter based in a procedurally generated galaxy. In Escape from Andromeda, every planet is a level, and every star is a part of your story.

title: My Drug Cartel
description: My Drug Cartel is a drug plantation management game with basebuilding and combat elements. Expand your plantation, hire workers, research new drugs and construct buildings. But be ready to face a heavy response by law enforcement by hiring guards, buying weapons and ammunition and building defences.

title: AzuTower
description:
AzuTower is a Pizza Tower mod that replaces some of the characters with characters from the anime Azumanga Daioh.
Starring Chiyo Mihama as Peppino, Ayumu "Osaka" Kasuga as Gustavo, and more!

title: Adelie: Chasing Pavements
description:
Survive being chased by a rolling snowball with a crafty penguin.

Pickup, combine, and throw objects to delay the snowball’s inevitable descent! Throwing objects at the snowball chips away at its continually growing volume, while throwing them at other objects can craft tools to better suit your survival.

title: Rocket League: Season 14
description:
DIVE INTO A FRESH AQUADOME ARENA IN ROCKET LEAGUE SEASON 14 !

Rocket League Season 14 submerges players in aquatic ambience. Kick off in a new version of AquaDome and deck out your car in maritime items !

title: Fantasy Tower Defense Ultimate
description: Fantasy Tower Defense Ultimate - an exhilarating game where players will immerse themselves in a world of adventure, filled with mysteries and dangers.

title: Cube Stack Ultimate
description: Cube Stack Ultimate is an incredible game of stacking cubes that provides endless enjoyment.

title: Shockman Collection Vol. 1
description: ~ Cyber Citizen Shockman + Cyber Citizen Shockman 2: A New Menace ~

title: Bottle Tap
description: Use your intellect to discover various ways to collect stars using a bottle cap on intricate and unique levels.

title: DACHStudio Jigsaw Puzzle Box
description: Beautifully drawn artworks from the DACHstudio members for you to puzzle. Multiple difficulties from 4x4 to 28x26 pieces for everyone to enjoy.

title: Mister 9
description: Look for irregularities in the house where the uncles live. Irregulars are the enemy. For the sake of world peace, shoot without mercy.

title: Hotdog Runner

description: Transform into a mysterious black cat, navigate through various traps in the shadows, and find the treasure in the ancient castle.

title: These Thieving Hearts
description: A wealthy benefactor. A master lockpick. A magical bodyguard. A trusted ally. A skillful rival. All of them are out to steal priceless treasures. Which one of them will steal your heart?

title: The Raptured
description: The Raptured is a TPS horror survival video game that follows Fletcher in Still Pines, overrun by apparitions that stalk the player. Find out what happened to the town, and try not to be consumed by the treacherous hordes of the apparitions.

title: The Recurrence
description: Explore an open-ended nightmare using paranormal equipment to survive an onslaught of evil spirits that await your return.

title: The Red Button
description: Resist the urge to press the button and do not uncover the secrets that may lie within its crimson facade. The choice is yours: to press or not to press.

title: There's No Dinosaurs 2
description: We are back with “There’s No Dinosaurs 2” - a relaxing hidden object point & click game in which your objective is to locate randomly placed dinosaurs amongst nine brand new cozy environments with beautifully hand-drawn graphics. Can you find all the dinosaurs?🦖

title: The One
description:
The One' came about when they sought to create a game that focused on a narrative, seeking to keep the player absorbed in the story and exploration of the world.

The main concept from which this idea was born was a simple pen. From this came the mechanics, which mostly revolve around using the feathers, and the main theme, angels and their wings.

Due to the scope of the project, it will be separated into two iterations. The initial idea is the realisation of the first iteration for the delivery of the TFM, while the second iteration will remain in a conceptual form that can be realised from the first iteration.

The first iteration includes the entire 3D open world that the player will explore in search of the elements that will give him access to the story and improve his skills. The second iteration will transform the upgrade items into "portals" that will transport the player to 2D arcade-like levels with side-scrolling platforming, where they will have to progress through different obstacles in order to get that upgrade item.

title: The Mystery of Blackthorn Castle 2
description: Travel back in time to Blackthorn Castle in this much larger game sequel. Break the dark wizard's spells and make deals with a bridge troll!

title: The Night Jackals Vol. 1
description: "The Night Jackal" is a captivating game where you experience tension as you discover someone breaking into your phone through your security camera. In this game, you'll confront your fears with contemporary technology invading privacy.

title: The Nightmare Accord
description: A single player or coop game experience that pits players in the world of nightmares as a customizable child conquering their fears!

title: The Nightwatch
description: Fight your way through hordes of monsters in this highly customisable 2D survival roguelite. Explore, unearth and make the most out of the upgrades, talent trees and items available to push through the attack. What will you find in the dark floors of the wizard tower, and will you save the night ?

title: The Multiverse Trilogy
description: Introducing The Multiverse Trilogy. The prequel to Alternate Universe

title: The Mosquito Gang
description: Do you want to drink blood and buzz forever? Or to swat an annoying insect with one left hand? Dive into the eternal confrontation between human and mosquito in The Mosquito Gang!

title: The Monster War
description: Embark on an epic journey as a knight in a fantasy war. Experience Tower Defense, Side Scroller and Casual Puzzle modes all in one thrilling adventure. Defend the kingdom from the monster invasion, push back the threat, and conquer their bases of operations to emerge victorious from the war!

title: The Monarch: First Light
description: Will you be the savior to purify this land? The Monarch is a lane-defense game where you control a monarch, expand your kingdom, and defend against evil by strategically managing gold resources, recruiting diverse units, and exploring a world filled with mythical threats.

title: The Mines of White Label
description: Smash the materials. Sign the admin. Sell the company. Your next customer wants a mine that produces environmentally friendly oil spills...

title: The Midnight Walkers
description: Fight, Scavenge, and Extract in The Midnight Walkers, a hardcore FPS game with deadly zombies, dangerous players, and valuable loot. Craft weapons, armor, and consumables; trade items; and maintain your hideout. Escape Liberty Grand Center mega complex, and thrive...or die and lose everything.

title: Foreign Sun
description: Your choices reshape a living city. Explore a sprawling metropolis, wield mysterious powers, and uncover the secrets of the Eternal Lighthouse. Your decisions will make a world of difference.

title: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients
description: Party role-playing game. You control a squad of characters moving through an open game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

title: The Magician Of Justice
description: A personally created numerical RPG mini game，The game is full of exploration and randomness, collecting various abilities such as spirit stones, scrolls, weapons, etc. by finding treasure chests or eliminating monsters, and each battle has a different experience

title: The Lost Village: Fantasy
description: The sky shattered, and a group of folks who called themselves adventurers fell into this world. Their personalities are quirky yet passionately fiery, seemingly always filled with curiosity and hope. Currently, these folks are exploring the entirety of the cultivation world.

title: The Liminal Space
description: "The Liminal Space" is a thrilling horror adventure game. Explore surreal landscapes, solve puzzles, and escape from terrifying monsters. Are you ready to face the challenges? Enter "The Liminal Space" now!

title: The Lightless World
description: The Lightless World is a PC reverse horror action RPG co-op game set in a cosmic horror universe where players control demonic god protagonists.

title: The Legends of Maui
description: Defy gods and trick great spirits as you travel Aotearoa as the trickster Maui, in a time of magic. Based on the legends of Maui as well as several other myths and folklore from New Zealand.

title: The Implant
description: This is my first relatively big game. You are the brain of a huge narketing company that helps their clients to achieve their sales goals. And you do it in a creative way creating newsbreaks, opinion leaders and shows. Simulating life as you see it should be. And it works because of the implant plan

title: The Island: Escape Room
description: You wake up on an unknown island, alone and without help. Will you be able to solve the mysteries it contains? Will you find out how you got there? Could you escape from The Island?

title: The Jester's Revenge
description: Discover a humorous, supernatural adventure with a jester's ghost seeking revenge on the king. Use spectral powers to haunt and vex in a kingdom blending comedy with gothic horror. Become the master of spectral pranks in this unique, ghostly rebellion.

title: The Jusou 3
description: Why was that cursed nest born... A story tracing back even further, 25 years to its very origins. Exploration inside the school is done using a 3D map! Brace yourself and advance through the corridors swirling with terror!

title: The Krampus
description: A realistic third-person horror set in the 1800s. Play as brave children escaping Krampus. Navigate diverse levels, including Krampus' workshop and a haunting Victorian home. Choose to brave the nightmare solo or team up with a friend in online co-op. Run, hide, and find your way to survival

title: The Lands of Hyberian
description: Welcome to The Lands of Hyberian. The kingdom of Tydrall is ruled by the king and queen who have claimed all The Lands of Hyberian. It is up to the brave knights of Tydrall to answer the kings summon! Prepare your training and bring your wisdom as the king seeks an audience with you.

title: Killer Santa 1990
description: Step into a chilling 1990s horror story. After returning to your late grandfather's old house, you uncover missing people, a cursed DVD, and a murderous Santa Claus hunting you down.

title: The Last Days of Friendship Valley
description: A deckbuilding narrative RPG about conflict negotiation, goats, and impending doom. Make your own goat character, navigate arguments with cards, uncover an ancient mystery, and try to save the world.

title: The Last Stop
description: You're caught in a cycle of light and darkness in a subway car. This eerie dynamic demands memory, strategy, and swift decisions to traverse the unknown. Each moment of visibility is crucial to reach your goal: "The Last Stop".

title: The Legend of Elrian
description: The Legend of Elrian is an adventure with retro GameBoy inspired visuals. You incarnate Elrian, an Elf who has to leave his village to rescue his missing brother.

title: The Immemorial Order
description: After living in your new house for a few months, you discover the previous owners have left behind some items that were never meant to be found.

title: The Idle
description: The ultimate idle clicker game with endless possibilities and infinite fun. Passive and active income, seven currencies, interest, bets, prestige, perks and many more features are available!

title: The Hunt for the Lost Treasure 2
description: Fulfill your treasure hunt craving in this mind-teasing puzzle adventure on a newly discovered archipelago of islands in the Pacific Ocean not far from the Galápagos Islands.

title: The Haunting of Joni Evers
description: The Haunting of Joni Evers is a psychologically thrilling first-person strollplayer set in the small town of Harvest, Oklahoma. Confront, examine, and reexamine Joni’s memories in this emotional story of estranged family underscored by a malevolent, interdimensional haunting.

title: The hardest game in the universe 2: New DLC
description: 3 new stages in the new DLC of the most impossible game in the universe

title: The hardest game in the universe 2: Final DLC
description: Prepare for the ultimate test of skill and determination with the "Ultimate Challenge" DLC for "The Hardest Game in the Universe 2"! This expansion takes the difficulty to unprecedented heights, introducing over 20 new levels designed to push even the most seasoned players to their limits.

title: The Green Room Experiment: Episode 3
description: You're locked in a dream and you need to wake up. Unravel the mysteries of this surreal exploration series and immerse yourself in a dreamlike, strange and solitary universe.

title: The Great Rebellion
description: The Great Rebellion is a cyberpunk 2D sidescrolling run'n'gun roguelite using mouse/twinstick-shooter controls. It features randomly generated levels, multiple difficulty modes (including optional permadeath), a dynamic soundtrack and an upgradeable player character.

title: The Great Couturier
description: Create, evolve, and compete with other players in this fashion-focused game. Can you rise from a novice to become The Great Couturier?

title: O Vagabundo
description: O Vagabundo is a short adventure game that tells the story of a boy who wakes up in his house and his mother isn't home. Not knowing what happened or how long he slept, he goes out to look for food until several things start to happen.

title: Prometheus Unbound
description: Prometheus Unbound is a 2D stealth platformer with graceful speed and machine-precision movement. Play as the monstrous machine-made-mortal,Anala. Use her unassuming human form to maneuver through a neo-gothic sprawl and transform into a volatile, electric form to hunt enemies.

title: The Enchanted Worlds
description: Three enchanted books transport you to the worlds written on their pages. In this latest adventure with Uncle Henry, he has had a secret kept for many years that he now wishes to share with you.

title: The Emperor
description: "The Emperor" is a simulation game for dynasty cultivation. In the game, as the master of the divine realm, you can work hard to conquer the world, expand your territory, and govern the world. You can also cultivate education and benefit the people. Come and establish your kingdom's hegemony.

title: The Eerie Surroundings
description: Observe your surrounding and be confident there is or is not a anomaly to progress.

title: The Dungeon: Dungeon Awaits
description: Dungeon-Dungeon is a turn-based, loot-heavy fantasy roguelike dungeon crawler. Each step forward is a dance to avoid checkmate. Every monster and weapon has a unique shape, similar to a chess piece. Make the right moves, create a unique build, and conquer the Dungeon-Dungeon!

title: The Drylands
description: The Drylands is a car-combat party-based RPG. Fight for loot and explore an ever-changing procedurally generated world as the shifting sands reveal lost secrets.

title: The Elliot Brown Case
description: A new kind of detective game where you uncover cases entirely represented with cards. Interrogate any character about ANY other card. Dissect the events that lead to Eliott Brown's demise... Then write your own thrilling investigation stories and share them to fellow detectives around the world.

title: The Farmer & the Chicken
description: Unleash the chicken's power and escape in this arcade adventure to avoid being caught by the farmer!

title: The Exile Princes
description: A story focused, old school, procedural RPG: raise your banner and bring your house to victory in the unique medieval fantasy setting of the Exile Realms. Start out in questing service, gain companions, followers, power and influence, and ultimately through strength or guile learn to rule the lands.

title: The Final Farewell
description: The Final Farewell is a cosy narrative adventure about finding peace in death, and learning to let go. As a lost ghost, befriend wayward mortals and piece together misty memories. Lay to rest the echoes of the past and discover the truth of your own demise.

title: The Circle Tales: Elvenwoods
description: The Circle Tales: Elvenwoods is a free-to-play action-adventure game where you embark on a journey to slay a god. The very first game by Studio Castor, set in a medieval high fantasy open world.

title: The Crack
description: Crack is a text adventure game that combines a profound emotional experience with elements of mystery and puzzle-solving. In this game, players embark on a journey to revisit the past, explore themselves, and uncover hidden secrets.

title: The Cyber Masquerade
description: Degenerate loner jailbreaks a stolen android.

title: The Darkness Below
description: Embark on an epic journey into "The Darkness Below", a homage to the golden era of 90's cRPGs, with grid-based movement, turn-based combat and 2.5D perspective. Wander a vast and colorful fantasy world filled with puzzles, exotic creatures, forgotten dungeons and ancient guardians.

title: The Dark Side of Ceclon
description: Jensen, the sole survivor of the Nexentia shuttle crash on the planet CECLON. Alone, light years away from all human life! You will have to face the Nocturnes, primitive creatures in order to bring back the Veka energy, humanity's only hope.

title: The Dark Story
description: Welcome to THE DARK STORY get ready for a chilling adventure in a jungle mansion. Your task: survive, explore, and escape before the horrors within engulf you. Beware of jumpscares around every corner. Can you brave the darkness and uncover the secrets within?

title: The Dark Horde
description: The Dark Horde is an exciting roguelike deckbuilder where the cost to play cards is TIME. Play your cards to summon a horde of minions and to cast powerful sorceries! Improve your defenses, acquire rare cards, level up, unlock new upgrades and then lay waste to each human settlements!

title: The Dawn Of A Flower
description: "She became a prince to survive." Historical materials of ancient Egypt Fusion fantasy romance game "The Dawn Of A Flower"

title: The Dawning Clocks of Time: Remake
description: A story of love, war and betrayal on an intergalatic scale. A epic third person shooter with both sandbox and linear story progression. Take up arms and battle for the ages, who will decide the fate for all of humanity? Now remade in HD / 4K with cinematic presentation.

title: The Apocalypse Sacrifice
description: The Apocalypse Sacrifice is a point and click adventure game with multiple endings. You take on the role of an adventurer who has lost his memory, with the only clue being a note found in his mouth. As you recover your memories, you uncover chilling secrets hidden within the town.

title: The Butler Did It
description: Battle robots, make friends, and uncover a bizarre conspiracy to avert the apocalypse in this comedy of manners and mayhem with steampunk blasters!

title: The Bright Star Of Seraph-Katis
description: The Bright Star Of Seraph-Katis is a short text adventure game. This game combines a visual novel and an "adventure mode".

title: The Black Siege
description: The Black Plague had ravaged 14th Century Europe, turning humans into carnivorous monsters that brought destruction to the continent. Your kingdom stands as the last bastion. Build your fortress, mine resources and train troops to hold out until help arrives in this builder-defense roguelike.

title: The Bibites: Digital Life
description: Explore real digital life in The Bibites! Play god as you guide your bibites on their evolutionary journey. Analyze their Neural Network brains and genetic information as they adapt to their environments. Save your favorites and test their strength in Challenge Mode!

title: The Backrooms: Descent
description: The Backrooms: Descent is a 1-4 player co-op horror experience. You are tasked with descending into the vast levels of the Backrooms which have dangerous entities while also finding evidence of previous research teams before you find your escape.

title: The Beautiful Island
description: A short visual novel about war, peace and hope. Explore a city after a devastating war. Talk to people, try to understand, try to help. The heroes of war are dead, but you can be a hero of peace!

title: The Belligerence
description: A single player game developed to differentiate itself from existing fighting games. It can be enjoyed with a feeling closest to a real fight. The right stick-based attack and walking parry system provide sensory control. There is a mode to fight cpu and belly hard is incredibly strong

title: The Berlin Apartment
description: The Berlin Apartment tells the moving stories of inhabitants of an apartment in the city of Berlin over the last 120 years in several unique, emotional episodes as a character-driven adventure game.

title: Hundred Fires: The rising of red star - Episode 2
description: Hundred Fires is an action, stealth and infiltration game with an exciting story and incredible cinematics. This is a one man infiltration mission, you alone cannot defeat the entire Soviet army, you must use your best skills to hide, sneak away from the enemy and go undetected.

title: Thong Girl: The Video Game
description: The Adventures of Thong Girl combines classic 2D beat-em-up platforming with high-scoring arena action. Help our scantily clad super heroine defeat wave after wave of roid-raging bodybuilders, antipathetic teenagers, and gun-toting gangstas. Join in the fun with Thong Girl as she works her butt off to get to the bottom of the riots plaguing Music City.

title: Nasty Zombies
description: Team up with up to 4 players and take on endless waves of Nasty Zombies in a high-intensity, movement-focused boomer shooter. Use agility and smart positioning to survive semi-procedural maps and unlock permanent upgrades like Blessings, Miracles, and cosmetics.

title: 112 Reddings Helikopter
description:
112 Reddings Helikopter is an action game that takes place in the cities of Amsterdam and Berlin. Completely remodeled to give the feeling of flying over the city in a helicopter. The player has a total of 20 missions to complete, these are dangerous missions with the ultimate goal to bring the person at risk to safety within a limited amount of time.

The fires, traffic accidents, chemical disasters, armed robbery, factory accidents, sudden heart attacks and rescues from tall buildings are some of the many situations that will occur.

title: Ether
description: Help a Space Mercenary, Ether, complete a difficult scavenging mission in an abandoned ship. Explore 4 different biomes, each with its share of dangers, and escape a swarm of mutant space bugs.

title: James Bond 007: Nightfire
description: The PC version of James Bond 007: Nightfire was developed by Gearbox Software while Eurocom developed the home console version. It is mostly the same except for the removal of driving sections used in home console versions and some other minor modifications to the single player and multiplayer modes.

title: Solar Raiders
description: Suit up, grab your guns, and embark on a cosmic heist in this fast-paced bullet-hell roguelite. Solo or with friends, your goal is to overcome enemy packed dungeons and steal the Solar Core. Raid, loot, unlock powerful skills, create unstoppable builds and prepare to die.

title: 1-Bit Explorer
description:
1-Bit Explorer is an adventure game focused on exploration where you do NOT save the world and the world does NOT need saving.

The point is to explore to your heart's content and uncover mysteries and secrets (or don't, it's up to you, really).

title: 1-Bit Halloween
description: 1-Bit Halloween focuses on a home visit that a priest makes to a family. The game is on a single map with all the rooms of the house being visible to the player (like Dogville movie, in which you could see everything that happened in different places at once).

title: 2-Bit Explorer
description: 2-Bit Explorer is a game where exploration is king. A Lovecraftian Zelda-like. Explore the labyrinth that apparently has 1 more bit than you do and find you way out of the strange reality you find yourself in. Find the one you seek...

title: Become The Moon
description: Become The Moon is a roguelike deckbuilder and auto-battler mashup where players build powerful teams of minions from a deck they construct as they play. Will you save the moon from corruption, or embrace the chaos and become it?

title: The Murder of Dale Decker
description: Use your keyboard to uncover objects located at the crime scene. Guess words by typing to recall the space around you, uncover clues and solve the murder!

title: Echo Weaver
description: Time is your greatest resource and secrets are your only upgrades. Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

title: Otter Island
description:
Inspired by various classic RPG Maker horror games, like Ib and the Witch's House

It's a warm summer day and Zachary Dove is invited to his friend Connor's summer cottage, along with their other friend, Jeremy.

They are looking forward to a relaxing day of swimming, grilling, and drinking together. Later at night, however, things start to seem strange, and quickly take a turn for the terrifying.

title: Taxi Life: A City Driving Simulator - Supporter Edition
description: Climb into the driver's seat of your car and your business, transport passengers across Barcelona and grow your company! Can you help relieve the transportation challenges of a city that never sleeps?

title: Valiant Hearts: The Collection
description: In Valiant Hearts: The Collection, find both Valiant Hearts: The Great War and Valiant Hearts: Coming Home.

title: Reveil: Funhouse Edition
description:
In addition to REVEIL, the Funhouse Edition contains the following DLCs:
- REVEIL Original Soundtrack: 14 original compositions, beautiful and haunting.
- Digital Artbook: A look behind the scenes of the game, featuring concept art and inspirations.
- Black and White Camera Filter: Use this in game for vintage horror atmosphere.
- Audio Plays: A selection of audio plays recorded with the game's voice actors, more bits and pieces from the world of REVEIL.
- Developer Commentary: Commentary by the developers to be found in-game, for even more background insights.

title: Potion Problem
description: Potion Problem is a whimsical potion making puzzler about discovery, problem solving and potions! Create potions and fulfill orders, prepare bizarre ingredients and learn the deepest secrets of the alchemists world.

title: Shovelboy: Zone X
description: Zone X is a level expansion for SHOVELBOY with a new set of 15 extremely hard levels.

title: Reign of Guilds: Black Knight
description: Continue your journey with this pack unlocking additional exclusive in-game content!

title: Shadows of Souls
description: This is an Endless Runner - Fighter game. Defeat the enemies, get upgrades with coins and prestige points, complete the levels and try to get highest score that you can in endless mode.

title: Soda Scuffle
description: A survivor game. The items in life suddenly mutate, and you will control the soda that gains special abilities to defeat one monster after another to maintain peace. Rely on your movements to avoid enemy barrage. Pick up experience to upgrade, defeat all bosses you encounter, and you will win.

title: DreamEscape
description: DreamEscape is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame where you get into Max's mind and explore his dreams and find out about him and his life.

title: Spellarium 3
description: Spellarium 3 is one of our first games in the Match 3 Puzzle genre. The keyword is 'Puzzle,' which means that sometimes (not always!) you'll complete the level faster by removing objects in the correct order.

title: Crown Wars: The Black Prince - Blood Pact Weapon Skins
description: Sometimes you need to fight fire with fire and blood with blood. Use the Order's own demonic weapons against them by equipping this weapon skin pack.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Victors and Vanquished
description: Embark on a thrilling journey with "Victors and Vanquished"! In nineteen epic scenarios, play as Ragnar Lothbrok, Oda Nobunaga, Charlemagne, and more. Your strategy and choices decide your fate: Secure your pre-order now and be prepared to conquer the battlefield!

title: Acorn Cop
description: Based on a true story, Acorn Cop is a meme game where you shoot all the acorns, but do NOT shoot any human or other living things. Enjoy and collect easter egg items. Can you do just that for 20 minutes?

title: Find Cats With Friends
description: Find Cats With Friends - gather friends, search the island for 100 mischievous cats, and bring them back in this cooperative multiplayer quest!

title: Forest Keeper 2
description: Forest Keeper 2 is a continuation of the first part of the game! Plunge back into a little adventure with the forest guardian!

title: Floppa: The Dark Forest
description: Find 8 pictures of cats and don't let Big Floppa catch you!

title: Olive
description: Play as Olive, a sprightly old lady, to collect gems and progressively fill the scene with colour in this arcade runner style game. Grow plants with the coins you collect, unlock new abilities, and collect outfits to customise your look.

title: How Heavy Are My Nuts?
description: Do your Steam friends think you're too normal? Do you need a status that'll spice up their life? Introducing "How Heavy Are My Nuts?" The Game. Have the time of your life explaining this one to your father when he inevitably walks in on you playing it.

title: Bloody Hallowfest
description: What starts as the preparation for a special Halloween night event at a summer camp turns into a nightmare when someone with a bloodied axe ends the lives of all your friends. Will you manage to escape and save yourself?

title: My Bestie is a Femboy Streamer
description: Your bestie is a Streamer. You've asked him before, but he always remains elusive on the matter...

title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert, Counterstrike and The Aftermath
description:
This compilation contains:

Command & Conquer: Red Alert (base game)
Command & Conquer: Red Alert - Counterstrike (first expansion pack)
Command & Conquer: Red Alert - The Aftermath (second expansion pack)

title: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun and Firestorm
description: The Second Tiberium War begins in this legendary sequel to the original Command & Conquer. With his forces stronger than ever, arch villain and leader of The Brotherhood of Nod - Kane - is pitched in an epic battle against the world's war machine - the Global Defense Initiative.

title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 and Yuri’s Revenge
description: The Invasion Has Begun

title: Not Alone in the Space
description: "Not Alone in the Space" is a visual novel for adults only. Young pilot Avis and his two adorable female partners explore space. What they encounter will turn their minds inside out, forcing them to break the chain of command and expose their inner desires.

title: I Commissioned Some Abstract Bunnies
description: I paid artists to hide abstract bunnies and carrots in 15 canvases. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Alone Or Together
description: Two people will work together to clear the stage.

title: Fear Faith
description: Wield your sword in the right direction to defeat challenging horrors. Try to make sense of your steps through an impossible tower that changes with your decisions while trying to survive. Prove your Faith.

title: Ichorous Moon
description: Run! Race through the corrupted streets of Türme to stop the rising of the Ichorous Moon

title: My Pretty Closet
description: Embark on a forest stroll with your grandfather, only to awaken alone in a eerie cabin. Unveil buried memories, revealing parental secrets. Confront inner demons of depression and anxiety and seek for answers and peace in this unsettling yet serene psychological horror game.

title: Nebula Nomads
description: Embark on a spacefaring odyssey in Nebula Nomads! Pilot your cargo haulers through the cosmic expanse, mastering thrust vectoring as you deliver valuable packages between space stations. Earn credits, upgrade your fleet, and explore a captivating 2.5D universe. Launch into Nebula Nomads now!

title: Symphony Stride
description: Launch powerful combos in this fast and exciting deckbuilder roguelike. Choose two characters to form a team with unique combos for each pairing and embark on a procedurally generated quest of epic proportions!

title: Martha generator
description: about 20 marthas are generated and recycled each day in the middle of the ocean

title: Udongein X2
description: Reisen is now cordially invited to Hell!

title: KindergarTen 1: No Mercy
description:
The game takes place at a kindergarten, where the player is a cleaner who discover things, which is helping in the investigation. During the day, the kindergarten is open, so every morning the children are coming, and you must clean up the whole place. The kindergarten closes at 9:00 PM which means you have to be there at 8:50 PM. The game contains 5 nights of cleaning which pay you a reward of 26$ each day. Every night while cleaning, you find more and more information, that could help you solve the mystery of the murder.
Like in any other RPG Maker games the player can control the character (the cleaner) with the arrow keys, and of course the 'enter' or 'space' keys are the action buttons (which are very important in a mystery solving game).

title: KindergarTen 2: Daddy
description:
"I don't know what happened there...
Since I was there I keep hearing strange voices
in my head.
The sounds are like some children's laugh,
and sometimes they keep saying:
"Help us"
I don't know what's going on, but I
must find it out before I get mad."

title: From Eva with Green
description: From Eva with Green is a unique atmospheric pinball game.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Goku's Next Journey
description: Experience the final episode of the DRAGON BALL Z anime, depicting Goku's long-awaited battle with Uub! How will the battle between Goku and the reincarnation of Majin Buu turn out?

title: School Hero
description: Immerse yourself in this nostalgic yet modern blend of arcade-style action and anime storytelling, as Sakura high calls for a new Hero to rise in style. Will you answer the call and save the day?

title: Glitch Blaster's Waifu
description: Welcome to 'Glitch Blaster's Waifu,' the ultimate retro-style shoot 'em up adventure! As an intrepid hacker, you find yourself pitted against a malevolent AI that has kidnapped innocent girls.

title: Daiku no Medium Megumi
description: This small game was made right soon after Daiku no Medium back in 2019 to show its ending from a different point of view.

title: Paris Simulator
description: This is a realistic real life simulator where you can walk around Paris Interested in playing a real life simulator. This game is for you 1. Walk around Paris and see the Eifel Tower. 2. Go up to the top of the Eifel tower and walk around

title: Let's Park: Bus Edition
description: Have you ever been challenged to measure your accuracy skills?

title: Flag & Country
description: Form words, gather resources, and build your team of experts ready to explore the planet.

title: Desert Special Forces
description: Captain, you have a new mission!

title: Lunatic Taxi Driver
description: Lunatic Taxi Driver is an exciting and fast-paced game that puts you in the shoes of a taxi driver who is determined to show the world what it means to be a truly exceptional driver

title: SpHero
description: You are a Sphere, you are a Hero, you are... a SpHero! Use your Spherical powers to overcome your enemies and the trials ahead. You will be able to roll faster, bounce higher, throw fireballs or be a rolling magnet! Venture in 60 hand crafted levels and defeat 6 Boxes (bosses).

title: Saltaria
description: Enter the oceanic world of Saltaria. Build, manage and expand your steam ship. Explore islands surrounded by a vast creepy ocean covering a subterranean world inspired by Jules Verne. Hunt for legendary power crystals to empower weapons or to build fantastic machines that fight or work for you.

title: Letalis
description: Letalis presents an unconventional RPG adventure, paying homage to the classics of the Game Boy era while infusing inventive gameplay, souls mechanics and unexpected twists!

title: Troy: The Soldier
description: Troy, a turn based RPG with Rougelite aspects, is a game based around your use of cash and how much you waste. With an emphasis on music and it's Gameboy-like art style, Troy acts as a playable mixtape for whoever wants to listen to some tunes as well as play a game.

title: King Must Survive
description: In the enchanted world of the Middle Ages, it's a king's struggle for survival! Equipped with top-down shooter mechanics and rogue-lite elements, you must battle against increasingly challenging waves of enemy swarms.

title: Logic Town: Country Fair
description: Step right up and experience the all the joys of Spring in Country Fair, the newest DLC for Logic Town! From thrilling rides to mouth-watering snacks, games, and competitions, there's something for everyone to enjoy in this new bumper expansion.

title: Galactic Ascendancy
description: Humanity, having mastered faster-than-light travel, discovered a distant galaxy teeming with extraterrestrial civilizations. Join Admiral Preen in his conquest of the Andromeda Galaxy. Crush the resistance and invade their worlds.

title: Dragons and Nature
description: With powerful dragons and relatively weak animals, you can easily destroy the natural ecology, but you will eventually suffer backlash. Learning to coexist may be the key to long-term survival.

title: Hypcampex
description: Hypcampex is a 2D-Platformer that embarks you on a remarkable adventure across Planet Photonus as the legendary Electrex Bolt, where he strives to acquire the Artifact of the Hypcampex and battle through the war against the malevolent Avengers of Light, the Lavengers.

title: Battlethorne: Survivors
description: Defeat the Reaper's minions as you battle through forts, forests and castles. Gather gold to upgrade your character, slay thousands of enemies and defeat the Reaper.

title: Lio
description: Unravel the story of a boy who wakes up in a mysterious world without any memories.

title: Dice-Zee!
description: Dice-Zee! brings back a classic and beloved game that is popular across the world! Can you rank as one of the best dice scoring players in the world?

title: FourPoint: Prologue
description: Escaping while doing the right thing for each place in four places.Escape this place with items needed for the place, items that will help, and items that will allow you to do the right thing for the places!

title: Splash Carnival
description: Spash Carnival is roguelike shooting game featuring paintball weapons. Arm yourself with diverse low-durability weapons, splash the enemies and move forward! Welcome to the Splash Camival~!

title: Solitary Mark
description: This is a casual puzzle game that is very simple and easy to understand, suitable for players of all ages. Players need to eliminate blocks of the same color or shape by clicking on them, or swap positions to connect them into three or more patterns. Each elimination earns points, and special items can also be used. The game interface is simple and beautiful, with smooth operation, exquisite graphics, and cheerful music, but it will not make you feel tired while you are crazy.

title: Field of Vision
description: This is a puzzle game. The mischievous little flying dragon jumps in different clouds. Move left and right to keep the little flying dragon in the picture and above the clouds, otherwise the game will end. There are attackers and bonus balls above the clouds, try to avoid all attacking objects as much as possible, and pick up bonus balls to get higher scores. The gameplay is simple yet challenging, come and try how many points you can get!

title: Sequential Dungeon
description: Welcome to Sequential Dungeon, where 64 different levels in 8 uniquely themed floors await you in a simple yet challenging experience! Get ready to clear each of the levels in a limited amount of moves while mastering a varied array of different mechanics!

title: Magic University
description: Magic University - Welcome to the magical university, where mysterious walls hide incredible opportunities! An exciting adventure awaits you in the world of magic, where every day is filled with new discoveries and challenges.

title: Back to the Earth
description: Take an exciting journey. Find out the reason for your abduction. Help your space brothers. Alien adventures await you!

title: Command & Conquer and The Covert Operations
description: The legendary RTS game which started it all. Will you side with the humanistic GDI or bring the world to its knees with Kane and the Brotherhood of Nod. Your adversaries are without mercy. And so are you.

title: Misled Madness
description: Side-scroller platformer where you avoid hazards and race to the finish line for the fastest leaderboard times.

title: Nothing Together: Multicolor Eye Pain Theme
description: Do you like colors? Do you like a lot of colors? Do you like colors so bright they will hurt your eyes? Then we got a great deal for you! With the Multicolor Eye Pain Theme, you can now enjoy tons of amazing bright colors dynamically changing in the background!

title: Nothing Together: Banana Theme
description: Enjoy doing Nothing while looking at a black background with bright yellow texts with the Banana Theme DLC!

title: Nothing Together: Dark Fire Theme
description: Enjoy doing Nothing while looking at a black background with neon red texts with the Dark Fire Theme DLC!

title: Nothing Together: Retro Console Theme
description: Enjoy doing Nothing while looking at a black background with neon green texts with the Retro Console Theme DLC!

title: Nothing Together: Deep Purple Theme
description: Enjoy doing Nothing while looking at a nice deep purple background with the Deep Purple Theme DLC! Why would you want that? I don't know, someone in the Discord asked me to make this.

title: Nothing Together: Light Theme
description: Just doing Nothing is boring! Use the White Theme DLC to destroy your vision and see absolutely Nothing! It has never been easier to experience absolute nothingness!

title: Nothing Together: Cute Theme
description: With the Cute Theme DLC, you can look at cute colors while doing absolutely Nothing! Why would you want that? I don't know. Why would you want anything anyway, if you could have Nothing instead?

title: Nothing Together: Dark Theme
description: Experience truly Nothing with the Dark Theme DLC. Stare into the void and question your life decisions.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops III - Zombies Chronicles Deluxe Edition
description:
Call of Duty: Black Ops III Zombies Chronicles Deluxe includes the full base game, Season Pass, Zombies Chronicles & additional bonus digital content including:

The Giant Bonus Map: Zombies returns in all of its undead glory with "The Giant". Re-live the chaos of Treyarch's classic "Der Riese" Zombies map, picking up the Zombies story with Dempsey, Nikolai, Richtofen, and Takeo where Origins left off.

3 Personalization Packs: Fan favorite Cyborg & Weaponized 115 packs along with a new Black Ops 3 pack. Each pack comes with a weapon camo, reticles, and calling card.

The Zombies Chronicles content expansion which delivers 8 remastered classic maps from Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops III - The Giant
description: Zombies returns in all of its undead glory with 'The Giant,' a research facility featuring the weapon-upgrading Pack-a-Punch Machine. Re-live the chaos of Treyarch's classic 'Der Riese' Zombies map, picking up the Zombies story with Dempsey, Nikolai, Richtofen, and Takeo where Origins left off.

title: Dino Park
description: Dino Park is a cozy idle game about collecting dinosaurs! Watch your dinosaurs level up in real time, earning more money for your park. Create the perfect environment for your dinosaurs to increase the chance of discovering super rare variants! Can you collect them all?

title: Midnight Custody
description: Midnight Custody is a short found-footage-style game where you wander through an eerie parking garage. It's a freaky, immersive terror fest that'll keep you on the edge of your seat!

title: Sippy Disco: Light Up The Dance Floor
description: Light up the dance floor in this cozy puzzle game! Sippy the unicorn must step on every square in the fewest possible moves to make the dance floor light up. Partner with Parrots on skates and disco balls to brighten everyone’s day!

title: Kill Will
description: Retro-FPS / Post-Apocalyptic / Sci-Fi / Pixel-Art / Old-School / DIY

title: Pac-Man Arcade Emulator
description: Despite the name, it's not an emulated version of the arcade game. Rather, it's a homebrew conversion of Pac-Man for the Amstrad CPC, in a way that tries to be the as arcade-perfect as it could with the CPC's hardware limits.

title: Fallout: Yesterday
description: Fallout: Yesterday is a fan-made recreation of the canceled Black Isle's Fallout 3 (Van Buren) on the engine of Fallout 2.

title: Star Wars Galaxies: Evolve
description: A non-profit, fan-made, community-driven remaster of the classic MMORPG Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided.

title: EzQuiz
description:
Dive into EzQuiz, where hundreds of questions across diverse topics await to challenge your knowledge and sharpen your wits. How much do you really know?

EzQuiz has it all! Test your mastery across a universe of subjects in the most dynamic quiz game ever. Are you ready to become the ultimate quiz champion?

title: Spin the Lighthouse
description: Spin the Lighthouse offers a serene and meditative escape, inviting players to embark on a journey of relaxation. With a focus on simplicity and peaceful interactions, this game is designed for individuals of all ages who seek a moment of tranquility after a hectic day. Spin and unwind – "Spin the Lighthouse" is your ticket to a peaceful and rejuvenating gaming experience. Find your calm, one rotation at a time.

title: Spark & Kling
description: Spark & Kling is a couch co-op puzzle platformer where the player will take the role of either Spark, the electric bug, or Kling the metal gel blob. They are trapped in a Homemade lab by a Mad Scientist and the players will have to overcome obstacles and work together to escape.

title: Sekiro: Long May the Shadows Reflect
description: An unofficial overhauled mod that makes the game more challenging, changing skills, items, bosses, enemies, and upgrades.

title: Oblivion Eve
description:
A roguelike action-platformer where you use upgradeable weapons to combo powerful enemies to their doom!

Overcome tough fights, platforming challenges, puzzles, and more in your effort to free the titan who is incarcerated in the shifting prison's depths.

title: Little Eidolons
description:
An open-world rpg for Pico-8, where you can catch, train, and battle with over 100 varieties of monsters!

Gameplay is performed by navigating the overworld until you encounter either a wild Eidolon or an opposing trainer, which transitions the game to battle mode. Battle mode uses turn-based mechanics across a grid to allow you to fight - until all foes are defeated!

title: Fortnite: Chapter 5 - Season 2: Myths & Mortals
description: Pandora’s Box has been opened on the Fortnite Battle Royale Island, bringing Olympus to the battlefield.
