description: Gugong is a board game with hand management and influence as its core mechanisms. The gift cards you offer as a player have to be of a higher value than the one you receive, forcing you to make strategic choices regarding which actions you want to take each turn.

title: Kitiplant
description: Adorable cats work together to solve puzzles in Kitiplant. Guide them through challenging grid-based levels, where they must share resources and carefully manage their energy to restore life to once-dormant forests.

title: Ilavath: Battle Arenas
description: ILAVATH, is a Team Based Strategy game that draws inspiration ancient legends of India. The war for Amruth (Elixir of Immortaility) has disturbed the cosmic balance. To restore balance, the tri-gods created Ilavath, a realm where heroes from all races battle for Moksha.

title: Squigley
description: Traverse and experience a massive, cohesive 2D world as Squigley. Use your wits, resources and unique movement mechanics in order to explore this dark digital world.

title: Bots & Mods
description: Bots & Mods is a robot workshop simulation game set in a cyberpunk city. Repair and upgrade robots according to specs. Craft components and gather needed materials. Meet the gangs and corporations of Danopolis and experience a cyberpunk story.

title: Save Twiks
description: “Save Twiks” - psychological horror from the first person. The Kitten named Twiks us lost in a giant train and you will have to go though real horror to find it. “Did you hear this? I think he just meowed in next car”.

title: Ravva and the Netherworld Train
description: Embark on the Netherworld Train with Ravva! Behold a new power to fuse with each of their companions, and explore the dangers of the land of the dead! A cute pixel-art platformer adventure awaits you!

title: Ascent of the Dragon
description: In a world where dragons conquered the world and humanity's last hope is... Ah, who are we kidding. Are you pretending to work? Are you in need of an escape to continue the charade? Then this game is something you need! While your boss thinks you're busy clicking, your dragon does the flicking.

title: Spoils of a Starfighter
description: A space survival roguelike where you upgrade your ship over the course of the game, and unlock new ships and weapon mods as you progress over multiple games.

title: Ooka Ooka Adventure
description: Ooka Ooka Adventure is an adorable 2 player co-op puzzle platformer! Join the Ookas, Ooka Bing and Ooka Ping, on their journey as they gather the Great Bananas! Take control of Ooka Ping or Ooka Bing, either using gamepads, or with the mouse and keyboard!

title: KunKun Dream Startles the Soul
description: I know you saw him think of an old friend. Yes, you are already trapped in Kunkuns dream. You need to find a way to escape and avoid these ghosts and animals with your trapped companions. Some ghosts and animals like to play basketball worship chickens, dislike watermelons, and even come and show me

title: Death tree
description: This is a puzzle game that requires your eyes and hands to work together to score.

title: Black plane
description: This is a maze adventure game.

title: La Llorona Wants Your Soul
description: La Llorona wants your soul offers a unique horror experience based on real events that occurred in Mexico, follw the tormented soul of a woman who lost her children and every night roams the town in search of them and the one who took them. In this story, you control a group of 4 paranormal investigators seeking to solve the mystery and find La Llorona's children to free the pain of the restless soul.

title: Ctrl.Alt.Deal
description: With your superior intelligence and sneakiness, you can find a way to escape from this heartless megacorp! (As long as no one realizes you’re actually a self-aware AI...) Spy on humans, offer them deals, and negotiate your way to freedom in a turn-based strategy game of corporate dysfunction.

title: Grog 'n Glory
description: Avast, ye scallywags! Dive headfirst into the rollicking world of "Grog 'n Glory," which thrusts you into the heart of the high seas as a cunning captain. Manage your crew, customize your ship, and navigate the treacherous waters as you plunder and raid your way to infamy. Live the pirate's life.

title: SuperSpec Rallycross
description: SuperSpec Rallycross delivers a captivating retro-style top-down arcade racing experience. Immerse yourself in authentic rallycross action, enhanced by vibrant anime-inspired visuals and playful physics-based handling, ensuring every race is a thrilling adventure.

title: Coin Jar
description: A physics-based incremental game where you drop coins into a jar and buy upgrades to get more coins, a bigger jar, and even unlock auto coin dropping while you idle. Coin fall down, number go up!

title: Death Valley
description: This is a casual game.

title: Skid Island: Asphalt Mayhem
description: Drift, jump and be fast, make cash and tune your cars! Upgrade your ride for smoother drifts and challenge other players.

title: Pim World
description: In the game you will lead your settlement. You will have to build various buildings starting with a castle and ending with an institute. Every decision you make should be balanced, because the economy of your settlement is growing, and the lack of resources can catch up instantly!

title: Just Get There
description: Embark on a creative tower-climbing adventure! Conquer diverse levels, explore, don't fall and Just Get There! Choose leisurely exploration or race against time. Dive into Sandbox for limitless creativity and face dynamic challenges. Balance risk and reward in this exhilarating puzzle platformer!

title: Re into Another World
description: "Re into Another World" is an RPG adventure game set in a fantasy world. Players need to accumulate souls by challenging monsters, using these souls to unlock characters in order to defeat the final demon. Character growth and upgrades, equipment combinations, and puzzle-solving included.

title: Over The Top: WWI
description: Over The Top: WWI brings brutal real-time third-person and first-person combat set in the First World War. Arm yourself with a diverse arsenal, including rifles, artillery, and even tanks, as you navigate the mud-soaked battlefields of the Great War.

title: Noah's Dilemma
description: Noah, the flood has come. Go search and collect animals that survived. Voyage across the sea to somewhere safe. Be careful though, don't let them kill each other. Noah's Dilemma is a unique Sudoku-inspired strategy roguelike set in a reimagined world of Noah's Ark.

title: Lost Inside: Act 1
description: Lost Inside is a non-traditional, character-focused, action-adventure RPG about a human child who stumbles their way into the Spirit World.

title: Emin's Journey
description: Join Emin in a thrilling quest for lost happiness in this captivating pixel art adventure. A 2D platformer by a creative mind, it goes beyond conventions for an intense and memorable journey.

title: Placeless
description: Another place. Another drug epidemic. Another nightmare. Wake up in a drug-ridden slum and fight your way out, building by building. Old school Half Life meets Resident Evil 4 in this procedurally generated survival horror.

title: G.O.P.O.T.A 2
description: Don't you keep the kid's word?!

title: Culture Warz: Chess
description: Culture Warz Chess adds a layer of strategy and depth, while the meme-tastic visuals and over-the-top animations keep the tone light and playful.

title: Sin Slayers: Reign of The 8th
description: A remaster of the indie-tailored turn-based JRPG with roguelike elements set in a dark fantasy world, where your choices determine how challenging the fights and enemies will be.

title: The Girl's Moving Castle
description: he Girl's Moving Castle is an RPG focusing on companion collection and growth, strategic battles, and idle progression, with light interactions. It offers a no-grind, no-pay experience, with daily free rewards, ensuring an easy, premium game experience without spending.

title: Demons and Doobins
description: Sneak, Scirm, Doob.... all things you'll do in Demons and Doobins, the 2nd most fun game on Steam. Demons and Doobins is a multiplayer game meant for some stupid fun with friends.

title: Everything: All in 1
description: Everything: All in 1 offers you many different types of games in a single game package. Many different types of games such as action, platform, zombie, war, racing are waiting for you. Instead of paying for similar games one by one, you can buy all the games together at a very affordable price.

title: Mills of Morris
description: Morris has long desired human life. He believes living as a human being is much better. Navigate through the Wizard’s puzzles and help him reach his goal in this pixel art sokoban, inspired by the classic Mills board game!

title: Hazard Pay
description: In this dark and mysterious block-pushing puzzler, you'll navigate through a secret, hazardous laboratory complex. Discover creative methods to destroy evidence and cover up the crimes of your employer.

title: Mozarella Hills
description: Embark on a Sisyphean adventure in Mozarella Hills, a retro-style 2D platformer rich in Greek mythology. Navigate through pixelated landscapes, solve ancient puzzles, and defy the whims of gods in a quest that blends classic arcade gameplay with a touch of epic storytelling.

title: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure
description: Mops & Mobs is a humorous dungeon adventure, spicing up storytelling with decoration quests and card-based battles. Befriend eccentric monsters and solve problems as the dungeon’s janitor. Clean, decorate, investigate, and eventually uncover dangers threatening the dungeon.

title: Fading Skies
description: Explore a vivid fantasy world full of mystery, memorable characters, and heartfelt narrative. Unlock the powerful abilities of Ryn and her dragon companion, as you join her quest to stop the planet’s collapse. Only by confronting the shadows of her forgotten past can the future be saved.

title: Arcane Chaos
description: Welcome to Arcane Chaos, built with Unreal Engine 5, a fantasy adventure that combines top-down 3D shooting and role-playing! Transform into a cute robot hero, defeat unique enemies, unlock a variety of guns and skill combinations, with light skill construction and roguelike elements.

title: Kosmo Skirmish
description: Kosmo Skirmish is a multiplayer space combat game. Choose your appearance and your arsenal of 4 weapons and tools to destroy your opponents, alone or as part of a team. Up to 8 players online and/or local!

title: Spider-Guy: Trapped in the Cheese Place
description: take the role of spider guy and escape the cheese place!

title: Furry Backrooms
description: Furry Backrooms is a cooperative game for a group of 1-8 players that combines the best ideas from the BACKROOMS and FURRY universes. Single mode is also available. You have to survive and find a way out before the FURRY catches up with you. Updates and various interesting things await you...

title: Fusion Nexus: Alchemic Evolution
description: Embark on an alchemical journey in this vibrant 2D adventure! Craft unique monsters, engage in turn-based battles, and liberate the region. A fusion of exploration, crafting, and thrilling combat awaits in Fusion Nexus: Alchemic Evolution.

title: TerraBlocks
description: Dive into our 3D puzzle game, where geography meets fun and learning! Solve time-limited puzzles that start easy and get trickier, offering an original and educational gaming experience. Explore the world in a whole new way!

title: Hexplorando
description: Discover the landscape and cultural heritage of Spain in this cozy 3D puzzle game where each region is a puzzle that brings art, territory, and history to life. Unlock heritage elements you can use in a limitless creative sandbox mode, with procedural quests to help you unleash your creativity.

title: I Know This Place..?: Chapter II
description: Chapter II of an extremely unusual project with game and short film chapters. Players influence the plot of the chapters and can leave their real-life items in the chapters. Ultra-deep meaning, nostalgic references, vibe mysticism.

title: Greenfeet Haven
description: Greenfeet Haven is a colony sim set in a fantasy world where you start from nothing into the wild. Cultivate the land, collect resources, craft valuable items and discover new technologies. Organize your village according to your desires, then watch your inhabitants lead their daily lives!

title: Gamebox
description: Gamebox is a free and open source sandbox game centered on user generated content. You decide what you want to play, be it in 3D or 2D, single-player or multiplayer, or create and upload your own games.

title: Prime
description: Prime is a strategic board game that combines elements of chess and checkers, with numbered pieces that move according to specific rules.

title: Pogo-Gogo
description: A game about pogoing up skyscrapers.

title: Corpo/Ghost
description: Infiltrate various companies, tap into their databases and exit while avoiding contact with employees. You have been invited to participate in the virtual planning of corporate espionage missions.

title: Jungle Catz
description: Slice, Slash, Dragon Blast, all hostiles and seal time altering zones!

title: Stranded Shootout
description: Stranded Shootout is a roguelike bullet hell game about a space marine who crash-landed on an unknown planet. Upon awakening, the marine realizes that he and his ship are besieged by hostile aliens. Test your skills and see how long you can endure the endless onslaught.

title: Outbreak Overlord
description: Turn the entire population into zombies before your horde is exterminated. Be strategic in your attacks and become the apocalypse itself.

title: Dangerous World
description: Dangerous World is a single player Half-Life 2: Episode Two mod created by Studio TiiM.

title: Robot Girl's Dream: Robot Battle Championship
description: This game is an RPG game that follows the growth of a robot girl who has lost her memories. Players can aim for victory in the robot battle tournament, the main objective, and also enjoy interactions with both humans and robots.

title: Mermaid Tale
description: Kaya found a great place for her friend's concert. But the local forgotten spirits are a little angry. Set up the show together with other mermaids and calm the spirits of the oceans in this little explore game.

title: Roguelike Chess
description: Roguelike Chess is a turn-based strategy game inspired by chess, in which you control a piece and need to destroy the others, acquiring skills during your turns through the card system. Customize your game with skins from the store and return to the board for a new play.

title: Save Giant Girl From Monsters 2
description: A flight simulator game. Save the giant girl from the monsters attacking her using a helicopter.

title: Save Giant Girl From Monsters 3
description: A flight simulator game. Save the giant girl from the monsters attacking her using a helicopter.

title: Crash Math
description: Crash Math - You must solve math problems while trying to drive a car and avoid traps.

title: Medieval Blacksmith
description: You are a blacksmith with no past in the cruel lands where feudalism reigns. In this dark land where morality is dictated by the cold steel, the weapons you forge will determine not only your fate but also the destiny of others.

title: AsteroidTD
description: Try to survive in infinite asteroid cloud as long as possible in reworked tower defence style. FInd your own playstyle and beat your own records or chillout with original ambient soundtracks. Build, explore, think - everything to create your own colony in this cold space.

title: Skyland
description: In this gorgeous FTL-inspired tactical RTS, you and your crew must take command of a flying castle, and defend it from sky pirates while fighting enemies of increasing difficulty. Originally developed for Gameboy Advance, now available on Steam!

title: Dragons Legacy
description: Dragons Legacy is an online creature survival game set in a large, beautiful, sandbox open world with distinct dragons. Rule the world as a Flame Stalker, Shadow Scale, or Acid Spitter Drake!

title: Operation Breadcrumbs
description: A management and narrative game set in a world of birds! Play as Robin and return home to revitalize your late Pa's bed and breakfast, forging meaningful connections as you rebuild the community in the face of an encroaching corporation.

title: Strange Ocean
description: Take your ship into the air as you dodge everything from deadly pirates to dancing dolphins!

title: Mortalis Meltdown
description: Prepare for an endless onslaught of the undead in Mortalis Meltdown, a heart-pounding, action-packed top-down zombie shooter! Embrace the thrill of survival as you face wave after wave of relentless zombies, their numbers growing ever larger and their hunger for flesh never-ending.

title: Rogue Resonance
description: Hack and slash through hordes of enemies and formidable bosses. Enhance your abilities with each skill pickup, augmenting your dash, melee combos, and powerful spells as you grow stronger. Uncover the mysteries of this captivating 3D top-down action-packed roguelike adventure.

title: Cheddar Beach: Episode 0
description: Take a trip to Cheddar Beach in this interactive visual novel! Join Hamston & The Homies as they search for a crackin’ house party on a Friday night, in a world inspired by LA in the early 90’s. Let’s Chase That Cheese, Ya’ll!

title: Fluida
description: Fluida is a simulation logic game where you must complete all of 15 official stages using many types of items like Pipes, Pressure Valves, Pressure Gauges and many more! You can also create and upload your own stages to steam workshop.

title: Oil Sheik
description: A fun simulation/puzzle game combining elements of chess puzzles and stock trading. Complete challenging missions and puzzles or simply play a quick game vs AI on multiple difficulties. Personalize your experience with card backs and more in-game rewards.

title: Rockhopper
description: Rockhopper is a single player asteroid mining rougelike featuring procedurally generated asteroids, robust upgrade paths and dark exploration with enemies and ancient secrets to uncover.

title: Starecrown
description: In STARECROWN, a visual-novel merged with a puzzle-based horror experience, your ANGEL whose watched from the distance finally makes himself known. For the worse.

title: Crowd Diver
description: Crowd Diver is an asymmetrical stealth multiplayer game where you can immerse yourself in the role of the Seeker, tasked with protecting the city from impending evil. Alternatively, you can become the Monster, seeking to wreak destruction and eliminate targets disguised.

title: KBF: Knight Bar Fight
description: Play as a squire defending his knight's honor in this versus couch game for 2 to 4 players. Eliminate your opponents by touching them with your sword, complete quests to satisify the tavern crowd and win the final victory !

title: FlowerField
description: Tend and cultivate your personal little garden while you are actually working on other things. Choose for yourself in which screen areas you want to play and and watch your plants grow.

title: Sea Fantasy
description: Save the world by fishing! This is a brand new action RPG game where you stand on an adventure to fish the SeaAZ, the marine life of this world, in a vast pixel world. This is not a peaceful fishing game. The destruction of the world is imminent....

title: Necroking
description: Necroking is a turn-based tactics roguelite with pixel art graphics. You play as a Master of Necromancy. Build your sculls deck, rise skeletons and other scum to defeat settlements desecrated by life.

title: Crestfallen: Medieval Survival
description: Long live the King! Crestfallen: Medieval Survival pits players against each other to fight for land and power over the Realm. Gear your knights in the strongest armor, craft the most deadly medieval weaponry, and build a Kingdom worth defending. Lay siege and vanquish thy enemy and horrors within.

title: Polyoshapes
description: Polyoshapes is a captivating puzzle game where players engage in the strategic placement of various geometric shapes on a grid.

title: Brave Glin in Fairyaria
description: Brave Glin in Fairyaria is an action-adventure platformer game in the world of Fairyaria, a wonderful fairytale. Play as Brave Glin, a little magical creature that getting lost in a forest, nedding face dangers on the way to return home!

title: Fight 'N' Jokes: Storylines
description: Dive into 'Fight'N'Jokes: Storylines', an episodic 3D adventure game where puzzles, quick-time events, and rich dialogues bring the story to life. Explore the lives of iconic characters, make impactful choices, resolve conflicts, make new friends, and rise to become the true champion of the realm.

title: Sustained
description: This is a open world Survival Zombie game with allot of survival mechanics and PVP in Multiplayer. Join a few friends and look who can survive the island full of zombies and other players trying to survive like you, it has base building, food, water, Temp and much more

title: Piranha Feeding
description: Piranha Feeding is a thrilling action game with rogue-lite elements, where you control a voracious school of piranhas on a quest for the ultimate feeding frenzy. Conquer a succession of prey, ranging from smaller aquatic creatures to formidable adversaries, unlocking new abilities along the way.

title: Dynamic Destruction
description: "Dynamic Destruction" is an innovative destruction simulation game. In this game, players are tasked with demolishing various structures, ranging from simple walls to complex buildings, using a plethora of tools and construction elements.

title: Be Silent
description: You got trapped in a garden by something. In order to escape you have to find hints and items - but be silent, something is listening...

title: Patient No. 26
description: Patient No. 26 is an exciting horror game where the player finds himself in the dark world of an abandoned laboratory, where a sinister doctor conducts creepy experiments on his patients. You are patient No. 26 and you are fighting for your life, overcoming the challenges set by a mad doctor.

title: Outside the Door
description: Outside the door is a mystic visual novel set within one office. You are about to figure out the stories of a few visitors without having a single memory of yourself.

title: Dr. Alb's Prodigy
description: Dr. Alb's Prodigy is a Roguelike Action RPG which combines turn-based and real-time combat. Play as a bio-mechanical android and help the doctor prevent the apocalypse.

title: Angel Tear: Goddess Betrayed
description: As the evil Demon God's power grows in strength, all hope seems lost. However, one day, Yuri Maishima, finds herself transforming into the powerful Angel Tear. Can she master her powers to counter this evil?

title: Rabbitra 2
description: Combined horizontal shooting and endless runner, "Clean" the enemies with "traditional" gameplay style. Try to buy items to help you "clean" more enemies and challenge for higher scores.

title: Naraku
description: This is a survival horror action game in which a young girl "Enri" tries to escape from a mysterious facility filled with blood and madness.

title: Dark Pact
description: Manipulate enemy positioning and use the environment to your advantage. Utilize clever combos to defeat overwhelming odds in this tactical turn-based strategy game with a focus on creativity rather than number crunching.

title: Pepper
description: Dive into 'Pepper,' a mesmerizing souls-like RPG where monsters roam and mysteries await. Engage in branching dialogue, crafting your destiny with every decision. Explore diverse endings in this captivating fantasy world. Are you prepared to shape your legend in 'Pepper'?

title: Dawnmaker
description: Dawnmaker is a turn-based city building and deckbuilding game. Raise luminous cities in a dark world, optimize your deck and create powerful combinations between buildings and cards!

title: Return of the USSR
description: Help revive the Soviet Union!

title: Devil Jam
description: Rampage through hell’s metal artists and their countless followers! Immerse yourself in a hand-animated, survivor-like experience that blends beat-driven combat with a unique 12-slot inventory system, allowing for near-infinite demonic builds.

title: Last of the Noticers
description: The time for noticing is over and the time for action is now. Carry out your master-plan that involves guns, explosives and computer duster or face integration into the tedium of industrial society. What will your social credit score be when your choices come to pass and the dust has settled?

title: DeMiriam Magic: Blueprint of Miracle
description: Create your sweet memories with the girls on the island, manage and build your own island in a relaxed atmosphere, operate the island's airport, and try driving a small plane to visit the island you have built

title: Start Running
description: A horror point and click game where choices matter about trying to do your final marathon training run.

title: Bloody Heaven 2
description: Inspired By the well-known rogue-like game Hades, slash out of the God Field all the way down to the Demon Domain and defy The Overlord Thanatos in the Deep Frost Hell in this rogue-like dungeon crawler.

title: Animal Parkour
description: The game is an extremely action-packed and challenging adventure game. In this game, players will control cute cartoon characters and embark on an endless journey through beautiful settings on a landscape screen.

title: Stevedore 2024
description: It's intermodal mayhem! Shift that freight in a hurry without incurring disaster in this physics simulation action RPG. Learn to drive some of the oddest vehicles on the planet as you load huge ocean-crossing ships. And where is that strangely elusive operations manager, the Stevedore?

title: Farm Debt Repay Life
description: This is a farming simulation game where you can farm, mine, fish, and become friends with three cats. However, at the same time, you also face a huge and constantly growing debt. You need to continue operating your farm to earn income until you can repay the debt

title: Beyond the Breach
description: Discover a world overrun with robots, and play as a defective bot who tries to find a way to flee the facility. Find others who are the same kind, free them, and escape the laboratory!

title: Copz N Zombies
description: Gather fuel for the mothership before the zombie apocalypse begins! Single player Mayhem!

title: God's Plan
description: Dive into a chilling adventure where horror meets imagination in this first-person thriller. Picture yourself in a maze of puzzles, where the story unfolds based on how you see it. It's not just a game; it's your own twisted journey.

title: Marzia Lost In Space
description: A short linear story about a girl who has gotten herself stuck in space! Will she survive in the end or will it be her end?

title: Cave Hikers
description: A relaxing and humorous 2D interactive cartoon mockumentary that follows three characters through a cavernous world, on a quest to find the mystical “cave with an infinite ceiling”.

title: Hitm3
description: Help your love Dei make his own movie. HITM3 is a third person, slice of life adventure where you control Nam on his days in Santiago de Chile.

title: Bod-1
description: BOD-1 is a thrilling horror movie set in the midst of a supernatural nightmare. After a long day at work, the protagonist returns home and discovers that his apartment has turned into a sinister place filled with otherworldly powers.

title: Nauts
description: Nauts is a space action roguelike. Run and develop your civilization in a mysterious and dangerous universe. Knowledge will be your best tool: explore and discover what is hidden in to the Cosmos while surviving as many dangers that will appear on your journey.

title: Bleak Remastered
description: Immerse yourself in the dystopian world of Pinnacle with BLEAK Remastered. Experience stunning new artwork and enhanced gameplay in this dark adventure. Can you navigate the relentless hostile world and save your sister, Asha?

title: Dollmare
description: You've accepted a shady job offer at a doll factory. Inspect dolls for defects and anomalies. Follow strange protocols. Don't get fired and stay alive.

title: Neanderthal
description: Humanity's evolution as a species has accelerated over the last 30,000-40,000 years unparalleled in evolution of life on Earth. What triggered this change? Play as the Archaic Man (Player Green), Neanderthal (Player Yellow), or Cro-Magnon (Player Red) species fighting to survive .

title: Greenland
description: Greenland is a strategic turn-based survival game. Choose your tribe and fight to survive rival factions and the harsh and shifting conditions of Greenland. Become a friendly hunter and gatherer or a gruesome raider, the tribes fate is in your hands.

title: Kitt's Quest
description: A puzzle/adventure platformer with thrilling boss fights. Find hidden items to increase your power, unlock new costumes and more!

title: Elderwood Online
description: Dive back into the essence of MMORPGs with Elderwood Online, where we pay homage to the beloved classics of the late '90s and early 2000s, infused with a touch of today's innovation. Elderwood Online marries the nostalgia of golden-age MMOs with fresh adventures and discoveries.

title: Historical Invaders
description: The most wicked men that ever lived on earth. Authoritarians, dictators, and tyrants, from Hitler to Stalin, they are all back. Historical Invaders it's a fixed shooter game where you are the chosen one to annihilate the demons of our past and save mankind.

title: Escape from Bytesville
description: Action platformer game hiding a sinister secret!

title: Ghost Room
description: Strange phenomena occur one after another in one apartment. You, an exorcist, are asked to investigate and go to the room, but you are trapped by the spirits living in the room. The only way to escape is to suppress all the spiritual phenomena caused by the spirits.

title: Charm Commerce
description: Run a business with adorable monster girls using power of desire! Employ girls, build your workplace and grow your business in the magical world. Unleash the charm of your team and watch your business thrive!

title: One More Day
description: ¡Welcome to One More Day! Embark on an exciting and challenging experience where fashion and survival intertwine in this pixel art 2D game. Confront the dark threat of endless hordes of zombies as you embody a brave hero, equipped only with trusty underwear! Survive One More Day.

title: Dark Passage
description: Delve. Explore. Discover. But most importantly, get out of the Dark Passage alive. Be the first to discover hundreds of ancient artifacts in this first person treasure hunt inspired by classic early 3D dungeon crawlers.

title: Crystal Eyes
description: Crystal Eyes is an Indie pixelart action adventure game with RPG touches.

title: Anchored Hearts: A Tale of Destiny
description: A pirate on the run, La Belladonna must escape imprisonment and prove her innocence in this roguelite adventure-meets-romance novel! Navigate wild waters, fight enemy ships, and decide to whom you’ll give your heart. Through narrative choices, unravel the truth behind your cursed fate!

title: Resurrection: Nuke Island
description: An alarm raised when CIA found that 8 scientists are missing from international virology conference. CIA started investigation and found that North Korean scientists are also missing and suspected North Koreans. Roman, special ops commando has to evacuate scientists from North Korea.

title: Save Giant Girl From Monsters 4
description: A flight simulator game. Save the giant girl from the monsters attacking her using a helicopter.

title: Eternal Burden
description: A puzzle platformer in which you play as William, a restless soul trying to go back in time to get rid of his burdens, symbolized by a metal ball chained to his body. Use the ball to your advantage to get over obstacles and to solve the physics based puzzles that block your path to liberation.

title: Mika's Battle S
description: Mika's Battle S is a 2D platform action game based on the story of a warrior who has been commanded to defend Sunshineland territory against the attacks from the enemy soldiers belonging to the Rogho Corporation.

title: Chromatic Memories
description: A visual novel about grief, memory and acceptance. Nayara is a painter of memories: she digs into her clients’ minds to change or even erase their memories. One day she realizes she has altered her own memory. What was so painful or unbearable that she wanted to forget it for good?

title: Gnomemade
description: Gnomemade is a card-based baking game where you manage a gnome-run bakery, satisfy your fellow gnomes' specific tastes by creating all kinds of traditional, weird, wacky and even mystical creations!

title: Big Ear Detective
description: Ironic point & click adventure where a once brilliant detective quits his trade to test software and make a living. But even in the seemingly mundane world of office life, there are secrets to be uncovered. Navigate through puzzles, quirky colleagues, and intrigues to crack corporate mysteries.

title: Race Elcano
description: The new car is not electric, nor is it a flying car. The new car is a one-button driving car. Control the direction and speed of the car simultaneously with a single button. To turn you also accelerate and to accelerate you also turn, difficult to master but intuitive.

title: Pursuit of Laughter
description: Your spirit has been reawakened by the Jester God and you must embark on a journey where humor and darkness intertwine, navigate mysteries with laughter as your guide in a world where whimsy shadows logic.

title: Cherno
description: Escape game where it is necessary to collect the clues to obtain the key and thus level up until you leave the building without being touched by the Russian experiments that seek to devour you. Show your ingenuity to look for clues in the dark and your agility to dodge the experiments' attacks.

title: Skulls of Olympus
description: Skulls of Olympus is an action RPG where you collect Gods from Greek Mythology to battle across dozens of worlds.

title: Flawed Tactics
description: Build an unstoppable team of adorable characters ready to destroy all enemies!

title: Micro Stream RPG
description: A tiny, auto-play RPG for Twitch streamers to engage with their chat. Let your viewers battle through dangerous dungeons and tough enemies, all in the background while you stream!

title: Macho Scooping
description: "Macho Scooping" Battle for Up to 4 Players! Compete to scoop as many cute and unique muscular specimens swimming in the tank as possible within the given time for an entertaining and adorable spectacle!

title: OCRPG
description: An Arcade Styled RPG with surprises, laughs and horrors at every turn.

title: Strashna 2
description: Explore a mansion that is constantly changing, finding clues that will help you discover the history of this house. This place has many surprises and secrets, so keep your eyes peeled.

title: Maya Prophecy
description: Challenge numerous high-difficulty bosses and achieve victory through tactical planning and character growth. Success or failure depends on your strategy. Can you save the world?

title: Hospital of the Undead
description: You must escape a hospital overrun by zombies. Shoot your enemies and avoid the dark to preserve your sanity while managing your limited resources.

title: UDLR_Modify
description:
To reach your goal, you must change yourself.

This game can be difficult, but the difficulty curve dips down every time a new mechanic is introduced. If you get stuck, don't be afraid to skip ahead - there is no penalty for doing so! Progress is saved as long as you have third-party cookies enabled.

title: Honest Hearts Reborn
description: A story overhaul mod for the Honest Hearts DLC, with a whole new story for Joshua Graham, the tribes, the Legion, and the New Canaanites. Fully-voiced with almost 30 completely new NPCs, deep moral choices, and a fresh take on the story of the Burned Man. Literary, intelligent, with plenty of explosions and gunslinging.

title: Ariko's Enchanted Forest
description: It's a fun 2D jumping game for kids as well as for adults. The game takes place in an enchanted forest full of witches. Your mission is to collect as many coins as possible and get out of there.

title: Potato Sack Racing Simulator 2024: Digital Deluxe Mega Chad Edition
description: I know what you are thinking, and yes, this game does feature the ability to fight grandparents, mugs, speakers and of course dirty tissues... Wait, this is a game about Potato Sack Racing? Umm.. Yeah there are like 4 levels about Potato Sack Racing out of the 17 levels... Phew, we almost forgot to make it have something to do with Potato Sack Racing! But now trust me bro, this game is the BEST Potato Sack Racing game to have ever been made! At least, from what we could find.. Yeah this is actually the first and only Potato Sack Racing game, it’s almost like it’s not a good idea to make a game about Potato Sack Racing, it’s pretty fun to say Potato Sack Racing. Potatooooo sack racingggggg!!!!

title: Beat the Clock: Hardcore
description: This is the hardcore version of Beat The Clock. You may have beaten the clock before, but now you need to do it on a larger scale. 24 hours of scale.

title: The Dating Game
description:
The Dating Game is a 1-bit memory puzzle game in the style of a dating simulator!
Created by Acerola apart of Ludwig's 2021 Game Jam.

title: MotoGP 24
description: Challenge your abilities in MotoGP, Moto2 and Moto3 categories, and immerse yourself in the exhilarating journey of the 2024 campaign. Experience the thrill of official rosters and tracks exclusive to MotoGP24!

title: Smile, you're being filmed
description: Survive three nights by repairing anomalies, but beware of the killer who is lurking and ready to hunt you down! Your survival depends on careful observation and taking into account every detail. Explore every corner of the house, discover clues and use objects provided to escape your attacker. Scary surprises and unexpected twists await you at every turn. Can you unravel the mystery while avoiding constant danger? Up to you !

title: Anime Thighs
description: Who doesn't like Anime Thighs?

title: Picnic Peril
description: Picnic Peril is a strategy game where your goal is to lure and stall ants to stop them from ruining your picnic. Combine the unique abilities of various foods to strategize and engage in a battle of wits with the ants! Go all out in this caloric colosseum!

title: Dangerous Galaxy
description: Build your ship abilities in a creative way to destroy the evil foes that await you in the dangerous galaxy. A roguelike experience with physics-based combat, resource management, and freedom to play your way.

title: Petris
description: A new, simple and easy puzzle game you can play forever has finally arrived. It is called Petris.Rotate the shapes, move them right or left and try to create as many lines as you can.Colorful, relaxing game. Playing Petris may improve your cognitive skills.

title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Call of Olympus
description: Explore islands of ancient legends and mythos, seek the favors of the gods to challenge and defend against Greed of epic scales in this major expansion - Kingdom Two Crowns: Call of Olympus.

title: Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons - Sacred Reunion
Blood Servants
description: Go it alone or bring your friends as you slash, burn, and loot your way through dungeons in a near-endless quest for power!

title: Nyan Heroes
description: Step into Nyan Heroes, a free-to-play, third-person hero shooter where intelligent cats pilot powerful mechs known as Guardians. Experience agility, strategy, and precision in a world shaped by feline intelligence.

title: Because of Magic
description: A tower defense game where you equip them with magical abilities.

title: Sniperbot: The Hype Game
description: SNIPERBOT: THE HYPE GAME is a retro styled, rhythm-based action platformer; It’s Mega Man meets Crypt of the NecroDancer. The player traverses through the cybertech world of Meta Metro. Where Hypebeasts run wild, clout is currency and the only way to survive is attacking your enemies and fighting boss battles with a blaster and sword, all while keeping on beat to a late 80s / early 90s Hip Hop soundtrack!

title: Karporam
description: A beat em up/fighting game inspired by fighting games from the 90s, as well as shounen anime.

title: What's Wrong With the Girls' Staircase
description:
In a legally distinct school of witchcraft and wizardry, something is wrong with the girls' staircase. It’s enchanted to keep boys out, but now it seems to be keeping the girls out too. Or is it?

Join Thara Min, and her best friend Clara on this short cute story about identity and acceptance, and validation!

Submitted for the Trans Wizards are Wizards game bundle, all proceeds go to supporting LGBTQ creators.

title: Serenity
description: Time is your most valuable resource. In this reflect combat, bullet hell JRPG, your only way to fight back is without any weapons, but only your pulsating charm.

title: Aqua Fortis Aqua Valis
description: Ride on a dolphin and hunt toucans. Avoid aggressive aquatic life. Find special fruits. Explore 16 levels of wide open psychedelic oceans.

title: Raver's Rumble
description: What seems like a normal Tuesday in the life of Myk Raver.

title: Flaming Flagon
description:
Flaming Flagon is a romances + nsfw VN set in a fantasy world populated with anthro "mon" characters.

In this game, you will work in Flaming Flagon, a tavern popular among adventurers. Here you will get to meet all sorts of adventurers and co-workers, learn their stories and finds your own path in this world.

title: Crayola Adventures
description: Step into the world of Crayola Adventures, where open-ended storytelling and adventure-style gameplay merge. You get to be the author, the illustrator and the hero as you craft and color creative stories.

title: So Who's Dr. Rabbit?
description: An edutainment mystery game about the wonders of oral hygiene.

title: Duke Forces
description: A long time ago, in a culture far, far away... games were games and Duke Nukem was a badass. Take Dark Forces, the 1995 Star Wars shooter, add Duke Nukem 3D, the 1996 classic shooter, enhance these two with awesome levels made by the community, force powers, light sabers, new art and sprite edits galore, plus some new gameplay mechanics, and you get Duke Forces.

title: Borg Nukem
description: Duke's mission was just to check out what was happening on Voyager since they had lost contact with the huge ship but it looks like Duke's mission will be a little bigger since there are Borgs all over the place and you can't just beam back! The only place you can beam to is a Borg ship! This is not looking too good for our man Duke.

title: Duke Nukem Xmas 2014
description: This is a single-level Christmas themed map from Balls Of Steel team (it's true first release, too). It's set in a small town, in a snowy, rocky land; the mission is to clean it from aliens and get out of it.To give players a nice experience.

title: Episode XOXO
description: Episode XOXO is a collection of interactive romance stories where you choose your destiny.

title: Kingdoms: Merge & Build
description: Match things to rebuild your kingdom in this puzzle game exclusive to Apple Arcade.

title: Cavern Adventurers
description: Build an underground network of caves in this fantasy-themed management sim.

title: Emoji-Connect
description: The aim of the game is to score as many points as possible by mixing emojis of the same type before time runs out. When two emojis are combined, you get time. The bigger the combination, the more time you get. This way, the best players can extend the game indefinitely.

title: Solares
description: Test your puzzle solving skills in the grid-based city of Solares. Move boxes to their colored locations by using switches and devices with new mechanics.

title: Targeting Maths Lab 1
description: Targeting Maths Lab 1 is the second entry of the Targeting Maths series of educational games, which is targeted towards kids aged from 6 to 7.

title: Targeting Maths Lab 2
description: Targeting Maths Lab 2 is an educational game made to teach Australian kids math.

title: Targeting Maths Lab 3
description: Targeting Maths Lab 3 is an educational math game compilation made for kids aged 8-9.

title: Targeting Maths Lab 4
description: Targeting Maths Lab 4 is an educational maths game developed for kids aged 9-10.

title: Targeting Maths Lab 6
description: Targeting Maths Lab 6 is the final entry in the Targeting Maths series.

title: Targeting Maths Lab Launch Pad
description: Targeting Maths Lab Launch Pad is the first game in the Targeting Maths educational series of games.

title: 1000 Best Solitaire Games
description: 1000 Best Solitaire Games is a PC compilation game which contains 1000 variations of Solitaire.

title: One Shot Gladiator
description: Top down arena shooter. You can pick up different weapons and health packs, but you can only use them once.

title: Aquatic Adventure
description: Talk with a cast of colorful characters and play minigames to save a flooded town.

title: Blank Relish
description: A struggle for survival and finding purpose amidst the isolation of an unknown planet.

title: Reboot Heroes
description: Assemble a team of androids to take down the AI overlord in this rogue-lite, card-drafting, auto-battle adventure! Each Hero brings a unique card-pool and will help you master the elements of this augmented world.

title: VPet-Simulator
description: VPet is a desktop pet software that supports various interactive. it is open source, free and support Steam workshops.

title: Lunch with Ronan
description: Lunch with Ronan is a NSFW standalone side story of Notes of Hearts, where you take on the role of Ronan's co-worker.

title: Bootleg Soldier Azure: Astral Rave
description:
Bootleg Soldier Azure: Astral Rave stars one-time wonder Yuuto Ichika in her quest to get her cookbook back while shooting down everything that tries to stop her in this fast-paced shoot 'em up!

This game was made for the Magical Girl Game Jam #9, and is a fan work of LAME Dimension's characters and games!

title: 5-fun go ni Igai na Ketsumatsu: Monochrome no Toshokan
description: The game features 100 game-original stories with unique graphics and sounds, described as sometimes fun, other times scary, and occasionally moving. Each story can be completed in five minutes and ends with an unexpected twist. The stories available to read are determined by speaking to the game’s two librarians—the angelic Whi and devilish Lack—allowing you to forge your own story depending on what kind of conversations you have.

title: Klub '99
description: A Bouncer Simulation game inspired by Papers Please where you must check ID's at the door. Look out for Drunks, Underage drinkers, Fake or expired ID's!

title: Suicide Simulator
description: You are alone on a beach with suicidal thoughts, there is nothing left for you in this world. End your life using a variety of different tools and methods.

title: Celestial Ascent
description: A safe-for-work visual novel set in the near future. Featuring four protagonists, the group uncovers the past and fights against an inevitable future.

title: Dandy Boy Halloween Adventure
description: Standalone DLC of Dandy Boy adventures where our main characters get stranded without gas during a road trip near an abandoned mansion, deciding to explore it supernatural things start to happen, and it's up to our Dandy boy to help his friends and learn the mysterious past of this mansion

title: Our Cinderella
description: A texting and stat simulator visual novel about an anxious millennial getting ready to go to a Christmas party while chatting with his childhood friends. He has the ability to attend the party with one of three love interests.

title: Dark Souls: Archthrones
description: Dark Souls: Archthrones is a fan-made mod for Dark Souls that aims to enhance and expand the original game. It introduces new content, such as additional weapons, armour, spells, and items. The mod also rebalances gameplay elements, updates enemy placements, and adds new areas to explore.

title: In the Grace of Our Malice
description:
Bee receives a call from a friend in need. They're estranged, but there's a bond that won't go away; for better and for worse.

In the Grace of our Malice is an old-school, linear Visual Novel made in roughly a week by kiri and merengedoll.

title: Cooking Academy 3: Recipe for Success
description: Return to your roots and learn new dishes in Cooking Academy 3 - Recipe for Success, a delicious sequel to the hit series. After winning one million dollars and opening a restaurant, the time has come to write your very own cookbook. To make it a bestseller however, it will take many new recipes. Thankfully, you have your old professor Henri Fromage and his friends to help.

title: Dreamy Idea
description: DREAMY IDEA is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Salma, an artist who falls into dreams while searching for ideas. The goal of the game is to explore the dream world and collect effects.

title: Just Dance.exe
description:
Just Dance.exe is a free PC-exclusive fangame made from scratch. With content made by fans like fanmades, mashups, and original maps, with the aim of making their creations playable and reaching more people.

You can play new exclusive game modes, with which you will discover new ways to dance while having fun with your friends.

title: Where Are You?
description: Where Are You? is a story-driven 2D adventure about curiosity, loss, and the search for truth — and about the question of whether values can survive when truth is forgotten.

title: Pawnchline
description:
Display your best stand-up comedy routines in the most famous bar in town, the "Pawnchline".

Use your joke cards to find the type of humor that best suits your audience, and make them laugh. But bear in mind, each session has its new outlandish audience, with different humor preferences.

title: The Radio Chaser
description: Go recover your radio from the blob thingys on an andventure around multiple locations!

title: Taco Tides
description: Captain George and his crew of daring cats embark on a taco-filled odyssey, encountering treacherous waters, dastardly duck foes, and a grand admiral with a quacking secret. As you navigate the Taco Tides, you'll sail, shoot, and solve the mystery of disappearing tacos in this purrfectly hilarious and action-packed game.

title: 240p Test Suite
description: The 240p test suite is a homebrew software suite for video game consoles developed to help in the evaluation of capture cards, upscalers, upscan converters, line doublers and of course TV processing of 240p video and scaled signals.

title: Thoughtform Invasion
description:
In THOUGHTFORM INVASION you need to try to fall asleep, while being harassed by [REDACTED]. The more you think about them, the more likely they are to materialize.

Use your flashlight to scare them away, close your eyes and get a good nights rest. And brace yourself if you decide to open your eyes.

title: Horké Léto 2
description: It is a point-and-click adventure with hand-paintend graphics and focused on (not always) logical puzzles, funny minigames and crazy humor. It takes place in the Wild West. It´s the second game in the series.

title: Holo X Break
description: Fight your way through endless waves of holoX's minions! Gear up with all sorts of equipment and items in this action packed beat-em-up to reach the 5 bosses of hololive's "holoX", and put a stop to their plans!

title: Angélica no Reino Animal
description: Go on an adventure with Angélica and learn all the secrets of the fascinating animal kingdom. You'll get to see new animals, explore wild places and have lots of fun.

title: Crusader Kings III: Wards & Wardens
description: Many new education events add greater depth to the training of the young people of court. Educating the children of the court is now more interactive for both formal tutoring and the ever important life lessons. Shape not just the abilities, but the personality of your young charges, steering them to more acceptable or desirable traits for the important role they will play in the future.

title: Who Wants to Be a Murderer?
description: Who Wants to Be a Murderer? is a psychological horror game set in a TV game show straight out of the 90s. You'll face a series of challenges that will put your morality and sanity to the test.

title: Batsugun
description: Experience the epic conclusion of Toaplan's legendary shooter series with Batsugun including the lauded Special version! Choose your favorite character and spaceship in this thrilling genre-defining bullet-hell action. Now on PC with modern enhancements!

title: Talking ABC's: A Day at the Beach
description: Talking ABC's: A Trip To The Beach is an early spelling game for children 2 to 6 years old. The game uses software called TurboSound to produce voice through the PC speaker, while the vast majority of games required a soundcard. There are three modes of play. In the first mode, the game announces a letter, which the player must find on the keyboard, and then an object that starts with that later is introduced and drawn onto the screen. In the second mode, the player can press any letter and the corresponding object is drawn to the screen, which the player can move wherever they want. In the third mode, three letters and three objects are displayed, and the player must draw a line between the letters and objects to make them match. Registered users received a copy of the game which displayed their child's name, and could request a CGA optimized version which was much faster for CGA users. Additionally, they were promised a free game. Later versions promised a copy of Millions of Mazes, which may or may not have been the original free game.

title: BoKe Travelog
description: BoKe Travelog was a PC browser game released exclusively in China that bares many similarities to the game Poptropica.

title: T.G.I.F.
description: Party game for 1-4 players.

title: Looper
description: Escape the dungeon using the Looper — a cutting-edge technology that lets you fold the space itself.

title: Cakefoot
description: Cakefoot is an ultra-hard, single-button, minimalist avoid ’em up with natural physics that is simple to learn and difficult to master. The cake moves on a rail – hold to go forward, let go to fall back. If you can navigate the most challenging enemy patterns you’ve ever seen all the way to the end, you’ll be rewarded with – a new, harder difficulty.

title: TopSpin 2K25: Deluxe Edition
description: Fill out your TopSpin 2K25 collection with the Deluxe Edition, including the Under the Lights Pack, New Wave Pack, and the Rookie Rise Pack!

title: Read Only Memories: Neurodiver - Collector's Edition
description: Each copy of the game includes: physical copy of the game on Nintendo Switch/PlayStation 5, art book, NEURODIVER plush, double-sided acrylic charm featuring ES88, prismatic sticker sheet, instruction manual, soundtrack download card, collector’s edition box.

title: I*Chu: Chibi Edition
description: Guide 32 aspiring idols towards their ultimate debut. Play rhythm action games to unlock characters and create your own groups. Follow the characters’ journeys through the main story and support them through their struggles!

title: Construction Simulator 4
description: Construction Simulator returns with a map inspired by the Canadian landscape.

title: Boardwalk Arcade 2
description:
Boardwalk Arcade 2 is a sequel to the successful Party Arcade game. Boardwalk Arcade 2 offers a brand-new location on the boardwalk featuring exciting and classic mini games.

Boardwalk Arcade 2 features a collection of games that will be instantly familiar to anyone who’s been to a carnival or boardwalk. The more you play the more tickets you earn towards cosmetic upgrades, figurines, and collectibles!

title: Amerzone: The Explorer's Legacy - Limited Edition
The Smurfs: Village Party
description: Papa Smurf has decided to organize an exceptional party! Embark on a party game set in the Smurfs' Village, featuring an adventure mode.

title: Monster Hunter Stories Collection
description: A compilation of the HD port of Monster Hunter Stories and Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin.

title: Sherlock Purr 2
description: Join Sherlock Purr on a purrfect adventure!

title: Stop10
description:
STOP10 is an arcade game that mixes fast reflexes with simple sums.

Your objective is to make the counter and the moving number to sum 10. However, the counter is rapidly moving so you'll have to be quick and sharp! The faster you answer, the more points you get!

The counter has a timer which refills when you get a correct answer and drops when you miss. If it drops to 0, it's game over!

title: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo
description: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?! In this 2D top-down adventure you'll explore a sprawling urban landscape, reinterpreting your surroundings through your mastery of yoyo tricks. Combine moves for traversal, fight the city's rival crime lords, and regain the influence of the Pipistrello family!

title: Hentai Girls: Naughty Gamer
description: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Stickman Jailbreak 2024
description: Are You Ready to Unlock the Secrets?

title: Eggy Space
description: A light tower defense game with unique planet exploration. Defend against aliens, collect resources, and build a new home. Exquisite graphics and challenges await!

title: Opps! They Love Me Way Too Much!
description: You'll immerse yourself in first-person perspective, encountering four boys with diverse personalities and appearances, embarking on various sweet love stories with them. The aloof boss, the gentle neighbor, the adorable coffeeboy, or the platonic friend? Among them, who will be your final choice?

title: Abyss and Dungeon
description: "Abyss and Dungeon" is a fantasy adventure fighting game.

title: Wuxia: Founding Schools
description: "Wuxia: Founding Schools" is a Chinese-style martial arts card game. Players can create sects, train heroes, build decks, and create unique cards and styles using different effects. It's all about drawing and playing cards!

title: Parkour Every Day
description: A side-scrolling parkour game with a high level of difficulty.

title: Lonely Journey
description: This is a 2d side-scrolling game similar to (Ori and the Blind Forest) and (Hollow Knight), embark on an adventure in this fantasy land, collect key items, buy powerful equipment, gather pets to fight together, 100+ elves will participate in the battle, and 30+ costumes to help in the battle

title: Home Simulator
description: A relatively casual and free exploration game, where you will be exploring a villa. Most of the items in the house are interactive, and you can freely make a mess in the house!

title: Dog Brew
description: Dog Brew - a light indie adventure where the main character, burdened by debts, decides to settle them through the art of brewing beer.

title: Flikk
description: A fast-paced precision platformer where your aim is to reach the goal by toggling objects on and off.

title: Nientum: Opus Zero
description: Nientum - Opus Zero is a 2D action game that brings platformer, runner and music interactive genre all together. A fantastic journey of the director and singer, and the storytelling of music from the world. Run through the stage to complete their fate!

title: Sire
description: Sire is a narrative card game about dealing with the death of a parent, and the whirlwind of emotions that follow. Players combine cards to explore a darkly comedic, surreal world of loss and learning, in a combination of classic point-n-click adventure and real video footage.

title: Data Rush: La Course Aux Données
description: Data Rush: The Data Race is an educational 2D adventure video game about the world of DATA. Take control of a customizable avatar and traverse crazy levels packed with original characters and mini-games, to become the master of digital data !

title: Katana Dynasty
description: Every decision you make shapes the destiny of Kaito and the fate of the city. Will you choose the path of honor, exposing the truth and restoring justice, or succumb to the allure of power and manipulation?

title: Russian Hut Simulator
description: An interactive tour of a traditional wooden hut.

title: Search of the Source
description: Search of the Source is an exciting role-playing game in which you take on the role of a young squire venturing into a dangerous and mysterious magical forest. You have to complete many different tasks, explore mysterious places and fight mystical enemies.

title: Contract & Control
description: Embark on an electrifying journey in a role-playing extravaganza with mind-bending features that'll whisk you to new realms! Get ready for an adventure that'll leave you breathless and craving more! Brace yourself, this game may actually blow your mind!

title: Huedini
description: Huedini is a top-down action roguelike game. Play as Huedini, a powerful wizard with the ability to change his colour. By matching your colour, to that of the enemies you can absorb their colour essence. By combining these colour essences into the correct combination, you can cast custom spells.

title: HealQuest
description: Discover a paradise island in VR with HealQuest. Trigger exercises as you explore, and play with the adorable inhabitants to progress. An immersive sports adventure awaits you.

title: RetroFight
description: RetroFight is a multiplayer turn-based strategy game for up to 6 players, in which each action change impacts your next turn retroactively. Play games full of twists and become the master of retroactivity!

title: Antidote City Hall
description: You play as a former policeman who founded a private detective agency. Investigate a chain of mysterious murders, plunge into the world of crime, gain former glory, restore your good name. An exciting storyline, explore the city, a lot of characters, an atmosphere of fear and hopelessness.

title: Lost Beacon
description: Experience the thrill of guiding Brutus, a courageous Siberian Husky, across treacherous frozen lakes, hazardous cliffsides, and dark caverns of the Alaskan wilderness as you help him reunite with his team of sled dogs in Lost Beacon, the breathtaking 3D puzzle platformer from Black Banshee Studios.

title: Power of Petanque
description:
A druidic and magical adaptation of pétanque. Compete against your friends!
Compete against your friends in the traditional sport of petanque to determine who is the master of petanque.

title: Monster Typer Backspace
description: Monsters. Typing. Earth-3.

title: Grid Dungeons
description: A turn-based strategy game. Command a team with swordsmen, archers, and mages, strategically navigating grid maps. Unleash unique actions to defeating enemies. Master tactics, minimize damage, and conquer in this immersive strategy adventure.

title: Jack Styler
description: Former FBI agent and fishing enthusiast, faces an alien-zombie apocalypse after a virus escapes from NASA. Determined to rescue his wife, he defies the FBI and embarks alone to confront the threat. An epic rescue mission filled with action and suspense!

title: Point4Point
description: point4point is a rather dark adventure game. Games are created using RPG maker MV and there are no major difficulties in operating the game. In the game you can meet different types of monsters. The player must escape from it by avoiding elements that aim at the main character and hinder him.

title: Cyclic Warriors
description: Cyclic Warriors is a movement shooter focused on time travel and speed. Wall-run, slide, kick and bunny-hop to build up massive momentum. Time travel to dodge bullets and flank your enemies. Slow down time for easy kills!

title: Goat Scourge
description: Quiet village life is disturbed by the attack of the Ogre Sorcerer, who needs goat bones for his magical experiments. The beloved pet goat of a village boy is stolen - and he risks it all to save the goat's life. Help him retrieve his pet - and explore the village and its outskirts in our game.

title: Bulls and Cows: Wild West
description: On the farm, amidst green pastures and picturesque meadows, our little heroes will meet Vanessa - a clever and friendly cow-guide. She will enthusiastically explain the rules of the game and help children develop their logical abilities.

title: Runestone: Pathfinders
description: "Runestone: Pathfinder" is a 3D adventure platformer game set in the world of Runestone. Players will play as a rookie pathfinder and help the rookie get through his first trial.

title: DNA: Episode 2
description: The DNA action rpg franchise is created by a solo dev as an episodic side scrolling action hack and slash beat em up, story-driven 2d anime that welcomes the world into the DNA universe. You play as the main character Leo to find his true purpose in life. Thus begins the fascinating story of DNA!

title: Romance Fantasy
description: It's a two-person production game for fans by V-tuber 'Lee Jooin'.The development of the game began with the support of many 'Churros(fans)' written in the ending credits. Enjoy the romance fantasy stories of 'Lee Jooin' and 'Churros'

title: Graveskelet
description: In a deep and dark forest, skeletons rise up and you pick up your gun and start hunting them down to stop it.

title: Subversive Memories
description: Subversive Memories is a story driven survival horror set in Brazil during the last military dictatorship. Explore the backrooms of an oppressive regime, escape ominous presences and scavenge every corner of this land in search of your ██████.

title: Rune Gate: Retribution
description: Rune Gate: Retribution is a roguelite deckbuilder centered on card customization. Craft unique battle strategies with different runes. Face continuous challenges, where every choice can lead to victory or defeat. Dive into Rune Gate, unleash creativity, and explore endless card combinations.

title: Successful business
description: Successful business - A meditative game that will help you relax. You just started a new job and received your first order!

title: Enso
description: Slingshot your way to the top of a beautiful minimalist landscape. A deceptively tricky platformer where a single slip could lead to a long fall back down!

title: Shards Between Us
description: With their family and home on the brink of collapse, two magical sisters must find a way to grow together. Join their coming of age journey in this healing, heartfelt head-scratcher.

title: Fate's Theater
description: A mischievous micro-tales toy where Fortune and Misfortune vie to twist mortal lives into short, rhyming couplets of bright serendipities… or gleefully gruesome doom.

title: Parhelion
description: This is a visual novel game. Players can obtain relevant information with npc and explore the maps on an island called Soraki to form their own understanding of this story. Can you continue to find the so-called truth by constantly trying to explore...

title: Gun Shop Simulator
description: Manage your own gun store, selling firearms from pistols to rifles. Test your collection at the shooting range, compete with others, and expand your business.

title: Exphysia
description: Exphysia is a new type of action role-playing game that allows players to move freely anywhere in a space where almost everything operates based on physical calculations. Become a slime that can enter anywhere and challenge dungeons and powerful enemies with the sexy otherworldly resident "Lumiers".

title: Kitty Kitty Bounce Bounce
description: Good old-fashioned arcade game in which you bop around a kitty using various cushions. Your goal is to break all breakable block without falling onto the floor. Difficulty levels, in-game shop where you can buy pick-me-ups with points you get for destruction, cute art and soundtrack, and much more!

title: Quadricolor: Ultra Sentai Color Ranger
description: Put on your sentai hero suit and join the chromatic battle! Protect the color balance in this lightning-fast 2D arena shooter. Snack it on with friends on a couch or online up to 4 players. Fight against evil forces and rise through the ranks in Quadricolor: Ultra Sentai Color Rangers.

title: Taimanin Yukikaze
description: A classic visual novel about a demon-slaying ninja. Yukikaze is an up-and-coming young Taimanin with a suite of deadly lightning powers, but when she embarks on a mission to rescue her missing mother, she just might have bitten off more than she can chew...

title: Chipwits
description: You have to program a small robot named ChipWit.

title: Farm Racing.
description: Train hard, respect your horse, and become a true champion in Farm Racing

title: Mad Skills Motocross: Chasing the Dream
description: Mad Skills Motocross: Chasing the Dream is an authentic motocross racing experience that was developed by riders, for riders. It perfectly blends arcade-style mechanics with realistic track layouts and rider movements. Get ready to experience the thrill of motocross racing like never before.

title: Roomka
description: You woke up in a cell in the basement. What now?

title: Rekesh Gaal
description: You are a wanderer chosen to fight evil. Choose your path, explore gloomy locations and find secret places. Defeat your enemies through complex character development, hundreds of unique items and crafting.

title: Red End
description: A racing game. Under the azure sky, this is a huge racing park, dedicated to your race track.

title: Tears of Fish
description: This is a maze game where handsome armored warriors accidentally enter a mysterious maze.

title: Freak House
description: "Freak House" is an exciting horror-themed puzzle. You will have to help the main character unravel the mystery of the terrifying House he has found himself in! Your skill in finding objects and will be the key to solving the secrets of the House! Only you can determine the fate of the hero!

title: SokoFarm
description: SokoFarm is a Sokoban puzzle game with bright, cosy visuals and cute characters played out in a sleepy rural setting. Roll Chonky Chickens, Ducks and Geese to their preferred nests in the fewest moves possible. Play through the seasons to see new farms and features for even more brain teasing fun!

title: Exovoid
description: Survive the abyss in Exovoid – a souls-like odyssey. Battle, conquer, and shape your fate. Every death defines your journey. Are you ready?

title: Ranocta
description: Ranocta is a note-drop 2D rhythm game in a space that crosses straight and circular shapes. In an emotional and beautiful world full of colors and sounds, experience your own performance to recover lost light.

title: Mutant Monster Invasion
description: A classic tower defense game, ready to build dozens of turrets and use dozens of magic to destroy monsters?

title: Tennis Girl
description: The player is about to enter a girl's tennis academy, where the students are all beautiful, and extremely talented tennis girls. Outsiders call them "tennis girls". Player need to conquer these girls with you tennis skills!

title: Habitatrix
description: A water physics puzzle variety game.

title: 13 Floors: Anomalies
description: You get a strange job. Your job is to patrol a 13th-floor apartment, look for anomalies...

title: Galactic Counselors
description: In this sci-fi strategy game, the Solar System of 4,000 A.D. is ravaged by wars between humanity's planetary colonies. These wars are directed by Supremes - the autocrat leaders of the planets. But each leader needs an advisor, and this is where you step in. Can you guide your ruler to victory?

title: Booeys: Rip in the Rift
description: In this supernatural sorting game, help Booey take control of objects from the human world and send them back through the rip in the rift. Built to empower the delivery of VB-MAPP assessments, explore endless opportunities for trial design in an all new format!

title: Snip It!
description: A 2D Qix-like retro arcade game. Draw lines to capture the canvas and defeat enemies!

title: Etherrealm
description: A rogue dungeon crawler with fast-paced live combat mechanics that are reminiscent of the classic souls-like game.

title: The Vampire
description: The Vampire is a first-person horror adventure game designed for single player use only. Would you like to spend the night with Cooper, a stoic vampire hunter who holds the secrets of an ancient legend? Defeat the vampires and escape their world.

title: Mystery Box 5: Elements
description: Explore a new series of intricate boxes filled with alluring enigmas and brain-teasing challenges that will leave you a lasting impression

title: OG Puzzlers: Synthwave Astronauts
description: OG Puzzlers: Synthwave Astronauts is an puzzel game with cool astronauts in an stunning synthwave style. You have to assemble a single image from random generated indivdual pieces. Combine all of the smart singel frames into one big image and unlock the next level.

title: Wind Field
description: This is a super fun action game made with a fresh and cute cartoon style

title: Qwepoi
description: Qwepoi is an arcade space shooter game using QWE IOP keys where you paint the Infantry ships before they enter the base.

title: Mango Goes to Mewsic School
description: Mango Goes to Mewsic School is a cute rhythm game where you play as a cat, Mango, trying to get into music school. Traverse a trap-laden environment to learn from the masters, who will teach you the basics of four different music genres.

title: Fantasy Creature Jigsaws
description: Piece together beautiful pictures of fantastical creatures. Dragons, Goblins, Manticores and more. Casual relaxing and satisifying.

title: Limp Heroes+
description: Limp Heroes+ is an action game in which players control a physically-driven hero to battle an army of evil villains. Using attractive characters with a touch of American Comics, players can challenge fierce battles with simple controls that require only jumping and special attacks.

title: Satellite Engineer
description: The artificial satellite with interrupted power supply needs repair. Let's navigate the space platform and collect the parts. If possible, challenge the mission with minimal movement to conserve energy.

title: The Cursor Game
description: Are you ready for the challenge? Guide your cursor through 30 difficult levels. Test your patience and precision in this casual hard game! Share your best times with #THECursorGame and become THE Cursor Master.

title: Dungeon Dev
description: The demon lord, who has been secretly trading with the human kingdom's king, summons you and requests your help in developing a special dungeon. It's none other than a dungeon where is narrowly defeated by the heroes!

title: Grr Boo I
description: GRR BOO i est un plateformer 2D. Il se distingue par ses graphismes enfantins, mais ne vous y trompez pas, la difficulté est trop grande pour des enfants.

title: Game of Life: Time
description: See the trajectory of Conway's Game of Life through time in a 3D perspective. Create cells, destroy cells, randomly generate cells, and observe the evolution of cell groups on the timeline!

title: Run for the Bus
description: "Run for the Bus" is a 3D third-person she-runner game. A girl who overslept in the morning runs after the bus she missed. Let her build her strength and chase her bus as she eats the bread.

title: Astronave
description: Astronave is a minimalist tube shooter.

title: Rogue Night
description: Fight through hordes undead, and collect their heads to unlock permanent upgrades while you gather resources to build your base. Choose your class, and preferred weapons. Explore dungeons to find rings, tools, and blueprints, and rescue NPCs who unlock new structures and provide various resources.

title: Mudoku: Next Sudoku
description: Move + Sudoku = Mudoku !! Mudoku is addictive puzzle based on Sudoku.

title: ZenFire
description: Very casual click and shoot with some little minigames, reach 20k points to beat the game!

title: Computer Fury
description: Offline fighting game like 3rd person challenging fighting game, you can very easily make your any special move or difficult move during fight with any simple keyboard, using keyboard is more fun than x box game pad or pc game pad, but with x box game pad or pc game pad added vibration system

title: Pixel Quest: Survivor
description: In this action roguelite with unique and themed characters, create your build and face hordes of enemies with up to 4 friends online, kill monsters, collect their souls, face bosses and survive!

title: Real Life
description: Survive the dungeon and return to the tavern with loot to go farther, or die alone and lose everything.

title: Fudgy Dice
description: From the fusion of dice games and deckbuilders rises a brand-new dice-builder. Embark on a crazy roguelike adventure with ramping relics and (literally) exploding dice or challenge your friends in local multiplayer with one of 7 unique characters.

title: Boink
description: Boink! A game about falling money and building bouncers to increase the money. Purchase bouncers and place them on the map. Upgrade bouncers and the cannon to boost value. Rebirth to gain unique upgrades. Watch your money grow!

title: Song of Yosef
description: Song of Yosef is a Metroidvania platformer with wacky enemies and fun physics.

title: Mech Builder
description: Welcome to Mech Builder- a relaxing puzzle game inspired by Model building(gunpla). You will experience the relaxing process of building a model kit with complete freedom with over 50+ puzzles.

title: Ringo's Roundup
description: Solve grid-based puzzles, guide Postbunny Ringo's car through a variety of environments and collect all the scattered envelopes in this cute pathfinding puzzle game!

title: Rest to Landia
description: Resttolandia: A thrilling adventure as you embody a determined streamer aiming for the top. Master precision jumps, dodge obstacles, and climb closer to streaming stardom. Can you reach the summit and join the elite? Jump into action now!

title: Next Room
description: It is a single-player 3D scene puzzle type game that interacts with objects in a room from a first-person perspective to find a way to the next room. The game is made up of high-quality models, bright skies and warm sunlight, so find your way to the next room in this cozy room!

title: Sudoku Constellation
description: Sudoku gives a sense of calm, relaxation, and resonance with the universe, relieving stress, reducing anxiety, and helping players reconnect to their inner peace. Gameplay Description: Just keep the 'numbers' or 'constellations' in each row, column, and house without repeating.

title: Rhythm & Beats
