description: Explore the West and uncover its hidden gems through the excitement of finding fun objects.

title: Drift Force Xtreme: Ultimate Car Simulator 2024
description: Unleash Your Drift Fury. Become the Champion of Asphalt!

title: Escape Game The Kitty School
description:
I have visited an abandoned school
However a heavy rain got me stuck in the building……
What I found was totally insane……！？

title: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Deluxe Edition
description: Emotional, 3rd-person, story-driven, adventure game focused on solving puzzles and using stealth mechanics. Use your bow to interact with environmental elements. Sneak, climb or distract guards to move further unnoticed. Solve light puzzles alongside your path to rescue your loved one.

title: Across the Obelisk: Starter Set
description: Get the best possible start to your journey with the Starter Set! This essential bundle brings together the Across the Obelisk base game and the acclaimed expansion Sands of Ulminin accompanied by the hero pack featuring Amelia, the Queen.

title: Knowledge Keeper
description: In this game, you will become a keeper of knowledge, collecting shards of divine crystals. Look for the right way to crystals. Avoid dangerous obstacles. Teleport from one space to another to get closer to your goal.

title: Not Tonight & Not Tonight 2
description: Not Tonight is a post-Brexit management game, fusing a time-pressure RPG with a politically charged story where every decision matters.

title: Overdelivery: Delivery Simulator
description: Overdelivery: Speed, Deliver, Conquer! Dominate city streets, upgrade your wheels, and become the ultimate delivery champ!

title: They Always Run: Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes: - They Always Run - Audio Artbook (Arts from They Always Run)

title: WWII Airplane Fight: Battle War Squad
description: Dominate the skies, Conquer the seas, Rewrite wartime history.

title: Choko Nana
description: This is a single-player RPG where you can enjoy the basic elements of combat, collection, exploration, and growth. The game offers a simple experience composed of “little” elements, and the charming interactions between the cute characters are also a highlight.

title: This Is a Square!
description: It's not a very minimalist geometric rouge game.

title: Find True Love or Hell!
description: First-person perspective through role-playing When getting along with the "Destined Heroine", they constantly make choices to deepen mutual understanding, and strive to exchange sincerity for true love. These choices determine the final emotional outcome. In the end, who will Huang Di's true love be

title: Chaotic Conflicts
description: Chaotic Conflicts is a casual and chaotic fast-paced Online FPS game. In this chaotic shooter you'll try to shoot your way to the top of the scoreboard while competing with other players and random events.

title: Grandma Don't Click That!
description: Play as a computer virus destroying grandma's PC. In this unique platformer meets liquid physics simulation you will find yourself flowing through electronics, corrupting files, and evolving with only two goals in mind... spread and destroy!

title: Illumination
description: In the dense forest, there are endless mysteries.

title: Shock Wave
description: On the Silent Night of All Saints, monsters come to the human world at night.

title: Indies' Lies 2: Fire Seed
description: A turn-based strategy game that combines deck-building and tactical chess. Players control an expedition team consisting of three heroes, embarking on an adventure to find their way home. By scavenging equipment and building decks, players gradually forge their own path of battle。

title: Hexpire
description: Hexpire is a relaxing city builder where you build a prosperous empire by careful building placement.

title: BallBastic!
description: An arcade-style passion project based off similar ball-rolling games from the early 2000s. Guide the ball to the goal within the time limit, and be sure not to fall off!

title: Shrimp Game: Overkrill
description: Become a pilot of a SHRIMP - Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platform. Krill your friends, explore areas for loot and customize your SHRIMP!

title: Sword vs. Horde
description: A melee based horde survival game. You are a knight wielding an oversized greatsword. Whirl it around in circles and use your blade's momentum to slash through endless hordes of monsters. But take care! You'll get dizzy from all the spinning!

title: Road Engineer
description: You are a Road Engineer. Build roads and bridges to optimize traffic, cost, speed or distance for different vehicles on a lot of various and challenging levels!

title: Balium
description: Welcome! We are now going into open beta, free to play. This is a 5 year long project by 1 developer. Local play can be done with up to 4 controllers, or 3 and keyboard/mouse. Internet play has been added, and offers different modes of play like battle royal, timed, etc..

title: Olga: Episode 1
description: Relive Olga's childhood memories as she visits her grandparents' home in Belovodica, a secluded mountain village where some discoveries last a lifetime.

title: Emergency Cleanup Co.
description: Clean where chaos reigns. From filthy homes and cluttered offices to messy beaches and space stations, clear trash, scrape grime, and tidy up. Blast away dirt with high-pressure water, upgrade your tools, and restore order. Don’t keep your clients waiting, get to work!

title: Haunted Arcade
description: A cozy Arcade Game Collection turned on its head by the twists of a local Ghost.

title: Crops!
description: Crops! is an autobattler in which your fruits and vegetables come alive! Plant your crops in specific patterns and place them strategically to defend against rats, kobolds and even dragons.

title: Mushroots
description: New RTS for everyone!

title: Sis and Bro The Cyborg Siblings
description: A visual novel RPG where you play as one of two adorable robots and do whatever you want, even if you wanna do nothing!

title: Eko And The Bewitched Lands
description: "Eko and the Bewitched Lands" is a roguelite action RPG game. Help Eko on his mission to save the bewitched lands filled with enemies. Acquire and upgrade weapons of all kinds to combat and discover all the secrets that awaits for you.

title: Crop Chronicles
description: Dive into Crop Chronicles, where farm gaming evolves! Race against time, manage diverse crops, and fulfill dynamic orders. Embrace strategy and teamwork across 47 thrilling levels. Farm, fish, and flourish in this captivating adventure!

title: Rogue Sky
description: Master gravity-defying flight mechanics and time-bending powers in this bullet hell rogue-lite where strategic depth meets intense gameplay. Unravel synergistic upgrades and enhancements as you stop the alien invasion from ever happening. Are you ready to dominate the skies?

title: DudeGo
description: Each map is different and has a challenge for you. Are you ready to conquer the unexpected? Prove that you can handle every challenge the game has to offer. Last survivor is the winner. will it be you?

title: Project Cottontails
description: "Project Cottontails" is an interactive narrative adventure in the Manduria Civic Museum. Step into the shoes of Alessio, explore the museum, interact with characters and objects to piece together the story of your ancestor, a famous Allied aviator in World War II.

title: Primage
description: As the leader of a Stone Age tribe, gather resources, develop your settlement and lead your people through the challenges of a world full of danger and mystery. Your survival skills, strategic planning and decision-making will be key in this battle for survival.

title: Planetka
description: You play as a tiny sentient planet. Maintain your ecosystem, create new plant species and discover the hidden powers inside you. You’ll need them soon, because there is a human spaceship approaching with the intention to mine all your resources and they don’t care if it kills you in the process.

title: Hororo Meguru's Bing!! Ball
description: "Hororo Meguru’s BING!! BALL" offers a whimsical take on pinball action. Score big solo, or enjoy chaotic fun in 4-player matches. Collect enchanting Hororo stills as you progress. Easy to pick up for an on-the-go arcade delight!

title: Mushrush
description: Embark on a whimsical journey as a humanoid mushroom in this platformer adventure. Traverse through floating islands, giant trees, caves and lakes to befriend a group of fungal friends that can all grow together.

title: Personal Finance Simulator
description: Choose how much money you start with, a profession, and a city, then make personal financial decisions! Will you end up rich or end up getting evicted?

title: Crystalline Bliss
description: Embark on a journey to serenity within the eternal realms of pure consciousness in Crystalline Bliss. This lo-fi, melancholic, psychedelic voxel puzzle game transports you to the otherworldly landscapes beyond our reality. Delve into the mysteries of your soul and find your path to joy.

title: KunKunHome
description: This is a fictional story in which you play as a KunKun enthusiast named Su Shan, who sneaks into the suspected KunKun residence to explore.All content in the game is unrelated to reality, and any similarity is purely coincidental.

title: Penalty
description: Penalty is a 2D Openworld adventure RPG, with unique gameplay mechanics, FBF animations, and beautiful sound and visual effects. Fight your way through with zour weapons and with zour magic, you can use to customize your hero with armor and weapons.

title: Pawn Simulator
description: Pawn Simulator, Prove your trading prowess. Find the most profitable products by bargaining and show off your trading skills. Develop your trading strategies and master your tactics to stay ahead of your competitors. You're no longer just a vendor, you're on your way to becoming the ruler of Detroit's trading world! Make a name for yourself with your achievements in every trade and prove that you are the most successful merchant running a pawn shop.

title: Piggy's Great Adventure
description: Let's have a great adventure with Piggy the Little Dragon! Gather a group of unique friends and fight against dark demons! Fantasy SRPG is here!

title: Fountain
description: Lead a squad of up to 7 members entering a constantly changing barrier. In this mysterious adventure, meet interesting companions, fight against various enemies, collect rare treasures, and reveal the secrets concealed within the barrier.

title: Detective: The Motel
description: Detective The Motel is a deduction game where, to advance, you must take a pencil and a piece of paper and write down everything that seems like evidence in order to answer all the questions that arise. Solving the case will depend only on you.

title: How Old is James?
description: How Old is James? is a game about humanity. Assemble memories through a variety of brain-tickling puzzles and discover a hidden life of the main character, to ultimately answer — what makes us human.

title: Starlight Riddles
description: Starlight City is a city where the boundaries of reality are blurred. Waking up in an unfamiliar city with no memories of the past, you will find that you are not the only one suffering from amnesia. Residents of the city have also lost touch with their past, shrouding the place in mysteries.

title: Goeland: Seagull Adventure
description: Take off as a mischievous seagull, and soar into a captivating escapade! From playful pranks to selfless deeds, be the ultimate feathered troublemaker or a helpful hero. Solve puzzles, unravel secrets, and engage with an interactive world. Let your wings decide the fate of this charming adventure!

title: LingTian1
description: LingTian1 is a 3D visual style otome game. The Prince is madly in love with you. 500+ shots of exquisite dynamic images, 200+ scenes , main line and 9 side lines, Sections for interacting with the prince. Fully Voiced.

title: The Last Hospital
description: Every decision made influences humanity's fate, with USMLE level medical questions woven into patient care, revealing the mysteries of a dying world.

title: Luffi: Homebound
description: Luffi is returning home from time away at Hartfer's Art Academy. Explore, collect memories and make new friends along the way! Relax and enjoy a wholesome cozy experience as you journey home.

title: Day Of The Tank
description: Day of The Tank is a retro top down shooter where you have to defend your Command Post from waves of enemy tanks by killing them all. Fight across multiple destructible levels. Experience old school tank gaming from the 1980s, but with a modern save system!

title: Astral Rift
description: Fight and Explore your way through randomly generated dungeons full of hordes of dangerous enemies and powerful bosses to restore the Astral Crystal and save the world from spatial collapse! Expand your arsenal and brew potent potions as you grow into the strongest adventurer of all!

title: Cut the Cards
description: Create your own cards in this roguelike deckbuilder by cutting and pasting throughout your deck! Journey to the chasms, fighting off dragons and Boviks alike as you manage scarce resources.

title: Inexorable
description: This game is an innovative twist on classic snake - style games

title: Pocket Pusher
description: Your coin-pushing and ball-dropping fix! Drop strategically, win rewards, and enjoy the classic arcade thrill from the comfort of your home. A premium coin pusher experience, minimized.

title: Flyga
description: Be free as a bird, by being a bird. Fly around a vast landscape to explore it's nature and meet its inhabitants, both animal and human.

title: Gaze of Dread
description: Mary Thorne has booked a week-long getaway at a rental house to escape the distractions of her family so that she can focus on her project. While staying at the house, Valley View Escape, she begins to notice an unnerving presence watching her every move.

title: Endless Return
description: Exciting arcade action game where you will fight against hordes of enemies, upgrade your skills, and choose from a variety of weapons and abilities. With each battle you become stronger and unlock new possibilities. Dive into thrilling battles in captivating world of "Endless Return".

title: Our Doomed Bunker
description: Our Doomed Bunker is a short 1-4 player co-op puzzle horror game

title: The Maze of Zabendo
description: You play as Theo Abescar, a detective who is determined to find out what happened to his favorite park and cartoon when he was a child.

title: Project Bob
description: After a High_tech artificial intelligence robot named "SH" goes wild, you realize that you can't defeat him alone so you start to make a robot, helping you to stop him.

title: Hadley's Run: A Starship Saga
description: Slay your way through a relentless enemy horde in this roguelike twin-stick shooter. Kick ass. Find love. Save the universe.

title: Rime's Quest
description: Rime's Quest is an exciting adventure in the world of the Roman Empire, where an ordinary traveler decides to leave his everyday life and go on a dangerous journey. During the game, the player will go on an epic quest full of interesting events, riddles and encounters with numerous enemies.

title: Night of the Assassins
description: Night of the Assassins - you will find yourself in the role of a mysterious killer, able to manipulate the shadow and hide in it in order to approach your enemies unnoticed. Your character is a master of stealth and the art of assassination, who is legendary.

title: Black Wolfberry: WuJing
description: This is a third-person action shooter where you need to break through a maze

title: Insider Threat
description: Insider Threat is a first-person survival horror game that focuses on creating fear and tension for the player.

title: Pumpkin Woods
description: Collect magical ingredients and build your cozy witch home while exploring the wonderful sights and secrets of these mysterious lands. Beware though, danger might be lurking deep in these woods...

title: The Alchemist's Apprentice in the Maze of Madness
description: A loveletter to the dungeon crawler genre, filled with procedurally generated mazes, mix and match puzzles, traps and upgrades.

title: Little Oceania
description: Little Oceania is a minimal strategy building game. Create a delightful medieval kingdom in the middle of the ocean by placing cute miniature structures. Plan your space well, earn money, discover new buildings and biomes, and continually expand your picturesque island kingdom.

title: Sterospeed
description: Difficult Game To Master

title: Aisla
description: You play as Aisla, a woman who wakes up with no memories in a complex on Mars. Your objective is to explore the environments and discover who the character is and what situation she is in.

title: Crackernuts
description: Crackernuts is a narrative game about a goat-headed girl and her sister, a no-bodied head. They are on quest to find themselves and rescue their village from a curse of darkness.

title: Bunker Invaders
description: Work with your crew to keep the bunker standing.

title: Slot Advanture
description: Are you lucky or bad? 2D turn-based action adventure game. Defeat the monster with the hit rate you get by turning the slot. You can also get the character's stat, various items, and good ability buffs all at random. Trust your luck and go on an adventure rather than a high-level strategy.

title: Baisu

title: Luma Island
description: Luma Island is a casual life simulation and farming game where players explore a peaceful island, grow crops, care for animals, and interact with a small community of characters. The game focuses on day-to-day activities, resource gathering, and simple crafting mechanics in a relaxed, open-ended environment.

title: Freelife
description: Co-create a universe teeming with potential in this open world voxel sandbox.Craft a character that reflects your style, race around the city in high-octane vehicles, manage your underground empire or team up with friends for daring operations and thrilling heists!

title: Meme Christmas
description: An incredible New Year's roguelike in the genre of Survival! Immerse yourself in the holiday atmosphere and hold out as long as possible from the hordes of Memes and defeat all the Bosses...

title: Lamina Bruise
description: Lamina Bruise is an interactive short story narrated through imaginative technology. Hack a new path, traverse a world divided by inhospitable climate, escape the burning home.

title: Soulscape: Shadows of The Past - Episode 1
description: Soulscape: Shadows of the Past is an immersive and atmospheric adventure game that will take you on a journey into the world of Blake Turner, a former agent grappling with the shadows of his own past. Join us on the adventure through episode 1.

title: Pieces of the Past
description: 'Pieces of the Past'— a cute, sentimental adventure where you fix and restore family keepsakes, uncovering touching stories. Blend puzzle-solving with the joy of preserving memories in this delightful journey!

title: Test Subject Name

description: Deck of Delirium is a PvE deckbuilding card game where you build your own misfit crew full of animals, pirates, animal pirates, pompous sailors, and even cultists to make your way through the perilous journey across the sea battling rogue pirates, sea monsters, and other uncanny enemies.

title: PC Tycoon 2
description: Manage your computer company and develop your PC components, create your own laptop, monitor, develop an interactive operating system or build your PC. Research new technologies, improve your office and your factory, hire the best employees, buy other companies and build your computer empire!

description: All City King is a stealth game where you take the role of an up-and-coming street artist. Your target is the subway trains and your goal is to make your art travel all over the city.

description: You are a man in a room. Something feels off. Or maybe it's on. A short existential comedy point-and-click non-adventure about the limitations and imitations of human existence – or, really, whatever you want it to be about.

description: Throw asteroids on them, raise their sea levels and even make the whole moon fall on their heads! This is only a fraction of what you'll have to do to make sure your perfect creation is safe in this game mixing fast reflexes, strategy and lots of fire and destruction.

title: Anomalytics: From the Files of the Arcane Statistics Authority
description: As an agent of the Arcane Statistics Authority, delve into the concrete depths of abandoned warehouses, malicious start-ups, and redacted art exhibitions to log arcane phenomena. Armed with your trusty calculator and a trove of empirical equipment, prepare to combat the unknown ... by measuring it.

title: Arcadia Fallen II
description: In this sequel to the award-winning roleplay visual novel, Arcadia Fallen, you play as a senior student at Seven Wind’s Academy. Choose from three different magical disciplines, and let your choices shape the personality of your character as they navigate school life during a time of great change.

description: Blacklist Mafia - is not only a struggle for power and money, but also a dangerous game of survival. Who will be blacklisted, and who will become the new boss? Find out with us!

title: Black Werewolf
description: Black Werewolf: Werewolves from neighboring lands invaded your lands and began to destroy all your property. The village elder had no choice but to send you to deal with the enemies and find out what was going on.

title: Blazing Trail
description: Escape failed! All we have left is our will to survive, the endless hordes of enemies, and enough bullets to rip them all to shreds. Blazing trail. Vertical co-op shooter, offering accessible, action-packed gameplay.

description: Experience a thrilling third-person shooter game with action, adventure, and romance. Fight zombies and soldiers, complete missions, and unlock new areas. Meet characters who will help you on your journey and have fun with both story and arena modes.

title: Butterfly Simulator
description: Embark on a serene journey with "Butterfly Simulator"! Glide through a dynamic world, unlock stunning skins, and immerse in the beauty of nature. Relax, explore, and transform in this peaceful escape. Welcome to your whimsical retreat in the heart of nature's wonder.

From humble beginnings, guide to greatness by mastering martial arts, teaching the next generation of fighters, and standing up to rivals.

title: Hairdresser Simulator: Beards and Mustaches
description: Master the perfect shave with the Beards and Mustaches DLC! Shave, clip, and style beards to meet your clients' needs. Transform your salon into the establishment of choice for discerning gentlemen. Elevate their style and make each customer feel like a king.

title: JR EAST Train Simulator: Takasaki Line (Ueno to Takasaki) E233-3000 series
description: The Takasaki Line is a 74.7 km long line connecting Omiya Station in Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture to Takasaki Station in Takasaki City, Gunma Prefecture. This DLC includes the Tohoku Main Line section between Ueno and Omiya stations, for a total length of 101.4 km.

Dive into a survival roguelite by taking control of a S.E.E.D, an advanced reconnaissance android! To accomplish your mission, explore exoplanets to determine if they are suitable for humanity.

Thus, you'll need to search for vital elements necessary for life: Carbon, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, Oxygen, Phosphorus, and Sulfur. But beware, danger lurks on this unknown land, and your survival will depend on your ingenuity and skills. Traps abound, and you'll need to strategize to make it through.

Regularly, you'll have to shelter your character to escape ionic storms. Exploration will allow you to acquire new skills and enjoy more autonomy, speed, and gliding. Your biggest challenge? Managing your energy to avoid extinction.

title: Microtopia
description: Become the hive mind of a robot ant colony in Microtopia! Use pheromone trails to create, automate and optimize supply chains for your ants to follow. Collect resources, produce goods, feed your queen, grow your colony and fly out to expand the species!

Can you imagine a square bird or a round elephant? Only you can help Caracolino take on the dreaded Dr. Cubix! So, shall we go?

title: 7 Invaders
description: Seven friendly aliens land in a country town to go to a rock concert... But some people believe they've arrived to take over the planet! Anything can happen in this fun interplanetary story, narrated by Gustavinho, star of O Enigma da Esfinge. Have an instant seventh-grade contact with the 7 Invaders, an adventure full of galactically animated screens and otherworldly activities.

title: Flicts
description: Flicts is an interactive CD-ROM based on Ziraldo's 1969 book of the same name. It tells a story about a color that couldn't fit in with the rainbow, the flags, or anywhere else, and no one initially recognizes its deserved value.

title: The Secret of Crystal Mountain
description: Adventure through a land full of mystery and wonder in The Secret of Crystal Mountain, a platforming adventure game about a delivery cat making his way through a magical world. Stranded on a mysterious island, you explore, get to know its residents and uncover its magical secrets. Run around, swim, climb, glide, fight dangerous foes and discover magical items to explore the island and the mountain's peak.

title: A Prelude to Chaos
description: The Cyborg Queen is coming. Only you stand in her way. Collect power jewels to slow down her plans.

title: Urusei Yatsura: Dear My Friends
description:
Urusei Yatsura: Dear My Friends, was originally released on 1994 in Japan only, on SEGA CD.
The game is a delightful adventure game that brings to life the iconic characters from Rumiko Takahashi's beloved manga and anime series. This PC port, developed with Adventure Game Studio and translated into English, opens the door for fans worldwide to immerse themselves in the quirky world of the series.

title: Side Kicks! Beyond
description: An expanded port of Side Kicks! for Nintendo Switch, Android, and iOS that will add new episodes to the main story of Side Kicks!, as well as a crossover episode with BUSTAFELLOWS, which is set in the same world.

Welcome, rookie. Get your three coins and try your best shot to beat all the arcade machines. This arcade have a single rule: You beat a machine, you get your coin back.

Do you have what it takes to be the arcade king?

title: Cross Shuriken

title: The Adventures of CJ's Closet

title: Mercuralia
description: In your search for a rare bird, you are caught in the tide of a mysterious ritual, a festival of living statues, and the ruins of an ancient floating city. Mercuralia is a mix of first-person exploration with visual novel elements.

title: Clover Toshokan no Juunin-tachi
description:
On the corner of a modern town, on higher ground atop a hill is a Western building, old as though it were left behind by time. Closed for many years, it is a private library called "Clover Library". Loving books from a young age, Aikawa Chihiro wishes to one day have a job involving books. She then earns the job of a live-in custodian of the Clover Library.

With a look like that of on old photograph, strange and impossible things occur there, one after another.

The sense of being gazed upon, even though nobody should be inside. Books that moved before one knew it. Large, large shadows peering through the window. Finally, at night, people that come out of nowhere who call themselves "frequenters since the olden days".

Surrounded by these individuals- all of whom possess distinct personalities- Chihiro prepares the library for its opening day. Eventually, she's no longer able to suppress her suspicions and confusion over the continuous occurrences of strange happenings, as well as the truth behind who or what these frequenters really are.

Struck by her questions, this is their reply:

"I'm sorry. We kept our mouths shut about it. We are not human."
"In truth, we are actually books."

title: Clover Toshokan no Juunin-tachi II
description:
On the corner of a modern town, there is a private library called the "Clover Library". During the day, it seems like an ordinary library. However, when night comes, it becomes a strange library where the books take on human forms.

The cookbook, Natsume. The picture book, Riku. The book of paintings, Shikimi. The technical book, Itsuki. The book that's the latest craze, Aoi. Aikawa Chihiro, the protagonist, became the library's live-in caretaker. While somewhat inept, she continued to manage the library.

One day... The library's pet cat, Kuu, brought a single key to Chihiro.

"I wonder where this key is for? When it's night, I'll try asking everyone."

Now, on the very top floor of Clover Library, the so-called "forbidden door" will be opened.

title: Day 224
description:
There is not a day that goes by without tears,

But regardless, I must prepare because...

Today is different.

Today is the day.

Well-known and beloved melodies
Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.
A marvel of modernity
A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

title: Adolf

title: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2024-2025
description:
The "Professional Baseball Spirits" series is a professional baseball game that pursues realism.

The first home game, "Professional Baseball Spirits 2004,'' was released on March 25, 2004. "Professional Baseball Spirits 2015" introduces 3D scanning technology that photographs professional baseball players from 360 degrees and reproduces them three-dimensionally.

Furthermore, we have also adopted laser scanning technology that measures the precise shape of the stadium, allowing you to enjoy a realistic baseball experience with overwhelming expressiveness.

title: Ruthnar Online
description: Ruthnar Online is a free sandbox 2D MMORPG where you can face powerful creatures to develop your character in an open medieval fantasy world and craft your own equipment with eight diferent professions. The game also features guild wars and four different factions, join one of them to defend it and raid enemy cities. Finally, when you get strong enough you'll be able to fight in the BattleGrounds: Stronghold Conquests, Combat Arenas, Survival/Battle Royale, Leagues, Tournaments and more.

title: Deep Dark Wrath
description:
Deep Dark Wrath is a hand-drawn, card collecting, dungeon crawler where you fend off countless enemies and find its source with the help of powerful Enchanted Cards.

It's a 2D Topdown Action RPG Collectathon game that focuses on being easy-to-learn, replayable with the variety of ways to dungeon dive, but somewhat hard-to-master with a mostly fixed layout Dungeon.

title: CavEX
description: CavEX, short for Cave Explorer, is a Wii homebrew game with the goal to recreate most of the core survival aspects up until Beta 1.7.3. Any features beyond will not be added. The game has been dubbed by players and fans online as "Minecraft: Wii Edition".

title: The Failure of Aniconfuku: Convention Murder Episode
description:
Unlike many internet-founded projects, this convention was successful. But close to the end of the second day, someone was found dead in convention hall C. People reported to the local police, and all suspects were gathered in the police station.

And now, Here you are.

title: Eunae Liaro in: Fowl Play
description: You are a scholar, bard, and lover of a good mystery. What you are not is a detective. But when your detective friend is murdered while working on a case of his own, it's up to you to pick up where he left off.

title: Hauntsville
description: You're a nameless traveler, stranded in a ghost town in the Cursed West. Use your wits, elbow grease, and the iron on your hip. Build a homestead, work the land, and survive against unspeakable monsters in this unique Western horror survival game - alone or with friends!

title: Classified of 2015
description:
In [CLASSIFIED] of 2015, play as a yearbook editor working at a photography studio, trying to make sense of a bizarre photoshoot at Voyager Academy.

Use context clues and sleuth through the available photos to determine who's who, and solve the mystery of what went down at this middle school.

title: Wrongly Accused
description: Explore historical locations, find and analyse evidence. Unmask the real perpetrator so that justice can be served and the Wrongly Accused can be found innocent. Use problem solving, deduction and critical thinking skills to uncover the truth and maybe even expose a conspiracy in your own time.

title: We Suspect Foul Play
description:
Hollywood, a land of dreams!

But this dream has turned into a nightmare, with the assassination of famous actress Mary Helen in her villa in the middle of the night.

You are tasked to search the scene, find clues, and reconstruct what has happened!

title: Bombox
description: Bombox is a fast-paced casual game. Players must find and defuse the correct bomb wires before the countdown on the bomb box ends.

title: Machick
description: Defeat the heavily armed army of anti-magic toads and free the forest from destruction. Machick is a casual game where you craft your own wands, vanquish enemies, collect XP, and choose upgrades to go further on the journey.

title: Ario
description: A fantasy land plagued by nightmares, a common lad trying to rescue his missing mother and an evil forces conspiration to be unveiled. Join Ario in this thrilling adventure where your crossbow and skills will determine the fate of your people.

title: Killbeat
description: Killbeat is a rhythm shooter roguelike focusing on fast and brutal gameplay with a wide build variety. Descend into Cadence Drop, a sinkhole devouring an entire city. Fight your way deeper, driven by the rhythm towards the source of the beat. Make music with guns and guts!

title: Helga's Cheese Festival
description: Hey Arnold! fan game.

title: Polytrack
description: Polytrack is a low poly racing game made by the single developer, Kodub, that is inspired by Trackmania. It has a growing community of players and high skill ceiling. It also allows players to create their own tracks to share and play with the community.

title: Kajko i Kokosz: Szkoła Latania
description: Another adventure and arcade game, after Kajko and Kokosz in the Land of Borostworów, intended for children (from four years old), entirely based on the cult comic book by Janusz Christy, or more precisely - on the volume "Szkoła lania".

title: Poe
description: In this fast-paced difficult platformer, you assume the role of Bernard and his son Poe in an attempt to find each other. Enjoy the short, but sweet story of their paths to each other that are filled with friends, enemies and other obstacles.

title: Offroad Jeep Quest: Mountain Trails
description: The wild awaits—are you ready to conquer it?

title: Anime: Japanese Goblins
description:
SFW Console port of "Japanese Goblins".

Charming fairy-tale heroes. Puzzle game.
4 heroines of your harem. 12 unique pictures in different locations. Interesting puzzles.
You just have to help them undress!

title: Learn to Play Vol. 1: Fruit Collect
NightGhast
description: NightGhast is a first-person horror game about wicked witches and sinister widows...

title: Cleaning Queens 2: Sparkling Palace
description: Wipe, scrub, brush… And enjoy sparkling clean rooms as a true Cleaning Royal!

title: Fruity Puzzler
description: Welcome to the juicy world of Fruity Puzzler, where vibrant colors and brain-teasing challenges collide! Dive into a refreshing gaming experience that will tantalize your senses and stimulate your mind.

title: Restaurant Health Inspection Simulator: Sanitary Service
description: Explore, Inspect, Report: Master the Skills of a Restaurant Health Inspector.

title: Brain Memory 2
description: Enhance your memory every day and become a master!

title: Go Kart Mania
description: Your Ticket to World Kart Racing!

title: Drift Legacy
description: Epic Drifts, Legendary Roads: Your Journey Begins Now!

title: Sport Clubs Collection
description: Introducing the Sport Clubs Collection: Immerse yourself in the thrill of precision and skill with our exclusive 3-in-1 Games Bundle, featuring Archery Club, Darts Club, and Baseball Club – the perfect fusion of classic sports in one exhilarating pa

title: Forgotten Magic Tower
description: A dark maze style map exploration meat pigeon game, defeating enemies in a foggy dungeon to search for treasures, finding the entrance to the next level, and gradually collecting equipment to strengthen and defeat bosses and difficult official cards

title: Tatari: Curse Road
description: A simple survival horror set in a hilly town where you must escape from a ghost. There are no puzzles, item usage, or complex controls. If you fail, try again, memorize the roads, and find your way to the goal.

title: Shatter and Spin
description: Play electronic gyro, memories of cyber childhood! In Shatter and Spiral, players will be able to modify their gyro partners and manipulate them to shatter enemies one by one!

title: Nornium
description: This is a machine girl themed air combat action role-playing game. In the world of Nornium, you can experience ARPG cosmic air combat and its Rougelike variants, manipulate the "Time Tree" to jump around in parallel time and space at will, or enjoy a leisurely slow life in the presidential suite.

title: Zurarararush!!!
description: Zurararush!!! is a twin-stick shooter that you can play easily! Wear a wig as a weapon and defeat the virus that mutated inside your body! Power up your character and wig and become stronger! Defeat a lot of enemies and feel good! It's an arcade-style casual game that you'll want to play every day.

title: Galaxy Ballerina
description: A one-minute short story about sharing the stage.

title: Puzzle: Lines and Knots 2
description: Logical puzzle game for meditation and relaxation. The goal of the game is to assemble a puzzle consisting of knots.

title: Pixel Puzzles Ultimate: Custom Cars
description: Pixel Puzzles Ultimate, redefining digital puzzling.

title: Backpacker Guild
description: Welcome to the Backpacker Guild. To vanquish wicked monsters, hire diverse mercenaries and craft powerful items to pack their bags. Only by the hands of you, the guild master, can powerful mercenaries be created.

title: MGCM Combat Edition: DLC Char: Kamisaman (Isana Hakari)
description: This is "Kamisaman", an additional character of "MGCM Combat Edition". She can use either long-reaching normal moves or excellent projectiles to develop either defensive or offensive strategies. She is a hardworking girl who guides the main character and magical girls.

title: Magic City Detective: Wrath of the Ocean - Collector's Edition
description: Who says an impending tsunami isn't a good case for a detective? The Siren Lord didn't think much of the humans, and now that one of them has made his daughter disappear... How will you solve this problem?

title: Magic City Detective: Wrath of the Ocean DLC
description: Who says an impending tsunami isn't a good case for a detective? The Siren King didn't think much of the humans, and now that one of them has made his daughter disappear... How will you solve this problem?

title: House Builder: The Atomic Age DLC
description: Hope for the best, but prepare for the worst Build new 3 houses! A house prepared to test the power of nukes, a shelter to hide from them, and a UFO house for all other unpredictable events. All that in "The Atomic Age", the first DLC to House Builder.

title: Flashing Lights: Beast Swat Truck DLC
description: Strengthen your police department forces with the Beast Swat Truck DLC!

title: Flashing Lights: Visor Lights DLC
description: Customise your police, fire and EMS vehicles further than ever before with the free Visor Lights DLC! This pack gives you access to a large variety of visor light types, and allows you to customise them extensively - including colours and light patterns.

title: Escape Simulator: Magic DLC
description: This level pack includes four new escape rooms set in the world of witches and wizards. Grab your equipment in the magic shop and then go onward to the school of magic, where three classes await your mastery.

title: DriftCE: Toyota Supra MK5 DLC
description: Expand your fleet by pulling in another legendary car: the Toyota Supra MK5. To make your new car unique, take it to your garage and make changes to its set-up to best suit your driving style. Overcome your limits and leave rivals in the dust!

title: Aura: Hentai Cards - The Dark Sea DLC
description: Long ago, the elves of the Dark Forest promised to protect the sea kingdom of Aquantis from the depth's evil creatures. Though, a war with the Demon Queen prevented them from doing so. And many inhabitants of Pentarull know how vengeful the depth's creatures can be...

title: Arma 3: Creator DLC - Reaction Forces
description: When the call comes, nothing is more important than how fast you react. Make use of unique assets in several new game modes and let your quick thinking show while in the heart of action.

title: Cursed Despair
description: Cursed Despair offers a chilling experience where you and your friends will face a mysterious monster, plunging into deep despair. Gather the necessary items to survive, perform the ritual, and stand firm amidst the darkness.

title: Dimenshift: Direction is Meaningless
description: A minimalist sci-fi 2D platformer where you shift through walls and machines. Explore and find secrets in a strange, maze-like dimension, where the laws of physics don't seem to make sense.

title: Lil Doll House
description: In this twisted horror escape game, play as Cynthia, the doll of a vengeful little girl who wants nothing more than to subject you to horrific traps designed to kill. Use strategic thinking to effectively solve action-oriented puzzles and escape with your life. But be quick, the clock is ticking!

title: JR EAST Train Simulator: Rumoi Line (Fukagawa to Rumoi) Kiha 54-500 series
description: The Rumoi Line is a 14.4 km long JR Hokkaido line connecting Fukagawa Station in Fukagawa City, Hokkaido to Ishikari-Numata Station in Numata Town, Uryu County, Hokkaido. This DLC includes the up and down lines between Fukagawa and Rumoi (total length 50.1 km), including the discontinued section.

title: Soar: Pillars of Tasneem
description: Experience a beautiful world of floating islands through the eyes of a dragon

title: Avoid Falls!
description: Your objective: conquer these heart-stopping tracks and emerge victorious without succumbing to the abyss below.

title: Casual Mahjong
description: A single-player Japanese Riichi Mahjong game. After intense battles with real players, why not enjoy a relaxed and delightful match?

title: Horror School Story
description: Immerse yourself in the foreboding atmosphere of Enspire School of Digital Art, brought to life with realistic graphics. Solve intricate puzzles and face psychological challenges to progress through the nightmarish school environment. FACE YOUR FEAR and ESCAPE THE NIGHT.

title: KanjiMemory
description: Increase your grasp of Japanese kanji character readings by playing rounds of classic Memory game where you try to find and match kanji and their readings.

title: Seven Bullets Horror
description: In this game, players have seven bullets to defeat monsters. Use bullets wisely and aim for head shots. It is also possible to avoid being found by the monsters. The game ends when the player is attacked. To clear the game, the player must find three tools and reach the goal.

title: Horror of Victim
description: Psychological horror about a girl captured by an insane family.

title: Now Open! Horror House
description: This is a simulation management and tower defense type game where players take on the role of a "Horror House Owner". Using various mechanisms and props, players aim to scare off visitors who come to challenge the "Horror House", gradually expanding and strengthening the business.

title: Mysterious Mystery, EP 1: The Duo Dilemma
description: Mysterious Mystery is a fully voiced mystery visual novel centered around the detective duo, Justin and Dakota. Solve multiple cases using Dakota's evidence gathering abilities and Justin's expert interrogation. Discover outlandish cases, meet unique characters, and become world class detectives.

title: Măgurele Mystery 2
description: After Captain Burcea's discovery from the previous game, the secret services started experimenting with what they found, but everything goes out of control and a virus is created by mistake... or was it? Peoples zombie-like starts wandering around and mutated creatures start killing.

title: School 666
description: School 666 is a 1-4 Player Co-op Survival Horror. You must escape this endless nightmare. Try to identify the correct path and survive the anomalies in this endless school. Some extremely powerful anomalies will catch you to their dimensions. Explore the reason why you are here... and don't die.

title: FunPlay School
description: A moderate horror game set in the FunPlay School where you will have to try to escape from all that nightmare, crossing rooms with puzzles from the easiest to the most difficult. Will you do it?

title: Old School Rally
description: A nostalgic racing game that combines the charm of classic retro style visuals with the thrill of international rally competitions.

title: Session: Skate Sim - Schoolyard
description: Return to the school benches… to pull off your tricks! The new Schoolyard map just might become your new favourite skate playground.

title: Neon Fantasy: Horses
description: Neon Fantasy: Horses is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: Neon Fantasy: Butterflies
description: Neon Fantasy: Butterflies is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: Neon Fantasy: Rodents
description: Neon Fantasy: Rodents is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Character Pass 1
description: Set Contents: 6 DLC characters to be released: Lucilius, 2B, Vane, Beatrix, ???, ???

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Additional Character 2B
description: Set Contents: •Playable character: 2B ;Premium Avatar: 2B; Badge: 2B; Weapon Cutout: Virtuous Contract;Figure Studio poses and expressions 1-6 for 2B,Pod 042, Access Point

title: Brave Fantasy
description: This is an adventure RPG with a focus on boss battles, defeating powerful enemies and gaining lots of equipment rewards. With different equipment to enhance yourself, challenge more powerful bosses and uncover the secrets of this fantasy world.

title: Power Fantasy: Kaze the Samurai
description: Kaze the Samurai, adorned in crimson armor, embodied the ancient code of the warrior with unparalleled swiftness and precision. Raised in the shadow of cherry blossoms, he honed his skills under the tutelage of masters, blending speed with deadly precision in each strike.

title: AI Fantasy
description: A text adventure with everything pre-generated and illustrated by AI. 100 unique stories, over 10,000 events, several thousand items, narrated story, AI-generated music, and progression between runs.

title: Memorel
description: Memorel is a cozy puzzle game that let's you relax while you test your memory through interaction with hand-drawn images from days of yore. Explore the minds of artists from the 18th to the 20th century while you train your memory. 200+ cards just wait for you to collect them.

title: Super Pixel Merge Balls
description: Drop balls and combine them to get enough points until you find the Master Beach Ball Thug Life on this cute, fun and relaxing pixel art game. How many point will you get?

title: Function Ball
description: You input any function to guide the red ball on the plane to the goal.

title: Superation
description: You are Thoridar Valkyrsson, bastard child of Thor. Fight the Aesir and earn your place among them in Superation: a boxing roguelite experience

title: Only Climber
description: Only Climber is a game to reach the top, created by combining many platform elements. It has a single-player structure in the FPS genre. Feel the challenge in the world of many different themes in this game, which shows that reaching the top has never been this difficult.

title: Dwarf Dove
description: A lowpoly style action game, third-person perspective, no experience and bag, Instead is upgrade bar. To defeat the enemy,you can use magic, command skill, block, etc., and you can unlock various command skills and magic. Try to block enemy's fireball in first scene and jump without near obstacles.

title: Cauldron Tale
description: After mysteriously losing your magic, you move to Charmroot, a mystical village of witches, wizards and other fantasy townsfolk. Build your farm, solve the mystery, and get to know the world and characters of Charmroot all at your own pace in this cozy, story-driven fantasy farm-life adventure!

title: Byte Breach
description: Embark on a chilling sci-fi co-op survival horror in a dystopian future ruled by AI corporations. Navigate through real and digital domains, filled with dark secrets and sinister entities. Utilize stealth, strategy, and teamwork to survive intense, unpredictable challenges. Will you outsmart the AI?

title: Cemetery of Bob
description: Cemetery of Bob is a challenging roguelike auto-battler focused on tactical aspect of gameplay. Build your army of undead. Recruit your zombies, upgrade your skeletons, observe your enemy and adapt to his strategy. Do everything in your power to defend the Cemetery from Bob's usurpation.

title: Warfare: Battleground
description: "Warfare: Battleground" is a classic arcade shooter where skill and reaction speed play a key role. Fight on exciting themed maps and use more than 20 weapons to win in various battle modes.

title: Crimson Hell
description: Crimson Hell is a survival-horror game in which you play as Sae, a journalism student determined to find her missing sister. Traverse through three nightmarish realms, collecting limited resources, fighting monsters, and solving puzzles in order to escape and uncover the truth.

title: Random Legion
description: This is a casual and strategy attributes of self-movement game. Players will take on the role of the leader, expanding the team, learning talents and skills, strengthening equipment, transforming soldiers and other ways to combat power, breaking through random levels, and ultimately to win the game.

title: Floralis
description: In the cruel and dangerous world of carnivorous plants, on the ruins of human civilization, our heroine is born. A child of trees and primitive genetic engineering. She will have to fight for her life, unravel the mysteries of the past and try to become something more.

title: Black Hole Escape
description: You take on the role of a lost astronaut who must return to the spaceship in zero-gravity space. Refill oxygen, avoid obstacles, and head towards the destination. Discover endless possibilities in this unique space adventure!

title: Dissimilar
description: Dissimilar est un jeu narratif en 2D isométrique, avec une exploration semi-ouverte et des combats stratégiques en tour par tour.

title: Sobosuba
description: Shoot, squish, merge, amass! sobosuba is a satisfying physics game where you shoot and combine squishy blobs together, creating ever bigger blobs for the high score.

title: Burkina Faso: Radical Insurgency
description: BF:RI Is a Hardcore Tactical Shooter depicting the ongoing Burkina Faso Insurgency. You are CIA Special Operations Group tasked with hunting down ISIS insurgents

title: Space Battle: Mayhem
description: Get ready to expand your space experience with the exciting DLC "MAYHEM" for Space Battle! This downloadable content pack brings with it a new, more challenging game mode where you will have to defeat as many ships as possible.

title: Erogoddess: Olympus
description: Erogoddess: Olympus - is a dating simulator with feminized Greek gods. Zeus, Athena, Hera, Artemis, Poseidon and other gods are waiting for you. Your goal is to establish a romantic relationship and pass the tests. Are you ready to receive your reward?

title: Diorama Builder: Noir City
description: This expansion of DIORAMA BUILDER brings the diorama "NOIR CITY", which will allow you to set up a central area of a city in NOIR style, representing the architectural style of the 1940s and 1950s.

title: Board Game Cafe
description: Welcome to Board Game Cafe, the ultimate destination for board game enthusiasts and cafe aficionados! Step into the shoes of a board game cafe owner in this unique management game, featuring officially licensed board games.

title: Sea Rover
description: This is a very fun adventure game

title: Dungeon Deck
description: Explore a dungeon in the form of a deck of cards! Collect rare items, build your own deck, and defeat the dungeon!

title: A Game Called Paako: The Game Called Paako
description: The Game Called Paako is the game about how A Game Called Paako ends.

title: Space Cats
description: "Space Cats": Zip around as a space cat dodging rockets and grabbing Catnip for double points and a trippy speed boost. A fresh, funny game with a nod to internet culture, blending challenge, humor, and nostalgia.

title: Spaceship Driver License
description: Welcome to the galaxy of technologies! It feels very good that it keeps getting closer and closer to ordinary people

title: Hyperspacer
description: Travel through space in your own spaceship, land on planets and moons, learn about local history, perform various tasks, collect scientific data, gather minerals, acquire better equipment, upgrade your ship, advance your skills, and delve into the main storyline.

title: Space Elevator Project
description: A simulation sci-fi game where players take on the role of the project manager of a space elevator project. They will progressively achieve project phase goals and ultimately accomplish the ultimate goal of constructing a Mars colonization spacecraft.

title: Space Station Defender
description: Defeat enemies and get parts! Build your own spaceship!

title: King Island 3
description: Embark on the final chapter of the King Island Franchise and venture into new depths, discover the Lost City and encounter Lola the Enchantress, you are no longer alone, Kaptivo!

title: Three Kingdoms and Martial Arts and Jianghu
description: A sandbox role-playing game that combines the Three Kingdoms and martial arts

title: Childhood's Rush
description: An easy-to-play 3D rogue-lite TPS action game that you can enjoy in just a hour!

title: Steel Division 2: Tribute to Normandy '44
description: Celebrate Steel Division history as you command 14 new divisions in Steel Division 2: Tribute to Normandy '44. This major expansion introduces the original Steel Division: Normandy 44’s battlegroups, updated with new arsenals, traits, soldier models, 200 new units, 8 new aces and new voice-acting.

title: Rift Riff
description: Rift Riff is a minimalistic tower defense game. Build towers at strategic locations and survive increasingly more difficult waves of enemies.

title: Dream Mists
description: An adventure title in which the player assumes the role of a character who has lost his memory. During the game you gain new abilities and collect information that will help you discover your true identity and the secrets of your past. Get ready for an adventure.

title: Cheese Moon
description: Cheese Moon is an adventure game where cute rabbits explore the moon. Dig out the huge secret hidden on the back of the moon by fighting off aggressive cheeses, and machines with the words 'RTMK' written on them. Summon the rabbit clone to clear the stage. There are 5 worlds, 100 stages waiting.

title: A Witch's Game
description: Seeking solace from the hunt of the blasphemed, a witch has made a game of tarot cards. She uses the intentions of her enemies against themselves, redirecting opposing attacks to work in her favor instead.

title: The Fear Business
description: The fear of the scared ones keep them alive, VHS supernatural survival horror.

title: Club Koala
description: Club Koala is the ultimate home to party games and island construction! Build and experience a world that transcends imagination. Dive into party games and venture across hundreds of maps and challenges, while exploring the oppurtinities of building your own maps with ease! Play, Create and Explore.

title: Omoikane
description: Delve into the addictive world of Rīchi Mahjong with this intense roguelike deckbuilder. Strategically build your wall with powerful tiles, navigate complex interactions, and test your skills against rule bending kami opponents. Every hand counts in this thrilling battle against entropy!

title: Bingo Beavers: Halloween Decorations
description: Transform your Beaver Manor with enchanting Halloween decor! No new rooms, but every space brims with festive frights from whimsical witches to ghostly figures. A charmingly eerie adventure through each existing spot awaits!

title: Heromantic
description: Play a steely reporter or a rookie heroine, and brave your way through deadly secrets, evil plots, valiant heroes, and scheming villains in this parodical superhero visual novel!

title: Pogo Rogue
description: Bounce to the top in this skill based, roguelite action-platformer! Collect powerful items, pick unique weapons, and fight off a variety of enemies while navigating around with a fun, difficult, and unique movement system. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Fungal Fiefdom
description: 3D Tower defense, fungi vs robots. Strategically place defensive mushrooms and use powerful abilities to protect your colony and advance against the evil automatons.

title: Revelatio
description: "Revelatio" is a turn-based strategy game that combines tile-based combat and elements of roguelike. Strategically summon and control units to claim victory. Stain the world with your darkness by corrupting various units, bosses and even NPCs.

title: Hyper Flux
description: Hyper Flux is a single-player speedrunning 3D platformer that demands you to speed through shattered planets using your zero-gravity suit and force-manipulating orbs. Fly through the skies of insane levels to reach the end portal as fast as possible.

title: Shape of Dreams
description: Shape of Dreams is an action rogue-lite infused with MOBA-esque elements. Venture into a vivid dream world, and create your own champion by freely swapping skills with whatever you like. Play solo against all odds, or with friends in a 4-player co-op game.

title: Quest Industries
description: An incremental factory builder where you build a factory that produces fantasy RPG gear for adventurers. Gather resources and craft items to sell. Invest your earnings to discover exotic resources and legendary items blueprints that will make you a fortune.

title: Ghost Villa
description: In Ghost Villa you farm and cook during the day, by night you fight hordes of ghosts that want to haunt and take possession of your home.

title: Reclaim The Living
description: Reclaim The Living is a zombie horde-survivor roguelike where you play as Dr. J. Ferret, an eccentric scientist who developed a cure capable of turning the infected back to normal. Expand your laboratory and upgrade your arsenal of gadgets to save humanity!

title: Defend It!
description: Defend it! Are you sure you can defend the base until the last enemy? Try your luck because it's free to play!

title: Five Nights With Los Penguinos
description: Five Nights With Los Pinguinos is a horror game about a security guard who accidentally got a very dangerous job.

title: Purpose 1951
description: "Purpose 1951" is an almost pure walking simulator set in the United States of 1951. You play as a retired doctor whose life falls apart.

title: Meteor Havok
description: Meteor Havok is a take on the classic Asteroids arcade shooter. Enter the asteroid fields to blast a path to safety with your agile ship and powerful lasers.

title: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness
description: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness – is an isometric, story-driven game in the Action RPG genre, combining the mechanics of metroidvania exploration and the dynamics of modern slashers. Lead the medieval resistance against the alien invasion on Earth!

title: Source of the Nile: Digital Edition
description: The single-player version of the legendary board game "Source of the Nile", finally brought to the digital realm. A challenging game of discovery played on a hexagon-grid map showing known Africa ca. 1820, in which the player competes with nature in order to survive.

title: Tactical Mission: Target Rush
description: Tactical Mission: Target Rush is an immersive, single-player tactical FPS where every shot counts. Challenge yourself by chasing high scores as you rush through CQB courses, improving your marksmanship against your own best times.

title: Under The Whisper
description: You are a curious and brave mother cat, a furry tabby with a heart of gold and an adventurous nose looking for the best gift.

title: Sea of Chaos
description: RTS (Real-Time Strategy)，Base Defense，Recruit Minions，Character Development，Multi-Part

title: SOS: Forgotten Planet
description: A survival horror where Morse code is the key to everything. Tap it to open doors. Listen and decode it to crack open supply caches. Every run rebuilds the lab and hides a different truth to uncover. Survive it, and walk away actually knowing Morse.

title: Genome Guardian
description: Genome Guardian is a top-down roguelite turret shooter where you must defend yourself from hostile aliens at the microscopic level. Combine & discover 70 weapons across 4 modes using a vast array of turrets, perks, modifiers and power-ups on this vibrant journey to the depths of the abyss.

title: Critterball Derby
description: Create and manage your own team, and play ball against your rivals in normal or ranked play. Tight controls and a smooth learning curve will have you knocking it out of the park in no time in this arcade baseball simulator. Or challenge your skills with difficult homerun challenges.

title: Mute Crimson DX
description: Mute Crimson DX is an action-packed precision-platformer where you guide Ninja on his quest to climb up walls, slice through bad guys and overcome great evils!

title: Defense of the Earth
description: Gather a task force of the best fighters earth has to offer and research technology to defend against the invaders out of space. You have to lead your squad through various grid- and turn-based battles. Between missions, you plan your next moves, manage your crew's abilities and relationships.

title: The Boy Sorcerer: Lost memory
description: Help Anant escape the tower curse. You will climb the tower, unlock new memories until you complete all game modes for each floor. Good luck and may your memory serve you well.

title: Starmetal Crusaders
description: Unique Take on classic RTS gameplay that blend resource management, base-building, and real-time combat. Utilize a unique fusion system to upgrade your structures, customize your Units, and adapt to ever-changing challenges on the battlefield.

title: Survival Of Exon
description: In Survival of Exon, strategic combat is key. Eliminate foes to collect coins and upgrade your character, becoming a force to be reckoned with. As the difficulty ramps up, you'll need to strategically enhance your gear to overcome the onslaught and emerge victorious.

title: Paraside: Duality Unbound
description: In the wake of an apocalypse, lead Earth’s remnants to combat extraplanar threats in a double-sided world of cosmic horror and desperate struggle. Explore unknown territories. Evolve your task force. Manipulate space and minds ingeniously to reignite hope in this new strategic RPG.

title: Frogo Jump
description: Frogo Jump is a precision platformer with restricted movement. Play Frogo who can only jump his way out of wells he fell into.

title: Spiritus Vindicta
description: Investigate haunted locations, collect evidence, and learn about dangerous ghosts in a spooky 2D ghost hunting experience.

title: Head Chef
description: Head Chef is a restaurant management game. Supply the kitchen, select your staff, create a delicious menu and… cook! Make your guests happy and find your way to the stars. Keep control of your team and finances, because the higher you climb, the harder you fall.

title: Lucky Hunter
description: Lucky Hunter is a deck-building auto battler Roguelike game. Your pieces are automatically played on the board, and players will focus on building unique decks and relics, making the best of the synergies between pieces to defeat increasingly powerful prey.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle World: Rooms
description: Add 20 new puzzles to your Jigsaw Puzzle World game.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle World: Weather

Combat is in 2d and you will receive your loot in 3d.

Fractal Sailor is an experimental, atmospheric horror tech demo where you take the role of a lone sailor navigating a hovercraft through a dark and mystic fractal environment. Your objective is to refuel and reactivate abandoned stations that have collected rare resources from these fractals.

However, you are not alone...

Survive for as long as possible and immerse yourself in this chilling experience!

title: Mot's Grand Prix
description:
Step back in time to an era when folk were real folk and race car steering wheels were real steering wheels. Mot's Grand Prix is a pseudo 3D Formula 1 racer inspired by Grand Prix Circuit, Continental Circus and a bunch of other 80s/90s racers.

The game has 4 difficulty levels plus a practice mode to learn the courses without the pressure of racing.

description:
The Coma 2B: Catacomb is a Korean survival horror adventure. It is a back story of the previous game The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters, and a story bridge of all series. You are back in game as Youngho Choi, the main protagonist of The Coma 1, you must venture from the mirror dimension of reality to survive. What happened between The Coma 1 and The Coma 2? The answer is in here.

Immerse yourself in the warped Sehwa district as you encounter an engaging cast of characters, solve puzzles, discover revealing clues, and fight for survival against a relentless psycho.

Running and wielding your flashlight makes you an easy target. You must precariously balance the urgency of exploration with your absolute need to survive!

Enter the broken mind of Eliza de Moor, a once-celebrated singer, now trapped in the labyrinth of her own forgotten memories. The only hope for recovering her memories lies with Doctor Stern and his experimental medicine. As Eliza, you'll navigate the reality and the world behind the broken mirror, guided by the effects of the drug.

Will you be able to piece together the mystery of your past, or will you get lost in this dark and twisted reality?

If the pieces spin too fast, they’ll explode. To slow them down, you must take into account their relationships based on the five elements theory of Chinese cosmology (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water): Water nourishes Wood and controls Fire; Wood nourishes Fire and controls Earth, and so on. A procedural Metroid-like with no fights, focused on exploration and route-planning, in which you play a mouse trying to escape from an ever-changing house.

Each run is a compact Metroid-like experience, in which you will find upgrades to explore the house differently each time. From a magnetic grapple to reach a metallic faucet, to a rideable rocket that can burst through the glass blocking the way, you will find many upgrades, each with its own uses.
