description: A Tactical Roguelike about the life (and death) of post-apocalyptic gladiators in a dystopian society. Embrace the arena, become the LANISTA!

title: The Thing That Happened
description: Thing That Happened is an Openworld Third Person - Action Adventure Survial game. You can use multiple weapons, attachments, close combat skills tree's and crafting to break through your enemies.

title: Poop Spotter: The Game To Improve the Quality of Poop~
description: Monitor the line of the poop factory and find out the defective products. This is a "spot the difference" game with poop.

title: Fruitio
description: A relaxing, fun and creative physics based puzzle game. Take time out in Fruitio wold and chillax!

title: School Paranormal Laboratory
description: To those who will become investigators at our research institute, Our institute conducts research on mysterious phenomena and grudges that occur in schools. As an investigator, you will carry out field surveys, but it is a simple job that even those with no experience can perform.

title: TypeSpell Journey
description: It is a relaxing and casual software suitable for users of all ages. It can be used to learn words, practice spelling or typing. It can be a game or an educational tool, depending on how you use it.

title: Emblems: Sunless Vow
description: Can they stop arguing long enough to escape the void?! A Roguelike Visual Novel with QUICK turn-based combat and flexible difficulty. Calculate, power-up, and stack favors to The Heart's content... Or take on a narrative campaign filled with Mystery + Drama + Shenanigans.

title: Fear of Fear
description: Arachnophobia, Trypophobia, and Thalassophobia are just some of the horrors that await you. Choose your phobia and conquer your fear.

title: Apartment No 129
description: Emir, who has an interest in mysterious events, steps alone into the abandoned apartment known as "Apartment No 129" to trace the trail of a paranormal event that occurred in 2009 and shook the country. However, he will find himself in an unexpected confrontation within this cursed apartment.

title: Dungeon Ruins
description: Dungeon Ruins is a 2D platformer with roguelike elements in which you will find yourself in the shoes of a brave pioneer exploring mysterious dungeons full of treasures and dangers. You have to go through multi-story labyrinths filled with various enemies, riddles and treasures.

title: Fall Of The MS Estonia
description: Step into the shoes of a passenger aboard the ill-fated MS Estonia in this immersive simulation. Discover what caused the ship's demise on the tragic day of 27th September 1994. With time running out, are you able to find a way off the ship?

title: Warehouse Manager Simulator
description: In "Warehouse Manager Simulator", step into the shoes of a burgeoning entrepreneur with ambitions to conquer the logistics industry. Begin your journey by acquiring your first warehouse and a humble forklift, ready to embark on a path towards warehouse management mastery.

title: Bad Mechanic
description: Bad Mechanic is a tower-defense action roguelike. Plan (and improvise) your defenses against a swarm of weird little guys. Dodge your own towers' attacks as you collect loot. Build a unique arsenal of towers and items in each run that will kill you in spectacular fashion.

title: Ostallian Core
description: A modern omnidirectional space shooter with colorful retro-style ASCII art and light RPG elements, featuring optional permadeath.

title: Eggstraction
description: Eggstraction is a multiplayer (4vs1) heist game where four feathered friends must face off against an egg-napping farmer. With chaos around every corner, can the chickens rescue their stolen eggs, or will they end up back in their cage?

title: Cubik
description: Cubik is a minimalist puzzle game revolving around cubes. Rotate them to the right color where they melt into the background. Join Cubik for a soothing brain exercise.

title: Bitesize Heroes: Forest Defender
description: Prepare for an epic battle in this captivating blend of real-time strategy and tower defense! Build, defend, and triumph as you strategically place towers, manage resources, and upgrade your arsenal to fend off relentless waves of enemies.

title: Dark Rampage
description: Dark Rampage is an 2D platformer with action elements where you play as a hero who finds himself in a dark and dangerous world after he falls into a dark well. You have to explore various locations, fight monsters and solve puzzles.

title: Mysterious Planet
description: Mysterious Planet - A fascinating 3D puzzle game for logic and thinking! Your ship is forced to land on a mysterious planet due to lack of fuel. And now a mysterious and fascinating world filled with puzzles opens up before you!

title: Hitobashira: Human Suika
description: A fun human fusion puzzle game, merge people to sacrifice them and feed their souls to the Monolith.

title: Infinity Blaster
description: In Infinity Blaster you blast through space, defeat challenging enemies and upgrade your weapons! Compete on the global leaderboard, survive an infinite loop of increasingly difficult foes, and unlock 98achievements. Can you prove yourself as the ultimate space adventurer?

title: Pinhead Adventures
description: The First Game from Neversold Studios, Pinhead Adventures is a planet hopping, gun toting, sword swinging, grappling adventure! Zortan has killed every last living soul except for the Pinhead and Orbo. Join Pinhead and Orbo to fight Zortan in this 3D Action Platformer!

title: Trench Defender
description: An action-packed FPS where you defend your trench against waves of attacking enemies by utilizing a large selection of modern (and not so modern) military weapons, features both single-player and two player online multiplayer (peer-to-peer).

title: So, This Vampire Walks Into a Bar
description: Join our broke protagonist Jackie, who, after a workplace accident, will never look the same again. Jackie desperately tries to make ends meet by working in an unusual bar, despite having no experience at all!

title: The Echo Escape
description: Escape from the suspicious space by eluding [them].

title: Just Wing It
description: Just Wing it is a multiplayer Collect-o-thon where you can explore different worlds and hangout with friends. Oh yeah. You are also a rubber duck...

title: Case: Online
description: Case: Online is a fangame based of Case 2: Animatronics Survival Multiplayer.

title: RestorArt: Fairwood Hills - Collector's Edition
description: Embark on a captivating journey as an art restorer in the charming town of Fairwood Hills. Uncover hidden stories as you mend torn canvases, remove stickers, and restore burnt edges.

title: Lightist
description: This is an interesting physics puzzle game. You can create objects arbitrarily to interact with light. Your gole is to make the light cast on all of the stars in the scene. So let's unleash our imagination and enjoy this game.

title: Crazy Destruction
description: Crazy Destruction is a 3D physics puzzle game in which fun and exciting levels of varying difficulty await you! Take control of a mechanical cannon and destroy everything in your path! Using tactics and thinking, calculate every shot you take, because you're running out of ammunition!

title: True Story Time
description: "True Story Time" - the ultimate party game that guarantees endless laughter and unforgettable moments with friends!

title: Frozen Below: Arctic Expedition
description: "Frozen Below: Arctic Expedition" is a horror exploration game. Explore an Arctic cave, uncover secrets, and escape a lurking presence. With realistic graphics and immersive sound design, can you survive the frozen terror and escape the darkness?

title: Dungeons and Ducklings
description: Dungeons and Ducklings is a Retro - PacMan - Roguelite Adventure. Help Mama Duck rescue her ducklings from the evil Lich by navigating his dark dungeon. Use powerful attacks to create your own path through the Lich's maze.

title: Happy Sheepies
description: Happy Sheepies is a relaxing sheep-farming game that includes some Crafting and Business Management elements with its simple Drag & Drop gameplay. Meet the needs of your sheepies, craft and sell your products, and grow your business!

title: Cube Lands: The Final Wish
description: Welcome to the world of Cube Lands! Solve puzzles using elemental blocks and various other unique and innovative mechanics. Travel through forests, caves, deserts, mountains and much more to defeat the Eye. Be careful, it is always watching...

title: Project L33t
description: Dive into Project L33T, a hardcore first-person tactical extraction shooter. Confront AI foes and rival players, engage in high-stakes battles for precious loot, and risk all your gear to collect, secure, and extract Artifacts in this hostile environment.

title: Kings And Goblins
description: Try your best with this old-school difficult platformer game. Kings and Goblins will truly test your skill, will you be able to beat the game??

title: Slime Mayhem
description: You were created by a few scientists for a suicide mission. How long can you survive by clearing mutant slimes?

title: SpectroPhobia
description: "SpectroPhobia" is a spine-chilling adventure where you must outsmart the shadows in a haunted mansion. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and evade the lurking entity. Uncover the mansion's dark secrets to survive.

title: Dawn of the Ashen Queen
description: Dawn of the Ashen Queen is a classic grid-based dungeon crawler. Set out with your party to reveal the legacy of a millennia old curse in a narrative-rich experience. Explore the colorful world of Eshavon, unearth its many secrets and fight dangerous foes sent out to stop you in your mission.

title: Heaven Stairs
description: Where shadows whispered secrets and moonlight danced with forgotten memories

title: Barnacles Beers and Brawls
description: Barnacles, Beers, and Brawls is a fast-paced bar management game. You are a tavern bar manager in a world filled with plundering pirates and tentacled monstrosities. Hurry through a stylized map playing microgames themed around bartending duties like pouring a glass of beer or cleaning up a mess

title: BouncyBirdy
description: A simple bird game, have fun playing :)

title: OG Memory: Synthwave Monsters
description: OG Memory: Synthwave Monsters/b] is an memory game with scary monster images. You have to find all of the correct pairs to complete the game. your best round will be count and always be displayed in game, to compare your rounds. try to reduce your turns every game and set up your new record.

title: Wild Animals Transporter
description: The world keeps changing

title: Veil of Madness
description: Veil of Madness is a Lovecraftian Deck Builder game that merges the strategic charm of a deck builder with the immersive experience of a first-person RPG genre. Unravel eldritch secrets, battle insanity, and shape your destiny in this chilling journey.

title: Last Loremaster
description: Harness the power of the six cardinal elements in Last Loremaster, a high-octane ARPG set in a stunning mythological world. Play as Jahir, a powerful Elemental Loremaster combatting the encroaching Unravelling as you seamlessly freeze, burn, crush, and electrocute your foes!

title: Six Blow: Bullet Rain
description: "Six Blow: Bullet Rain" combines FPS action with living bullet cards. Survive the Wild West, customize your shots, and strategize!

title: Recipiente
description: It is a game that challenges the player's memory and quick decision making, using a scheme of colors and shapes in which the solution is to stay focused and have sharp reflexes in a spatial atmosphere that can be used to your advantage depending on its agility.

title: Vambrace: Dungeon Monarch
description: Vambrace: Dungeon Monarch is a unique combination of Deck-Building and Dungeon Defense, with a wide variety of military units and combinations, strategies and magic manifested in cards. Make your dungeon more dangerous by defending it against increasingly powerful enemies.

title: Nooo! My Body!
description: Breathtaking jump and run with an incredible story and unforgettable gameplay, in which you control a severed head! Don't forget to vote this masterpiece as Game of the Year.

title: NMO: No More Operators
description: NMO is a thrilling multiplayer (5 vs 1) game where one player, the Ox, lurks in the shadows to deceive and neutralize the Operators, while others take on the role of Operators, working independently or cooperatively to identify and eliminate the Ox hidden among them.

title: Caracoles
description: Hilarious like a fart... but longer! In Caracoles you compete against your pals in the fastest outrageously slow racing multiplayer battles ever.

title: BrokenLore: Follow
description: BrokenLore: Follow is a captivating psychological first-person horror game that immerses players in the haunting narrative of Anne, as she grapples with issues of self-acceptance, bullying, and worthlessness while encountering metaphorical surreal creatures that heighten the terror of her journey.

title: Coastal Defense
description: Coastal Defense is a replayable top-down tower defense game inspired by real-world coastal defense structures. Buy and upgrade your coastal defenses to defeat incoming navies!

title: Gung Beetle
description: Gung Beetle is a satisfying twin-stick bullet heaven where you play as a dung beetle covering your ball in ridiculous weaponry. Upgrade your guns part by part to build out insane combos and lay waste to thousands of enemies. Become the Gung Beetle.

title: Paintball: The Puzzle Game
description: Paintball is a top down puzzle game for 1 to 3 players. Copy given colored geometric shapes by throwing a ball back and forth.

title: Sempra Infernalis
description: Fight your way out of hell against the increasingly dangerous hellspawn devoted to making YOU, the latest addition to the unhappy infernal family. Upgrade your character to improve your chances of escape and seek out and unlock legendary weapons and abilities in this epically fun demon slayer.

title: Damn Sewer
description: An indie horror game in which you find yourself in a mysterious abandoned sewer where people disappear. At first there is nothing unusual, but gradually you realize that something terrible lives in the sewer.

title: Hive Dive
description: A roguelite on-rails shooter where you pilot a remote-controlled drone into hordes of a vast, everchanging swarm of alien bugs. Shoot down enemies and fly through colourful hives to take down the queen of the swarm.

title: Golden Lap
description: Step into the polished shoes of a racing team manager in the heart-stirring Golden Era of motorsport where every decision can lead to glory or gravel. With sleek minimalist charm and deep strategic gameplay, Golden Lap offers a unique experience in the motorsport management genre.

title: Dungeon Divers
description: Dungeon Divers is a dungeon-themed puzzle game about clearing derelict dungeons. As the newest employee of Dungeon Divers Inc., you must advance through multiple procedural generated levels, use your wits, and tools you acquire along the way to get to the core to defuse it and bring home the cash.

title: Marked: The Quest for Tripura
description: A single player puzzle exploration game where you play as Dee, short for Drauni, explore the ruins of Hampi, solving turn based puzzles, to find a way to escape your past and make it to the lost cities of Tripura. The puzzles reveal the origins of Chess and the long buried secrets of your ancestors.

title: Inverted Angel
description: A girl visited your home, who you don't know but she identified herself as your girlfriend. She seems a little bit Menhera, but she knows too much to be just a stalker. This is a Kawaii Future Mystery, the AI judges your guesses for branching story. Please Try to find out true identity of her.

title: Ethereal Abyss
description: Ethereal Abyss is a single-player third-person shooter with psychological horror elements, inspired by the Backrooms. Navigate multi-dimensional levels, solve puzzles with time-inversion mechanic, while resisting enslavement by your mind.

title: Cats in the Ancient City of Gu Su
description: In the ancient city of Gu Su during the Qing Dynasty, embark on a quest to find adorable cats! Let the cats collide with historical scenes and characters in amusing ways."

title: GreenColdBody
description: You will play as a video blogger, surrounded by some kind of terrifying force, still striving to express the Love in your heart. This game can only be played up to 2.5 times.

title: Nonetheless
description: An atmospheric puzzler that begins simply, but soon splays out into complex directions.

title: Hand of Anima
description: Fuse cards together in this roguelike deckbuilder to unleash their full potential. Discover powerful fusion combinations, craft unique decks, harness the power of ancient runes, and conquer challenging enemies on your quest to restore peace to the realm of Erdia.

title: Bone Meal
description: Plant strange mutated crop in a chilling rogue-like with strategic resource management. Use a wide variety of seeds through three seasons to survive the blinding glow of the sun. Brew tonics, produce biofuel, upgrade facilities, and don't go hungry.

title: Joe 'n Jo
description: Joe ‘n Jo is a challenging physics-based platformer about two giraffes who are strapped together for eternity. Play solo or with a friend and make your way through unique environments that will test your coordination and patience!

title: Reminiscence in the Rain
description: The world's most "sentimental" tale. "Let's go away together." Those were Yuika Aoi's last words. It was the winter of my first year of college. She disappeared, without a trace. Where had she gone? - only the flower knows.

title: Spring Dogs: Ultimate Multiplayer Battle Royale
description: Step into the frenetic universe of Spring Dogs and strive to emerge victorious in this locally focused multiplayer battle royale. Customize your character and challenge up to 17 AI-controlled competitors, 8 human players in split-screen, or 16 in team mode.

title: Swarm Fortress
description: Build walls, turrets and summon allies to survive hordes of enemies in this top-down sandbox base builder.

title: Terra Exodus
description: Defend the evacuation of Terra on the losing side of an alien invasion. This experimental action strategy game breaks out of genre norms to provide fresh mechanics to strategic gaming.

title: LightGone
description: Step into the darkness with Ashley, a college dropout lost in a mysterious world devoid of light. Traverse eerie liminal locales and evade lurking monsters to unravel the mysteries of this chilling 2D game with horror elements. Can you lead Ashley to safety, or will the shadows consume her?

title: Small Wars: Mohicans
description: Small Wars: Mohicans offers you a quick and fun to play experience of the French & Indian War (1754-1760) in the vast wilderness of 18th century North America. Play the French and their Indigenous Allies or Britain troops and colonials and gain control of the new world.

title: VGA Planets Nu
description: A graphical multi-player play by turn war game that simulates combat in space between galactic empires.

title: Cities: Skylines II - San Francisco Set
description: Bring some sunny vibes to your city with this San Francisco themed set. A Muscle Car Garage building, 5 different Muscle car models and a police vehicle will spruce up your bustling beach city. Included in the set is also the iconic Golden Gate Bridge and of course - a San Francisco map.

title: Cities: Skylines II - Bridges & Ports
description: Livelier coasts are now available with this new expansion, Bridges & Ports! With a new set of tools you are now able to create a bustling port to your city, and add beautiful new details like draw bridges and lighthouses.

title: Project Circle
description: This is an action fighting game in which one character explores the map. There are many enemies in the map and you need to defeat them.

title: Wrath of Towers
description: In this game, your task will be to create a reliable defense that can withstand the onslaught of enemies. You will have to build various towers that will help you hold back the enemy advance.

title: Dungeons of Alethrion
description: Dungeons of Alethrion is a dungeon crawler roguelike game based on the Youtube animated series, Tales of Alethrion. Play as epic heroes from the show, each with unique abilities. Play it alone or grab a friend to join you in the dungeons!

title: Harvest Cafe
description: Explore, grow, repair and cook delicious food! Harvest Cafe combines an open-world adventure with a restaurant business simulation, giving you the opportunity to enjoy farm life.

title: Fishdom: Seasons Under the Sea
description: Celebrate the holiday season with Fishdom: Seasons Under the Sea! Solve match 3 puzzles and build up your Halloween, Thanksgiving, and Christmas aquariums.

title: Flowers Mosaics
description: A game full of mosaic puzzles with a botanical theme. Enjoy colorful flower backgrounds while solving nonograms at your own pace.

title: Four Seasons Around the World: Winter in New York
description: Follow the French photographer on his journey through many puzzles. See how the story about Francois and his girlfriend unravels while absorbing the winter magic in New York City.

title: Frozen Kingdom
description: When an evil wizard turns Fairy Land into a dark, cold winter, it is your job to help a friendly magician restore the land to an eternal summer with bright colors, warmth, and merry laughter. Help the magician by solving match 3 puzzles.

title: FunPark Beach Blast
description: The hottest, grooviest spot on the beach, and you're in charge of the show! Join Jamie Madigan for a summer working the roller coasters at a seaside amusement park. Are there enough thrills, twists and loops for everyone in this 50s-themed time management game?

title: Galactic Express
description: A casual sci-fi puzzle game where you pack interplanetary cargo into futuristic spaceships.

title: Galaxy Quest
description:
Save your partner in Galaxy Quest, an intergalactic match-3 mission! During a routine research flight, your partner and his crew are sucked into a wormhole. With nothing more than his final distorted radio transmission to guide you, you set out to find them.

Unearthly dangers and challenges await you, but luckily, so do helpful extraterrestrials who are eager to help you on your journey. Together, you'll experience a unique adventure and a one-of-a-kind match-3 game.

title: Gaslamp Cases 4: The Arcane Village
description: Detective Morgan Johnson and his partner Jack Brown have solved many cases that have left their colleagues stumped, but the one mystery they've never answered is the origin of their friend Eleanor. While following Eleanor's trail, Morgan and Jack find themselves stranded near an isolated village where dark rituals are performed.

title: Girls With Secrets
description: You play as a woman who starts investigating the murder of her best friend. Interrogate suspects, find hidden objects, collect evidence, solve minigames and finally -- catch the true killer!

title: Gizmos: Jungle Adventures
description: Explore mysterious jungles with old friends and solve 120 nonogram puzzles together.

title: Touhou Heisatsu Yuugi
description: A little strange ACT game where Reimu brandishes a special wand.

title: Eons Away
description: Eons Away is a turn-based RPG with unique combat mechanics. Explore a vibrant, handpainted world overshadowed by an encroaching corruption. Every decision is important, be it how you fight your battles or the bonds you make. Choose your path wisely.

title: Frank Fux
description:
In this daring adventure, you as Frank Fux try to using wit and jumping power to escape the depths of the dungeon and satisfy your greed.

Navigate Frank from platform to platform with only one direction in mind - upwards!
But be careful! A wrong jump can quickly send you back into the depths.

title: Pixel of War
description: You are "Crados" and you will murder the Pixel of War. The Epic (and short) adventure of Conquest, Destiny and Revenge.

title: Grabbers in the Woods
description: A unique first person atmospheric exploration game set in a surreal woods nestled within the confines of a bizarre dream known as the Collective Reverie, a nexus of all dreamers where their individual hopes and fears coalesce into a bizarre nightmare.

title: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 - Path to the King of the Pirates & Soul Map 3
description: Gol D. Roger, the King of Pirates, a man who took everything the world had to offer. Push yourself to the limit as you attempt to surpass his legend!

title: Sandvich Maker
description: Heavy and Pyro want to make the biggest sandvich ever, and you will help them!

title: Hidden Art: Twilight in The Museum
description: Wander the galleries and find inaccuracies on a series of masterpieces. Discover 4 game modes, play against the time and prove a connoisseur in this artful hidden object game.

title: Halloween: The Twelve Cards Curse
description: A spooky-themed clutter game. You have to find specific items in the jumbled decorations before the little witches, ghosts and other terrors start knocking on the doors.

title: Half-Life: Escape 2.0
description: A new episode from the Half-Life Universe!

title: Infinite Red: The Day the Earth Stood Still
description: A game about an unreleased, unfinished, video game tie-in to a canceled 1999 multimedia reboot of Infinite Red, a 1970s tokusatsu character.

title: Detective Olivia: The Cult of Whisperers
MEIOU and Taxes
description: MEIOU and Taxes is a mod that reworks almost every aspect of Europa Universalis IV. It: adds over fifteen-hundred new provinces; extends the game's timeline (1356-1856); reworks trade, religion, colonization and estates; and adds population, immigration and disease systems to the game.

title: Polar Bowler 1st Frame
description: Send PB flying down the ice and hit as many pins as you can in this arcade-style game.

title: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead
description: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead is a single-player horror adventure game inspired by the critically acclaimed blockbuster movie franchise that highlights a unique survivor story after an invasion of deadly creatures. In this exclusive spin-off, experience the journey of a young woman who must endure a treacherous apocalypse in the midst of interpersonal family conflicts, all while coming to terms with her own inner fears.

title: Posh Boutique 2
description: After taking over her grandmother's line of fancy clothing stores, Alicia finds out she's won the lottery! With her winnings in hand, Alicia's ready to take her Posh Boutique to the next level. Help Alicia expand her business by assisting each customer in their search for the perfect outfit, adding just the right accessories, and choosing the best upgrades and enhancements for each location.

title: Sheep's Symphony
description: Shee's Symphony is a rhythm runner fangame. Choose from a selection of outfits, stages, and enemies, and aim for the best ranking in each song!

title: Rainbow Mosaics 12: Easter Helper
description: A nonogram game with puzzles themed around the easter bunny & eggs.

title: Rainbow Mosaics: Christmas Lights
description: A festive nonogram game with 100 puzzles to solve.

title: Rainbow Mosaics: Blooming Garden
description: This is a nonogram game with 120 puzzles to solve.

title: Midnight Castle
description: Start searching for magical items now! Unveil mysterious treasures and characters and test your wits and dexterity in this enigmatic world. In Midnight Castle, you never know what might happen next...

title: Yeti Quest: Crazy Penguins
description: Help Yeti and his crazy penguin pals save their Antarctic island home from the ice storm! Explore 100 exciting, challenging match-3 levels on the snow-covered island and lead the penguin team safely through the many dangers.

title: Yeti Legend: Mystery of the Forest
description: When a chemical spill spreads into the forest, creatures larger than life start emerging from the shadows - and right into your own backyard. Fight to survive as you attempt to solve the mystery in this hide-and-seek hidden object adventure.

title: Secret Archives
description: This is a third person shooter game The main plot is a secret experiment being conducted somewhere in the future During this process, a strange mineral was discovered and caused a large-scale infection The protagonist's task is to retrieve important "files" and escape from this place!

title: Deep Beyond
description: Deep Beyond Is a first-person interactive thriller about a sea explorer and the mystery behind her father’s disappearance.

title: Echoes of The Deep
description:
Echoes of The Deep is a pixelart roguelite dungeon game where you fight your way through the levels of the dungeon. In these levels you'll encounter different enemies, treasures and more. This game features and adaptive difficulty system that will adhere to how you perform.

Will you overcome the dungeon a victor, or will you succumb to the Echoes of The Deep like the many before you..

title: As We Descend
description: The roguelike deckbuilder with the soul of a strategy game. Recruit, upgrade, and deploy your forces in tactical battles against corrupt creatures. Make hard decisions in humanity’s final city to bolster your odds. Will you break the cycle of endless descent?

title: Overwatch 2: Season 10 - Venture Forth
description: Drill into the competition with the newest damage hero Venture, discover a world turned over with a new Mirrorwatch event, explore an updated Mythic system, and more.

title: Tiny Tires
description: Race around coffee cups and jump off notepads in Tiny Tires - a simple, fast-paced miniature racing game. A throwback to classic racing games, featuring a top-down perspective making it easy to keep an eye on any opponents trying to get one up on you.

title: Thinkin' Things: Sky Island Mysteries
description:
Solve Mysteries and Bring Order Back to the Sky Islands!

Break out your logic, prioritization and decision-making skills—you’ll find hundreds of zany and absorbing challenges at the Sky Islands! The more problems you complete, the more clues you pick up for the mysteries. Then zip on over to Clue Central and help Detective Joe Cluestoe and his sidekick, Spike, identify who’s behind each daring deed.

title: JumpStart Artist
description: Introduce children to art fundamentals with a complete set of easy-to-use design and media tools that include 40 printable activities and 60 project starters. Your child will meet famous artists, explore artistic style, and discover different genres while learning art basics including line, shape, color, texture, and pattern. A robust art kit, with an animation feature, lets kids paint, draw, and design unique masterpieces. Encourage your budding artists while helping them meet the National Standards for the Arts.

title: Balloon Knight
description: When the dark lord returns to the world after a thousand-year slumber, only the valiant Balloon Knight can save the world.

title: Massmouthmas
description:
It's a Massmouth Christmas special! Massmouthmas takes place after the events of Massmouth 1 but before Massmouth 2.

The protagonist Massmouth is on winter vacation in a remote cabin when employment benefactor The Worm calls over video with an urgent problem. A friend of The Worm owns a toy factory near Massmouth's holiday spot that is malfunctioning and it must be fixed immediately. With a promise of compensation, Massmouth heads out into the cold see what they can do.

title: How Not To Be Seen!
description: How Not To Be Seen! is a jokewad without gameplay: it consists instead of a 1:59 machinima adaptation of a Monty Python sketch of the same name.

title: Shopping Clutter 13: Mr. Claus On Vacation
MassMouth 2
description: MassMouth must embark on a journey to save his boss, The Worm, who is kidnapped by a mysterious group of aliens.

title: The Adventures of MassMouth
description: MassMouth is an alien from the planet Zeeble (a zeebloid). He has a small, green body with a large mouth. MassMouth is an employee of The Worm, a rich alien with his own personal moon. The Worm employs MassMouth to bring him various valuable items. MassMouth is very well-paid and has his own personal room.

title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate: Mecha Sonic Moveset
Super Smash Bros. Ultimate: Dread Samus
Super Smash Bros. Ultimate: Masked Man Moveset
Mr The Killer
description:
You play the character of "The Killer" : an autistic hitman disguised as Death.

Your boat sank and the ocean current carried you to the nearby shores. These are, unfortunately, those of a country where you are wanted by police for past misdeeds. You will have to show skill and courage to get you out of this bad situation. Will you successfully lead The Killer to the neighbouring border, to a place where he would escape his pursuers?

title: Undertale Red & Yellow
description: Have you played Undertale Yellow? After completing it, did you think: "Man, I really wanna replay Undertale now, but I've already played it so many times..." No? WELL TOO BAD! Introducing: Undertale Red & Yellow! An Undertale mod designed to scratch that Undertale Yellow itch!

title: WGSpace
description: WGSpace episode is a 8 level episode for Duke Nukem 3D.

title: WGRealms
description: WGRealms is a 5 level adventure Episode for DukeNukem 3D

title: Haunted Nukem
description: Duke is having a nightmare, what he does not realize is how much blood lies ahead. Duke has to take the (blood) elevators to the core of the horror and stop the beast. The aliens that Duke has killed in the past have somehow brought Duke into a realm that doesn't exist. Its a dark place with almost no escape. If Duke can't make it through he will never awaken this deep sleep.

title: That
description: The game features abstract surreal scenery and doesn't really contain an objective, it is more of a game to relax to and explore.

title: Arms Remix
description:
Arms Remix is a pseudo expansion for Nintendo's Fighting game Arms. It also gives new aesthetics for every stage and character in the form of new lighting and new alts respectively.

"Welcome to ARMS REMIX, A brand new way to experience ARMS! Featuring:

- A brand new ARM roster with more a more evenly spread element count!
- Remixed Stages (Stages with changed time of day and even colors!)
- Remixed Alts (A brand new alt for every character!)
- Revamped UI
- and much more!"

description:
The Human Body with Pipo is a program with which, in a simple, fun and practical way, children will investigate the inside of the human body,
fun and practical way, children will investigate the inside of the human body.
It is aimed at children from 5 to 12 years of age; however, in its easier levels, some of the games are very stimulating from the age of 4, especially the Puzzles or the Pairs. This product can be adapted depending on the age, needs and abilities of each subject.
The product is structured in 14 themes that are dealt with in the presentation
(robot screen) and 9 different activities where to experiment and to be able to
understand the functioning of the human body: what is hidden under the skin, what are the bones for?
What happens to food after it passes through the mouth? etc.

The duration of each game varies depending on the child's learning pace and motivation of the child. In addition, some games have several levels of difficulty. There is no time pressure and at any time the game can be interrupted and the child can leave the game.
They are very stimulating games, which quickly capture the child's interest. Although
some of the learning that is presented is of a later evolutionary stage, he can always manipulate them in some way.

The game features an integrated timer, so no need to worry about LiveSplit when you want to start a playthrough!

title: Green Green 2: Koi no Special Summer
description: As the new school year begins in Kanenone Gakuen, so does a new era as it becomes a co-educational school! You are Midorikawa Yutaka, a new first-year student who initially was wary of other students, but as they lived together in the dormitory, they gradually became your friends. Although school life was inconvenient to the point of death, everyone was enjoying it in their own way, until one day... when it was announced its closure! Students were divided and chaos surged between those who wanted the school to stay open and those who wanted it closed. What is the fate of Kanenone Gakuen? And what will happen to Yutaka and his friends' school life and love?

title: Green Green 3: Hello, Goodbye
description:
It has been a year since the Kanenone Gakuen transitioned into a co-ed school, integrating female students into a previously all-male high school. The school closure riots that followed were temporarily settled and the summer vacation was coming to an end by August. Yuusuke and Futaba are still fighting as usual, but they managed to keep it afloat. Everything seemed normal again, until suddenly... a fire broke out in the girls' dormitory! And now the girls have to live alongside the boys in their dormitory.
Yuusuke tries his best to make love amid all this, but he is now in trouble when a girl he has known since childhood shows up, and he starts to share a room with twin sisters!
An unprecedented ordeal looms before the two of them!
This is the final part of the series, filled with joy and conflict!

The main content of this expansion is the Necropolis league, as well as major changes to the endgame, including new Tier 17 maps and bosses, a rework to scarabs, and the ability to have multiple Atlas Passive Skill Tree layouts. The game takes you on an arcade-inspired journey through a fantastic world full of surprises and challenges. Every stage in Rainbow Cotton is guarded by peculiar bosses that puts your skills to the test. Collect power-ups, build up your flashy projectiles, and hurl them at colorful enemies. Use powerful magic attacks to clear the screen with fireballs and lightning. Only the most courageous (or stubborn, Willow-obsessed!) witches will prevail!

In fact, with Maggie and Portia finally existing in the same timeline, how could things go any way other than totes fab?

The fans have spoken, and we've heard you loud and clear: Mice Tea simply did not contain enough gyarus. This very special April Fools scenario aims to correct that mistake. Jam packed with as much gyaru goodness as we could muster, with guest illustrations from Popcore, blackshirtboy, NotZachForWork, CupcakeCarly, ComicTF, Ayvie, and Cavitees, and guest audio by Raina the Mouse, there's a lot to enjoy.

description: Immerse yourself in a survival and exploration game set in a procedural Wild West world. Choose your role, and set out to prove your legend on the frontier by building, mining, and battling alone or with friends.

title: Incremental Town RPG
description: Incremental Town RPG is an idle game where you manage the workforce of a small village, inputs, capital, other resources and help provide all the equipment and weaponry needed to progress and defeat creatures in distant Dungeons.

title: Virus 3D
description: Eradicate the logic viruses infecting your android baby sister in order to save her life in this fast-paced twin-stick shooter.

title: Chordioid
description: Chordioid is a unique musical JRPG where you battle to the beat. Explore a strange world, make unlikely friends, and uncover dark secrets, all while the beat goes on.

title: Slo's Home
description: Forty seeks revenge by trying to get all the information possible to unmask the real Slo, paying him back in kind. Slo's Home is a game that combines the control of an action game with the control of a point'n click adventure.

title: Castle Conquest: Medieval Strategy
description: A simple strategy about capturing castles. Build up your forces, manage armies and capture enemy fortresses. Build buildings in castles and use strategic tricks. Capture all the fortresses to win.

title: Legacy of Epstein: Foul Dreamer
description: Following the events of his "Bad Omen", Juglio arrives in the fallen city of Gettysburg to search for his friend Lenny.

title: Warrior Lords
description: Warrior Lords offers a furious medieval arcade experience, drawing inspiration from classic beat 'em ups. Battle through Western Europe wielding cold steel, delivering powerful kicks and summoning dragons. Choose from 6 unique heroes and defeat your rivals in a quest for supremacy.

title: Astral Disorder
description: As the lone maintenance worker on an unkempt space train station, navigate the chaos unleashed by a catastrophic crash and evade a relentless beast. Armed with scattered tools and state-of-the-art equipment, outsmart your pursuer and secure passage to safety aboard a distant escape pod.

title: Baseball Legacy Manager 24
description: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional baseball team!

title: Monkey See, Monkey Doo, Monkey Kiss You
description: Monkey See, Monkey Doo, Monkey Kiss You is a gripping first-person horror adventure. Stranded in a sinister forest, evade amorous monkeys while navigating treacherous paths. Face chilling encounters, uncover mysteries, and fight for survival in this pulse-pounding tale of fear and tension.

title: Liminality
description: Liminality is a single-player exploration game focused on liminal spaces, but mainly the poolrooms. Dive into the eerie but relaxing lukewarm water of the poolrooms. Navigate through the liminal spaces, where reality blurs, and uncover the secrets that lie beneath the surface

title: Diary of a Stoner
description: Wander through the Stoner Universe and Duel with Magical Cards! Will you use your power for Good? Or Evil? Many different endings are available depending on the choices you make. You are about to embark on a wonderous stoned adventure!

title: Cursed Dawn
description: Cursed Dawn is a wave survival FPS featuring complex maps packed with secrets, dynamic spawns, and hordes of zombies to turn into gory mulch. Plan your defense, stay on the move, and master the maps. Remember: Nowhere is safe, death is assured, how long can you last until you become zombie chow?.

title: Syuukun in Mirror World
description: The game is a short walking simulator that explores a 3D space. However, the controlling character is trapped in the Mirror World, and the player must control him from the real world to lead him to the goal.

title: SGS Battle For: Hue
description: The battle of Hué is an epic fight during the audacious 1968 Tết offensive launched by the Communists during the Vietnam War. Relive one of the longest, bloodiest battles the Americans would fight against VC in that emblematic conflict.

title: Mirage: A Biplane Adventure
description: Embark on a daring journey in Mirage. Master aerial combat, navigate treacherous skies, and unravel the mystery behind invading machines. Can you save the world?

title: Farm Together 2
description: Grow your own farm all by yourself, or cooperate with your friends in the long awaited sequel to the cozy, relaxing farming experience!

title: Eternal Strands
description: Fight epic, towering creatures while blending magical abilities with an arsenal of powerful weapons to keep the world from crumbling in this third-person, action-adventure game.

title: Hydrogen Game
description: A falling puzzle game where you drop 118 different elements and aim for a high score. You don't have to know the elements! Can you see the 118th element?

title: Item Collector Ball
description: You're a ball that collects items! Explore this carefully crafted time trial platformer with a plethora of unique physics based obstacles. Unique music and retro aesthetic define this game and provide a relaxing and satisfying experience. Easy to pick up but challenging to master.

title: Kill The Clock
description: Enter mid-1900s Europe on a quest for revenge, only to find your nemesis murdered. Framed for the crime, unravel the mystery with RPG elements, offering various choices to crack the case. With each playthrough, uncover new killers and methods. Can you clear your name before it's too late?

title: Bird Year
description: Bird Year is a gentle, family-friendly arcade game where you're a bird. Feed your hungry babies and avoid the dangers of the forest all year long. Catch bugs, eat berries and dodge predators while using your chosen bird's unique abilities. Unlock bonus content including more birds and a bonus level!

title: Dead Season
description: Guide a group of unprepared strangers in their struggle to survive a zombie apocalypse, in Dead Season, a turn-based tactics game. Strategize to endure against relentless undead hordes, but beware, noise attracts more danger. Can you escape the outbreak's grip?

title: Lands of Koastalia
description: Lands of Koastalia is a relaxing city building game with a unique building system. As Mayor, your primary mission is to keep people happy. Craft natural-looking villages, manage resources within and across them, explore an island, and meet the needs of your residents.

title: Diamond Drone
description: Put your drone piloting skills to the test in Diamond Drone! Race against the clock to collect all the rubies while keeping an eye on your battery level. Don't forget to search for batteries on the floor to recharge. How skilled are you at maneuvering drones?

title: Unscripted Fate
description: The protagonist is Alex, who comes from a poor family and by this reason, from an innocent child ends up being part of a criminal organization from a young age.

title: Pinball Storm: Lokanta
description: Pinball Storm:Lokanta is a RPG game combing Roguelike and pinball gameplay. You will be part of the resistance against plutocracy. Use your marble pinball to eliminate waves of enemies, and collect resources to further enhance your pinball. Save the world from hell!

title: MrHuh
description: Fight zombies.

title: On the Bubble
description: Inspired by classic platforming games, On the Bubble is an action-packed 3D platforming experience for fans of fast-paced games. The level editor allows anyone to make their own creations to be completed at breakneck speeds.

title: Teo Dove Pro Skater 2
description: Skateboarding game in the spirit of THPS. Perform flip tricks, grabs, grinds. Insane lines. Level up your character and learn new tricks. Find hidden secrets. And challenge your rival to a classic game of skate HORSE!

title: Dirge For The Zone
description: Dirge For the Zone/D4Z is a top-down shooter with role-playing and base-building elements. Build your base, protect your people and send them to explore the Zone.

title: Football Manager Lifestyle 24
description: Can you balance football management and life simulation? Football Manager Lifestyle 24 uniquely blends both, Guide your club to glory and pursue personal ventures to become a lifestyle icon. Grow your club, manage fishing and farming businesses, make friends, and win trophies in this dynamic world.

title: Skuf Backrooms
description: Have you ever wondered what might be waiting for you when you once again leave the confines of your apartment? And you obviously didn't realize that an ordinary walk to the garbage chute could turn into your nightmare.

title: Escape From Zombietown
description: Escape From Zombietown is an Action Shooter FPS where you collect guns, grenades and consumables to help you fight off the zombies while you make your way out of town. With 20 levels filled to the brim with zombies, this game has all the zombie annihilating action you need.

title: Machorium: Muscle Aquarium Simulator
description: Machorium - Muscle Aquarium Simulator - is a relaxing idle and sandbox game where you can unwind and have fun. Use points generated by cute little decorative muscle men to unlock various items and create your ideal muscle aquarium, Machorium.

title: Shush
description: You are one of the "Waste Warriors", navigating hazardous forests to gather trash for the Eco-Collector. Collect resources, build a base, evade enemies, and uncover the dark secret hidden within the Eco-Collector to survive.

title: Programming Factory
description: What kind of sparks will programming and factories create? Watching strings and numbers run on the conveyor belt, enjoy leisure time!!!

title: Escape the Kreegan
description: Escape corruption and deliver truth to the people in the only way you know how. as a space fighter pilot! You steal a ship and flee, it falls to you to duke it out in space and deliver truth to the people. Restore peace. Restore justice. Save humanity and Escape The Kreegan!

title: Don't Let It Die
description: As the first tribe to discover fire, master its creation amidst prehistoric survival challenges. Synergize 17+ unique characters, items, and strategize to ignite your legacy and secure humanity's dawn. A solo quest for fire's mastery awaits those with the will to not only survive, but thrive.

title: Sipssassin
description: You are the Sipssassin and your mission is to drink people’s drinks without getting caught. Run, fight, sneak and drink through unique levels, tackle challenges across four different game modes, unlock new characters, tools and power ups, while discovering hidden secrets.

title: Egg Defense
description: 'Egg Defense' is a strategy game where players deploy units to defend against enemy eggs from portals. Units have unique skills. Every 5 stages, players upgrade character skills using selected cards. The game blends casual strategy with enjoyable action for a delightful gaming experience.

title: Steel Symphony
description: Steel Symphony is a 2D Action-Strategy platformer where players craft combat sentinels by selecting components and balancing stats like integrity, mobility, and weapon capabilities. Chassis, weapons, and modules shape each sentinel's role with varied abilities for strategic customization.

title: Coffee For Cthulhu
description: Coffee For Cthulhu is a Lovecraftian Comfy Coffee Shop Simulator. During the day, you serve customers, brew coffee, and keep the various coffee machines from exploding or attacking customers. During the Night you hunt for ingredients in the dark woods where the feral monsters lay in wait.

title: Buzz or Die
description: If you win, you are acquitted; if you lose, you are executed. Death row inmates compete for ratings and talk battle in the conversation deck!

title: Milfvania Ep. 1
description: An animated adult visual novel, set up in a post-soviet environment. Yes, you live with the landlady.

title: Duckside
description: Imagine DayZ or Rust but you're a duck. A persistent world survival game with PVP, PVE, crafting, base building and hat wearing ducks, wielding weapons.

title: Xīn Shéndiāo Xiálǚ zhī Wánjiépiān
description:
Xin Shen Diao Xia Lu Zhi Wanjie Pian is the second installment in the series based on Louis Cha's (better known by his pen name Jin Yong) The Return of the Condor Heroes. Players will control Yang Guo who finds out that his lover Xiaolongnü is still alive after 16 years and sets out to find her.

The game plays like an RPG. Players move Yang Guo using the mouse and battles use a turn-based system where each character out of a party of up to 3 characters can attack as soon as their meter is full.

title: A Turnabout to El Dorado
description:
Taking place several months after the events of Spirit of Justice, Phoenix finds himself alone when he takes a rather strange -- and extremely hopeless case. With an uncooperative defendant, a staggering amount of evidence supporting the police's case, and a prosecutor that clearly has it in for him, how will Phoenix turn things around? Is there even any room for doubt?

Where does the truth lie?

In the hearts of the key players, all with their own secrets and motives?

Between the trees of the dense forest, the scene of a horrific murder?

Or perhaps, in the mythical city of gold that seems to be the connecting factor between the strange circumstances of the case -- El Dorado?

title: Eighteen
description:
You awaken in a house that is not yours. You are haunted by a past that you hope is not yours. You are given a name that you fear can never truly be yours.

You are Tohya Hachijo.

...Or are you?

In this short interactive experience, take control of an amnesiac looking to find his footing in the home of a strange woman, as he discovers his past -- or runs from it.

title: The Firebrand
description:
"The pain's always the same."

An interrogation room. Sitting on one side of a table is a woman. On the other is you - a detective tired of asking questions, but desperate for answers.

Who is the woman? Why is she here? What has she done?

The only way to find out is to talk. Every conversation topic giving new leads to chase down. Some worthwhile. Others not so much.

Follow the rabbit hole until you reach the truth.

title: Didnapper
description:
Didnapper is a non-profit fan RPG Maker game originally developed by Wychkith for the ADIDAS Message Boards as a fun little curiosity before it became a full game after developer Kendrian became lead developer in 2012.

The story revolves around a princess from a unnamed fantasy kingdom named Suki who, after being betrayed by her cousin Cherisa who wanted to inherit the throne instead of her, is given the choice to join the Kidnapping Guild that held her captive in exchange of not being bound and gagged in a cell and to discover why Cherisa betrayed her.

As a kidnapper, she is tasked to kidnap girls for ransom while her guild searches for information on her cousin's whereabouts.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Vegas Collection
description: A collection of both Rainbow Six Vegas & Rainbow Six Vegas 2. Rainbow operatives take to the chaotic streets of Las Vegas as an escalating terrorist siege in 'Sin City' threatens to take world terrorism to new, uncontrollable heights in Rainbow Six Vegas. In Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Vegas 2, it is your last chance to rescue America's sexiest city from an escalating terrorist siege that will force you into heart-pounding action from beginning to end. The best are back and this time winner takes all.

title: Exoprimal: Season 4
description:
The third Capcom Collab is slated to release its set of collaborative content with Mega Man alongside Title Update 4.
It'll include suit skins, decals, charms, stamps, and emotes based on the beloved Mega Man franchise!

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II - Nuketown Zombies
description:
Nuketown Zombies, also known as Nuketown in-game, is a Zombies map that is featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is based on Nuketown, a multiplayer map from Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

The map was previously only available to players who purchased the Hardened, Care Package, or Digital Deluxe editions but was later made available to purchase in the system's digital marketplace.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II - Nuketown 2025
description:
Nuketown 2025 is a downloadable map released for Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is a remake of Nuketown which first appeared in Call of Duty: Black Ops. While the original Nuketown went for more of a traditional 1950s theme, the new map is now in a 1960s retro-futuristic Mid-Century modern style meant to represent the "Home of the Future" for 2025.

It was available for free to anyone who pre-ordered the game, purchased a launch copy, or purchased the Hardened edition or the "Care Package" limited special edition of the game. It was later made available to download for free to everyone as well as being included in an update for Call of Duty: Black Ops II on Wii U.

title: Luminastadt
description: It's a cosy colony simulation game. Build and expand your colony by designing buildings, roads and infrastructure. Manage resources such as food, water and building materials. Manage housing, healthcare and education to keep your population happy and productive.

title: Catarsis: Catventure
description: Step into an exciting journey in Catarsis, a rogue-like action game where you are the last hope for the world. In this outlaw-like action game, surviving enemy attacks in each room will require careful choices of upgrading your character's abilities and the features of the weapons in your inventory.

title: Box To The Beat VR: Indie Electro Beats
description: Introducing the "Indie Electro Beats" DLC for BOX to the BEAT! Enjoy 10 unique tracks crafted by two up and coming artists! Feel the intensity as you sync your punches with the beats made by these talented creators. Step into the ring and prepare to be challenged as you take on these intense levels!

title: Car Wash
description: Car Wash is a cozy experience where you transform dirty, old cars into gleaming masterpieces. Enjoy the relaxing process of scrubbing, polishing, and adding the perfect finishing touch with the power of fresh soap and a hint of clean perfume!

title: Funny Farm Learning Games for Toddlers and Kids
description: Does your child like farm animals, farm life, animated puzzles and want to learn their first colors, shapes and sizes? Then get your child our new Farm Games educational game, which includes different animated levels and a ton of fun.

title: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons
description: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler game with 6 unique races to choose, robust combat, a grand saga spanning a continent full of unique kingdoms, free-form skill system, and a guild management system to master as you uncover the secrets of the world of Dragaea!

title: Animal Farm Jigsaw Games for Toddlers, Babys and Kids
description: The ultimate farm children's game with lots of animal puzzles and farm motifs. The perfect learning game for all children, toddlers, babies, jigsaw puzzle and animal lovers. Familyfriendly!

title: Trouble Comes Twice: Bonus Stories
description: An optional DLC that adds additional post-story moments to Trouble Comes Twice! Enjoy various short stories starring the twins and their love interests.

title: Time Avarice
description: Time is your currency and challenge. Destroy crystals for time; lose it if they vanish. Every run offers new power-ups, with choices that shape your journey. Unlock more as you play, all set in a visually dynamic, arcade-inspired space roguelite.

title: Save the Frog Keita
description: This game is to help the frog Kata and his friends escape from a dangerous area.

title: Escape Blocks
description: A space themed puzzle game.

title: Cosmic Kitchen
description: Cosmic Kitchen is a 2D cooking game set in space! Your mission: Feed hungry monsters or else they will take over all the galaxies! Think fast and grab food as it flies into orbit. Use planets, asteroids and more to get cooking and save the universe!

title: Destination Paradise
description: Embark on a global adventure to uncover hidden objects in charming locations, solving puzzles across 20 captivating chapters.

title: Catch My Color
description: Catch My Color is a game that find objects by applying the appropriate colors to the sights of Korea in black and white. Have fun coloring various landmarks in different colors and discovering hidden elements!

title: Serega Madness Pixel Adventures
description: Serega Madness Pixel Adventures — is a single player horror adventure game set in a pixel world. Solve interesting puzzles while hiding from the insidious horrors waiting for you in the shadows.

title: Secret Forest
description: Discover a vibrant realm brimming with wonders, where incredible races come to life. Master a unique combat system and challenge epic foes in your quest for glory.

title: SteamRush
description: STEAMRUSH is a third-person Boss Rush game featuring fast-paced melee combat against unique bosses, punctuated by exploration segments that gradually unveil the captivating story of the isolated city-state of Haze.

title: Button Man
description: Button Man is a side-scrolling adventure game set in a fictional Nova Scotia during prohibition. After years of being the henchmen to the local bootlegging kingpin your job now is to find who killed him and protect the town from what’s coming to it. Explore Kingsport and learn the truth!

title: Deep in The Fear
description: Dive into heart-pounding terror with our co-op horror experience for 5 players. Uncover chilling mysteries, face unspeakable horrors, and survive together in this intense collaborative nightmare. Will your team escape the shadows, or succumb to the darkness that lurks within?

title: Just a Cute Capybara Puzzle
description: Just a Cute Capybara Puzzle to keep you happy.

title: The Last Tiger
description: In the game "The Last Tiger," you will control the fate of four tank commanders during World War II! You will participate in the most bloody tank battles of the Second World War.

title: NeoSprint
description: The exhilarating Atari racing classic “Sprint” series returns! NeoSprint zooms back to life as a single screen arcade racer for up to 8 players, paired with a robust track builder and intuitive sharing tools, ensuring a racing experience that satisfies speed demons and architects alike.

title: Void Foundation: Into The Void
description: Void Foundation: Into The Void is a JRPG game with SCP & Randomized dungeon exploration element. Void Foundation tells the story of a future world which human history has been rewritten due to the discovery of Void Gate Players will be recruited as void adventurers, discover the secrets of the void.

title: Automate It
description: Automate It is a factory building game that requires clever solutions to its size, power, and time constraints. Solve challenges, build and share your own levels, or open things up in sandbox mode. If you want to build it - Automate It.

title: Clone War
description: It's a roguelike game that gets stronger by winning a fight against clones.

title: Steel Effigy
description: Fight against a horde of soulless machines in this 1 to 4 player action-roguelite, hack n slash. Wield several combat defining weapons simultaneously and imbue them with elemental augments to enhance their power. Create unique builds by collecting and using powerful items to devastating effect.

title: True Idle Simulator 2
description: How long can You do nothing?

title: Mad World Survivors
description: Mad World Survivors is a casual Vampire Survivors Like game in the style of cyber-post-apocalyptic horror with elements of a simplified roguelike. Here, every decision you make can cause an avalanche of consequences for the hordes of monsters you will face.

title: SoulTail
description: Play SoulTail and save the forest. Summon and nurture a guardian spirit with various cards and their combinations to protect the forest from the encroaching monsters. Become a guardian who defends the forest with the power of your strategy and luck!

title: Auto RiskRisk: Deluxe Pieces
description: The Deluxe Pieces sets unlocks 4 new fighter pawns and 12 new battlefield play mats for customising your team.

title: Assassin's Belief
description: This is an interesting balloon game where balloons appear randomly from the edge below the stage and disappear when they rise to the edge above the stage.

title: Everlords
description: Everlords combines the elements of real-time strategy and base management. As a mighty Everlord, you possess the godlike power to create worlds, harness the elements, and guide your devoted followers in the battle against the advancing chaos forces.

title: April 24th
description: The main character is an experienced journalist who always strives to uncover the truth. He manages to gain access to the house, which is guarded by the police.

title: They Can Fart
description: Play as a one-eyed farting creature and glide across the stars in this 3v3 online competitive gravity based multiplayer game, where you jump between planets, dodge other player’s bullet, and plant seeds to make your team win.

title: Subway
description: Detect even the smallest change and safely reach the destination station.

title: Storm's Eye
description: As a Runner, master your environment and claw your way through the endless stream of corrupted monsters chasing you. Gear yourself up on the drops of your adversaries, recycle or upgrade it, and complete objective to move forward. But beware of the Storm !

title: Catarsis
description: Catarsis unfolds in a future environment and people share this place with AI robots. In the midst of chaos scientists developed a revolutionary technology which will enable cats’ intelligence to inhabit a robotic body, allowing it to liberate the world from the ruthless rule of humans.

title: Kebabstar
description: From desert to stars! Craft your path to fame with Kebabstar! From desert hardships to star-studded parties, become a social media phenomenon by mastering the art of kebab-making and outshining your enemies.

title: Rhythm Reunion
description: The band is getting back together! Haven't you heard?! 'Summer Vacation' is reuniting for one last gig! Take part in this artistically diverse visual novel as you explore the new lives of each of the old band members, all whilst you convince each of them to return to the lime light!

title: Ghost For Hire
description: Welcome to Ghost for Hire! As the newest hire for the Ghost Protection Management, your job is to drive off mortal trespassers from various protected properties. Use our state-of-the-art equipment to survey the environment, spook the intruders, and scare them into believing in the supernatural!

title: Forgotten Vale
description: Cast into an idyllic wilderness, will you endure? A sandbox city-building game featuring a deceptively cheerful world: build freely —no grids— plus a fully simulated economy, intricate production chains, deep research tree, and growth you can feel. Can your people survive the winter?

title: Castaway
description: Survive day and night on a small island in the middle of the ocean.

description: Casino Simulator Expand Your Casino From Scratch, Hire Employees, Customize It, Gamble, Enjoy Your Own Casino

description: Build the best rocket with your partner and race the other team through space! It’s Not Rocket Science! offers 2 versus 2 local multiplayer. It is played with controllers.

title: Human Resource
description: Navigate through the corridors of corporate tyranny using only your keyboard skills. Unleash your vengeance upon the oppressive office management as you flip, dodge, and dash through cubicles and meeting rooms. Fast-paced adrenaline arcade.

title: Sex Magic
description: Sex Magic is a captivating visual novel that immerses you in a world of magic

description: Let's solve a scrambled cube in its unfolded state. Manipulate the cube pieces of a randomly mixed cube to solve it.

description: Yet Another Hentai Puzzle game to keep you happy.

title: MyTavern
description: Design and create your own tavern. Make the space comfortable for guest to stay and rest the night away.

description: Single button - Push or slash. Anything to get them off the hill. Side effects might include sneezing, freezing, farting, poisoning, healing, or setting on fire.

title: Maintenance Crew
description: A cooperative horror game where you must work to maintain a base to keep monsters from getting in.

title: The Stairway 7
description: The Stairway 7 is an endless loop anomaly hunt and observation "spot the difference" game where you are stuck in a endless loop of stairways with a cat and you have to observe your surroundings carefully to reach the exit. Anomalies are watching, and ready to hunt you down. Don't take them with you.

title: DeTechtive 2112
description: DeTechtive 2112 is a co-op, stealth/action game from an isometric perspective with a linear storyline set in a cyber universe.

title: Project 13: Nightwatch
description: A new Observer Gametype where you take on the role of an Observer tasked with guarding the HQ of the Project 13 Corp. . Prevent any Observer Prisoner, each potentially containing a anomaly, from infiltrating the HQ. Equipped with a high-tech binocular, your observation skills are the key to success.

description: On a sun-bathed beach, in a rustic town, he wakes up with her by his side again. A brief moment is all she need.

title: Spirit Harem
description: An erotic visual novel about sexy spirit girls!

title: The Crystal Archer Girl
description: This game combines dating simulation with third-person combat.

title: Paintballers: MLPB 2024
description: Welcome to Paintballers MLPB 2024, a cross-platform video game meticulously designed by professional paintball players. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or a newcomer, Paintballers delivers an authentic and thrilling paintball experience like never before.

title: Price for Freedom: Gold and Sand
description: Gold and Sand is a CRPG with turn based tactical combat, with limb based targeting and bleeding and maiming mechanics. Several mini games such as cooking, fishing, and others.

title: Mazelit: Rolling With Style
description: Roll your own player character by choosing from six more style options for Mazelit - or create your own and use it in the game.

title: Chaos Frenzy
description: Eris the Chaos goddess has lost her powers source The chaos emeralds by an unknow being at the chaos dimension, now she's got a goal to archive Get back her powers and become the chaos goddess once again but it won't be easy for her, emeralds have taken the form of her most deep dears, dont give up!

title: Chef Life: A Restaurant Simulator - Tokyo Delight
description: Explore Japanese gastronomy with the TOKYO DELIGHT pack, which includes 8 iconic recipes, new decor items to transform your restaurant into an authentic izakaya, and equipment for your chef.

title: Mycelium
description: Enter the post-extinction world of Mycelium. With humans extinct, take control of a new, sentient species of fungi-Spores. Grow your Spore community, grant them powerful abilities, and battle against evolved insects in this Action Roguelite, Pet-Simulator game!

title: TR-12
description: Defeat all monsters and survive for twenty minutes using your keyboard (or gamepad) to simultaneously move and shoot, running into powerups, like Haste and Nuke, in this newly hand-crafted shooter inspired by 16-bit classics like Smash T.V. and Contra.

title: Resource Recon
description: RESOURCE RECON is an exciting game in which you take on the role of a brave miner on a quest to find rare materials in the depths of the earth.Your main goal is to collect valuable resources and minerals that can only be found in the most dangerous and exciting places underground.

title: Axe Ghost
description: In Axe Ghost you play cards to battle an advancing monster horde in turn-based spatial combat. Manipulate enemy positions, group monsters for high scores, and face off against the loathsome Garnemar!

title: MagFighter
description: Dive into the chaotic world of MagFighter! A top-down multiplayer brawler featuring 50+ spells for epic magical battles. Witness dynamic spell collisions, strategically customize your loadout, and enjoy GBA-era pixel art visuals. Unleash the magic and become the ultimate MagFighter!

title: Emperor of the Fading Suns Enhanced
description: This classic 4X strategy game, renowned for its deep game play and unparalleled setting, allows one to five players to battle on land, air, sea and space as they fight each other and AI for control of humanity. Trade, build, and engage in diplomacy with the Church, Merchant League, and alien races.

title: Cybersex: Lust Story
description: Welcome to the world of Cybersex: Lust Story – an enthralling visual novel for adults, where you become the architect of your own destiny, interacting with a mysterious android being that encapsulates uniqueness and distinction.

title: Super Dragon Punch Force 3
description: Super Dragon Punch Force 3 is an exciting new free-to-play, 2.5D fighting game from South African developer Talent Digital Art. Jump into fast-paced 1-v-1 fights and master a constantly expanding roster of epic characters, each with their own distinct style and abilities.

description: Explore the world of Chicken Boy, for DOS...

title: Happy Monster
