description: JRPG meets Western RPG: Help Aria uncover a dark conspiracy. Battle through hordes of enemies and meet complex and charming characters in a colorful fantasy-world.

title: Earth Defenders
description: During the game, you play the role of one of the army commanders who faces alien invaders.-Expand your base-Extract raw materials-Create troops-Counteract invaders

title: Endloop
description: You are trapped in an endless stairway with no end in sight. Solve twisted puzzles and maybe you will escape your fate.

title: FaceYourFear
description: Face your fear is a horror game based on a story with puzzles and a realistic and stressful atmosphere.

title: Fatal Terminal
description: A retrofuturistic co-op horror about extracting secret objects from abandoned space stations for corporate clients.

title: Fatal Falls
description: In Fatal Falls you explore the dark secrets of "The Grand Elysium", a posh luxury hotel. Interact with its guests, drink a cocktail at the bar, peruse the noble premises – the choice is yours! Just make sure you choose appropriate answers when talking to people who are mentally unstable...

title: Felbound
description: Felbound is a challenging and ruthless roguelike game. Embark on a journey into a mysterious dungeon, facing off against orcs and goblins with a plethora of weapons spells and items!

title: Floops Big House Adventure
description: Shoot, loot, and toot your way through 90's cartoon inspired Floops Big House Adventure! Floops is a wave based roguelike arcade game. Learn enemy attacks and upgrade combinations in order to take down the Monster Overlord!

title: Forgotten Mechs
description: Quick mech battle for two players. Choose weapons, explore the map and destroy your opponent.

title: Forest Fellers
description: Forest Fellers! A game about Gnomes, Trees, and chopping them. Generate wood as you hire your very own Forest Fellers (Gnomes) to fell forests YOU make. Your Gnomes will grow and level up the more they chop allowing you to get more and more efficient trees for them to take down.

title: Flying Ferret
description: In this action game, a mysterious ferret with special jumping ability and its friends are made to jump and fly at high speed from island to island over the blue ocean to fly farther and farther.

title: Fowl Swarm
description: Just another day at the farm, face seemingly endless swarms of killer chickens. They will keep coming, you can't hide. Survive for as long as you can...

title: Fresh Milk For Mars
description: A cute puzzle game in which you have to catch cows and bring them back to Mars.

title: Akuyaku Reijou ha Ringoku no Outaishi ni Dekiai Sareru
Gaming Cafe Life
description: Manage your very own gaming cafe!

title: Ghost of Viyk
description: In the lands of Vyik, death is just the beginning. Tailor your items and abilities to create your unique battle style — and slay enemies who never play by the rules, in this Ukrainian Grimfolk roguelite action. Because the price of freedom is never fair.

title: Gingar Ail
description: Gingar Ail is a story-based SF RPG indie game set on the Moon Base. Become Asta, the protagonist and one of the agents who lost all her memories in an accident, and discover secrets of the Moon Base. Battles involve turn-based strategy.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibugawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 14 - Rasen no Kan Satsujin Jiken
description: Two cases are intertwined in a spiral, Heading toward a sad truth.

title: Gobocore: Goblin Rescue Squad
description: Party Building Turn Based Auto-Battler about little goblins rescuing their kidnapped tribe members. Smash. Evolve. Survive.

title: Godslayer Arena
description: Godslayer Arena is a fusion of autobattlers and action-rpgs. Draft a set of synergizing spells for your Godslayer to cast and witness their power as they take on the arena. Combat is performed automatically, and success is determined through strategic build creation.

title: Golden Road
description: Hey buddy, have you ever driven around your city?

title: Granser
description: A story driven rpg inspired by JRPGS like Xenogears/saga, featuring a unique turn based battle system. Follow Saragat and his dubious allies as they untangle the web of lies and attempt to dismantle the shadowy conspiracy of "The Core", as a far greater threat will reawaken.

title: Greed and Fear and the Rest
description: You are ready to say goodbye to life, but are you prepared to face your life's truth? Navigate a grad student's life between greed and fear in his final 6 hours (and beyond) in this BL visual novel.

title: Gregg: Tower Defence
description: Play as Gregg. Gather, build and destroy your slimy enemies in this thrilling pixel art tower defence!

title: Grub Truck
description: Grub Truck is a food truck simulation game where you cook up mouthwatering meals, strategise enticing menus, set the perfect prices, complete quests and decorate your trucks with style. Invest your earnings wisely to upgrade your fleet as you build, cook, and conquer the culinary scene!

title: Hearts in Orbit: When Stars Align
description: Hearts in Orbit is a fantasy romance visual novel that follows two stars who fell in love and have reincarnated as humans. Will they remember their origins? Will they fall in love again? That's for you to decide.

title: Hell's Bell
description: GO TO HELL ... in this hand-drawn, hack-n-slash adventure. "Hell's Bell" is a story-driven brawler following Bell, who after learning a family secret, finds herself fighting endless hordes of demons in the underworld.

title: Hemlock
description: An action packed 3rd person Roguelike, With a rich tapestry of handcrafted levels, a multitude of game-changing items, and thrilling boss fights. Are you ready to face the unknown, rewrite your destiny, and emerge victorious in the fight to restore Hemlock?

title: Heroes of Latera
description: Heroes of Latera is a 3d fantasy style survivor based in the realm of Latera. Explore unique classes each with their own individual abilities and play styles. Fight through the endless waves of Eu'roks hoard as you amass wealth, experience, and a pile of bodies.

title: Hexceed: Year 4 Pass
description: This is your pass to 6 exciting new worlds to complete in hexceed! With 700+ levels to complete!

title: Hexceed: Rubrum
description: This DLC unlocks a brand new world for hexceed: Rubrum Puzzle your way through 140 new levels - levels include all previously introduced mechanics!

title: Hexforger
description: Craft your spells in ONLINE CO-OP with your friends in this SURVIVORS-LIKE! Slaughter monsters, gain gold, upgrade your spells to infinite heights. Crush challenges and unlock new spells, upgrades, pickups, realms. Up to 4 players in this unique twist on the survivors-like formula!

title: Hidden Riddles: The Amazon Mystery
description: Help the detective crack a difficult case! Hundreds of exciting levels! Hidden Riddles - The Amazon Mystery: Solve mysterious puzzles!

title: Find Kittens: The Last of Cats
description: Explore this mysterious post-apocalyptic world by finding cute cats and this black and white world will be colore.

title: Suffocation
description:
Best Friends love eachother. Best Friends care about eachother, look out for one another. Best Friends never go anywhere without eachother.

Best Friends should never lie to one another. Best Friends should never fight with eachother, make eachother jealous. Best Friends love eachother.

That's what he thinks, anyway. He's your Best Friend. Nothing more or less.

title: Hydrogen
description: Enter a post-apocalyptic Sci-Fi world in 'Hydrogen,' a thrilling Roguelite ARPG. Navigate through procedurally generated instances, each playthrough offering unique challenges, random items, and perks to level up your character.

title: Hyperbeat
description: Embark as a knight in an order chasing your potential. Featuring an original soundtrack, precision rhythm gameplay, character customization, and a story following an ensemble cast, only one question remains. What will you find at the peak of what you're chasing?

title: Hyperfield
description: Welcome to the exhilarating world of Hyperfield, a groundbreaking sports sensation that fuses the intensity of rugby with mind-bending supernatural abilities! Step onto the futuristic pitch where speed, strategy, and superhuman powers collide in an electrifying display of athleticism.

title: Incremental Island
description: Build and expand a vibrant civilization on a procedurally generated island

title: Inflatum
description: Inflatum is a cute animal rescue game. Rescue the poor hapless critter who is only trying to reach his stranded family. Save him from the hazards littering the landscape. Use gas tanks to inflate objects to come to the critter's aid.

title: InOutPath
description: You will play the role of a smart and agile kitten, learn and utilize various strange and interesting mechanisms to unlock 300+ puzzles that are extremely characteristic and full of challenges, to obtain an unforgettable puzzle-solving experience.

title: Skelemental: Monk's Fury
description: Reborn as the Skeleton Monk after a deadly betrayal, you scour a ravaged and corrupted land to find your captured lover and exact revenge on the one who killed you. Master impactful martial arts combos imbued with elemental power to avenge your own death and bring balance to the land of Mortis.

title: Interior Designer
description: Step into the world of Interior Designer. Embark on client jobs, dominate the Design League, and create stunning interiors. Shape your spaces, and unleash your style. Your masterpiece awaits.

title: Introspection
description: IntroSpection is a top-down bullethell-like action game about a man forced to confront his past. Delve into memories and blast through waves of inner demons as you explore one man's mental purgatory.

title: Into the Restless Ruins
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build the dungeon you fight through. Each night use your cards to expand the ruins then battle through them harvesting Glimour from the residents, so The Maiden may grant your heart’s desire. But be warned - eventually your trespassing will awaken The Warden.

title: Jumping Orb
description: Jump, challenge, collect, win!

title: Just Skill Shooter 3: 2D Edition
description: Try on the role of a shooter who opposes the whole world

title: Keepers of Ancient Lands
description: ou are one of the defenders of ancient lands. In this game, you have to destroy crowds of enemies with the help of your faithful warriors.

title: Keep It Steady!
description: Try to see how high of a score you can get in Keep It Steady! Move the paddles individual sides up and down to try to guide a small ball into the correct hole. Watch out for the wrong holes though, If you hit too many it will be game over!

title: Killer Junkyard
description: The night is young and you are fuel. Evade grotesque mechanical-human creatures as you attempt to survive until dawn in this PSX style atmospheric horror game.

title: Killmaiden
description: A fast paced singleplayer arena shooter. Choose one of three goals to win each stage, explore the tech tree and defeat 10 bosses on the way to meet the devil on stage 66. What's the highest score you can reach?

title: Kindred
description: A physics-based 2D puzzle-platformer.

title: King of Retail 2
description: Ready to build another empire? You are once again back in the role as the manager, trying to make the best of a busy store. Find the right things to sell, get the right employees and turn every stone for a profit. Can you handle the pressure or will you buck under? Welcome to King of Retail 2.

title: Knight of Nevermore
description: Knight of Nevermore is a roguelike action-platformer featuring tight combat and diverse builds. Fight skillfully, platform carefully and equip yourself wisely if you plan to overcome the challenges of Nevermore.

title: Life as a Lich
description: Embrace lichdom: research powerful spells, recruit undead legions, manage your domains, rule the underworld, and become a demigod!

title: Light and Shadow: Schatten über Empyria
description: Meet new companions, regain your memory after a stranding, join a story guild, save the world from the shadow, or plunge it into ruin.

title: Light Box
description: Roll and shine endlessly in this game! Move left, move right, avoid obstacles, and collect Life-Shields for protection. Watch out for traps and other dangerous boxes. Keep rolling and shining!

title: Over the Net
description: Simple 2,5D volleyball. Just start game and enjoy it! 2 Game Modes (1vs1, 2vs2) | 4 Arenas (Beach, Castle, School and Mars) | 6 Colours to Choose Prove that you are the best volleyball player in the world!

title: Pinbot
description: Pinbot reimagines the timeless breakout game in an immersive 3D setting. Traditional brick formations now morph into incubators nurturing alien robots, demanding swift destruction! In this robotic realm, every element is mechanized.

title: Legend of Gallant
description: An evil warlock has broken the crystal and unleashed magic onto the world. Stop the crystal's corruption and end the chaos in this Match 3 game.

title: Quest of the Dragon Soul
description: Explore a world of magical dragons, mythical demons and hidden treasures. But be warned, strange creatures are hiding in the shadows in this Match 3 adventure.

title: Star Ring
description: Novel × Otome × Simulation Development Welcome to Star Poetry Academy! You who pursue your dreams will be the brightest star in the future. ——Nine career routes, seven playable characters, and rich game systems create a unique showbiz legend

title: Nori Danshi!!
description: "Wound up? By any nori but me." A thrilling school life with 4 good-looking nori! Which "nori" will you "omusubi" with ......?

title: A Boy And His Barrel
description:
You've befriended (and apparently married) a barrel full of blueberry sauce named Violet, but the demons don't understand your love and will attack the both of you without hesitation.

Both of you must make it out alive - if either of you dies, you must restart. Defend her with the limited provisions you get, and escort her to the exit gate!

title: Space Raiders
description: Embark on an intergalactic journey in this adrenaline-pumping 2D space shooter! Pilot your sleek spacecraft through treacherous enemy armadas as you battle to save the galaxy from imminent destruction. With intuitive controls and fast-paced action, blast your way through wave after wave of alien invaders. Dodge incoming fire, shoot enemies in this thrilling arcade-style adventure. Are you ready to become the hero the universe desperately needs?

title: Vampachi
description: Dodge, evolve, survive in this survival shmup. Help vampire hunter Liz Belmont to survive until dawn. Except dawn will never come.

title: Final Fantasy XVI: Collector's Edition
description:
Final Fantasy XVI is the first fully fledged action RPG in the mainline Final Fantasy series. Clive Rosfield is on a mission to free mankind from its fate, and must use the Eikonic powers at his disposal to overcome every obstacle his enemies lay before him.

Collector's Edition in-game item
Bonus Weapon: Blood Sword
The fabled scarlet steel of Firion, hero of Final Fantasy II.

Collector's Edition bonus digital contents
Digital Mini Artbook, Digital Mini Soundtrack
These digital contents allows you to enjoy the world of "FINAL FANTASY XVI" to your heart's content.

Collector's Edition bonus physical contents
Premium Statue - Phoenix vs Ifrit
A premium statue depicting a battle between two eikons - Phoenix and Ifrit.
Approx. size: W230mm x D150mm x H270mm
Material: PVC, ABS

Metal Eikon Pin Collection
A premium metal pin collection featuring eight eikons.
Approx. size: W33mm x D5mm x H35mm (Ifrit)
Material: Zinc Alloy, Brass

Special Clive Rosfield SteelBook Case
A SteelBook case featuring artwork of Clive Rosfield, the protagonist. Use the case to store the disc-based media of your choice.
Material: Tin, Polypropylene

Cloth World Map of Valisthea
A cloth map of Valisthea where the story unfolds.
Approx. size: W615mm x D350mm, Thickness 0.3mm
Material: 100% Cotton

title: Sonic Overture '95
description:
Sonic Overture '95 is a fan-made prequel to the first Sonic the Hedgehog, inspired by 32-bit games from the Saturn era and the scraped concepts from the original Sonic the Hedgehog. It tells the story of Sonic's adventures on Christmas Island.

The game is an unofficial revival of the game known as Sonic Overture, which had a demo released in 2014.

title: Cards of Heart
description: Cards of Heart is a narrative-focused cozy digital card game mixed with a fantasy top-down RPG about a young woman’s daily mental health struggles against her inner Shadows.

title: Aladdin Magic Carpet Racing
description:
"Aladdin Magic Carpet Racing" is an exhilarating, fast-paced racing game set against the enchanting backdrop of Agrabah. Players can choose to race as either Aladdin or Princess Jasmine, navigating their way through four uniquely designed and challenging race courses. The game’s vibrant visuals and dynamic tracks capture the essence of the magical world, offering an immersive racing experience.

In each race, players will dodge obstacles, collect power-ups, and outmaneuver opponents to gain the lead. The courses are filled with iconic locations from the Aladdin universe, providing a nostalgic yet thrilling adventure. The ultimate goal is to defeat the evil sorcerer Jafar in the final showdown to win the prestigious Agrabah Cup and become the reigning magic carpet racing champion.

title: Mazie
description:
Mazie is fast bat 'n' ball action with more fascinating features than you can shake a joystick at. For a start, you don't just fire at the bricks - they fire at you. Avalanches of bombs will wing their way toward you, the dreaded Yello will descend from jets flying over, and the red devil tumbles from its cage. All can have a seriously detrimental effect on your life! Then there are the capsules to be caught, some of which can give you a larger bat, or a plank over part of the holy grass, or a free life, or even a wipe screen.

36 screens with a more difficult big bonus version of each and every one - that's the marvel of Mazie.

title: The Playroom: AR Studio
description:
Ever wanted to have your own movie studio? Then AR Studio is for you.

Use your tablet or smartphone to create funky banners and holographic billboards, wear funny masks, add your own music and special effects and be the star of your own TV show. You could even start a regular broadcast, beamed directly to “Live From PlayStation”. What will your show be about?

title: Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl - Fresh Meat
description: A free update/DLC that adds five all-new maps for you to destroy your friends on and eight new units that introduce new tactics to the game such as the ability to heal units or to slow down the enemy by freezing them. Destroy your enemies like never before!

title: Sunder For People Who Don't Have Time To Play Sunder
description: Get the full Sunder experience in just a fraction of the time! All of the action, with only 10% of the average monster count! The maps range from a few minutes to 15-20 minutes ﻿long. ﻿Play it now, and next time you're at a party, you'll have just enough Sunder knowledge to impress everyone with your analysis of the combat encounters. ﻿﻿

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Mega Edition
description:
The Mega Edition of Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid comes with:
- Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid physical game sealed in a standard case.
- Deluxe Morpher SteelBook with inset magnet recess.
- Five power coins that magnetically attach to the SteelBook Morpher
- 18 x 24 inch poster.
- Collector's Edition Content:
- Update One Content (v1.2):
- Update Two Content (v1.3):

title: Venom Vendetta
description: Venom Vendetta is a short single tech-base-themed mbf21 map for Doom2. The main focus was to make a map with a small monster count that could be quickly completed.

title: Palworld: Pokémon Mod
description: A mod for Palworld which changes many models from the game to Pokémon characters. It was taken down by Nintendo due to copyright infringement.

title: Lost in the Amazon
description: Lost in the Amazon is an interactive CD-ROM based on the book of the same name by Toni Brandão, which provides lots of information about the region's indigenous people, animals, and plants. It also includes two games: a matching card game between animals or plants and a Frogger-style where you need to bring items back to the tent.

title: Monsty Corp: The Sequels
description: Two Timelines crossing over. Your actions will impact the future in ways you never could have imagined!

title: Monsty Corp: The Prequels
description:
Play as Maria Romanoff on her last day of work at Monsty Corp
Monsty Corp is an advanced science facility in the middle of the Australian desert, Maria, a member of the Practical AI Division, has been tasked with activating a new AI. Little does she know, this is her last day on the job.

Uncover the secrets of the past!
Find out what happened before the events of Monsty Corp, and how it became what it is today.

title: Fantasy Mosaics 37: Spooky Night
description: A nonogram puzzle game about a penguin family who spends the night at an abandoned, spooky manor.

title: Front Edge
description: Front Edge is a real-time strategy game set in a modern warfare setting.

title: Grids of Thermometers
description: Fill grids of thermometers with mercury. Numbers on the grid edges tell you how many cells must be filled in each row and column. No random guessing! Many levels to solve with logic only.

title: Easter Journey
description:
Easter Journey is a delightful puzzle game designed to celebrate the enchanting atmosphere of Easter. Flip Easter-themed cards to uncover matching pairs.

The game offers four different difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert. Each level challenges players' memory and attention skills while immersing them in the joyous holiday spirit with adorable Easter characters and atmospheric music.

Easter Journey, with its four distinct difficulty levels, adds an extra layer of joy to your Easter celebrations!

title: From Four Sides
description: From Four Sides is a game in which you control a yellow square and must dodge flying spikes in four directions. Points are awarded for dodging spikes. The game ends when the spike hits you.

title: Vigna's Stereo Switch
description:
1-Button Rhythm Game based on 'Arknights', a mobile tower defense game by Hypergryph.

Survive waves of notes vibing to avant-garde music!

title: On Mount Ségou
description: On Mount Ségou is a short, kinetic visual novel with an atmospheric, dark fantasy story. Ellie and Captain Syna of the Azurium Air Fleet travel to Mount Ségou to offer a prayer to the Nameless One.

title: Vespera_Hotel
description: Welcome to Vespera Hotel! Please observe the precautions on manager's letter and greet our dear guests with your smile.

title: Bloodroot
description:
A war between the mages and regular humans ended with the regular humans acquiring the power of magic. Despite overcoming this hurdle, they possessed no army capable of beating the mages.
Luckily, the half-blooded witches were able to take down the lord of the mages, allowing the world to reset in peace.

The half-blooded witches of the church used their magic and miracles to dispel the crazed magic that warps the regular humans.
The heroine was one such witch.
One day, she receives information from an old church friend named Yuris regarding a certain underground city, and sets off to explore it.

title: Pilapila
description: An indie puzzle game about rearranging blocks to reach your goal.

title: Osmar: A Primeira Fatia do Pão-de-fôrma
description: Have you ever thought about how the first slice of bread feels? That's right, the one nobody eats, the one they always leave aside! That's what you'll discover in this exciting story: Osmar, the first slice of bread, and his friend Cookie are on a mission to find the box of candies.

title: Tarde Animada
description: Join the funniest gang on the Internet and spend an afternoon playing with super cool characters! Tarde Animada mixes an adventure game with various kinds of games. Have fun wandering around the Bugigangue club! Commanding Gustavinho, you meet all the characters, talk to all of them, and choose who you want to play with! It's like spending an afternoon with your Bugigangue friends! Each of them has a different game! You can play target shooting, penalty shootout, cook, mad scientist, and much more!

title: Wonderland: Gold Saint In Adventure
description:
Garen, who was in the Twin Wombs of the Holy Kingdom, inexplicably arrived at the mysterious place full of magma when he woke up and also wore a retro knight costume. , is the best thing to do in the future.
Garen exited the Cave of Flames and heard someone calling his name: it was the Cancer Saint, DeathMask. Deathmask was also transported to this strange world when he woke up from his sleep. It was very likely that all the Golden Saints were involved.
The best way to deal with the disease is through a first battle in a different world, Gallon and Dis fought their adventure in the mysterious different world of Fontainebleau. What is the problem? What is the problem? What is the problem?

title: Super Roll Out
description:
"Super Roll Out" is the exciting debut game from Project8024Games, blending the charm of classic Nintendo 64 and Sega Dreamcast titles with modern gameplay elements.

Take control of Ballu, the determined protagonist on a mission to halt the havoc caused by the nefarious Dr. Marblous. Journey through diverse worlds,

solving puzzles and gathering shattered Mega Gems to restore peace and thwart tyranny. Explore numerous worlds filled with challenges and uncover thrilling mini-games along the way.

Can you rescue the planets from impending destruction and restore order to the cosmos?

title: No Players Online
description: you find an abandoned fps game on an old computer. you decide to play it.

title: Travel to France
description: Travel to France invites you to visit the country of love! Explore the country, see world-famous sights and enjoy the world-class cuisine.

title: Reydllom
description:
A dark search for an evil witch begins.
Can you survive?

title: Highlaundry Overwashed: Play with your friends!
description: Wash, dry, and sort clothes against the clock, mastering new challenges with each level.

title: Marvel First Alliance 2
description:
Marvel First Alliance 2 is a beat 'em up where you can choose between tons of famous characters from the Marvel universe to lead a fight against the forces of evil led by Red Skull, who is trying to take over the world.

Marvel First Alliance 2 has four different playing modes. In all, you can visit eight different zones divided into more than twenty levels packed full of enemies, including some special bosses.

title: Marvel Infinity War
description:
Adam Warlock warns the earth of the Infinity Stones being sought by Magus, and so earth's heroes divide into teams to collect each Gem. These gems are placed into the possession of The Enchantress, MODOK, Selene, Ronan the Accuser, and Russia's superheroes.

In the end, the gathering of the heroes is what allows Magus to collect them all and try to wipe the floor with them.

Marvel Infinity War is a module created by ZVitor, based on the Marvel Comics Universe, and is a sequel to the Marvel First Alliance series. The game has 80 playable characters plus one secret character. There are also over 36 bosses to contend with. The game uses a six-button control scheme. Each character has at least one special move and an ultra move. There are also many special assist characters to summon.

title: Grovesong
description: Explore the still and calming Grove. Draw music in the air. Each note has it's distinct colour and sound. Make your own calming songs by mixing the Colours and Sound of the Grove.

title: Vaer
description: The Light of the Sun is dying. Collect energy and return it to the sun to save the light. Made in under 48 hours for Ludum Dare 39.

title: Zealot's Curse
description: Obey your Masters. Destroy your enemies. Created for #7DRL.

title: Tripper
description: The game is one long difficult level. Get to the end of the level in the best time you can.

title: The Punniest Pun Messter
description:
What if you're cursed to make others laugh?

The 'Jester' is an entity who grants children happiness, but he was just another persona of myth... Until one day he appears on your windowsill and bestows his powers upon you. Now you're inflicted with a pun-curse, and thus begins your journey to cure yourself!

Upon changing schools, you meet three boarders who seem to have something to do with your curse...

But little do you know that your curse isn't really what it seems to be...

title: Jest Messter
description:
A comedy-mystery otome visual novel.

Oh no! You're stuck with a pun-curse "gifted" by the mysterious Jester, a mythical entity known to bring happiness in exchange for your memories.

Armed with the worst dad jokes known to mankind, you transferred to the prestigious Marney High in hopes to uncover the Jester's identity... and hopefully make new friends along the way!

Luckily, your new classmates are just as weird as you are: a stuck-up scholar, a brainrot-loving memelord, a two-faced actor, a weapon-wielding roommate, and a secretive senior with a dangerous secret...

So be careful who you trust! As sinister plots start to unravel around you and your classmates, you find yourself tangled in their web of secrets and schemes.

And maybe... your pun-curse is the key to solve them all?

Commercial remaster of "The Punniest Pun Messter".

title: Caixa Mágica de Estórias
description: The Caixa Mágica de Estórias brings you four wonderful stories, written by Lúcia Pimental and Alice Góes, with animated illustrations, soundtrack and narrated text. You'll also have fun with memory games, puzzles, crosswords, and coloring.

title: Elden Ring Reforged
description: ELDEN RING Reforged (ERR) is a mod by Kirnifr and ivi, with assistance from Poeconcept, Hanalove and Cavou. ERR is a thorough revision of ELDEN RING's balance and mechanics. The mod covers enemies, boss fights, hitboxes, animations, equipment, the camera, and more. Main features include unique camera parameters for boss fights, improved enemy hitboxes, reworked scaling and leveling, a new Runeforging system to encourage open world exploration and make NG+ more rewarding, changed gameplay mechanics that fix many of the vanilla game's issues, new Spells and Weapons, and more!

title: Gyakuten Vocaloid
description:
A very serious crime has taken place in the Vocaloid world and only a top lawyer can find the truth and that lawyer is... wait... Hatsune Miku!?
Exactly! Put yourself in the shoes of Miku to solve the case that looms over the court in this fan-game full of tension and ideal comedy for lovers of Ace Attorney and Vocaloid, discover the truth behind the contradictions in the testimonials and prove that your client is innocent!

title: Wedding Peach
description: A PC98 game based on the anime Wedding Peach.

title: Junkfood 2: Summertime Slotter
description: Junkfood 2 is a Boom compatible Speedmapping Community Project held in Meowgi's Pacifist Paradise Discord Server which features 83 newly designed slaughter levels; This time, with a summertime theme! The basic premise was to make "Junk Food" slaughter (BFG spammy, high monster count maps) where not a lot of time is spent deliberating about layout/detailing/fight design and other things that can bog a mapper down. It's just good BFG fun.

title: Gentei Shooter
description: Gentei Shooter is a fast paced bullet hell game where defeating a certain enemy can drop weapons. The weapons you can get from a triangle are better than the default shot, but they have limited ammo.

title: EWar
description: EWar was an unofficial multiplayer version of Grow's tabletop game War.

title: Watashi Koso ga Gakuen no Joou-sama
description:
What? An otome game where you become a sadistic high school girl and aim to become the queen of the school!?

Yes, it's time for women to be "aggressive" too!!

"Watashi Koso ga Gakuen no Joou-sama" has the heroine take the lead and swing the handsome guys around. It's a ♀＞♂ Romance Simulation Game! !

Whether it’s kabedoning them or pushing them down… "I" will be the one doing all that!!

title: Gunslinger Solitaire
description: Travel the Wild West while earning money as a solitaire cowboy.

title: Dr. Despicable's Dastardly Deeds
description: Make the world a better place, one dastardly deed at a time in this match 3 comedy game that lets you be the mad scientist. Each invention gets more ridiculous and has a twisted purpose that Dr. Despicable and his minions eagerly await.

title: The Hungry Lamb: Traveling in the Late Ming Dynasty
description: A travel text adventure game with Chinese traditional style. Player will escort four girls to Luoyang in order to discover the truth and make decisions along the way. This game involves themes of “Revenge, Cannibalism, etc.” the darker sides of life, but still expect to convey a positive emotion.

title: Planisphere 2
description: Planisphere 2 is a replica of New York City.

title: Imp Encounter
description: Based on the infamous fan fiction Impse, Imp Encounter adds in a cutscene based on the story in the middle of the game.

title: Sonder
description: Experience an innovative co-op adventure where two players have to work together. Engage in collaborative puzzle solving and dynamic combat with each player having unique abilities. Delve into a psychological narrative that explores the essence of humanity.

title: Odyssey of the Anachronistic Tome
description: "Odyssey of the Anachronistic Tome" features Patchouli Knowledge who was pulled into a strange, forgotten Gensokyo from a long abandoned canon with the gameplay inspired by the very first Touhou! This is our little alpha build for the Touhou Game Jam 13 with the theme "Retroactive, Retrospective, downright... Retro". Thank you for checking out our game! This is not only the first thing we've ever worked on as a group, but the first game any of us have ever worked on as individuals and with only a 72 hour time budget... sorry if the game explodes lol.

title: Jewel Match Royale
description: Restore magnificent castles in a royal match-3 adventure.

title: Jewel Match Royale 2: Rise of the King
Fables Mosaic: Cinderella
description: Experience Cinderella story through logic puzzles!

title: Fables Mosaic: Little Red Riding Hood
description: Help Little Red Riding Hood to bring candies to her Granny! It features a collection of colored puzzles solved by logic, while following the Little Red Riding Hood Story.

title: Fables Mosaic: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
description: Help Snow White to find true love! It features a collection of colored puzzles solved by logic, while following the Snow White Story. Are you ready to solve the puzzles as the story develops?

title: My Favorite Notification
description: A 5 minute Visual Novel made in Bitsy, about a Discord call between two trans friends.

title: Champions Arena
description: Champions Arena is a turn-based gacha RPG. Collect unique Champions and engage in real-time turn-based PVP battles!

title: Pinball League: Hardhat Zone
description: Pinball League: HardHat Zone is a 3D pinball game that allows players to experience this classic game in a whole new way. although the construction theme is not as glamorous as it could be and the sound effects tend to lag behind a little, the graphics are highly polished and really help to draw players into the game. the two player mode also helps to ramp up the fun factor by allowing friends to go head to head to see who has the best skills.

title: Le monde d'orathos
description: The elf world wanted to learn creation magic, but the kingdom didn't want it. The king decided to create an island for any inhabitant who wanted to leave, but no return was possible. A young elf wanted to act... He discovered something strange that the king was hiding.

title: TerraFirmaCraft+
description:
"Survival Mode as it should have been." TerraFirmaCraft Plus is a fork & continuation of the mod TerraFirmaCraft, for the sandbox survival game Minecraft.
The mod aims to continue off where TerraFirmaCraft (Classic) ceased development.
TerraFirmaCraft Plus is developed by one of the former developers of TerraFirmaCraft (Classic).
The mod focuses on "believability" rather than "realism", & includes an overhaul to world generation, crafting systems & more.

title: Shardfall: FitQuest VR
description:
Beautiful Worlds, Endless Enemies, and Unlimited Exploration.
Take on a huge range of fierce enemies with different fighting styles. Attack with powerful jabs, crosses, hooks and uppercuts. Defend yourself with blocks, jumps, ducks and dodges. Think and adapt to survive.

title: 3x9 Kingdom: Road of Adventures
description:
Playing as Oleg or Olga, you will go on an exciting journey into a 3x9 Kingdom to help the kids return home.

During the story, you will meet many characters of Russian folklore, such as The Gorynych Snake, Baba Yaga, The Mermaid, Chernomor, and many others. Some creatures will need your help, while others will try their best to keep the kids in the 3x9 Kingdom.

title: Star Wars: Deathtroopers
description: Star Wars: Death Troopers is a FPS/3rd person action adventure video game. It is a game based on the novels Death Troopers and Red Harvest, both written by author Joe Schreiber. The game is divided into: Story Mode, Onslaught Mode and Multiplayer.

title: Shaman's Mask of the Rune Magic
description: Non-linear platformer action game about a shaman and his mask.

title: Kitty Patrol: Paw Showtime
description: Discover the adventures of this patrol of adventurous kittens who will have to save the world together.

title: Party Games
description: Introducing the "Party Games" bundle - the ultimate collection for unforgettable moments with family and friends!

title: Superscout
description: "Superscout" is a live-action interactive movie game where you will unravel the secrets of the girls you meet. The love beyond lifetimes, never let it go; the kindness in this life, engraved in your soul. Your choices will change your loved ones’ fate; those who love you will change yours...

title: Dark Hunting Ground
description: "Dark Hunting Ground" is a minimalist style of pixel construction brush treasure game. As a new member of the Hunter Association, players will hunt monsters against the void, gain trophies and experience in battles, and challenge the source of void erosion with your unique construction ideas.

title: Leaving The Hospital
description: A difficult to control horizontal plate escape game, players control patients to escape from the hospital, the game has a difficult control system, the game includes two-person cooperation and two-person racing mode, hope to bring you some joy.

title: Koishi Adventure
description: Koishi Adventure is a 2D top-down slash-and-shoot Touhou Project doujin RPG, where you'll be adventuring in the absurd and brutal world of Lotusland from the perspective of the Komeiji Koishi~ In the game, you can explore dungeons, collect equipments, and constantly strengthen your party~

title: Absolute Fear: Aooni
description:
20 years after the birth of the legendary horror game "AOONI"...
A completely new first-person, 3D horror stealth action "Absolute Fear -AOONI-" is now available!

title: Tower Defense: Infinite War - Infinite Starter Package
description: This content requires the base game Tower Defense: Infinite War on Steam in order to play.

title: Pixel Puzzles Traditional Jigsaws: Chihuahuas
description: Pixel Puzzles, your number one place for digital jigsaws.

title: RocketRecoil
description: Change the past by propelling yourself towards the future. Or something like that. Just blow yourself up with rockets to move around. The game's hard to play.

title: PicoTrains
description: A retro-styled railway management strategy game!

title: Mereonozis 2D: The Kingdom of Gremlins
description: A puzzle-bazed metroidvania. Help the robot to repair the station. But there are gremlins who will try to break everything you've just fixed!

title: Minotauros
description: Minotauros is a single-player horror game that lets you experience the challenge faced by the hero Theseus. Explore, fight or flee when the Minotaur finds you. You're both hunter and prey. Find the secrets of the labyrinth to win.

title: Nine Realms: Dawn Touch
description: Rule the god of thunder and challenge all the gods of the nine realms! In this Rogue-like, hack and slash game, develop your strategy and skills, subject all the gods who challenge you to your wrath, and become the only god of the universe.

title: The Croaker
description:
The Croaker is a very fun, feature-packed game where you can collect apples. Where's the fun in that? Well, these apples you collect are used all throughout the game: You can buy skins, powerups, unlock many achievements, and compete on leaderboards against the top players!

There are 50 campaign levels, where the protagonist, Jeremy, gets trapped in a simulation and must escape without the antagonist of Virtual Guy finding him. Not only that, there are going to be brand new Bonus Levels every few updates just to keep adding content to the game.

title: Starpoly
description: Discover strategic depth in our space board game! Use star-currency to buy interstellar sites. Compete with friends in turn-based matches, utilizing the Starbridge for tactical advantage. Accumulate currency for the Lottery, offering rewards and site boosts. Achieve cosmic success

title: Topac Battle
description: Topac Battle is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy Topacs and Level them up, trade for a higher rarity, and become the master of the chill battle scene. Customize your Park as you progress from a simple park to your dream setup with rare exotic monster and ultra-rare color variants!

title: Amelie And The Lost Spirit
description: Dive into the intense "Amelie And The Lost Spirit," a single-player action game set in a horror environment. Help Amelie find her way out of the witch's realm. Seek help from your Ghost friends as you try to escape the witch's clutches to your freedom.

title: Lullaby in Dreams
description: An adventure game project for children. A cave-in in a dungeon begins an adventure in an unknown land, for some an isekai, for the others an adventure in search of answers.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021: Jeep RAM Remastered

title: VR Harem Sex: Mai DLC
description: Immersive harem experience in VR space! High functionality and freedom with lesbian play, cross-sectional views, big tits/poor tits, and more!

Search for hints to figure out what he wants and how to give it to him, but be careful with what you investigate. Some things are meant to be left alone and forgotten...

title: Run Run Bird!
description: Embark on a whimsical journey into the enchanting world of our beloved animal friends with "Run Run Bird!"

description: Aidan in Danger is a retro-style 2D platform game. The player takes on the role of Aidan, the guardian of the last dragon. Face challenging levels, menacing creatures, and an interdimensional villain, all while enjoying beautiful graphics and an exciting soundtrack.

title: Finding Sparky
description: 'Finding Sparky' is game in which an extremely ordinary boy, Tom, goes on an adventure across a haunted village to retrieve his kidnapped dog. With Tom, defeat the ghosts and (a slightly big) animal friends to get to the bottom of the case and find out what the hell dog kidnapper really wan

description: Immerse yourself in the fascinating ancient world of cube puzzles, where each step reveals a new mystery. You will explore different zones, each filled with unique puzzles that require the use of cubes to solve them.

description: Embark on an adventure to find out the reason for the appearance of monsters on Mt. Fuji. "Fujisan Nobori" is a game where you defeat boss monsters on each floor and ascend towards the summit. Be the first in your country to reach the summit.

title: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
description: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Norse Gods, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

description: Addictive and difficult, combining precise jumping and mental endurance. Explore this universe with double jump, dash, dilemmes, choices, 3d and 2d. Each level is unique, for an unforgetable experience.

title: JDM: Rise of the Scorpion
description: Experience the automotive culture of Japan with a free prologue to Japanese Drift Master. Learn about the story of the rebellious high schooler Hatori and race through the winding roads at Haikama Lake. Discover the places where drift was born!

title: Thorns: Police never sleeps
description: Thorns. Police never sleeps is a kinetic visual novel about an alternative future. After global warming, cities were separated by a giant ocean. Our story begins in one of these cities.

title: Rise of Industry 2
description: Navigate the competitive industrial landscape of vibrant 1980's USA! Make strategic manufacturing decisions, optimize production chains, acquire technologies, and expand your global business network with key contacts. Opportunities await those savvy enough to capitalize on them!

title: Blood On The Dusty Trail
description: In this thrilling audio book, we follow the story of Caleb, a young outlaw who finds himself on the run after a robbery. As he navigates the dangers of the Wild West, his gang of outlaws plan their get away.

title: Mochi Sprint
description: You have become a "Mochi". A perfectly round Mochi. Navigate through 2D scrolling dungeons, avoiding brutal traps, and aim for the goal (mortar). That's all there is to the game.

title: Evergreen: The Board Game
description: A tree-growing abstract strategy game where you make your planet the greenest and most fertile of all!

description: Travel to Poland in 1772, experience life as a servant, and solve a mystery at court!

If you make a mistake, you might have to start from the beginning!? This is a vertical scrolling action game that is very difficult but somewhat addictive.

title: Find Eden
description: In this cute adventure game you play as Timmy, who was magically teleported into the realm of cats. Unravel the mystery of Eden and awaken the fighting spirit of the felines. You solve puzzles, defeat monsters, upgrade new powers, all while meeting quirky cats in a classic hand-drawn 2D style.

title: Shui's Odyssey
description: This is a puzzle game that combines text and images. Players use visual illusions to piece together fragments of memories from Alzheimer's patients, in order to reconstruct the truth of the story and witness the passage of time for three generations.

title: Minigames Mayhem
description: Minigames Mayhem is a fun collection of minigames, that can bring joy for players not only in single-player but also with friends in your living room or across vast distances. Try to beat the high scores, compete with others, and bring mayhem on other players in many simple but fun games!

title: Idle Hero TD
description: Endless idle tower defense game full of deep strategy and combat mechanics. Unlock and upgrade dozens of epic fantasy heroes to defeat an infinite swarm of enemy monsters. Strategize hero placements, synergies, and skills for an effective defense, then sit back and let the auto-battler do its thing!

title: Combat Cat
description: A fast-paced, side-scrolling, bullet hell with an inventory system where a player can upgrade their weapons and player stats to survive as long as possible.

title: Circus Challenge
description: Many people are afraid of clowns, but what scares the clowns? Dive into a nightmare world where you will face many risks in the ring. Be careful with every step you take and overcome obstacles to escape from your nightmare.

title: The Dilemma
description: When you open your eyes in a dark labyrinth, what should you do? Find the right path and escape from this labyrinth!

title: Red Light
description: Red Light is a retro-styled extraction shooter where you take a mission to raid an abandoned Soviet R&D Institute filled with mercenaries and living results of human experiments to solve the mystery of your disappeared brother.

title: Zeta Wave Infinity
description:
Enjoy in this adrenalinic arcade game with the beatiful AI pilots named
ZETA and OMEGA

title: Ninpaw
description: Enter the arena and fight your friends in local multiplayer combat. Play as cute cats, master your skills and play through game modes to reign supreme over your opponents.

description: Welcome to Tiny Ski Resort! Where pixel art, skiing, multiplayer races, and a beautiful story all come together.

title: Taco Terror
description: TACO TERROR is a boomer shooter set in a cyberpunk future where capitalism rules everyone - except for you. Run, gun, choke, dive, jump(?), and slide your way through the forces of T.A.C.O. Take back New TACO City from these forces of fried evil before you become too... delicious.

description: Embark on a thrilling trilogy as Vinnie, Kiro, and Shorty battle urban gangsters and the Italian mafia. Upgrade weapons, immerse in a bloody tale, and enjoy enhanced gameplay features. Fight, upgrade, and chase your targets in this action-packed adventure!

description: Navigate office intrigue in Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies! Complete tasks, uncover the carrier of illegal leads, and outsmart coworkers in this strategic multiplayer game set in an early 2000s office.

title: Street Race Kings
description: You are brought into a racing league, the SRK. Once you can qualify and prove yourself to the league, you then make your way to the top, racing against various competitors, and taking down stage bosses to move up in rank! Multiple vehicles, customization, open world maps, and more!

title: Run Dungeon
description: Run Dungeon combines the heart-pounding action of an endless runner combined with the strategic depth of an RPG. An infinite dungeon full of monsters, loot, traps, spells, and bosses awaits you.

title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 7 - Collector's Edition
description: AviGames presents the seventh game in the hidden object series of "Big Adventure: Trip to Europe". Embark on a journey through beautiful European countries and look for hidden objects in old Europe and Scandinavia, play exciting mini-games and collect souvenirs from different countries.

title: Jetrunner
description: JETRUNNER is a parkour FPS, with cel shaded, comic like visuals, and a gameplay loop that can be best described as Trackmania meets Titanfall. Rich, expressive movement, and tight gunplay is what JETRUNNER is all about.

title: A Storm Unsung
description: An action roguelite with a multitude of unlockable characters. Challenge procedural dungeons generated by an AI Dungeon Master who controls the pace of combat and the frequency of random events.

title: Super Blockbuster
description: Super Blockbuster is a retro action-puzzle game. Kick blocks to solve tricky puzzles and take on a diverse cast of enemies, all in gorgeous pixel art, inspired by the golden age of 2D puzzle games.

title: Try to Wake Up : The Legend of Trevis
description: Legend has it that if you fall into a deep sleep while your body struggles to survive, Trevis will welcome your soul into his labyrinth. If you want to wake up, take a good look around and don't overlook any anomalies...

title: Shoko
description: Capture and battle hundreds of different monsters to complete your bestiary. Shoko is a game with waves of enemies to defeat and Roguelite elements in a cute, colorful, hand-drawn universe.

title: Trivia Trials
description: It's about Trial and Error. Show your resilience by passing all 20 random Questions and Riddles before your Time runs out, or admit to your weakness and surrender. It's your choice. Do you have what it takes?

title: Unnatural Selection
description: Four Player Party-Shooter Featuring Cute Animals Wielding Wacky Guns! Play as animals and fight your friends to win the tournament, eliminating the most players to win the round!

title: Rivers of Chaos
description: Conquer the galaxy in this cinematic, battle-simulator. Each playthrough offering a completely unique galaxy, over 100 total specialized ships to command, and distinct commanders to lead your people. Pick your favorite faction and lead your forces into a dynamically generated battlefield.

title: Aston
description: The aim of the game is to find the passwords of the encrypted doors in the rooms and finish the game.

title: Necrophobia
description: Start your life anew at Heaven's Gates Academy. Learn new subjects, make new friends, experience what you've never before deemed possible. Change your fate, and the fate of those around you- your decisions matter greatly.

title: Cellular Survival
description: Cellular Survival is an action shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Choose your path, equip yourself, and push forward and overcome the perils that stand in the way of your survival. The fate of the microscopic realm rests in your hands.

title: Ember Point
description: Ember Point is a red-hot, combat-focused, third-person action game. Play as a disgraced defector, Gravitus, from a militaristic mega-corporation. He is stuck cleaning up the mess his former employers left behind — all while wielding a top secret “cure” for a gruesome disease.

title: Fall Words
description: Fall Words is a challenging physics puzzle game that has you type letters to drop them and collect all the asterisks. Letters have different shapes and physics and based on that there are various mechanics in the game: bridge, domino, hanging, rolling, and more! Try it now and see how words fall!

title: Mutant Football League 2
description:
Mutant Football League 2 is an over-the-top, arcade-style football game packed with thrills, strategy, and unrelenting action. Created by the original designer of Mutant League Football and Mutant League Hockey, MFL2 takes brutal gridiron battles to the next level, delivering deep strategic 8-on-8 gameplay, bone-crunching hits, and outrageous mutants that parody your favorite players.

Prepare yourself for the most brutal football experience ever. Step into diabolical arenas filled with deadly traps, where victory isn’t just about scoring points – it’s about survival. Win the traditional way by outscoring your opponent or force a forfeit by racking up a body count that leaves the opposition in shambles. Outwit, cheat, and dominate your way to victory in the most chaotic, carnage-filled football game yet. Whether you're a die-hard sports fan or just looking for wild, unpredictable fun, MFL2 delivers an experience like no other.

title: Robo Pose
description: Robo Pose is a difficult game about Robot that needs to strike the right Pose in order to overcome procedurally generated obstacles.

title: Jupiter Junkworks
description: Fast paced arcade puzzle action awaits you in Jupiter Junkworks! Complete arcade puzzle contracts to earn resources while rebuilding and upgrading a ruined spaceship junkyard. All set in a sci-fi narrative campaign mode where you'll join an unlikely trio of travellers as they overcome challenges.

title: CloudStudy
description: An online study room shared by players around the world. Those who work hard for their dreams are welcome to join.

title: Swords & Bones 4
description: The fourth installment of Swords & Bones immerses you in a new fantasy adventure, with pixel art in a side-scrolling action-platformer style. In this latest chapter, harness the power of magic to emerge victorious!

title: Spaced Out
description: Retro, classic, couch-buddy competition in space! Simple controls make it easy for friends and family to join in the fun!

title: Spellbrew Express
description: Low wages, high adventure – every delivery is a magical struggle. Bounce, blast, and cast through treacherous ruins and vibrant forests in this movement-based 2D platformer. That goblin brew atop the mountain won't deliver itself. Time is money— get moving!

title: Multiplayer Spiders
description: Multiplayer Spiders - You and Your steam spider friends must stop the invading spiders from spinning their web of fear.

title: Whelm
description: A mysterious island has fallen into disrepair and only you can save it. Rescue animals, replant seeds and repair machines. We're counting on you, young penguin.

title: Desert Of The Undead New Frontiers
description: Slaughter the undead to save your town in this 8 bit action run-n-gun

title: Vindefiant
description: A disgruntled employee is fired from his job, sparking a path of rage and destruction. Lead Alyx through his journey of vengeance and creatively kill enemies in this pixel-art adventure where you, are the villain.

title: Last Ride
description: Last Ride is a supernatural investigation game where you explore haunted sites, gather clues, identify evil spirits, and use the right methods to capture them while learning to protect the human world.

title: Dodge Barrage
description: Dodge Barrage is a chaotic sports-fighting game, where you’ll need quick reflexes and aggressive plays to take down your opponents. Play with up to four players either locally or online.

description: Truth Universally Acknowledged is a short dating sim with 4 love interests that takes place in a whimsical high school setting.

title: MistsBook
description: "MistsBook" is a deck-building roguelite game where automatic chain reactions form the core gameplay. where you can play all the cards you draw with just one button press. You will collect patterns, symbols, and seals to uncover clues and reveal the pages of this book that has no beginning or end.

title: Pearl Fishery: Quest for the Mega Pearl
description: Shoot pearls, fire harpoons, and collect treasure under the mysterious "Pearl Island" in this new single-player, ocean-themed coin pusher game!

description: Yandere visual novel fan game.

description: Earth's surface has been dessimated by radiation from The War. The only remaining safe havens are found under the seas. Now you must cook, craft, and survive alone in your submarine, delivering vital supplies to the Starving Survivors - all while battling monsters both real and imagined.

title: Midnight Cruise
description: As you progress, you'll need to find keys and open locked doors. Solve puzzles and find passages. A first-person game with elements of horror. Explore the ship and its cabins, collect batteries for your flashlight. Ability to use the camera Solve puzzles. The darkness can conceal various secrets.

"I have to use my skills! Gosh!!" "I'm so excited! I'm back!!" "What is that? A UFO!!" "Something is chasing me from behind!!"

title: Boring Movies
description: Challenge your friends to identify famous movies based on your most boring possible description of the plot! Can you stump them or are your friends actual true cinema fanatics that can name Citizen Kane from the most minute detail?

title: Syon
description: A 2D horror to find and repel anomalies. Light the lantern of the girl and the ability of the ghost to fight back.

The player enters to follow the trail of a group of lost children from the town. There lies a dark journey and quest for justice: Judge Harlan.

description: CyberTaxi Lunatic Nights is a free roam taxi driving simulator set in a dark-noir Prison City. As a cab driver you have to find your wrongfully accused sister and rescue her from this dystopian city-facility. Complete unique missions, defeat lurking thugs and maintain your fuel level to succeed!

title: Scarecrow vs. Big Butt Birds
description: Defend crops as a scarecrow with a hand-tapped gun. Aim carefully against plump, persistent birds. Enjoy tacos in this quirky simulator!

title: The Collection
description: A First person, Short story indie horror game with an immersive atmosphere.

title: Epic Pixel War
description: An action roguelike where you send armies of powerful units with different powers to fight against hordes of enemies, upgrading and finding new units as you go.

title: Quadbots: The Rise of Chrono
description: Embark on a cosmic quest to retrieve shattered NOVANGEL orbs, conquer colossal guardians, and ultimately defeat Chrono. Dive into an action-packed adventure with epic battles and a gripping storyline.

description: A short walking sim game where after a car crash you wander into strange lands. Chop some cactus and turn an old mill into a concert hall. That's your life now.

title: Odd Sequence
description: Odd Sequence is an indie-action game with armed bots and RPG elements in platformer gameplay. Geometric characters and a flat, minimalist art style give this game its uniqueness. Odd Sequence focuses heavily on the combat aspect and the attack customization.

title: Feed
description: "Feed" is a bite-sized retro point-and-click puzzle game. It features multiple puzzles and a touch of cult horror.

title: StarsKnight
description: This is a game that constantly iterates and updates. Before the final version, different gameplay will be updated to get through the iteration period. The final iteration of the game's main mode will be a galactic demon city game with a big map and a big story background!

title: Rebellion Against Rebellion
description: Dive into the indie MMORPG, Rebellion Against Rebellion! Embark on a magical journey in a world of enchantment, shaped by mystical crystals. Acquire magical abilities, collect characters, and pets on epic adventures! Join now for an uplifting, enchanting experience!

title: Super Puzzled Cat
description: Help Puzzled Cat use jetpacks, portals, bombs, gum, and more to conquer treacherous platforming stages. Play your own way using save states to explore a world full of challenges and secrets - but can you find the way through? Travel through time and space and reach enlightenment.

title: Stickman Browser
description: Play the stickman fight in the browser! Destroying all Website Elements! Like what we all have imagined when we are a child!

title: Cats Balance
description: Balance the cats and don't let them fall into the water in this 2D physics puzzler.

title: Cats Around Us: Giant Cat
description: We've hidden numerous cats in a silent comic about a giant cat causing chaos in a village. Can you find all those cats?

title: Interrogator
description: A text-based, interrogation-centered puzzle game with text and voice as the main inputs. Each of the 18 cases is a self-contained mystery for you to solve. It is up to you to eradicate crime in the tri-state area once and for all.

title: Cheap Car Repair
description: Cheap Car Repair - go back in time to Poland of the 90's. Run your own Cheap Car Repair shop. Look for savings wherever you can. Make lots of money and avoid angry customers!

title: Silva
description: Silva is a platform and action game, with elements of RogueLike, which brings a lot of action and dynamic gameplay, where we will bring you a mix of ancient cultural elements with Brazilian history in a playful way.

title: Reborn: Dragona PH
description: This enhanced version aims to captivate and enthrall potential players by highlighting the captivating elements and challenges offered by Reborn: Dragona PH.

title: Kick'n Hell
description: Kick'n Hell is a retro style 3D precision platformer where you traverse the nine circles of hell as a martial artist and kick filthy demons! Do you have what it takes to escape and show Satan who's boss? Take on the ultimate test and show us what you got!

title: Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzles: Lost Empires
description: On an undiscovered continent, incomprehensible deities sit atop golden towers. Magical winds blow across plains and canyons, while the jungle keeps all its secrets.

title: Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzles: Olympus
description: Scholars granted access to the most ancient archives may read about the beings who once dwelt on Olympus. The scrolls tell tales of incredible power and terrifying wrath.

title: DachStudio Puzzle Box: Grimmstories by datGestruepp
description: Get 20 beautifull tradtitionally hand drawn Grimmstorie paintings from datGestruepp to puzzle.

title: DachStudio Puzzle Box: JuVentures
description: Get 20 beautifully hand drawn JuVentures paintings from JujiBla to puzzle.

title: DachStudio Puzzle Box: Megumi_M Gemstone Zodiacs
description: 10 beautifully hand drawn Zodiac Gemstones paintings from Megumi_M to puzzle.

title: Cashier Sim
description: Do you want to start making your first money and no one accepts you without experience?

title: Let's Go Home!
description: “Let's Go Home!” is a fun and challenging game where you play as the main character who has forgotten the way home.

title: The End of Sanity
description: Dive into a dark, supernatural open world in this survival RPG, where the city is under the grip of dark entities controlling AI machines. Harness solar power and the environment to fuel your equipment, engage in intense combat, and build defenses. Reclaim the city from the shadows.

title: Armless Samurai
description: Your arms may be taken from you, but not your honour. Your legs have become your sword and shield. Run on walls, dive kick & dash into your enemies, parry bullets with your shins. Become a warrior of legend, Armless Samurai!

title: Wizzerd Quest 2
description: Time to save Evenfall Bay! Wizzerd Quest 2 is a first-person action RPG with full splitscreen co-op, from the developers behind the acclaimed freeware Wizzerd Quest. Liberate regions from the Rising Night in this charming retro adventure inspired by the greats of the late 90's and early 00s!

title: PrisonSoul: Reunion
description: An ancient castle with human-making technology.A human, a dummy...Unrelated brothers, imprisoned by time in a castle...When you unlock the secrets of time, can you escape from your predicament?

title: Haunt N Seek: Silent Siren
description: Atmospheric Survival / Psycholiogical horror with online escape rooms & more Other Mini-Games included in-game. Mini Sticks Air Hockey Arrow Darts Chess Pool Foosball & more

title: Pigeon Simulator Survival
description: Step into the feathery shoes of a daring pigeon in the heart of a bustling park with Pigeon Simulator Survival! This one-of-a-kind game promises a whimsical and utterly entertaining adventure that's bound to tickle your funny bone and keep you coming back for more.

title: Shark Siege
description: Survive the siege and keep your vessel afloat in "Shark Siege", where the deep blue sea is your adversary, and courage is your strongest ally. Join the voyage, if you dare!

title: SCP: Hours to Go
description: SCP: Hours to Go is a survival horror escape room game based on the SCP Foundation Wiki. A catastrophic event shuts down the facility, leaving you alone in the security room. Solve puzzles and contain loose SCPs to escape, or survive for as long as possible for a high score.

title: Seafarer
description: SEAFARER is a game set in the age of sailships where you play as a young captain commanding a merchant ship in search of fame and fortune.

title: The Wicked West
description: A Low-Poly Western-themed FPS that can be played alone or with with up to 6 friends! Wield iconic weapons like the revolver, lever-action rifle, shotgun, and sniper all while relying on strategy, quick reflexes, and steady aim to outduel your friends!

title: The Temple of Children
description: The Temple of Children is a story-driven horror adventure about a simple little girl from a Russian province. Against her will she became part of horrible events, watching her reality turn into hell. To survive she needs to unravel the secret that children are hiding.

title: The Hunter Cursed by Night
description: A short-and-sweet 1-bit adventure game with real-time combat. Engage in ranged or close combat to defeat supernatural monsters. Upgrade your tools to progress deeper into the woods.

title: SSR Wives: The Murder Of My Winter Crush
description: SSR Wives: The Murder Of My Winter Crush Is an upcoming Retro Survival Horror experience that takes inspiration from iconic staples of the survival horror genre with the charming narrative intrigue of a Visual Novel. Atmospheric exploration, Challenging puzzles, and Horrifying encounters await!

title: Square Saga: The Trials
description: Dig, find, and fight your way to victory in this PVP, twin-stick, 2D arcade action title. Tunnel through the post-apocalyptic Earth, master the art of wielding rock cannons and uranium powered lasers, consume tons of speed & strength enhancing power-drinks and ultimately, vanquish your rival!

title: Tales From The Arcade: Fartmania
description: Welcome to the whimsical world of "Fartmania"! Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey through the skies with our unconventional hero – a pig who defies gravity with the power of flatulence!

title: The Demon's Exorcism
description: "The Demon's Exorcism" is a first-person psychological horror game that reveals the story of a family trapped in a haunting curse. Immerse yourself in the chilling narrative as you exorcise the demon and break the curse.

title: The Evil Sect
description: Take on the role of Phillip in this light action/horror FPS. They kidnapped your daughter, SAVE HER. Aim, shoot, run, jump, defend yourself. Do everything you can to stay alive, explore the area and complete the objective.

title: The Indie Dev
description: THE GAME AWARDS invites you, the player, to a behind-the-scenes look at one wannabe indie darling's sordid tryst with game development. Learn what it takes to be an amateur, laugh at jokes, experience plot twists, and join our rookie dev on a rollercoaster ride that's rapidly running out of track.

title: Memary: Memory of The Nameless One
description: The mysterious cat offer help to guide you. The room with puzzle awaits you and when you solve it, you will regain your memory. To reclaim your identity, you choose to follow mysterious cat and solve all puzzle in the rooms of question.

title: Murder at the Birch Tree Theater
description: Use deductive and abductive reasoning to uncover the truth behind a series of several unsettling deaths at a smalltown community theater. Uncover a narrative that spans decades by revealing the lies, petty grievances, and power struggles of people who came together to make art.

title: Nimillion: The Last Expedition
description: Metroidvania Spaceship adventure with physics-based rocket ship controls. Retro-inspired Thruster-only flight, unlock and upgrade abilities, solve physics puzzles, battle tough bosses, conquer brutal terrain. Easy to learn, hard to master old-school thrills!

title: Northern Tales 6: Oath to the Gods - Collector's Edition
description: Ragnar the great Viking king continues his journey. Now he needs to return home after a long wandering. However, new adventures lie ahead. Who knows what new dangers may lie in wait for Ragnar and the party on the way to the house.

title: Outrun Them
description: It's all in the name.. outrun them.

title: Flathead
description: Flathead is a psychological horror puzzle game developed by Tim Oxton. Players will wager their lives in a game of Over or Under. Gain enough points to buy your freedom, but nightmares lurk in the dark, and negative outcomes will occur if not enough points are banked.

title: Rage of the Dragons NEO
description: Engage in intense tag team battles in Rage of the Dragons NEO! Play the cult-classic among the fans of Fighting Games with brand-exclusive content!

title: Rise of the Village Hero
description: Rise of the Village Hero is an indie RPG game inspired by classics. Explore levels, uncover and complete quests through dialogue with NPCs. Find and receive equipment and treasures, slay monsters to earn your title as the Hero of Drobroja.

title: La Bestia: The Migrant's Long Journey
description: Imagine having to leave your home and everything you know behind. Live the experience of a migrant immersed in a lonely journey while listening to the stories of your companions.

title: Labyrinth: The Wizard's Cat
description: Enter the dungeon and help the master wizard to find his cat in this oldschool dungeon crawler. Discover powerful magical items and weapons. Solve puzzles and traps and fight the enemies in this real time combat dungeon crawler game.

title: Leap In The Right Direction
description: Jump into 'Leap In The Right Direction,' a 2D platformer featuring the friendliest of frogs! Test your skills through the challenging level filled with tricky jumps and cunning obstacles. Navigate the vibrant world, overcome frustrations, and leap your way to victory.

title: Legend of Rome 2: The Magic Hourglass
description: Play your way through many exciting and tricky Match 3 levels. Use the help of the gods, collect power-ups and play various bonus games! Build a Roman settlement, embellish all the buildings and enable Laura to return home successfully.

title: Machina of the Farthest
description: "Wouldn't it be awesome to fly?" Travel to the world's end in this warping-boomerang adventure with its beautiful pixel art.

title: Maple & Rufus: The Water Robbery
description: Maple & Rufus: The Water Robbery is an escape room style game where you must solve multiple puzzles and riddles to uncover who is stealing water from the citizens of Pumpkin Hollow.

title: Amadeus: A Riddle for Thee - Episode 1: Waltz
description: Amadeus: A Riddle for Thee is a linear narrative Visual Novel + Adventure game, heavily inspired by Umineko When They Cry thematically, and Professor Layton aesthetically.

title: Assassins Unleashed: The Apocalypse
description: Assassins Unleashed is an in development missions based game that requires some thinking and planning to take out your opponents, from hacking turrets, to more traditional methods such as pistols, each target is a different challenge.

title: Babe-lathe
description: Climb and explore the Queen's tower-island in this grid-based 3D platformer filled with bonk-like random encounters, mischievous ghosts, tricky jumps and a horrible, horrible curse..

title: Becoming Captain
description: Dive into a unique Roguelike Deckbuilder experience with Becoming Captain, set in a sci-fi realm where piracy is nearly eradicated—except on the notorious Calamity. Will you become its captain or die trying?

title: Beyond the Fringe
description: Welcome to Beyond the Fringe, a single-player action/adventure set in a sci-fi universe with over seven different handcrafted maps to explore! Fight, fly, loot, mine, and craft your way through each world, searching for your mother and discovering the truth about the danger looming over the galaxy.

title: Bob the Block: Rebooted
description: Bob the Block Rebooted is a pixelated indie platformer heavily influenced by recoil mechanics. You must use your ability to jump paired with your infinite ammo gun to traverse 40 difficult stages. Conquer anything from large, expansive jumps to tight, precise maze-like levels.

title: Break The Line
description:
Rogue elements + Free Layout + Battle Mastery + Turn-based March.
What kind of different experience will it bring? Will you be able to hold on to a tower caught in a tidal wave of enemy attacks? May be the answer you're looking for.

title: Cyber Internet Club Simulator
description: Take charge as the brains behind the trendiest cyber club in the city. Turn your humble beginnings into a top-tier cyber sanctuary through resource management, strategic investments, and maintaining a steady cash flow. Are you prepared to construct the cyber club you've always envisioned?

title: Sugamenia
description:
Immerse yourself in SUGAMENIA, a 2D action platformer, where you'll have to solve puzzles in an epic adventure.

Play as Violet, a fearless space explorer marooned on this unknown planet, and your powerful ally, Suichi, a flying robot that can deploy bombs, be used as a platform, offer advice in order to find hidden treasures, and many more features.

title: Pieces I: A Maskros Nebula Game
description: Pieces I is a jigsaw puzzle game set in the mysterious Maskros Nebula universe. It features 3 comic-style puzzles and a calming ambient soundtrack. Get a glimpse of the cyber city of CobeeDot, visit the overgrown Nou-Raex and float through the dystopian Eskolea!

title: Super Bad Hero
description: The game uses physics engines, bullet time, and many parody types of enemies, such as sirens, toilet people, gun demons, superheroes emitting laser light, etc. It is a bit like the 3D version of 'Metal Slug' or the gun version of 'Blade and Sorcery', which is very exciting and interesting.

title: Super Boba: Pachinko Cafe
description: This is a modern twist on arcade-style pachinko! This is the perfect AFK game for when you would rather watch or put minimal effort and still win! Create shockwaves and gravity wells to manipulate falling objects into target cups. The more you more catch, the more you score!

title: Supermarket Bash
description: This is a happy and tense weekend. The rush to buy in the supermarket has quietly begun. As a member of this family, are you ready to contribute to this carnival?

title: Hidden Superhero Cats: Bonus Level
description: Hidden Superhero Cats - Bonus Level includes one additional hand-drawn level with 100 more cats to find! ️‍

title: Cat Short Way
description: Join the brave cat in his exciting adventure and help him save the old factory from our mice and crows in the game "Cat Shortcut". You are captivated by the waiting and dangerous moments, many riddles that need to be solved! Good luck, hero!

title: Cat God Ranch
description: Keep your ranch running in this roguelite deckbuilder where you must please the fabled Cat God, or risk being shut down! Breed & feed your animals to pay tribute... or else!

title: Shooper Nova
description: Craft Your Ultimate Circular Fortress! Dive into SHOOPER NOVA, where you choose props and components to build a unique fortress. Unlock combos to shape your strategy and battle style. Become an unstoppable barrage machine and obliterate waves of enemies from all directions!

title: Gabenwood 2: 99 Hidden Euros
description: New challenges for the fan of hidden object puzzles! Be our hero! Go to the parallel Universe and find all anomaly to save the Gabenwood from destruction!

title: Whispers of Silence
description: Dive into the haunting narrative of "Whispers of silence" a first-person exploration game where every object tells a story and every note reveals a fragment of the past.

title: DCS: F-15C Aggressors Air Combat Maneuvering Campaign by Maple Flag
description: The F-15C Aggressors ACM campaign puts you in the cockpit of an F-15C Eagle, as a new Aggressor pilot with the 65th Aggressor Squadron at Nellis Air Force Base. Based on real world procedures you will fly as Red Air against Blue Air Forces.

title: Hues: Sunset Valley
description: 40 more levels with springs!

title: Quantum Tripper: Max
description: Response to emotional relishing that is secretively empowered with constant professional creativity.

title: Marvellous Inc.: MarvGPT
description: Help Marvellous Inc build their own GTP model.
