description: Arcane Array Arena is a shooting auto-battler game that "Combines Offense and Defense". You summon items in a magic circle and shoot them against your opponent! Create your own unique item builds, compose the most powerful deployment, and defeat your opponents!

title: Capitals Quizzer: Globe Mode
description: Name countries from their map position.

title: Capitals Quizzer: People Mode
description: Where were they born?

title: Battle Babes: Blood, Sun & Moon
description: Battle Babes is a fast-paced, free-to-play multiplayer turn-based strategy card game. Collect, strategize, and battle your way to victory with 6+ powerful hero decks! Experiment with 200+ unique cards each with their own special abilities. Customize your decks and challenge your friends to a fight!

title: Survivors in Blood
description: A warrior can't find peace even after death if he's offered a reward for bringing back a demon determined to take over the Earth. Welcome back to the land of the living, take up arms, forget fear and go hunting!

title: Angry stone
description: The mischievous little flying dragon accidentally entered the maze.

title: Jinni: Haunted House
description: Can you escape this haunted house? Or will you become a hostage of the mysterious creatures? It's up to you! Find your way out of the haunted house and save your life!

title: Legends of Elysium
description:
Legends of Elysium is a fantasy game combining the mechanics known from trading card games and board games.

Unleash powerful decks and strategize across unique boards in this free-to-play strategy. Dive into a rich fantasy world and build your collection of tradable cards.

Challenge your friends, build your fortune and carve your legend in Legends of Elysium!

title: 63 Days
description: A real-time tactics game from Destructive Creations taking place during WWII. The capital city of Poland, Warsaw, is under occupation of German forces, however there are groups of fearless people who are not afraid to face the enemy. 63 Days follows the steps of their previous game War Mongrels to deliver a Commandos-like game play set in the darkest days of human history.

title: Turbo Golf Racing: Space Explorer's Galactic Ball Set
description:
Go boldly where no racer has gone before, with the Space Explorer's Galactic Ball Set.
After purchase, these items will appear in the Garage section of Turbo Golf Racing.

title: 8-Bit RTS Series: Complete Collection
description: Welcome back, commander! The 8-Bit Series of games brings fast-paced action and strategy to your living room. Command deadly armies of military, medieval, alien and other unique factions and wage war in campaign mode, versus and co-op multiplayer.

title: I Made a Femboy Squirt!
description: An old friend asks a big favor...

title: Terrible Lizards
description: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

title: Banishing You
description: Banishing You will transport you into a realm of dreams and imaginations. Summoned by four alluring strangers you will have to deal with passive aggressive comments, a grand quest to help the inhabitants of that realm and maybe the end of the world.

title: Fly Me To The Home!
description:
One Home, Two Boots, Infinite Retry!
Simple & Challenging jet boots homecoming action game using only two buttons

title: A Dash of Color
description: A Dash of Color is a fast-paced minimalist precision-platformer with occasional puzzle elements. Gameplay focuses on smooth movement and pathfinding through unique levels. Dash, dodge, dip, duck, dive, dye, and die on your way to victory!

title: Mystery Escape
description: Dive into an adventure, alone, with your friends or play with random people. Solve various puzzles and overcome all the traps. There are currently 5 different rooms in which you can prove yourself. More and more rooms will be added in permanent updates. I hope to see you on the other side.

title: Sanguine
description: Experience survival horror—scarce resources, relentless creatures, and a town drowning in blood. Uncover your past and decide your fate as Sanguine lets you play your way with both Classic and Modern perspectives, each offering a distinct survival experience.

title: DEPO: Buy Me a XXL Coffee
description: Did you like DEPO and do you want to help me to continue generating content for the game? Wow, you are willing to buy the XXL coffee! It means a lot to me, thank you very much.🤫 Hey... You will also give an XXL coffee inside the game to Meyers.

title: DEPO: Buy Me a Coffee
description: Did you like DEPO and do you want to help me to continue generating content for the game? What better way than to buy me a coffee! Thank you for your support. 🤫Psss... You will also give a coffee inside the game to Meyers.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Brazilian Dunes Rally
description: Ride along fast tracks in the middle of paradisiacal dunes and lagoons during a race full of speed, dust, and adrenaline. Come with us to Brazilian Dunes Rally. This DLC includes: - Roller coaster map: Brazilian Dunes Rally. - One roller coaster cart.

title: Raey
description: Embark on the journey and watch Raey's eventful life unfold before your eyes. From the cradle to the grave - Raey will take the player through a roller coaster of emotions as he endures everything that is thrown at him.

title: Amazing Grace
description: A cute, bouncy 2d Platformer about jumping down from heaven to rescue your child from hell.

title: Bunker Farmer
description: Bunker Farmer is a farming arcade game about defending your crops from some unwanted guests. You the player will have access to technology to Grow, Harvest and Defend your crops. When things get a bit too much or you need to research an item its time to return to your bunker for safety.

title: Follow Dream
description: It is an innovative elimination game that combines classic block gameplay with modern color art.

title: Desert Race Adventures
description: Embark on a thrilling rally adventure across Europe and Africa in Desert Race Adventures! Manage your team, vehicle, and resources strategically to navigate treacherous terrains and claim victory. Every decision counts in this intense desert racing challenge. Will you lead your team to glory?

title: Master of Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzle - Edge of Spring
description: Experience the magic of nature's awakening in 'Edge of Spring' – where every puzzle is a blooming delight! Enjoy 36 gorgeous puzzles.

title: Nekoto
description: Customize your cat in detail and live with it! In a town where only people who live with cats can live, you'll enhance your life by working to find lost cats. All cats have different characteristics and about 26,000 patterns! The town is also randomly generated, so the structure changes every time!

title: Risky Chronicles and the Curse of Destiny
description: Embark on the role of Risky, our fearless adventurer, in an epic 2D and 3D adventure! Explore the enchanting worlds of this modern platform/adventure game.

title: Cool Kid Cody: Season 3 - Episode 01
description: Season 3 Episode 1: No Way Alone! With the help of his friends and a grappling hook, Peter embarks on a reckless plan to fly to Chill Haven and save Cody.

title: Sweet Bitter
description: "Sweet Bitter" is a visual novel for adults only. A young boy named Phoenix, fleeing a painful past, finds himself a neighbor of two mysterious women: seductive Charlotte and her turbulent daughter Kira.

title: Functional: Trees
description: A new section with 13 new levels for the functional game.

title: Sex Hotel Simulator 18+
description: Welcome, fellow gamers, to the enchanting universe of SEX Hotel Simulator 18+! Immerse yourself in the role of a savvy hotel owner in this visually stunning novel simulator. From a humble abode to a luxury haven for lovers, your journey starts now!

title: Sex Halloween
description: Sex Halloween - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: HardBall! + HardBall II
description: In HardBall, experience baseball that’s so real and true-to-life, it’s like you can reach out and touch it. HardBall II retains the all-star qualities of the original, but with more features, more choices, playability and true-to-ballplayer animation, and even more major league ballparks.

title: Gunship + Gunship 2000
description: In Gunship, climb into the cockpit of America's most advanced helicopter. Race low and deadly over the treetops at 200m.p.h. and deliver a powerful punch against the enemy! In Gunship 2000, you'll take charge of five copters on hundreds of combat missions in the Persian Gulf and Central Europe.

title: Beyond the Portal: Island's Salvation
description: After an accident, we find ourselves stranded on a mysterious and perilous island. Dive into a captivating turn-based role-playing game featuring a diverse cast of monstergirls. Is it possible to escape from this enigmatic place?

title: The Way Of Kings
description: 《The Way Of Kings》is a love and war based real-time action role-playing game.It tells the story of an ordinary man named Qin Shihuang, who experiences countless fantasy adventures in the end times to conquer the world, unify Kyushu and become emperor.

title: Seeds of Paradise
description: A short side story set in the same universe as "Sylvie's Bar" featuring a different flavor of monster girl brothels. You play an overworked man who's all but run out of luck, but the sadistic strawberry girl who keeps the business running may just take pity on you, yet.

title: Challenge Love
description: Challenge yourself to love with beautiful girls through “Challenge Love”! This game is not suitable for teenagers! Adults only!

description: "I Fell In Love With A Fantasy Farmer" is a point-and-click adventure game and yuri dating sim. The game is set in the Ochre Valley, the agricultural breadbasket of the Kingdom of Falkenhorn. You play as Lady Althea Redwood, a knight sent by King Hakon to solve the locals' problems.

description: Unique armoured aircraft: “Dragonfly (Deluxe edition)”;New movement part: rotor “MR-2 Maple”;New movement part: rotor “Impeller”;Cabin: “Harpy”;Portrait: “Odonata”;Unique paint can: “Burning chitin”;Unique background and logo for profile customization;Early access to new structural parts;4000 in-game coinsMaximum number of parts increased

description: Introducing FixEight, Toaplan's thrilling vertical run-and-gun game featuring eight peerless warriors with cutting-edge weapons. Embark on an exhilarating cosmic escapade with up to three players at once. Now on PC with modern extras!

description: The heroine is framed to become a death row inmate. However, a mysterious organization that searches for beautiful death row inmates gives her a new identity, in exchange for her working for the organization. In order to prevent escape, she was put on electronic leg irons and started a new life...

title: Horny Suika: Wet Watermelon
description: Horny Suika - Wet Watermelon is an adorable and fun game about dropping "fruits" into a container, with a little twist. New features and different game modes. Combine small "fruits" to make them larger, creating big "watermelons" without overflowing the container, and enjoy your worthy "rewards".

title: Ball Blitz!
description: Ball Blitz! is an engaging puzzle game where players combine sports balls to create bigger versions and earn points. With a mix of strategy and quick thinking, your goal is to achieve the highest score possible. The bigger the combination, the more points you score!

title: Speedway Survival
description: Survive the darkest hour at UT! As Sola, defeat shadow monsters wreaking havoc on Speedway with your magical flashlight! Will you be able to rescue Sola's sister, Luna?!

title: Hollow Floor
description: Hollow Floor is a psychological horror walking simulator set in a looping, scorched apartment. Stalked by a restless corpse, you must unravel the truth before you're consumed by it.

title: Kindvixen's
description: Kindvixens is an adult visual novel. where you play as, a guy new in the city, trying to find a woman to fall in love with.

description: This is a DLC where you can play quests featuring additional monsters from the shooting action game "METAL DOGS".

description: The ‘Elspeth – Thrones of Decay’ pack introduces Elspeth Von Draken, a new Legendary Lord for the Empire, usable in both the Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns.

description: The ‘Tamurkhan – Thrones of Decay’ pack introduces Tamurkhan the Maggot Lord, a new Legendary Lord for Nurgle, usable in both the Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns.

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Thrones of Decay: Malakai
description: The ‘Malakai – Thrones of Decay’ pack introduces Malakai Makaisson, a new Legendary Lord for the Dwarfs, usable in both the Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns.

title: Litter ShiFu
description: Little ShiFu is a first person horror puzzle game. A sudden night visit broke Zhang Qingyi originally quiet high school life. Think the little girl Xuanxuan looking for the lost little Mi as the source, the old community in a strange murder unexpectedly slowly surfaced...

title: Usual
description: Enjoy the quiet life in the Japanese countryside. You can relax and spend your time doing some housework. A walk around the neighborhood and relaxing on the sofa in the sunlight will help you recover from the daily grind.

description: The fairy tale land is distorted! Deliver the item to calm the angry princess! Will you be able to calm the princess and save the fairyland?!! #platformer game #action #adventure #a trap game #a trick game

description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

3D first-person adventure game. A meditative, thoughtful journey without violence, monsters or jump scares. Atmosphere inspired by the works of David Lynch.

Explore the Valley of Mists, where dreams create reality. Study people's dreams and determine their fate. Leave the hectic world for a while and return to yourself.

description: Have you opened your restaurant yet? Now you have the opportunity to supplement your menu with organic products, increase the profit of your restaurant and simply enjoy the nature and atmosphere of the farm. description: Landoria is a cartoon fantasy strategy game where you begin your campaign in a procedurally generated world as one of the faction leaders to capture strategic locations and defend against the opponents' siege together with your heroes to expand your territory.

description: In a city devastated by catastrophe, you're the lone survivor among nightmarish swarms of insects. Armed with bravery, cunning, and diverse weapons, navigate ruins of a once-vibrant metropolis, battling relentless waves of monstrous bugs. Survive, reclaim, conquer the infestation.

description: Dive into The Splintered Sea expansion, introducing water to Besiege for more machine-building conquests! Battle your way through a 10-level oceanic campaign, explore an all new sandbox, and harness 8 new blocks to unleash chaos on the high seas!

description: Control the spear and throw it, break all the blocks in the level to win, score points, complete the level, earn coins and go to the next level.

description: This is a minimalist puzzle game where players control ghosts with unique traits to transport five elements between nodes. By applying the rules of generation and restraint, they transform or eliminate elements to reach specified quantities and objectives.

title: Can Bullet
description: BANG BANG BANG! CAN BULLET has come to your PC! Just shoot the cans and get rid of yesterday's, today's, and tomorrow's frustrations. A simple roguelike shooter, also good for a mid-afternoon coffee break.

description: The protagonist begins cohabiting with his girlfriend, Kanako Tsukishima, whom he started dating in college. Compared to their sweet romance, living together presents many practical challenges. Players must plan their daily lives, balancing academics, lifestyle, and romance.

description: Your boring life changed, when you started to work at the Komadori Inn. A picturesque forest by the sea and beautiful co-workers make the perfect place for relaxing.

Roll, jump, fly, and dash your way to victory in this simple physics based soccer extravaganza. (Good connection required)

As you move up the stage, overcome the increasing number of products and customer interruptions to achieve the target score and continue your secret story with the girls.

Compete against friends or online rivals in intense races, where quick reflexes and strategic use of diverse skills determine the victor. Team up and duke it out with rival Crews in Knockout City, where epic dodgeball battles settle the score in team-based multiplayer matches. Throw, catch, pass, dodge, and tackle your way to dodgeball dominance!

With the Private Hosted Server Edition of Knockout City, you can host a server for others to connect to, or jump into a Crew Vehicle and join the fray after connecting with others. The dodgeball battles don’t ever stop!

Filled with beautiful girls, romance, sex, and love, the game combines high-quality graphics with steamy animations, turning your wildest fantasies into reality.

description: Help the cute barista Moka-chan and goth barista Karina-chan make Milk Milk Coffee the most popular place in Tokyo! Brew coffee in a relaxing atmosphere, guess customers' wishes, beat competitors, win the hearts of critics and pretty girls.

description: Oh No! You died and were reborn as a god on Mount Olympus! Your goal is to find a way back to Earth! The problem? Gods keep falling in love with you! Go on dates, party through the night, and find out what’s happening on this crazy mountain!

title: Twilight Bastion
description: Twilight Bastion is a retro-styled soulslike 3D Metroidvania that places you in a torturous labyrinthine castle where skeletons, the undead, and gothic black knights await around every corner.

title: Bunniiies
description: These rabbits are crazy, they can't stop hugging each other! The only solution is to run this farm! Will you be a super breeder of love-crazed rabbits?

title: Lumina Veil
description: Lumina Veil, a horror game with a modern twist! Step into the shoes of a popular streamer on a journey into a strange new game. As you dive deeper, you'll find yourself escaping the isolation of your own world, only to discover that the lines between fantasy and reality are beginning to blur.

description: Reborn is a choice-based visual novel for adults centered on the life of a teenager in college. Become a student at the most prestigious college on the continent and experience all the delights of college life! Sex, humor, romance, drama and deep plot. All this is waiting for you in the game Reborn!

description: Arcane Lands is an open world game dedicated to building, exploring, and unlocking islands. Explore the island, grow crops, unlock skill, collect pets, use rune to open the way to automation, defeat hidden super bosses, and unlock the secrets of the archipelago!

title: Cargo Master Transporter
description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey as you assume the role of a seasoned Cargo Master Transporter in this pulse-pounding gaming adventure.

title: Customer Disservice
description: Customer Disservice is a fast-paced soul-crushing hostile work environment game designed to put your minimum wage skills to the test. Using the information provided in your handbook, determine what sales are allowed or disallowed by company policy and enforce appropriately.

title: Clock Out
description:
Medium-sized speedmap in a vanilla-flavoured underground industrial setting.
This was originally intended for Doomworld community project "Isolation" but Derek "Afterglow" MacDonald ended up spending more than the allocated 12 hour dev time.
These mapping restrictions are followed:
- Must not use of F_SKY1. - Must use damaging NUKAGE1. - Must place health items on FWATER1. - Use of Cacodemons encouraged.

title: Autotag
description: Embark on a heart-pounding adventure in Autotag, where classic tag meets a twist of mayhem! Armed with powerful weapons, outsmart opponents in the destructible arena, and prove your skills in intense online multiplayer battles. Are you ready for the ultimate game of tag?

title: Savoring Sword
description: Explore procedurally generated dungeons, fight monster girls, interact with your surroundings, collect items, and gain weight!

title: Central Killing Agency
description: In this 2d pixel art game, it's 1953 and you're playing as an agent hired by the Central Killing Agency to kill Fred Olsen. Experience multiple endings in this short, narrative-driven adventure.

title: Molementum
description: Molementum is an online party platformer in which you and up to three friends compete to become the best thief. Upgrade your mole's abilities to aid in your criminal escapades. Compete, steal, and heist in this wacky, fast-paced game.

title: Dreamland: Chapter 2
description: Welcome to Dreamland! A town which hosts the wildest college spring break activities filled with hot girls, parties and sex. However, if you look close enough, you'll discover that Dreamland also hides a dark and horrifying mystery which haunts you and your friends...

title: WolfQuest: Anniversary Edition - Hellroaring Mountain
description: Hellroaring Mountain rises above the Yellowstone River in north-central Yellowstone, several kilometers west of Slough Creek. This 8x8 kilometer map offers all the gameplay of the main Yellowstone maps with a few special new features.

title: Extinction Rifts
description: Extinction Rifts is a fast-paced FPS where you get stronger as your combo increases! Inspired by classic shooters, you will battle your way through secret enemy headquarters and destroy the Ancient Monoliths with your devastating gauntlet!

title: Bosstack
description: A turn-based command battle game where you choose skills and jobs to fight against bosses in sequence.

title: Helium Run
description: Inflate your balloons and rise to the top!

title: Recursion
description: A first-person point and click adventure set in a strange facility. Solve puzzles, read strategically placed notes, press buttons, potentially die, and hopefully escape the worst Monday you’ve had in at least a week.

title: Magic Research 2
description: Welcome to Magic Research 2, an incremental RPG from the creator of Magic Research. Learn countless spells, face powerful foes, and command a team of Wizards who can cast spells for you as you journey to find or create the Philosopher's Stone.

title: The Highlands of Jurgald
description: Fantasy Game

title: World of Tanks: Modern Armor
description:
The battlefield calls! World of Tanks Modern Armor puts you in command of over 1,000 modern and legendary tanks. Download for free, then lead your team to victory in intense PvP combat. Upgrade your tanks, unlock more powerful vehicles, and earn rewards with every triumph. Ready to show off your military might?

Command history’s mightiest machines: Choose from over 1,000 authentic, awe-inspiring tanks. Collect heroic WWII classics like the Sherman and modern powerhouses like the M1 Abrams. Pick vehicles that match your playstyle, or develop new skills.

Challenge yourself in PvP battles: Engage in high-risk, high-reward 15v15 multiplayer tank combat.

Customize your arsenal: Upgrade your vehicles, apply camo and emblems, and claim more powerful tanks to make your collection your own.

title: Histerya
description: Endless survival horror game where you survive strange creatures in a retro-inspired PS1 experience.

title: Sync
description: Launch the SYNC protocol, where you are the ultimate weapon. Your job is to commandeer different robotic synth’s abilities in a high-octane, first-person frenzy. Master the art of SYNCing, and control the pace of battle.

title: Banana
description: A digital simulator of the handheld game of the same name.

title: Exverse
description: Dive into 2085 with Exverse, a gripping FPS that merges intense shooter gameplay with innovative Web3 mechanics built on Unreal Engine 5. Humanity clings to survival in space after a cataclysmic event rendered Earth a wasteland. As the planet's flora unleashed a deadly toxin, the race to save or abandon Earth divides humanity.

title: Around the World Mosaics
description: A nonogram game with 80 puzzles set in 8 countries.

title: Around the World Mosaics II
description: Another nonogram game with 80 puzzles set in 8 different countries.

title: Holiday Jigsaw Valentine's Day 3
description: 500 romance themed photos to put together.

title: Drill and Dig!
description: Join inventor Polly on a journey into the underground world in the casual roguelike game "Drill and Dig!". Your goal is to find lost artefacts using an upgradeable drill. Descend deeper, discover resources and upgrades, avoid hazards and show off your digging skills! This game is suitable for a wide audience. It provides a pleasant pastime and enjoyable gaming sessions!

title: Genshin Impact: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades
description:
Version 4.6 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New character: Arlecchino
• New story quests for Arlecchino and Cyno
• New areas: Sea of Bygone Eras and Nostoi Region
• New quality of life features
• New main event: Iridescent Arataki Rockin' For Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness
• …and more!

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scions of Ithelia
description:
Prove your strength to Malacath and defend a demiplane of Oblivion in the Scions of Ithelia dungeon DLC.

Two Challenging Dungeons

Venture into two 4-player PvE dungeons, Oathsworn Pit and Bedlam Veil, coming soon to both the Crown Store and ESO Plus memberships.

Oathsworn Pit

A training ground for Malacath's chosen now lies soaked with the blood of the faithful, and the God of Curses demands you enact revenge on behalf of the fallen.

Bedlam Veil

Cultists have invaded the Bedlam Veil, located within the demiplane of Maelstrom. It’s up to you to defend this ancient vault and the mysterious relic it protects.

Rewards for the Worthy

Survive both dungeons to unlock unique rewards, including new item sets, collectibles, achievements, and more not found anywhere else in Tamriel.

title: Slay the Spire II
description:
The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns!

Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2 - featuring new characters, cards, events, alternate acts, and more!

title: Kill Knight
description: KILL KNIGHT is an ultra-responsive arcade-inspired isometric action shooter. Condemned to eternal sufferance, deep within the voids of an eldritch arena, you must wield an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate swarms of otherworldly horrors - and MASTER THE DEMON WITHIN.

title: Vampire Survivors: Operation Guns
description:
Grab your blaster, join Contra Force, and be the bullet hell in Vampire Survivors: Operation Guns

Assemble a squad of classic Characters and arm yourself with an explosive arsenal of arcade weaponry in this action packed expansion for Vampire Survivors. Blast through thousands of fearsome foes and bonkers bosses from throughout the lauded lineage of Contra games. Persist determinedly through prodigious stages inspired by iconic Konami series, but be prepared for a bullet-hell of a fight, because if your trigger finger lacks stamina, Earth may lack a future.

The DLC adds 11 characters, 22 weapons, 1 large stage, 1 bonus stage, 30 in-game unlocks and a 6 chapter adventure.

title: Never Alone 2
description:
Discover a world of fierce, frozen beauty in Never Alone 2, the upcoming 3D sequel to the BAFTA award-winning adventure drawn from the Iñupiaq storytelling tradition. Journey through the breathtaking Alaska wilderness as Nuna and Fox, her spirit companion, along the way unearthing an epic mystery that threatens your entire community.

Never Alone 2 is being developed using an Inclusive Development process with the Alaska Native community. It tells an original story from an award-winning Iñupiaq writer and draws from tradition and stories that have been shared across generations. Designed to be played co-op (online and couch), Never Alone 2 invites you to explore environments ranging from the harsh frozen tundra to forest valleys filled with ancient willows as you traverse beautifully realized landscapes that are filled with wonder. Together you will work to navigate these wilds, forge connections with the spirits, and experience how the Alaska Native people have survived and thrived for over 10,000 years in one of the harshest and most breathtaking parts of the world.

title: UnderMine 2
description: Delve back into the heart-pounding depths of the Undermine in this action roguelike sequel! Uncover ancient secrets, battle fierce foes, and conquer Delvemore Castle with a friend by your side!

title: Darkest Dungeon II: Kingdoms
description: Kingdoms is a free standalone campaign game mode coming to Darkest Dungeon II. This new game mode challenges players in a desperate race against the clock to find and defeat a monstrous threat before it overwhelms and destroys the Kingdom. Journey across the land to gather resources and battle evil incursions, all while defending a network of safe haven Inns.

title: RKGK
description: Turn heads. Drop jaws. Be bright. In this single-player 3D platformer, you’re the only one who can take down Mr. Buff and his lackies to restore color and life to the citizens of Cap City. Accompany Valah and the RKGK crew on their journey to take down the oppressive B Corp.

title: The Last Spell: Dwarves of Runenberg
description: Protect the haven of Runenberg, lead Dwarves with unique abilities into battle and discover new exclusive Perks, weapons and items in the first DLC of the acclaimed tactical rogue-lite. Dive once more into the chaos of The Last Spell to unleash your unique new weaponry upon the Hordes of Evil.

title: Brotato: Abyssal Terrors
description: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

title: Old World: Behind the Throne
description:
Old World - Behind the Throne introduces the machinations of the royal court with new mechanics, rivalries, and the ability to leverage your power with opulence projects that bring you closer to victory.

New historical characters take center stage in the role of advisors, viziers, aristocrats, and courtiers. These rising stars bring their own ambitions, desires, and drives with them. Will Alcibiades change his allegiances multiple times throughout his life or will you be able to put an end to his double-dealing antics? Will you let Enlil-nadin-sumi successfully usurp the throne of Babylon? Or will Harpagus betray your ruler after a long life of service? Let others manage your cities and befriend them, or watch as they turn into dangerous rivals fueled by a thirst for power.

title: V Rising: Legacy of Castlevania
description:
In collaboration with Konami Digital Entertainment, Stunlock Studios proudly presents Legacy of Castlevania!

The mighty hero of the Belmont Clan, Simon Belmont, is here to challenge all of Vampire kind. Wielding his legendary Vampire Killer and an infamous arsenal of holy weaponry, no night stalker will be safe from his righteous crusade through Vardoran. Defeat him and unlock the secrets of a brand new weapon, the whip, adapting new combat abilities that embody the grace and precision of the deadly Vampire hunter!

Legacy of Castlevania is a free update releasing as part of V Rising's 1.0 update as it leaves Early Access. The new whip weapon is now a permanent addition to the game and there will always be some way to learn it, while Simon Belmont’s presence is indefinite.

title: The Rogue Prince of Persia
description:
The Rogue Prince of Persia is a 2D action-platformer developed by Evil Empire in collaboration with Ubisoft. The game combines fast-paced parkour movement with roguelite combat and progression systems. Players control the Prince as he battles enemies and explores procedurally generated levels filled with traps and hazards.
Each run offers new weapons, upgrades, and choices that influence gameplay and replayability.

title: Agujero
description: Agujero is a Deep Hole Crawler made for Dungeon Crawler Jam 2024.

title: Bestiario
description: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

title: Lost Chronicles
description:
Investigate the disappearance of a child and unravel the secrets of a deceptively quiet town called Forest Hill.
“Lost Chronicles” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Object, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and challenging quests.

title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX - Extra Song: "Raison d'être"

The song has also been added to the jukebox.

title: Quickerflak 2
description: Quickerflak 2 is a retro-hardcore room-beater time-attack super fast-paced minigame.

title: Monster Legacy: New Horizons 2
description: Discover the second part of these peculiar adventurous children who explore fantastic worlds and encounter monsters of all kinds.

title: Waiting for Instructions Run
description: Speed and accuracy are key! The "Waiting for Instructions RUN" is a RUN game in which you must use your typing skills to avoid obstacles. Use your typing skills to lead the human waiting for instructions to the goal in a situation where one fingertip can change his fate!

title: Chaos Trigger
description: Go back and forth in a hail of bullets , use all kinds of weapons to take down your enemies.

title: Ai no Karakuri
description: The vast institute is home to numerous enemies and gimmicks. Use electromagnetic rifles, killer rays, and infrared rays to overcome the strongest enemies and gimmicks!

title: Artificial Fashionista

title: Kart
description: A kart racer?! On PC?! with Steam Workshop support for tracks, racers, and more?! Playable offline or online, with friends or otherwise!? Yeah, you're not dreaming; this is real!

title: Lost in Art: A Miniature Realm
description: Explore the miniature universe filled with Eastern mythology, forgotten folk tales and surprising historical events in this puzzle adventure game. Step into real artworks, unreveal mysteries by solving unique puzzles, and be the hero of the miniature folk.

title: Parts Unknown 2024

Alongside this exciting update, Fallout 4 will be available to purchase on the Epic Games Store. Fallout 4 also will be Steam Deck verified.

- Enclave Remnants brings the Pre-War cabal, The Enclave, into the Fallout 4 storyline. In this new quest, “Echoes of the Past,” can you stop The Enclave from spreading their dangerous ideology and gaining a foothold in the Commonwealth? Along with workshop items and the Enclave Colonel uniform, we are including the following previously released Creation Club content including Enclave Weapon Skins, Enclave Armor Skins, Tesla Cannon, Hellfire Power Armor, X-02 Power Armor, and the Heavy Incinerator.

- Makeshift Weapon Pack: Ever thought a piggy bank would make a great weapon in a pinch? This weapon pack includes a variety of unconventional objects that have been transformed into deadly weapons, such as: a baseball launcher, a nail gun and a piggy bank.

- Halloween Workshop: Leftover from an ill-fated Halloween party, thrown by the New England Technocrat Society, these 38 new Halloween decorations include witches, cauldrons, ghouls and more! Decorate for Halloween or make your settlements spooky all year round!

• Lunar Animals PAC
• Namco Pals PAC

PAC-MAN Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs is an online-only PAC-MAN eating competition! Eat your way through multiple interconnected mazes using Power Pellets and a variety of Power Items to chomp the GHOSTS and opponent PAC-MAN players! Be the last PAC standing at the end of each match in this 64-player Battle Royale to be the Chomp Champ!

title: Hentai Girls: Athlete Crush
description: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Kanjozoku 2: Drift Car Games
description: Push your limits and dominate the asphalt in cutthroat street races!

title: Cape's Escape Game 8th Room
description: Solve the mystery and escape from the room

title: Eggconsole Hydlide II PC-8801
description: Hydlide Series Part 2. Become the chosen one and seal the evil consciousness targeting Fairyland! Utilize magic to conquer a field map six times larger than the previous

title: Five Nights of Nightmare: Escape Horror Story
description: A chilling horror game that will push your nerves to the limit... An abandoned house, shrouded in a dark secret with the terrifying ghost of an old woman.

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance - Demon Subquest: Holy Will and Profane Dissent
description:
Additional content that will grant access to the subquest "Holy Will and Profane Dissent".
In this quest, players will be able to take on "Dagda", and even recruit him should they prove victorious.

*After progressing to a certain point in the game, talk to the Bethel researcher in the Tokyo Diet Building to begin the subquest.
*It is recommended that this subquest be attempted at the end of the game.

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance - Demon Subquest: Sakura Cinders of the East
description:
Additional content that will grant access to the subquest "Sakura Cinders of the East".

In this quest, players will be able to take on "Konohana Sakuya", and even recruit her should they prove victorious.

*After progressing to a certain point in the game, talk to the Bethel researcher in the Tokyo Diet Building to begin the subquest.
*It is recommended that this subquest be attempted at least halfway through the game.

title: Karsus
description: Guide Karsus the Magician through the caves to search for his magic book, challenge the pumpkin monsters, skeletons, bats, spiders.

title: Tower Walker: The Northlanders
description: Tower Walker: The Northlanders adds 6 new playable species from the frozen northland territories with special and unique racial traits.

title: Caribbean Crashers
description: Embark on a thrilling and strategic adventure in "Caribbean Crashers," a captivating game that combines tactical prowess with explosive action. Set in the sun-soaked, pirate-infested waters of the Caribbean!

title: Lockjaw
description: Lockjaw is a party brawler where robots use interchangeable arm, leg, and head parts to knock each other around to win a robo-royale! Play with up to four players locally or over Steam Remote Play Together.

title: Russian Roulette: Online
description: "Russian Roulette: Online" is a pulse-pounding multiplayer survival game where speed and luck determine the victor. Dive into the chaos for an adrenaline-fueled showdown—only the fastest and luckiest will emerge victorious!

title: Thule
description: A turn-based 4X strategy game set in a dark fantasy world. Engage in the dynamic conflict as one of five factions vying for supremacy over Thule through both randomly generated worlds and diverse missions.

title: Toilet Paper Please
description: In Toilet Paper, please! you are a Toilet Paper Roll who wants to collect all the pieces of toilet paper in the world. Face more the 100 levels in this classic but challenging avoid and collect game.

title: VanySlash
description: Heroine, a close-combat magic-user, and her partner, an axe to fight and collect magical Tools!

title: Liquidum: Femme Fatale
description: A level pack with 10 new levels for Liquidum, a water-themed logic puzzle game.

title: Star Conflict: Procyon
description: This pack includes:Rank 8 Federation Suppressor class Destroyer ProcyonWeapon: CoilgunPortrait «Taylor Nelson»Active modules:Photon EmitterMultiphase shieldRepelling BeamWormhole projector

title: Palm Sex Night's
description: This is the place where unique creatures - Palms - are gathered. We have selected the sexiest of them and placed them in this beautiful attraction. But at night, they get very strange.

title: Sacred X: Heavens Wonderland
description: Sacred X: Heavens Wonderland is a unique Eastern fantasy open world MMORPG! The game has a large seamless map of more than 60,000 square kilometers. You will embark on a thrilling free adventure in this world full of swords and magic!

title: Beat in Zero
description: Your choices will determine your destiny.The deck-building RPG "Beat in Zero" is a game where you choose one of three characters and go on a quest to find the "0 card" lying at the bottom of the floor.Randomly generated events and cards take you on a different adventure each time.

title: Thanks Merlin
description: Thanks Merlin is an adventure horror game where the main goal is to survive. You find yourself in a closed toy store under the control of a giant toy - Chummy Tummy. With a flashlight and a laser gun, you must find a way out of the maze of horror by solving puzzles created by the inventor Merlin.

title: Apex Automata
description: Get ready for an epic showdown against rebel machines in Android Resistance, a frenetic top-down shooter that challenges your skills and strategy. Take on the role of Adrian-317, the wise Vanguard, and assemble a diverse team of androids, each with their unique abilities.

title: Mr.Chip
description: Will the main character who turns into a chip survive? Pick a good card and make the main character stronger to survive!

title: Sounds of War
description: Experience the action! Sounds of War delivers intense 5v5 battles across modes like Capture The Flag and Free for All. Customize weapons, rank up, and become the ultimate warrior. Join a clan, challenge friends, and dominate the battlefield. Warfare redefined!

title: The Lust City 2
description: Embark on an exotic quest in "The Lust City 2"! Lead your crew through a steamy jungle, unlocking treasures and secrets of an ancient tribe. Craft your seductive harem in a thrilling adventure that will leave you breathless. Explore the lustful depths of the jungle – where danger meets desire!

title: P4st3l
description: Pastel is an FPS horror game where you experience a beautiful liminal space and sub-mechanophobia towards underwater and above-water objects.

title: Slingshottr
description: A co-op physics-based space scrap salvaging game! Work with friends to bring in scrap and receive spaceship upgrades.

title: Bubble Milf
description: Bubble Milf is a visual novel that puts the keys to an intriguing mysterious world in your hands. While chasing the Mysterious Desires and understanding what is going on. You will be at the top.

title: Atomic Bot: Survivor of Planets
description: Collect all the weapons and free the planets from evil clones!

title: Too Small To Matter
description: Journey of animals trying to survive a War. An emotional tale where you'll decide the fate of all who embark on this journey.

title: Living in Spring
description: “An ADV of eternity and changeless” A world dominated by “Cruel Spring” - a phenomenon that human will become “Sacrifice” if not keep moving. Only the boy and the girl, they have “Eternal Body”, go on a journey. The endless steps seem to be a happy changeless, but can't be the same forever...

title: Codename: Ocean Keeper
description: The entire underwater world will be hunting you. Find caves and dig tunnels to obtain valuable resources to upgrade your mech. Combine a vast array of weapons and create your unique build that will allow you to last as long as possible and unravel the mysteries of the ocean.

title: Chronicles Of Crystal: Turn-Basde Epoch
description: Pixel style RPG world card-like Roguelike,players will live in a mysterious medieval world.The world is full of adventure and challenge,you will embark on a legendary journey through the portal to different levels,randomly challenge a variety of powerful monsters, and engage in intense card battles!

title: Shop Legends
description: Immerse yourself in an Idle Simulation Tycoon RPG like no other, where you are tasked with managing a thriving item shop, crafting legendary gear for customers, commanding mighty heroes to loot rare artifacts & blueprints all while challenging top-ranked shopkeepers in an epic business adventure!

title: Brick Buster Blast
description: "Brick Buster Blast" is an addictive arcade game where your objective is to demolish all the bricks while grabbing power-ups that rain down from above to advance through each level.

title: Arrogue
description: Collect, upgrade and unlock powerful arrows and relics to protect and restore your village. For that you’ll have to fight against procedurally generated hordes of enemies in this turn-per-turn, physics-based, roguelike! Explore the map, find the right path and make decisive choices in random events.

title: BattleField BattleFront
description: If I would categorize "BattleField BattleFront," it would be summarized as a RTSTD (real-time strategy tower defense) game.

title: Spellarium 6
description: Spellarium is becoming increasingly puzzle-like! In this game, we've introduced the Iron Box, which adds some twists to the levels. As usual, there's a story to follow, a town to build, and some bonus games!

title: MonoRace
description: MonoRace is a cheerful monobike racing where you can explore tracks and get points by performing tricks. Try the game in VR and PC versions with unique controls.

title: Railway Life
description: Travel the forgotten railways on your little steam train in this charming slice-of-life adventure game, where you explore the fields, towns, mountains and beaches of a small British island and help turn it into a thriving community.

title: Meranbaralan
description: "Meranbaralan" is an exhilarating action game where you burn and destroy a moving wooden fortress called "Onbu".Players will take on the role of a salamander and will board the Onbu, spitting flames, and use bombs to completely destroy the city before it reaches the city!

title: AO: Containment Breach
description: AO: Containment Breach is a Procedurally Generated, Level Building, Semi-Auto-Battling, Rouge-lite, Horror hybrid. Fight and Contain AOs as you travel through the Terra AO facility. During "Dives" scavenge for Materials to Craft unique Weapons, and Upgrades.

title: Shoot or Shout
description: Experience the thrill of roguelite action in Shoot or Shout! Team up, shoot or shout at wacky enemies, and face unique bosses across dimensions. Navigate pre-designed levels in this pixel-art adventure packed with action and strategy!

title: Rearea
description: Come explore this ever-changing and mysterious area, fight alongside your companions on the same screen, explore, collect, and build And discover new gameplay!

title: Beak Blades
description: A fast-paced, crazy and chaotic battler full of different weapons, maps, game modes, and hats! Fight with swords, battleaxes, and knives! Blast each other with shotguns, rocket launchers, and flame throwers! This is BEAK BLADES!

title: Oyster Wars
description: Serve your own justice. In a world where the rich step on the poor without consequence, Wade ventures to the private island of a ruthless CEO for revenge. Help Wade use his hook shot to clear gaps, grab items and find secrets in this 2D pixel platformer. Will you stand up against the powers that be?

title: Terres
description: Terres is a 4 player co-op horror game. Our agents reported something went wrong at a certain facility. Your team were appointed to investigate the area and complete the given objectives. Be careful and do not leave any Terres personnel behind. It is not easy to train a Terres staff.

title: Sakura Isekai Adventure
description: Sakura Isekai Adventure is a yuri adventure story set in a fantasy world. Aki’s ordinary life is turned upside-down when she’s summoned to the magical land of Anthem by a cute cat-eared witch to find a missing priestess. Now what will she do?!

title: No.9
description: Synchronizing form and time.

title: I Will Never Give You Any Thing
description: I WILL NEVER GIVE YOU ANY THING is an MBF21-compatible miniwad with a broken color palette.

title: SCP: Infohazard
description: SCP: Infohazard is a survival horror game based on the stories of the SCP Foundation, where you take on the role of a test subject who becomes the survivor or a reality-bending disaster. To survive, you must restore reality fragments around the facility while avoiding some of the most dangerous monsters and anomalies that they contain. You must navigate through the high-tech facility and to find a way to stop what might just be an end-of-the-world scenario. SCP: Infohazard immerses you in the inner workings of The SCP Foundation like never before, with breathtaking details, clever puzzles, heart-pounding stealth, combat, and more. Use the environment to your advantage as you avoid detection, shoot around corners, distract the monstrous anomalies, and more.

title: Shadow of the Elders
description: You find yourself in the aftermath of a devastating civil war. Islands scattered across the world with the remnant survivors seeking refuge in small villages. They beckon you for embrace. In wait of hope on the shores of Elmoria.

title: Van Helsing: Hunter or Hunted
description:
Legendary vampire hunter Van Helsing has been captured by the Lord Of Darkness himself, Dracula!

The Hunter has to resort to stealth, creeping around a dungeon in Dracula's castle, avoiding threats, and collecting items. Once he has collected all parts of his weapon, he can turn the tide on the enemies that were terrorizing before, and possibly even put an end to Dracula's evil for good.

Hide, explore, and kill in this stealth/fps mashup based on the classic rivalry!

title: Super Interdimensional Labyrinth Party (For Cats)
description: Super Interdimensional Labyrinth Party (for cats) is a downloadable, 2D, cooperative multiplayer, arcade style platformer for windows, about four MAGIC INTERSTELLAR CATS and what they do for fun on a friday night.

title: Running Through a Crypto Mine
description: You are a possum with a large magnet in a crypto mine. You job is to destroy every server you see, while hiding from the crypto security.

title: Shuffleboard Dungeon
description: Roll your way through over thirty encounters with careful aim and thoughtful strategy. Learn the strengths and weaknesses of different enemies as you battle your way through a Gothic citadel.

title: Space Syrup
description: A visual novel. Join Rhea Ramirez as she starts her internship at Space Syrup, an agency that helps out any planet in need.

title: Welcome to Silverscale Lake!
description: A small-town mystery set in a "mundanely magical" modern-day/very near future world with science-fantasy elements, taking place over the course of 9 days. Figure out the truth behind the tragic disaster that shut down the magi-tech factory 20 years ago.

title: Handball for Plants!
description: A short arcade game about plants who play handball, violently. Score as many points you can in 99 seconds.

title: Vesseled
description:
Deep into dark sewers, a creature made out of stones awakens. The walls are rotten, the floor slimy, but a calming song plays in the distance...

This vessel's body is weak, only being able to move when not seeing, you'll have to wander into the darkness with absolute certainty, you may not be alone in this journey.

title: Joke, Please
description: A game in which you find out personal information about your customers so you make a machine generate a good joke for them.

title: The Midnight Queens
description: A crime-themed RPG Maker game taking place in the streets of Vancouver. Featuring a large cast of cute, and dangerous chibi girls.

title: Soul Mates
description: You’re trapped inside a haunted house, stalked by angry ghosts. To survive, you’ll have to run, hide, strategize, give gifts, chat, flirt… Wait, what kind of game is this? Oh right, it’s a point-and-click survival horror dating sim!

title: Interstellar Dominion
description: Open World Space Survival

title: Strawberry's Flowers
description: Help Strawberry Cow collect flowers for Mama!

title: Ospesjel
description: A short story about the soul of a book making a five-year pact with a trickster spirit to turn her into a human. The five years are almost up, and as she slowly turns back into a novel, she returns to the spirit to beg it to keep her human by any means necessary.

title: A Letter to Luna
description: A short rhythm game created for a mini game jam. Use the power of music to send your letter! Score well enough and you might even get something back.

title: Plop, Fizz, Boom!
description: Assume command of a sailboat, whilst dodging incoming projectiles, lasers, and what not through 16 increasingly difficult levels of seafaring mayhem.

title: Chatfox Tax Evasion Adventure
description: Play as Chatfox in three new and exciting environments. Press space to shoot, shift to slow down, arrow keys to move. Shoot and evade the tax forms to progress through the levels. Collect Fox Bux and spend them in the shop to upgrade Chatfox! Become Unstoppable and Defeat all three evil bosses.

title: Prism Indigo
description: Prism Indigo is an 8-bit bullet hell shooter developed in the TIC-80 game engine. Blast your way through waves of deadly Shades, save your friends through superior firepower, and try to rack up the highest score possible.

title: Astro Aegis
description: An asteroids-like game where the player traverses space around a planet. The game features a rock-paper-scissors set of weapons and targets, where the player must rotate between the appropriate weapon for the asteroids they're trying to clear.

title: Dirok
description:
Dîrok is a unique game. First because it is the first game that combines four in a row with deck building and second because it is the first turn-based game in real time.

That means that while you are on your turn to make your move, things continue to happen on the board. This raises a new level of strategy never seen before.

In addition, the game has more than 100 real historical figures with which to form your deck and all of them will have a bio that will help us better understand who they were.

As if that were not enough, the characters will have different levels of strength, defense, life and dodge, in addition to having unique positive skills for allies and/or negative ones for enemies, thus being able to change the dynamics of the game at any time.

title: Endure the Swarm
description: The Swarm only moves when you do. Plan carefully, and take your time. But beware, it will destroy every door, window, and fence standing it its way to get to you. Topple furniture, flip tables, and drag boxes to survive in over 50 devious levels in this new turn based twist on the block pushing genre.

title: Ice Block Puzzle
description: 50+ Levels of Unique Classic Puzzle Action Inspired by the NES

title: Limbus Company: Season 4 - Clear All Cathy
description:
Season 4: Clear All Cathy is the fourth Season of Limbus Company.

It consists of the game's sixth main Story Chapter (Canto VI: The Heartbreaking), centered on Heathcliff from the literary source Wuthering Heights, the fourth Mirror Dungeon, dubbed Mirror of the Wuthering, and Line 4 of Refraction Railway, alongside two side story chapters.

title: Limbus Company: Season 3 - Bon Voyage
description:
Season 3: Bon Voyage is the third Season of Limbus Company.

It consists of the game's fifth Story Chapter (Canto V: The Evil Defining), focusing on Ishmael from the literary source Moby Dick, the third Mirror Dungeon, dubbed Mirror of the Lake and Line 3 of Refraction Railway, as well as the release of 7 Identities based on story content, 6 E.G.O exclusive to the Season's Pass and 1 additional E.G.O available through extraction.

It also consists of the game's third and fourth Detour Tales, Miracle in District 20 and Yield my Flesh to Claim Their Bones. The former event adds an additional 2 E.G.O to the season and the later adds an additional 4 Identities to the season.

title: Sumikko Gurashi: Tobidasu Ehon to Himitsu no Ko
description: A party game featuring 20 comical and humorous minigames based on the concept of picture books such as Momotaro, Little Red Riding Hood, Arabian Nights, The Little Mermaid, and The Little Match Girl. Each minigame is playable with a single Joy-Con and supports up to four players.

title: Airtime Media
description: Today is your last day as an employee at Airtime Media. Make your way from Reception to Neighbourhood 16 in Airtime Central, and kill the CEO. You may have to fight misinformation on the way there.

title: Spooky Scary Spaces
description: Spooky Scary Spaces is a third-person adventure game, with a gameplay and visual style inspired by the survival horror games of the Playstation 1 and Playstation 2 era. In it, the player is a girl who, water pistol in hand, enters a house where other children are constantly disappearing. However, inside the house she observes that it does not follow a logical order, and each area seems to have no relation to the previous one. Even so, she advances through the house despite her fear, knowing that she is on the right path, as indicated by the presence of the Motogotchi (hand-held video game consoles) of the children who disappeared there earlier.

title: Lost Fragment
description: Survival Horror game made in Unreal Engine 5

title: Craving
description: Craving is a pixel art game(poem) about drug addiction, depression an anxiety, with a simple but phisical mechanic which try to represent that suffering. It's just a test of a larger project.

title: Rubber Bandits: Animal Bandits
description: What's the best disguise to go on a heist? Of course dressing up as (or literally being) a cute or wild animal! No one suspects a fluffy animal for a bandit.

title: EA Sports UFC 5: Mike Tyson
description: As Real As It Gets

title: Fate/Zero the Visual Novel
description: A fanmade visual novel based on the light novel Fate/Zero

title: Sprill: Aqua Adventures
description: Sprill: Aqua Adventures is a puzzle game featuring a fox called Sprill who inside his automated bubble (which can be rotated) is trying to find buried treasure at the bottom of the sea.

title: Real Stories from the Grave: The Body
description: Real Stories from the Grave: The Body is a short horror experience made for the Haunted Ps1 Jam. You transport a body in the middle of the night.

title: Besitupia: Mediator
description: Waking up in a mysterious bunker, you realize that you've ended up on a planet full of mysteries and dangers. Use your skills and intuition to overcome obstacles and escape to freedom.

title: Forgiveness RPG: The First Chapter - Part Three
The Avengers United Battle Force
description:
Avengers: United Battle Force is an remix of the old Captain America and Avengers arcade game with new chars and many cool things.

Its a 2 players beat-em-up game, featuring Avengers plus some guest chars from Marvel universe.

title: Kaspar i Nudådalen
description: Kaspar i Nudådalen is a Swedish adventure/puzzle game based on the Christmas calender TV show of the same name. The game has 24 mini-games that are unlocked with a code that was revealed on TV after that day's episode of the Christmas calendar ("Julkalendern").

title: Hiouden II
description: Like its predecessor, Hiōden 2 is a mixture of RPG and real-time strategy. The player commands one or more teams at the same time. The battles are mostly automatic, with preparation having more weight that the actual commands during battles. There is an option to "stop the clock" and adjust the strategy. Most of the gameplay involves exploring the maze-like isometric location with the player's teams, fighting enemies on the way, gathering treasure, and solving (mostly very simple) puzzles to advance to the next area. RPG element comes in form of character levels. The windows-based interface from the previous game returns, with slight adjustments (point-and-click navigation through the main area instead of clicking on arrow keys; more comfortable menu with items displayed next to the character's portrait, etc.).

title: Ama Me (In Incisis)
description: After much wait, your old friend from high school finally replies to your letter and agrees to meet you for coffee at the local bar! Reconnect with him and be besties again!! Or don't!!!

title: Menage a Trois
description:
Sol Fitzroy is a gloomy student starting college at her parent’s behest. She expects nothing from the prestigious Ivy University, but with soccer sweetheart Chet Chester and football star Bill Lowman, Sol might have a good time in the end.

As Chet encounters hostile teammates and Bill deals with his father’s expectations, Sol makes a realization of her own. Menage a Trois is a LGBTQ+ visual novel about a trans girl, a (soccer) ball boy, and an all-American football star.

title: SOS OPS!: Guns n' Ops
description: GUNS N' OPS! is not just DLC, it's an explosive party in the world of shooters that will turn your perception of strategy and fun upside down. Are you ready to dive into this insane chaos?

title: Meaning
description: Domestic life with Sol and Chet

title: Moments
description: Moments is a game where you knock the moon out of the sky, bounce it along the clouds and land it in a black hole. It's a challenging puzzle game with over 90 levels. The first 20 are free in the demo below

title: At the Poison's Edge
description: You are about to die at your lover's hand

title: Dark Card
description: A game about exploration and experimentation

title: Acai cOrner
description: You have fallen into the sewers. You find your favorite guitar! You feel different. You are a magical girl now. There are monsters everywhere.

title: Reaper's Goodbye
description: At a food stall serving lost souls, five troubled patrons tell their tales of woe while waiting for the midnight train.

title: Four Before Midnight
description:
It’s the night of the royal ball! A night of excitement, festivities, and romance—as well as gruesome death for everyone in the castle, unless the irresponsible fairy godparent Ivy can change their fates.

Explore the castle, eavesdrop on its many inhabitants, and solve elaborate puzzles through careful (or not-so-careful) magical meddling. Everything in the castle is interconnected in ways that may not be obvious at first glance: turning candy into bananas might result in a broken statue, and revising a painting could lead to accidental arson.

Armed with just four minutes, your brains, and a time-traveling clock, can you bring this story to its happily ever after?

title: Reaper's Rite
description: A young man is confronted by his own mortality -- along with the demon he's been sentenced to seal -- as he contemplates whether to fulfil his farming family's ritual sacrifice.

title: Snowboarders: Kiri Adventures
description: A snowboarding game in which you pick as many coins as you can while doing backflips in the snowy hills. Avoid the rocks!

title: Moth to a Matchstick
description: Ignite the past, one match at a time, and discover if love can withstand time as fleeting as the matches you light. Can you rekindle a love lost in the shadows before the flame fades away forever?

title: Calling Card
description: A kinetic visual novel in which you play as a henchperson tasked with helping out their boss. Listen closely and read between the lines, and you might just find out something new about him.

title: Vampire: The Regicide
description:
It is a quiet night in Krakow, and the Prince has just been murdered.

You are Mikael, a young Ventrue with no memories of his mortal life. When a power struggle in the wake of the Prince's death leaves the Sheriff and Seneschal unwilling to work together, the investigation of his murder falls to you.

Joining you is Kira, the only childe of the dead Prince Aleksander. Together, you must investigate the scene of the crime, interrogate your suspects, and bring the killer to justice before the loss of its Prince sends Krakow crumbling into chaos.

Aleksander was known as a just and beloved Prince—who could have wanted him dead? And what could have driven them to it?

title: The Necromancer's Tower
description: A Tiny DRPG.

title: Half of Our
description: These are the last 30 minutes of your life.

title: Ancient Observer
description: A short time travel adventure game about a fox exploring a ruined temple.

title: Romace
description:
A visual novel with a diverse cast of characters from various ethnicities, exploring romance and relationships through an asexual lens.

This is an ongoing collaborative project created to showcase some aspects of the ace experience, by a team of three ace students for their honours year at university, There are multiple paths and endings, including platonic endings, available within our prototype!

title: The Rewrite Journal
description:
"The Prince's lie could only last until the twelfth hour."

On an island in the sky, five friends live out near idyllic lives. But one of them is distanced from the others; separated by time. To get back into their lives, he makes a wish. Except even the most simple of wishes can backfire when their story excludes yours...

title: Kegani Friends
description: Crabby Friends is a doujin fighting game whose cast features a diverse bunch of giant, anthropomorphized crabs.

title: Rune Worth 2: Jikuu no Shinsen
description: Rune Worth 2: Jikuu no Shinsen is a Role-Playing game, developed and published by T&E Soft, which was released in Japan in 1991

title: Rune Worth 3: Shinseiki Kourin
description: The third installment in the Rune Worth series.

title: Knights & Dragons: The Endless Quest
description:
The land is vast and the maps are blank. For the brave and bold, every new path could lead to untold riches... or a gruesome death.

Choose one of five adventuring classes and embark on an open world journey. Gather treasure and build experience to become ever more powerful. You're going to need all the strength you can muster for the battles ahead.

Finish the task and you'll discover all new heroes and tests to enjoy. Grab two of your friends to come along for a three player throw down. The quest is truly endless!

title: Bretonne Lais
description: Bretonne Lais is a role-playing game loosely based on the Breton lays, medieval European (mostly French or English) romance tales drawing inspiration from chivalric stories and Celtic mythology and folklore. Rather than presenting a single story the game is divided into several unrelated scenarios, each involving Celtic legends and mostly focusing on supernatural motives (floating islands, unicorns, popular Celtic figures such as Queen Mab, etc.). The player can choose between several male and female characters with pre-defined anime-style portraits, allocating points into their primary parameters. Much of the game is played solo, though a few NPCs can join the main character one at a time. Despite its Japanese origins the game takes cues from Western RPG design philosophy, offering non-linear exploration of vast interconnected areas. Battles take place on the same screen as exploration and involve turn-based navigation and simple attack commands.

title: Seiken Densetsu
description: The protagonist of Seiken Densetsu must explore dangerous wilderness in a fantasy land in order to locate and obtain four sacred swords, which allegedly grant immortality to whoever manages to possess them. This Japanese-made role-playing game is heavily influenced by early Ultima installments, having a nearly identical visual style, interface, and gameplay system. The protagonist explores an overhead world map, visiting towns where weapons, armor, items and food can be bought. Food rations are necessary to have for preventing the hero from starving. Experience points and gold are obtained from defeating enemies. Interaction is performed by pressing keys corresponding to commands, such as Move, Question, Enter, etc.

title: Lisa: The Undone
description: Based on the setting and stories established in Lisa: The Painful and Lisa: The Joyful by Dingaling, LISA: The UNDONE reimagines the storyline of Lisa: The Joyful into a longer, unique experience all its own, with countless rewrites, resprites, and alterations to the setting, story and gameplay that make it a very different experience with its own messages and story to tell. Follow a... different Buddy Armstrong and Rando as they seek to understand themselves and explore the eccentric world they inhabit.

title: ITGmania
description: ITGmania is a cross-platform rhythm game and engine. Similar to Dance Dance Revolution, it is often played with dance mats or pads. Although originally created to simulate the now defunct game, In The Groove, it has since grown to be a completely community driven effort providing regular new content and updates.

title: Magic Tales: Baba Yaga and the Magic Geese
description: "Baba Yaga and the Magic Geese" is the second part of the "Magic Tales" series. It is based on Russian folklore and tells the story of a girl, Tasha, whose little brother Niki is kidnapped by magic geese for the evil witch Baba Yaga. When Tasha gets him out of Baba Yaga's hut, they receive magical help from a stream of milk, an apple tree and an oven, which allows them to escape and safely return home, while the evil witch lands on a lonely island.

title: The Spell Brigade
description: The Spell Brigade is an online co-op Survivors-like for 1-4 players. Team up with your wizard friends to slay hordes of dark creatures. Complete team-based objectives, unlock new upgrades and create overpowered spell synergies. Friend nor foe is safe in this friendly fire bullet heaven!

title: Limbus Company: Season 2 - Reminiscence
description:
Season 2: Reminiscence, is the second Season of Limbus Company.

It consists of the game's fourth Story Chapter (Canto IV: The Unchanging), the second Mirror Dungeon and Line 2 of Refraction Railway, as well as the release of 8 Identities based on story content and 6 E.G.O exclusive to the Season's Pass.

It also consists of the game's second Detour Tale, The Magic Hell Bus. This event adds an additional 2 Identities and 2 E.G.O to the season.

title: Limbus Company: Season 1 - Orientation
description:
Season 1: Orientation, is the first Season of Limbus Company, coinciding with the game's launch.

It consists of the game's Prologue and first three Story Chapters, the first Mirror Dungeon and Line 1 of Refraction Railway, as well as the release of 13 Identities based on story content and 13 E.G.O exclusive to the Season's Pass.

It also consists of the game's first Detour Tale, Hell's Chicken. This event adds an additional 2 Identities and 2 E.G.O to the season.

title: Three Verses
description: THREE VERSES is an adventure game / first person dungeoncrawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

title: Crash Team Rumble: Season 2
description: Party Mode was the second season of Crash Team Rumble, it began on the 12th of September 2023 and ended on the 5th of December 2023.

title: Crash Team Rumble: Season 3
description: All Fired Up was the third and final season of Crash Team Rumble, it began on the 7th of December 2023 and ended on the 4th of March 2024. This season was themed around the Spyro series.

title: Lurking for Love
description:
You’re settling down in a suburban town in Texas, starting a new life for yourself. Lately, your mail has been getting sent to the wrong house and keeps ending up at your neighbor’s front door. Or at least, that’s what he told you.

Your polite neighbor Jacob has been returning your mail quite often lately. It’s almost like he wants to talk to you more...

Lurking For Love is a Horror visual novel game featuring Jacob Alden, a lonesome man who has quite the interest in you.

title: Block in the Lock
description: Block in the Lock is a 2D puzzle game where you move different blocks simultaneously like a hive mind. These blocks can be shifted and shaped to create certain patterns. All blocks move at the same time in the same direction and interact with their environment. A puzzle is solved when the movable blocks fill out the required shape with a certain pattern.

title: Grounded: Fully Yoked Edition
description:
The free 1.4 "Fully Yoked" content update for all players introduces royal Ant Queens, a New Game+ mode, full Japanese VO, and an exciting array of new weapons, armor, and more. Additional content includes new molars, infused bugs, the ability to upgrade gear past level 9, four new achievements, one new mutation, twelve Ant Queen-related buildings, new baby ant pets, and other gameplay additions. Beginning with this update, hosts can now load a save while in the middle of a multiplayer session and all connected players will seamlessly transition into the new game world.

Beat the Javamatic, Brood Mother, Mantis and Wasp Queen to open a secret door. What's behind the door?

The Fully Yoked updated is anticipated to be the final (large) update to Grounded

title: Fallout 76: Season 16 - Duel with the Devil
description:
Season 16: Duel with the Devil's theme is an epic fight between Rip Daring (of Astoundingly Awesome Tales fame) and the Jersey Devil! It released March 26, 2024 alongside the "Atlantic City -- America’s Playground" free update.

Fear not! This season, the astoundingly awesome and unfailingly patriotic Rip Daring is duking it out with the Jersey Devil. No one but the burly hero--and Nurse Guinevere and Percival--could stand toe to toe with the fearsome cryptid stalking New Jersey.
Except you, Vault Dweller. You, too, can don the outfit of the famed cryptid hunter and take down devils with an all-new weapon, Cremator! Once unlocked, the Cremator will be craftable and moddable at Weapon Workbenches once you hit level 30. This season, you can also unlock Adelaide, the amazing Assaultron actress who will adorn your C.A.M.P. and deign to sign autographs for all her adoring fans.

You will also notice some changes to Seasons. The Scoreboard has been replaced by pages where you can see all the rewards that are available. As you complete challenges and earn S.C.O.R.E., you will rank up and unlock new pages. For each rank, you earn 25 tickets. You can then redeem those tickets for rewards on pages you have already unlocked.

title: Fallout 76: Atlantic City - America's Playground
description:
Atlantic City – America’s Playground is a free update for Fallout 76 and with it comes new questlines, open exploration of Atlantic City and a season full of adventurous rewards.

America’s Playground brings you back to Atlantic City, where Mayor Tim, in charge of the local Municipal Government, asks you to deal with the Overgrown threat that is taking over the flooded city center. Don’t forget to bring your gardening shears.

Meanwhile, in Appalachia, the Russo family has evicted the Mothman cultists and turned the Ingram Mansion into a swanky night club. They seem to be doing well after escaping their blood-stained past in Atlantic City, but beneath the surface of their glamorous exterior, the Russos are harboring some dark secrets, and they need your help.

There’s a lot to dig into in this update, and along with new quests, we are introducing free exploration of Atlantic City! There are even new side quests that you can pick up from the ever-optimistic Jeremiah Hopkin’s bulletin board in the Whitespring Resort, so make Atlantic City your next vacation destination. Take your time, wade through the flooded streets, stroll along the boardwalk and stop to smell the Overgrown.

title: Sweetsdigger
description:
Lovely 68000 classic digging and shooting! 20 quick stages influenced by Jeff Minter's Gridrunner & ZUN's Highly Responsive to Prayers.

After the latest incident, Momoyo's new employer has her making plans for tonight! Dig up some sweets to bring to Megumu.

title: Calum
description: A rhythmic action gameplay inspired by souls-like and beat-in-ups games with a top-down view.

title: Metal Savior Black
description: A fast paced sci-fi shooter with tons of enemies, weapons and secrets to unlock. Will you survive the onslaught?

title: The DeLuca Family: Season 1
description: The DeLuca Family is a story-driven adult game. Try to win over the ladies of the house and increase in the ranks in the crimeworld. Choose your playstyle with three modes - full experience (Text-based rpg game), story+freeroaming, or VN-Mode. But no matter the mode, lots of lewd!

description: Embark on an epic journey in Space Vortex! Hunt aliens, destroy their statues, collect black hole seeds, and access different space locations. Defeat enemies with asteroids in this thrilling adventure!

title: Magnus Trilogy
description:
Magnus Trilogy is a series of three visually captivating and emotionally immersive visual novel games, each with its own unique narrative and hand-drawn graphics. The Trilogy invites players to explore the depths of the human psyche, confronting them with unsettling themes and thought-provoking storytelling.

Magnus Trilogy includes 3 games:
Magnus Imago
Magnus Positive Phototaxis
Lazarus A.D. 2222

description: In this fictional, peaceful country where many people live, players are free to do everything in their lives, including work, training, love, raising children, and participating in events and tournaments. It's a game that you can relax, enjoy, and be happy.

description: Enter the arena of 1 Shot 1 Kill, a game where every shot counts. This adrenaline-pumping 3D arena shooter brings you modern split-screen gaming. With its roots in classic couch co-op and competitive modes, this game promises an unforgettable multiplayer experience, best shared with friends.

From washing and feeding to grooming and pampering, keep those cats content and entertained amidst the chaos. Are You ready for a wild ride of cat antics and endless laughs?

description: Collaboration Work with KTactical x Xenoaisam Studio. KTactical costumes of K-chan and G-Chan

title: BattleClaws

Capture as many points as possible before time runs out to outlast your opponents and be the last claw standing! Only the ultimate Battle Claws can claim a spot on the all time leaderboard!

title: AOD
