description: Join the epic battle in an arena filled with gladiators and test your skills in a game where every move can lead to glory or downfall. Collect achievements, refine your strategies, and become a legend in the endless fight for survival and recognition!

title: Asteroid Jungle
description: An arcade style ship vs ship stealth battle. Find them before they find you. Destroy their ship before they destroy yours. Only skill will determine the victor.

title: Asteroid Sentinel
description: Shoot down masses of asteroids and aliens in this arcade-style shooter with roguelike elements. Level up and upgrade your guns to cope with the endless waves being thrown at you.

title: Project Tachyon
description: An exciting run-and-gun action shooting game in a rogue-lite format! Fight for the future by crossing timelines with the protagonist Sigma to prevent an artificial intelligence rebellion!

title: Akayashiki
description: Akayashiki is a game where you must escape from a killer roaming the mansion.

description: Prepare to face your deepest fears in Sinister Mansion, a bone-chilling horror experience that will haunt your every step.

title: Hentai Homewrecker

title: Ninja Kato 3
description: 【Third in the Ninja Kato series!】 A side-scrolling 2D action game. Control the robot ninja Kato and train him to become a full-fledged ninja.

title: DNA: Episode 4
description: The DNA action rpg franchise is created by a solo dev as an episodic side scrolling action hack and slash beat em up, story-driven 2d anime that welcomes the world into the DNA universe. You play as the main character Leo to find his true purpose in life. Thus begins the fascinating story of DNA!

title: Papercut Art Gallery-Growth
description: An artistic puzzle game inspired by the art of paper cutting. You need to assemble paper cutting pieces to restore the artworks in the museum themed around growth.

title: Who's the Boss
description: The game features a variety of game modes, each with its own unique challenges and objectives.

title: Dragenas
description: Dragonfly fairies of the Sacred Swamp rely on the full moon to earn their wings, and insect spirits for their power. With the help of mother sages to guide them, they must rid their world of magic-wielding monsters.

title: Besotted
description: Dive into the world of Besotted. A classic JRPG 2D-3D art style set in a fantasy world with 3 main protagonist. Each with their own deep back stories that's full of death, revenge, love, and destiny. Join the 3 as they team up together all with the same goal in mind.

title: Kit Cat
description: Cute cats need love! Discover the best jigsaw puzzle story with animals, a relaxing adventure for kids in 2D.

title: Bikini Hunter Attack on Bikini Army
description: This is a 3D action game where you become a bikini hunter and fight against the bikini army. ・Use shooting, fighting, guarding, and invincibility techniques depending on the situation You can enjoy a variety of battles.

title: Pharmacy Simulator
description: Experience a realistic pharmacy management experience with Pharmacy Simulator. Set up your shop, decorate it as you wish, and purchase over a hundred types of medications. Pharmacy Simulator offers you an incredibly realistic pharmacy experience. Prove your skills in a challenging economic system.

title: Carnival
description: Carnival is an atmospheric folk horror point-&-click featuring atmospheric low-resolution pixel art graphics, multiple locations drawn from Venice itself, and developing relationships with NPCs, allowing the player to influence events in the game and achieve multiple different endings.

title: De:Fanastasis
description: A full-length RPG that focuses on map exploration, where you can enjoy "discovery". A ruined kingdom with countless hidden passages and doors. Peek into the lingering thoughts of the dead to find clues, and expand your search with items from hidden treasure chests. Fragments of information obtained in various places may eventually connect and reveal not only one's own memories but also the hidden "truth."

title: The GIF Game
description: Your group chat. On a TV. With a scoreboard. A couch party game for 3 to 8 players where every phone is the controller. Three prompts, two GIFs, one winner per round. No app for your guests. Plays in person or remotely over any video call.

title: Cryohazard
description: Cryohazard is a spooky turn-based strategy rogue-lite. Pilot an upgradeable train caravan into the depths of the hazardous Soul Storm. Fight off the angels that give chase.

title: Elemental Empire
description: An economic 4x strategy in a space filled with magic and procedurally generated planets. Build your own empire and become the sole ruler of a new world. Compete against your friends in multiplayer mode.

title: The Horrible Inside
description: You have to plunge into the depths of madness and uncover the dark secrets that lurk within. With every step you take, you will encounter paranormal phenomena and ghosts of your past.

title: Digital Audio Wasteland
description: Digital Audio Wasteland is a comedic first person exploration game about discovering the music in the world and using that music to change it by throwing the biggest rave at the end of the world through the music you find along the way

description: Only Up: Skibidi Together is an intense online parkour game of precision and speed. Jump and climb over various obstacles, each with unique challenges and surprises. The slightest mistake can result in a fall to the starting line.

title: Chloe the Cat
description: Jump, spin, and pounce your way through colorful worlds and challenging obstacles in this charming precision platformer! Collect coins to acquire new looks, scour through every corner to scavenge for food, and expertly leap and bounce past danger through a handcrafted adventure.

title: Infinikin

title: Hungry Mouse
description: We control a mouse and try to steal cheeses on the ground, earning points as we steal. However, as we earn points, a cat starts chasing us.

title: Unsung Empires: The Cholas II Legacy of Rajendra Chola
description: Take control of Rajendra Chola, and uphold the legacy of your kingdom amidst challenges, battles, and tough decisions in this narrative-driven action-adventure game. Will you honor its heritage or forge a new path? Your leadership will shape the destiny of Thanjavur.

title: Legends Resurrected Online
description: Legends Resurrected Online It is a Free MMORPG with a classic 2D style. Explore and discover the wide variety of weapons and items you can obtain. Find a group and take down the wild beasts, create equipment to aid your progress.

title: Slendrina Remake
description: Slendrina Remake is a scary survival game set in a dungeon where you must gather items, solve puzzles, and evade the sinister Slendrina herself to make it out alive. Experience the atmosphere of fear and tension in this gripping horror adventure.

title: Trace
description: Third-person RPG with messenger tracking exploration

title: Internet Cafe & Supermarket Simulator 2024
description: Internet Cafe & Supermarket Simulator 2024" is a comprehensive simulation game that combines the management of both an internet cafe and a supermarket. Step into the role of a shop owner, apply your business acumen, and expand your empire step by step.

title: Mad Smartphone Tycoon
description: Build Your smartphone Empire in MAD SMARTPHONE TYCOON, your main goal in this game is to create the ultimate smartphone that combines both performance and aesthetics. Expand your company, dominate the global market, become a tycoon in the world of mobile phones!

title: The Fanciful Chronicle
description: The Fanciful Chronicle is a singleplayer first person narrative game. As Mike, you find yourself at a highschool reunion where all kind of memories return to you as you meet your friend Sam. As you explore these memories, Mike discovers more and more about his past - or lack thereof.

title: Robot Arena Survivors
description: Robot Arena Survivors is a single-player arena auto-shooter. You are piloting one of your own Hovercraft Units to fight against many waves of deadly robots. Unlock powerful abilities and rewards to get the job done.

title: Travellin Cats in Christmas
description: Cats Hidden in Christmas is a FREE hidden object game in which you must find 100 cats hidden in a festive, hand-drawn scene. Can you find them all?

title: The Vigilante Diaries
description: The Vigilante Diaries is a narrative-driven role-playing game where you assume the role of a masked vigilante. Experience his life journey through his diaries spanning years, navigate the changes within his hideout, and make every decision that shapes his destiny.

title: Splash Dino
description: Drag objects (wooden boxes and triangles and other objects) to help the little dino throw the wooden ball into the water. And remember that dino can help you with tips, skips and dino points. 100 levels.

title: World of Solaria
description: Embark on an epic journey in World of Solaria, the ultimate free-to-play 2D pixel MMORPG! Join forces with players worldwide to conquer foes, master skills, and unearth hidden artifacts. Craft your destiny, engage in PvP battles, and shape Solaria's destiny in a dynamic economy.

title: Mission Rovee
description: Control Rovee and complete her mission. Using the terminal and clever pathing, ensure Rovee finishes her mission successfully. Be careful, or she'll run out of battery and her mission will come to an end.

title: Jorogumo's Cradle

title: Game Cafe

title: Sime is Back

title: Run Away From Me. Alexandra
description: An action-packed adventure quest with horror elements about Alexandra, who fell into the clutches of a maniac. Your task is to escape from him, completing quests along the way. What ending will you have? Can you choose from the maniac's lair? And who is the real victim in this story?

title: Mythic Crusade
description: Explore, gain resources, expand your town, recruit armies, fight infidels, find new spells, learn skills, and find powerful artifacts. Create your unique build and reclaim the Mythic Holy Land.

title: We Need Space
description: A romantic comedy visual novel with a sci-fi tilt. If you've ever wanted to blast someone into space, this may very well be for you.

title: Grapplers: Relic Rivals
description: Engage in fast-paced local PvP matches while unearthing ancient relics and harnessing their power to conquer your rivals. Dodge deadly traps, utilize your grappling hook, activate mystical runes, and master each relic to defeat your opponents and reign victorious in this thrilling PvP platformer!

title: Café Manager
description: Design your dream cafe, manage staff, serve a variety of coffees and desserts, and grow your business. Are you ready to brew your way to success?

title: Cyberpunk Horror
description: Cyberpunk Horror - is a first-person horror game that conveys a real atmosphere of horror in a cyberpunk setting.

title: Odd Eye
description: Two different worlds from different colored eyes.

title: Tower of Mask
description: Tower of Mask is a thrilling survival horror in the spirit of the 80's dungeon crawlers. The most claustrophobic dungeon in modern times is yours to venture through alone. Hero, face the ancient tower where eerie masked humans prowl.

title: Salvation of Sisyphus

Equipped with only your pet rock, suffer trials and tribulations - come out a changed person. Join Sisyphus on his journey to salvation and reach the top together! In this horror game, you will get to play as Daniel, a desperate man trying to support his ill daughter by stealing from the dead... however, this time, Daniel will experience hell on earth, as things don't go according to plan...

description: Game includes 7 funny roach birthday party pictures as puzzles. Each puzzle is available as 25, 49 or 100 pieces. There is no time limit, reference image is always available during assembling. Take your time, enjoy assembling and have a fun with roach party pictures!

title: Incident Survival

description: It's a different way to feel the emotion of fear. While playing a game, even the slightest sound will cause you to start the game from the beginning. While you are trying to solve a mysterious case, you have an accident on the forest road. You must find a way out of the forest.

title: Trans-Siberian Legends: Beautiful Girls
description: This DLC adds beautiful girls to passenger cars.

title: Spellarium 2
description: that's the Part 2 of our successfull Spellarium series. Our world consists of 6 elements: the Earth, Water,Fire,Light,Darkness and Water. So, we need to create the 7th element. The game has 110 Match 3 levels plus Solitaires, Spot the Difference and Hidden Objects scenes. Plus a nice town to build.

title: Slime Clicker
description: Bright adventure in the world of slimes with RPG elements! Battle bosses, dive into minigames, level up your character, and unlock unique weapons. Wishlist now!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KMCO Airport
description: As the seventh busiest airport in the United States, MCO facilitates the travel of over 40 million passengers each year. It is renowned for its distinctive hub-and-spoke architectural design, which enhances operational efficiency and passenger convenience.

title: Shift Legacy Collection
description: Step into the monochromatic and mind-bending universe of the Shift series developed by Antony Lavelle, where black and white landscapes hide more than meets the eye. This collection unites the original four titles - Shift, Shift 2, Shift 3, and Shift 4.

title: Skate O'Clock
description: Skate O'Clock is dynamic, action, skateboarding game in retro style. Win the race against time by collecting coins through multiple levels.

title: Shogun
description: Carve your legacy in a world of samurais, where strategy, prosperity, and heritage converge.

title: Tomboy Adventure 2
description: Start a relaxing adventure together with your (girl) friend!

title: One Military Camp: Biomes
description: Explore new ways to organize your camp with the new versions of biomes for One Military Camp. It is now possible to choose any of the five biomes in their clear version.

title: Silk Suki: Chat Messaging Game
description: Spend a night with Suki! Chat with Suki, complete missions, unlock poses, and fully undress her! 16 kawaii poses to unlock, and all clothing can be removed! Try out the free demo.

title: Terunyan to Amanoiwato
description: Terunyan to Amanoiwato is a rhythm game in which Terunyan wanders around and collects elementals. Elementals can be efficiently gathered by collecting them in rhythm to the music.

title: Solium Infernum: Belphegor, Paragon of Impiety
description: Take the Infernal Throne as Belphegor, the Paragon of Impiety, a diabolical inventor whose contraptions are designed to serve one wicked purpose; to corrupt, weaken, and enslave!

title: Assault Suit Leynos 2: Saturn Tribute
description: Modify your robot and head to the battlefield!

title: Rusty Dusty
description: "Rusty Dusty es un juego 2D donde un robot de limpieza lucha por su libertad en un edificio residencial, enfrentando temas de clasismo. Los jugadores toman decisiones importantes que afectan el destino del protagonista."

title: The Backworlds
description: RUN, JUMP, ESCAPE. Endlessly high buildings of dead ruins are towering over a giant chasm of green mist. But the reality of our world is seeping in, and some familiar places are now stuck there. This is how you are invited there - against your will. Enter the hostile realm of the BACKWORLDS.

title: Soul King: Out of the Box
description: Lynn must call on her abilities and blasters once agian to brave the dangers of this new land, face new nightmares, and find the pieces needed to get legendary creator and dream weaver Grimzo Out of the Box

title: Below Surface
description: Fast-paced 3D horror game about exploring a supernatural cave

title: Spirit Swap
description: A love story of a body swap between a man and a woman sharing one body.

title: Rich City
description: Rich City - Real-time strategy and clicker in one person. Take the reins and make a real economic oasis in the middle of an empty meadow! Build and demolish buildings, collect profits, fulfill the demands of the citizens and you will definitely be rewarded for your labors!

title: Human Upgrade Labs
description: You will be taking on various tests/puzzles in Human Upgrade Labs. These tests will essentially be various mini games, 30 of them, placed into several different categories, created using multiple hand painted and sometimes experimental visual styles and combined into a single story.

title: Hoodies Squad: Alcoholypse
description: In Grochow, something strange is causing the residents to behave abnormally. Three inseparable buddies must restore balance by discovering the causes of this confusion and heading deep into the mysterious Alkoholipsa. Will they succeed in restoring normalcy before the neighborhood collapses?

title: Vagrus: The Riven Realms - Old Acquaintances
description: Vagrus – The Riven Realms: Old Acquaintances, introduces two new Companions with new abilities, individual and specific loyalty quests that explore their own stories, new enemies and rewards, as well as newfound additions to hirelings that can join owners of the DLC.

title: The Last Farmer
description: "The Last Farmer" is not just a tale of survival; it's a journey of restoration. Amidst the sprawling deserts of a forgotten Texas, your farm becomes a symbol of hope and persistence.

title: SGS Battle For: Dien Bien Phu
description: The emblematic siege battle of Dien Bien Phu that ended French rule over Indochina in 1954. Fight for the defense of the fortified camp or try to storm it, in order to reach the upcoming Geneva Peace Conference in a position of force.

title: Nanuka: Secret of the Shattering Moon
description: A new exciting cinematic 2D puzzle platformer set in a colourful cartoony land. Nanuka is utterly unprepared for the adventure ahead. She has to use her martial art combat skills to defeat quirky foes while making friends that will be key to uncovering the secret of the shattering moon.

title: Stellaris: Cosmic Storms
description: A new phenomenon has been observed around the Galaxy - storms are sweeping through system. Prepare your Empire and brace to face this new upcoming threat, and leverage possibilities that open when your opponents are weakened by it.

title: Stellaris: Grand Archive
description: The Galaxy is vast and full of wonders, and it is up to you to store records of all the unique lifeforms and marvels you will meet. Build a new megastructure, and collect examples of specimens you will meet in your space-faring adventures!

title: Assistant to the Lost Detective: Remaster
description: A novel-style mystery adventure game. Explore 2D top-down maps! Enjoy easy puzzles and comical text. Become the assistant to the lost detective Chiho-chan and help solve mysteries!

title: KunKun Defender
description: Oh no! The Kun Virus has broken out. A group of zombies infected with the Kun Virus is using Iron Mountain to crazily ram into any living creature. You must pick up your gun to fight against the onslaught of Kun-infected zombies until Big Joe arrives in a helicopter to rescue you.

title: House of Cards: TD
description: A game where you must defend yourself against robots that have come from the future, intending exclusively to destroy all of humanity. You must employ various strategies and characters to survive this time-traveling journey! Are you up for this adventure?

title: Kwark: Online and Multiplayer
description: Kwark is a game about a character who needs to complete levels and then something impossible happens at the end! The game can be either 1-person or 3-person! But now a MULTIPLAYER has been added. Play with friends, and have fun!.

title: Spin Hero
description: Spin Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder, where you spin the reels to decide your fate. Collect powerful symbols for your inventory, adapt and evolve your strategy, learning from defeats to unlock new possibilities and synergies.

title: My Recycling Center: Container Truck Expansion
description: Start the container skip or dump truck! Load the filled containers with the animated crane and drive them to the waste processing plant. Get through the animated gate to the weigh station and see how much is loaded. Then unload the trash in the designated areas.

title: Stellaris: Rick The Cube Species Portrait
description: An exclusive portrait for you species, to play as the most enigmatic species in the galaxy.

title: Sandwich Sim
description: A game where you play as a slightly confused bear trying to assemble the ultimate meal no matter who tries to get in your way. Relax and fish, visit the grocery store, escape bureaucracy, and more on your way to achieve enlightenment via sandwich.

title: What Happened to Kate
description: "What happened to Kate" is a gripping puzzle adventure set in a mysteriously silent home. Unravel your coworker's disappearance through challenging puzzles. Delve into the depths of mystery and discover what lies within the quiet.

title: Trap Tower Trials
description: Trap Tower Trials is a 3D single-player platformer that will test your dexterity with various traps and obstacles. This game is designed to be a challenge; therefore, we are not responsible for any peripherals broken in anger. Do you think you'll be able to climb the tower?

title: WattGames
description: Turn your indoor cycling into an adventure! A new revolution in fitness gaming, WATTGAMES is the first-ever indoor cycling game that lets you do battle with fearsome enemies, explore a beautifully crafted world and complete missions through exercise. Ride for your life!

title: I Witness
description: I Witness is a 2-player online co-op psychological horror game that follows a sibling whose curiosity leads them to investigate a neighbor suspected of being a serial killer who, unbeknownst to them, hides a disturbing desire.

title: Moaisland
description: Moaisland is a humorous and surreal, first-person, retro-styled, point-and-click adventure game starring the mysterious Moai statues of Rapa Nui (Easter Island).

title: Sluggerpunk
description: Sluggerpunk is a gripping 2D survivors roguelike adventure. As you navigate through a myriad of challenges, hone your skills and strategies to clash with formidable foes lurking in the underground. Build a versatile arsenal of abilities and gear to enhance your chances to survive, but will you?

title: Rise & Muse
description: "Rise & Muse" is a single-player game that blends RPG, deck-building, and Roguelike elements. Set in the land of Muse, you will engage in strategic battles against formidable enemies, unravel the seal of the male deity, defeat the goddess, and restore world order.

title: PC Futbol 8
description: The wait is over! The legendary Spanish football management video game, PC Fútbol, is back after many years with new dynamics and the classic spirit!

title: The Earth Is Flat
description: Help Teddy on his adventure to prove that the Earth is flat and win back his ex-girlfriend. Venture through various countries such as Canada, the US, Brazil, Ireland, Italy and many others. Face crazy scientists, control a Jet Ski, try to reach the Earth's atmosphere with balloons, and more.

title: The Krilling: Scare Feast!
description: In this funny bayou based game, complete recipes as a cursed shrimp ghost by luring in and scaring unassuming hotel guests. Collect your victims emotions, mess with physics, and unlock new possessables to please the mysterious Gator Ghost and possibly become human again!

title: Holosaga: Invasion of the HoloX
description: Liberated from the shackles of power, Laplace led the HoloX members and the army to invade Earth! You must gather the members of the HoloLive and stop them.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: Swayfield Branch
description: Hiawathamr Trainz Add-ons presents the Swayfield Branch for Trainz! The Swayfield Branch is a UK themed route set in the Midlands of the United Kingdon. On the southern end of the route is the main line that connects the branch line to the rest of the BR system for both goods and passenger traffic.

title: Trainz Plus: Swayfield Branch
description: Hiawathamr Trainz Add-ons presents the Swayfield Branch for Trainz! The Swayfield Branch is a UK themed route set in the Midlands of the United Kingdon. On the southern end of the route is the main line that connects the branch line to the rest of the BR system for both goods and passenger traffic.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Swayfield Branch
description: Hiawathamr Trainz Add-ons presents the Swayfield Branch for Trainz! The Swayfield Branch is a UK themed route set in the Midlands of the United Kingdon. On the southern end of the route is the main line that connects the branch line to the rest of the BR system for both goods and passenger traffic.

title: Level Up! Factory
description: Commander! Manage your shelter with survivors in a abandoned nuclear power plant. Search resources to make different types of boxes, send expeditions, repair work areas, face enemies to defend your facilities, deploy drones and rc cars, prepare for special events and more. All in real-time.

title: Storage Looter
description: Storage Looter is a loot game in a Voxel universe. Your goal is to collect the rarest and most profitable items in order to improve your store. From classic recovery to a metal detector, there are many things to do!

title: Tashikani
description: Line up numbers to make 10 in this falling block puzzle game!

title: Boom Lift Operator
description: "Boom Lift Operator" is an immersive training game where players learn to operate boom lifts safely through realistic simulations and challenges.

title: Réussir: Code de la Route - Bonus ASSR 1 - ASSR 2: Permis AM - French Highway Code
Wandness
description: Craft wands, create synergies, battle monsters, and survive. Dive into the depths of magic crafting, where you'll forge spells from magical components and elemental gems for endless combinations. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, and unleash your magic madness to overcome the darkness.

title: The Aquarians
description: A point-and-click playable short where you take the role of an artifact collector, navigating the Aquarian Temple's enigmatic architecture and locating its prized relics.

title: Pixel Town: Akanemachi Sideshow
description: While on vacation on a scenic island, Fuu and her brother find themselves trapped when a magical barrier forms around the island. Now Fuu must unravel the secrets of the island to secure their escape.

title: Tattered Sails
description: The Golden Age of Piracy, a time when legends are made or torn down. No trip over the seas is safe and every voyage could be your last. Or... You could find riches, power, and become legend!

title: Ravenwood Academy: A Wizard101 Story
description: Step into the role of an outcast student wizard attending Ravenwood Academy and prepare to discover the truth behind the school’s bizarre events. Search for clues and solve mysteries in this story-book style puzzle game where things often aren't what they seem.

title: Belly Bumpers
description: Use your belly to knockout other players in this 2-8 online and local party game. Eat juicy burgers to increase the size of your belly or force-feed opponents until they burst. Bump it out in a world of food-themed stages.

title: Tresmir Sight
description: Can you find what you're looking for? Or are you at the mercy of Tisik and her followers? Your words matter in this short game of dialogue.

title: Car-Toon Chaos
description: Car-toon Chaos is an action-packed game where high-speed chases and combat converge. Play as a vigilante driver with fully loaded automatic weapons, pursuing criminals by day and evading colossal dinosaurs by night. Playable on both PC and VR.

title: Crossout: Ronin

title: Outlanders: The Keeper's Shanty
description: The arrival of rowdy tourists disrupts the serenity of a group of tropical islands home to the meticulous ecologists Pirate Sisters. As the ambition of the castaways agitates the ecosystem, it's up to its self-proclaimed protectors to take matters into their own hands and restore their home.

title: The Leviathan's Fantasy: Samurai and Onmyoji
description: The nine-tailed fox is a mythical animal in ancient Chinese legends, often used as a symbol of auspiciousness.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Empire State Express No. 999
description: Climb aboard and take the throttle of one of North America's most historic - and fastest - steam locomotives and “highball” the fabulous Empire State Express with New York Central & Hudson River 4-4-0 No. 999, masterfully created for Train Simulator Classic by Machine Rail!

title: Reclamation of Xanthros
description: Reclamation of Xanthros is a unique Tower-Defense Roguelike. Xeno have taken over the planet Xanthros and you must save it by defeating their Matriarche. Battle across a wide range of biomes with a changing assortment of Towers, Upgrades, and Artifacts. Features a unique turret building mechanic.

title: Master of Command
description: Take command in Europe's greatest 18th-century war. Equip & customize regiments, manage supplies, and engage in brutal real-time battles across procedural campaigns. Resources and replacements are scarce, and keeping your best men alive may matter more than any single victory.

title: Warehouse Bots
description: Take on the role of a warehouse manager overseeing a bustling hub of automated activity. In this immersive simulator, you'll delve into the intricacies of logistics as you control robots, construct efficient road networks, and fine-tune traffic flow to optimize your warehouse operations.

title: BobasQuest
description: Welcome to the exciting world of Bobas Quest, a fun pixel art platformer where you have to make nimble jumps and complete levels using teleportation.

title: Stellaris: Season 08
description: Stellaris: Season 08 includes "The Machine Age", a new expansion from Paradox Development Studios, "Cosmic Storms", a new mechanical expansion and "The Grand Archive Story Pack"!

title: Swords & Crystals: Dragon Hatchling Pet
description: You gain your personal Dragon Hatchling Pet which will follow you around in the game. The pet is an item that will automatilly be recovered upon losing. You can unlock but also dismiss the pet by simply clicking on the item.

title: Musa
description: Fight numerous monsters in exciting battles and obtain them all. Defeat all monsters and obtain all artifacts.

title: Shallow Sea Roaming
description: Find the secret treasure and explore the secrets of this mysterious island You need to use your courage and scientific knowledge to survive on this island,And find a way to leave this island!

title: Strike Force Heroes: Ninja Class
description: New DLC introducing the Ninja class, and a number of ninja related items!

title: Jam Scrapz Collection: The Minesweeper
description: One private; no guns; just your wits and trusty mine detector. Your mission is to clear a path through the minefields in the Great Desert. In most levels, you will have to find a mine detector to clear the mines, or carefully navigate through the field and avoid triggering any mines.

title: Icarus: Zebra Rescue Mission
description: unlocks the Zebra Rescue Mission, tasking you with locating 5 wild Zebra across the surface for Sinotai and returning them safely. Your reward for completing this mission is the 5 rescued Zebras as new mounts for you to train, equip and ride.

title: Killer Vegetable
description: Girl VS Vegetables「crisp and fresh」A horror game aiming to conquer vegetables

title: Sudoku Acres
description: Sudoku Acres is a cozy cross-up of farm building and puzzle solving. Grow your skills and your environment as you complete Sudoku puzzles, acquire animals, and unlock decorations your farm.

title: Fucus
description: A game where you fight against parkours and drones on an endless road in space.

title: Tea Talk
description: "Tea Talk"? Are you a grumpy old man? Or a doormat? Or is there someone else?

title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - The Book of Hungry Names: Wardens and Furies
description: Wardens and Furies unlocks the options to play as a member of the Black Fury tribe or the Hart Warden tribe, as well as adding new Gifts for the tribes.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Aquatic Adventures
description: 2 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Dive deep with these aquatic themed tables with a unique center playfield kickback mechanic.

title: Escape Room Collection C2: Psychological Horror
description: A collection of escape room games with a psychological horror theme. Intensely scary visually stimulated and cleverly psychologically intrigued as players are both timid and captivated, you'll be locked in a room full of horror atmospheres where you must find clues and solve puzzles to escape.

title: 21 Mayble Drive
description: You find yourself in an abandoned house, consumed by darkness and mysteries. The old walls creak, and the air is filled with the smell of decay and fear.

title: Toxic Place
description: Toxic Place, an exciting story in the form of a soul like game, combined with a sandbox for you to experience adventure. In a world full of pollution and monsters that have been affected have mutated into terrifying creatures. Will you be able to survive this cruel world?

title: Fearful Injection
description: Find anomalies, talk to ghosts and survive the night.

title: DeSoloFender
description: a tower defense game in a 3D environment. Unique interface design and damage system which significantly increases the strategy factor. With a choice of 4 different weapons and a lot of improvement options, this game is perfect for putting your strategic skills to the test.

title: Protocol Five
description: Protocol Filve is a surreal first-person adventure with multiple endings, you will find yourself in a world where some rotten things want to kill you. Some choices along the way drastically and irreversibly change the game, leading to one of the 5 possible endings.

title: Wealth Project
description: Practice mindfulness! Divide assets and liabilities! Calculate your net worth and how much time it takes to reach your dreams! Set a clear vision and goals to create your own wealth project!

title: Brains n' Bullets
description: Brains n' Bullets is the first shooter that lets you improve your school grades while playing. Learn vocabulary and other content by heart while you and your team fight to conquer the bases on tactical maps.

title: Cosmic Breakout
description: In this breakout-inspired game you engage in a hefty arcade battle: Move with your little board against the dark polygon-forces of the world.

title: Ronin Rush
description: Drawing inspiration from classic Hack & Slash, Beat ‘em Up, and SHMUP genres, we introduce our unique "Slice ‘em Up" adventure unfolding in fabled Japan! Navigate this Yokai-infested world utilizing a variety of tools, such as kunai, weapon arts, spirit abilities, and of course, the iconic katana!

title: Deathless Death
description: Deathless Death is a narrative puzzle game with psychological thriller elements. You play as a priest navigating a world of thoughts and illusions, tasked with listening to the confessions of four sinners. Through their stories, you uncover hidden truths about their pasts and unravel the complex fates that connect them, all centered around one mysterious woman.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Illustrations 2
description: Puzzles of beautiful Illustrations!

title: Two Bad Fellas
description: In this first person, horror, casual game, you have to protect your Teddy from the Two Bad Fellas. Find quickly a safe spot to hide your buddy and than move him to the next one. Explore the house and solve riddles but be aware, if you hold your Teddy for too long, you will be in big danger!

title: PortalBox
description: This game introduces portals to the classic box-pushing game! With the addition of portals, problems that were impossible in the ordinary box-pushing game become possible. Let’s explore this wonderful box-pushing game together!

title: Cool Kid Cody: Season 3 - Episode 02
description: Season 3 Episode 2: Legend of the Ten Dings! In an attempt to turn Daniel Average, Peter and Peggy find themselves fantasy role-playing in Saltamander-Pinte.

title: Rug Cleaning Simulator
description: Rug cleaning simulator is cozy, relaxing first person simulator about running small rug cleaning business. You start as a burned out person that leaves corporate job and open rug cleaning business.

title: Galandrix
description: Galandrix is an arcade game played from a top-down view and features both fast-paced action and real time strategic choices. Select your ship and blast off into the unknown against countless hordes of enemies.

title: Leafblade
description: The coziest mix of ARPG and monster tamer. Fight along the Mons you meet in your adventure to recover the bond between humans and Mons. Take care of your Mons in your farm, improving their combat and farm skills while ensuring their happiness.

title: Tennis Manager 2024
description: The courts have missed you, it’s time to sign your comeback and prove yourself as the greatest tennis manager. Tennis Manager 2024 is back and better than ever! Get ready to strategize, train your new wonderkids, and conquer the courts in the most immersive tennis management experience yet!

title: Sand Nomads
description: Sand Nomads is an open world tactical RPG where you lead a team of nomads looking for riches and fame across a massive futuristic sand planet. Explore the world, recruit companions, chase rewards and unravel the mysteries of ancient alien ruins!

title: Rapid Fury
description: In Rapid Fury (FPS) you blast the monsters and bosses with a shotgun across four arenas. Choose 20 waves of monsters or endless wave. Level up your skills after each wave. Electronic music helps you maintain your firing rhythm. Master the game and climb the leaderboard to the top. Have a blast!

title: Climbing In Barrel With Double-Barrel
description: This is a challenging game about climbing in barrel with double-barrel.

title: Urban Nightmare
description: "urban nightmare" is a first-person psychological horror game with VHS effect. Be careful and attentive, there is something hiding in these rooms, something is watching from the darkness.

title: Judge Sim
description: Step into the role of a judge and decide the fate of every case. Listen to witnesses, examine evidence, uncover contradictions, and deliver verdicts that will change lives. Every decision matters in this tense courtroom simulation full of twists.

title: The Violinist
description: If you love the violin, classical music, or any instrument, this vertical rhythm game is for you.Rosin up your bow, tune your violin, and launch yourself into musical success.

title: Island Party Chaos
description: Island Party Chaos: Dive into a hilarious multiplayer adventure! Navigate whimsical obstacles, conquer wild challenges, and outsmart rivals in the race to be the ultimate party champion. Get ready for laughter, strategy, and unpredictable mayhem – let the chaos begin!

title: Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey
description: "Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton's Journey" is a historical fantasy RPG set in the Wild West. Play as Jake, a cowboy uncovering secrets and exploring towns. Your choices shape Jake's destiny through quests and tough decisions. Experience compelling and fun stories for a memorable experience.

title: Cube Hero
description: Cube Hero is a simple puzzle roguelike deckbuilding game. Build your own powerful deck and defeat your enemies! There are always new enemies, cubes, treasures, and events waiting for you!

title: Lost in the Roots
description: A 2D adventure with a twisted story about guilt, where a girl is kidnapped and held in an attic somewhere in the countryside. Why and who took the girl to this godforsaken place? What to do when there is nowhere to run?

title: Great Feats of Ancient Russ
description: "Great Feats of Ancient Rus: Defenders of the Homeland" is an exciting real-time strategy game where you'll immerse yourself in the atmosphere of ancient Russian mythology and become the leader of a thriving settlement constantly under threat from lizardmen attacks.

title: Blood Reaver
description: A Dark-fantasy, Round-based FPS. Become the Blood Reaver in solo or 4-player co-op. Harness forbidden magic and weaponry to shoot, blast and slice your way through endless hordes of demons. Upgrade your arsenal and survive long enough to discover the ancient secrets of the gods of hell.

title: Moon Samurai
description: Moon Samurai is an intense, engaging action adventure that slips players into the high tops of a young warrior on a mission to defeat a corrupted government in the dangerous lunar city-state of RAM City.

title: Cyber Seekers: Conquest
description: Shoot, strike and hack machines in a rogue lite sci-fi adventure. Slot new abilities and upgrades in each run and become a superior Cyber Seeker.

title: Star Fetchers: Escape from Pork Belly
description: A action filled rouglite boxing game where you'll punch and claw yourself out of the fighting ring "Pork Belly", an illegal gladiator arena hidden in the outskirt of the Gray Zone.

title: Publish or Perish
description: Publish or Perish is a game that simulates working in academia. In order to keep your job, you must publish scientific work. Reviewers are here to get you and all you can do is try to survive. Can you publish enough papers to enjoy tenure? (Contains practical advice for academics)

title: Prism Indigo DX
description: Fight your friends to save your friends in Prism Indigo, a vicious retro-styled bullet hell shooter starring a rookie magical girl.

title: Hexton
description: Explore, build, harvest. Hexton is a relaxing building game where you try to create the largest city possible. Looking for a light challenge? This game's for you!

title: Legends of Aria: Classic
description: Legends of Aria Classic: Rediscover the thrill of MMORPG adventure with reverted ruleset to 2019, including the Karma System and original protected areas. Forge your legacy in a player-driven world of endless possibilities. Join us on a nostalgic journey into classic MMORPG gaming!

title: Singularity Survivors
description: Singularity Survivors throws you into the heart of a post-apocalyptic realm where the very essence of survival is put to the test in a vast, open-world environment. A game that demands wit, will, and strategy, you’re not just fighting to live — you’re crafting a new world from the ashes of the old.

title: Astral Outcast
description: You've become a spaceship captain who transports supplies to Earth's colony on Mars. On a return trip your ship gets lost on the way back to Earth. Can you find out how to survive in space and get back home?

title: S.X.E. Slider
description: A space-themed sliding tile puzzle game featuring 25 gorgeous images with a sci-fi theme.

title: SMYS: Costumes
description: Customize your zglubs with 100+ items to mix together.

title: SMYS: Classic - Costumes
description: Customize your zglubs with 100+ items to mix together.

title: Quatro!: Eclipse DLC
description: Space out with the Quatro! Eclipse DLC!

title: Sleeping With Sakuya Izayoi: ASMR DLC
description: Enjoy this short fully voiced scene that brings the Sleeping With Sakuya Izayoi experience to life through the use of immersive ASMR!

title: Poor Thief
description: We're guiding a thief to steal diamonds on the ground, earning points as we steal diamonds, but constantly being chased by the police.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Tabletop Terror
description: 1 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Classic Tabletop Board Game themed ultra-wide table with multiple playfields!

title: Train Sim World 4: Semmeringbahn - Wiener Neustadt - Mürzzuschlag Route
description: Explore the World's first true mountain railway in Train Sim World 4! Work winding trains at altitude through the rocky, forested peaks of the Austrian Alps. Climb the Semmering Pass before hastening downgrade towards historic Wiener Neustadt.

title: Tiny
description: Tiny: is a first-person platformer. Your goal is to reach the top and achieve a good speedrun. Test your speedrun skills in the weirdest little world you’ve ever climbed through.

title: Demon Save the World
description: "Demon Save the World" is an action rogue game where you play as a gangster to save the world.

title: Avians Against Aviation
description: Play as a bird flying against a hoard of airplanes and other flying machines or creatures in this cartoon themed side-scroller. Eat mosquitos and fight a series of nasty aviators who think the sky is theirs to control. It's either you, or them.

title: Bedrotting
description: This game is about bed rotting. You lie in the bed for 20 days trying to survive.

title: Truck
description: Survive endless hordes of zombies by driving over them and upgrading your truck with weapons. The only way out is to keep driving. Survive 30 minutes in each of the five maps, collect coins and unlock new trucks!

title: Memora Wanderer
description: Memora Wanderer is a cute nostalgic RPG in which you embark on an adventure in the lands of Memora. With an emphasis on world exploration, item gathering, freedom to level up where you want, and freedom to build your character's class, stats, and skills how you see fit.

title: Super Spy Academy
description: Join Leo in Super Spy Academy! Uncover a mysterious plot at a prestigious university, solve puzzles, interact with unique characters, and explore diverse areas to save the school from a perilous fate.

title: Slime Farm
description: Dive into Slime Farm Simulator, where you'll play with, and care for the Cutest magical slimes ever seen! Watch as they Evolve in whimsical ways, strategically manage their Elements and moods, and expand your enchantingly cute slime farm.

title: Sirocco
description: MOBA meets Vampire Survivors in a dynamic 5v5 arena inspired by the legendary Warcraft 3 mod: Battleships. Rally your team as you swap abilities mid-match, load up auto-firing weapons, and craft strategies on the fly in Sirocco. No rules — just fun.

title: Pocket Pusher: The Warehouse
description: A level for Pocket Pusher based on my experiences working in a Warehouse

title: PolarDread
description:
PolarDread is a horror game inspired by games in the Sit And Survive Genre that takes the concept provided in the game and flips it on its head several times, throwing the trailer into tense situations where they will need to act on their feet to avoid bloodthirsty mascots in a winter-themed resort.

Hide under a desk from a massive mechanical bear, throw objects, or even the mascots themselves, close doors, vents, and keep your barring until the clock strikes six.

title: Catch the Vandal
description: Catch the Vandal is an multiplayer game where players take on the roles of both police officers and vandals. Police officers must identify the vandals among the citizens, while the vandals try to disguise themselves and vandalize the city. Have fun competing to achieve objectives and win the game.

title: Zombie Battle
description: The doctors would like create new humans. Stronger, faster humans. But the humans will be zombies. The zombies killing the doctors! Your name is 'Joe'. You are Soldier. You travel the helicopter to Zombie Land, you must save the doctors and kill the zombies.

title: Infinicrypt
description: Take control of one of 3 mighty heroes to vanquish an evil as old as time. Dodge attacks, slay monsters, and collect items in this bullet-hell dungeon-delving roguelike! Are you ready for the infinite depths?

title: Shaqing
description: "Shaqing" is a Chinese horror puzzle game set in "Wuzhan Town". Players must help the protagonist escape an evil scene where dreams and reality blur, and save his beloved. The objective is to help the protagonist escape and save his beloved.

title: Dragon Ruins
description: A dungeon crawling microgame for tired people.

title: Lizards vs Slavs: Arena
description: The great Svyatoslav Igorevich was captured by the evil jackets, and now they force him to fight in the arena.

title: Defense of the Dauntless
description: Endless horde mode tower defense with permanent and per-run progression. Unlock dozens of towers, survive and become dauntless.

title: I Am Etheric
description: I Am Etheric is a realistic first-person horror game in which a man with spiritual power visits a small, secluded psychiatric hospital in a town to banish an archon who can travel through different dimensions

title: Kane no naru Ki
description:
There is only one objective. Defeat the last boss in front of you.
This is a challenging work game centered on combat.
Character development, skill-based combat,
It is recommended for those who are looking for a challenging level of difficulty.

We do not recommend this game to those who are looking for scenario, story element, exploration and adventure element.

title: Pax Solis
description: Pax Solis is a mod for Europa Universalis IV which adds more content to the 1444 start date, especially East Asian content which is relatively neglected by the main game. The map and UI are also changed to an extent.

title: Atlas Novum
description: Atlas Novum is an overhaul mod for Europa Universalis IV which alters many aspects of the game: a massive map overhaul adding in 1000s of new provinces; the addition of 1000+ countries, over 1000 new cultures and a dozen new religions, including a minority system and culture families; a rework of development into wealth, infrastructure and population; 100 new trade goods with dynamic prices determined on supply and demand; and much more.

title: Inspire
description: Inspire is a Stylized Top-Down Shooter set in the near future. Customize your arsenal, soar through the skies with your jetpack, and shoot your way through an alien invasion alongside your transformable backpack companion.

title: Europa Universalis IV: Winds of Change
description: Winds of Change makes wide-ranging changes to twenty nations stretching from the Andean highlands to the vast steppes of Mongolia. There are many new branching missions, government reforms, events, estate privileges and more!

title: Minecraft: Annoying Difficulty
description: Minecraft: Annoying Difficulty is a mod developed by Fundy which adds a new difficulty option that makes the game more annoying to play.

title: Pirate Doom II
description: Pirate Doom II is a 32-level partial conversion for Doom II designed for MBF-compatible source ports, created by Darch.

title: Yars Rising
description:
In WayForward's experienced hands, the Yars franchise becomes an expansive mystery solved through 2D platforming action. Take control of the young hacker Emi Kimura, who is hired by a mysterious patron to infiltrate the shadowy QoTech corporation. Run, jump, sneak, and hack your way through challenges as you slowly unravel a complex secret shrouded in intrigue.

Emi grows in power throughout her adventure, allowing her to retrace her steps and reach previously inaccessible and secret areas. Her evolving hacking skills are critical to solving stimulating minigames that reference the innovative gameplay from the Atari 2600 title Yars' Revenge.

title: SteamWorld Heist II
description: Join Captain Leeway and his ragtag crew as they uncover the enigmatic menace threatening the Great Sea. Equip and upgrade your crew for turn-based gunfights packed with ricochet action and engage in real-time naval combat. Get ready to aim, plot, and plunder in this uproarious Steambot adventure!

title: Security: The Horrible Nights
description: Every time you die, a new story begins. You are the nighttime security guard at a hospital. Your job is to monitor the hospital and fix problems when they happen. Every night, a new horror tale will unfold. If you can survive enough nights, you will learn the truth behind all the horror.

title: Fetish Club
description: From Leather to Chains: Explore Every Fetish Fantasia in Fetish.

title: Diorama Builder: Medieval Castle
description: This expansion of DIORAMA BUILDER brings the diorama "MEDIEVAL CASTLE", which will allow you to assemble a complete Medieval Castle, with a royal bedroom, weapons room, prison, main hall, kitchen and everything with lots of details, such as armor, cannons, crossbows and more!

title: The Tennis Academy
description: The Tennis Academy is a solo-developed action fantasy RPG and dating sim. Uncover the mysteries of the castle-like school while fighting wacky tennis duels with hand-drawn 2D animated characters. Live your best college life, rizz up classmates to become your Doubles Partners, and save tennis!

title: Upstream Ante
description: A poker roguelike. Upstream Ante is a hypnotically satisfying card game based on Texas Hold'em where you place powerful bets, discover game-changing jokers, and choose fate cards to buff and debuff yourself as the game gets more intense for intense and adrenaline-pumping games.

title: Evergreen: Pines Expansion
description: Grow new challenges!Spice your matches with new plants and change how your world grows.

title: Evergreen: Cacti Expansion
description: Grow new challenges!Spice your matches with new plants and change how your world grows.

title: Exoprimal: Nimbus Alpha Kimen Set
description: This pack contains five cosmetic items, including a skin for the Support suit Nimbus α, which provides shotgun melee support. A demon mask imbued with mysterious power! Equip these cosmetic items and bewitch your way victory!

title: Exoprimal: Krieger Alpha Tin Machine Set
description: This pack includes five cosmetic items, including a suit skin for the Tank suit Krieger α, which uses a chargeable shotgun with wide-range scatter shot and compressed fire options. Tin Machine robots transcend generations and are loved by all! Equip these cosmetic items and develop a sturdy defense!

title: Exoprimal: Witchdoctor Mega Man Set
description: This pack contains five cosmetic items, including a suit skin which makes your exosuit take on the appearance of Air Man, with his signature torso propellor. Equip these cosmetic items and dash to the aid of your teammates!

title: Exoprimal: Murasame Alpha Gladiator Set
description: This pack includes five cosmetic items, including a suit skin for the tank Murasame α, which comes with a freezing counterattack. A gladiator in solid armor! Equip these cosmetic items, and scatter your enemies with a swing of your fighting spirit!

title: Exoprimal: Krieger Mega Man Set
description: This pack contains five cosmetic items, including a suit skin which makes your exosuit take on the appearance of the Yellow Devil classic enemy. Equip these cosmetic items and conquer the battlefield like a Yellow Devil!

title: Exoprimal: Skywave Alpha Future Flight Set
description: This pack contains five cosmetic items, including a skin for the Support suit Skywave, which calls down lightning from above to paralyze foes. Future Flight provides comfortable air travel! Equip these cosmetic items and deliver safe and secure support to your allies!

title: Exoprimal: Vigilant Alpha Insurgent Set
description: This pack contains five cosmetic items, including a skin for the Assault suit Vigilant α, which delivers precision blows from a distance. Insurgent, a combat uniform that suits a heavy rifle! Equipped with these cosmetic items, blend in with the battlefield and go after your prey!

title: Rento Fortune: Dice Configurator
description: Rento Dice Configurator is an optional dice editor plugin, which allows you to make your own custom dice to be used in the online, solo and local games. You can make dice like: 0 5 7 7 10 10 or 0 0 10 10 1 1 and be able to choose it before you roll

title: Mojito the Cat: Animals Skins
description: Expand your cube-shaped friend collection with this 4 new animal based skins

title: Eternal Fate: A Journey Begins
description: Old-school style RPG to enjoy a nostalgic tale with difficult and fair gameplay that is fully voiced.

title: Ecto
description: Play as bunny-hopping wizards with flower guns in a never-ending wonderland. Hold a frog in your left hand and a stick gun in your right as you jump around at 25 miles per hour, picking flowers and shooting robots with your friends.

title: Bug & Seek: Weevils DLC
description: This content requires the base game Bug & Seek in order to play.

title: Patriotika RPG: Shadow World
description: Join Patriotika and her team of superheroines and explore New Haven in this comic book-style pixel art RPG!

title: GeoMaze
description: Hexaspherical geo-spatial puzzle game.

title: Pocket Idler: Fishing Pond
description: Welcome, aspiring angler! Pocket Idler: Fishing Pond is the first cast in a series of relaxing and casual idle games designed to deliver bite-sized satisfaction.

title: Pie in the Sky
description: Pluck them. Pluck them all. You are an Australian Magpie on a mission. That mission: Spread havoc, cause mayhem, and grab the occasional unattended piece of food. Menace, rob, and terrify humans, enjoying old-school action arcade gameplay rendered in glorious retro PS2 graphics.

title: Mach Wing
description: In a mythological world dominated by combat ships known as MachWing, Ignis, a brave pilot, will play a significant role. A JRPG-style story unfolds, where battles take on a "Shoot em up" style with RPG and strategy elements. Experience this unusual blend!

title: Ugaris: The Legend Recovered
description: Welcome, Adventurer, to the enigmatic realms of Astonia. A world brimming with danger and opportunity awaits. Arm yourself with valor and let your powers craft your destiny.

title: The College Fantasy Before the End of the Empire
description: A fictional history based text romance adventure game based on the early 20th century. You need to use your choices to determine you, the one you choose, and even the fate of this country in an era where human stars shine.

title: Dissociative
description: A merging of dissociation between dream worlds. Lost in nightmares. Find your way through the desolate worlds, happy dreams and hidden horrors.

title: Lord Of Tower
description: "Lord of Tower" is an action RPG game. Climb the tower and meet the bosses on each floor.Defeat bosses with unique patterns and win in battle. Conquer all the bosses and become the true lord of the tower!

title: Perfect Knife
description: Can you throw the perfect knife?

title: Wrong Number
description: A short yaoi visual novel set in Australia. Go on a date with a stranger, become friends, or maybe something more... or nothing at all.

title: Relict
description: Relict is a sci-fi 3rd person action adventure roguelike shooter with a unique tarot twist on player abilities and enemies. Taking the role of the fool, fight your way through three unique planets to save the universe from a great evil.

title: The Public Domain: The Game
description: The most ambitious asset flip of all time! A new 2D Platformer with Adventure Game elements created by a single rouge nerd! Every single image and sound in this game is taken from a public domain or royalty free source, including a few familiar faces. . .

title: Sales Employee Takeru-Kun
description: Hello World!! This game is based on the image of a Japanese arcade game from the 70's to early 80's where you could easily play by inserting 1 coin. The player will work hard at his sales job to save L.Planning, a company that has been reincarnated into another world.

title: Cafe Maid Girls: Cute Kemono Lifeguard DLC
description:
Hinata will bring the love of the sea to your cafe and makes sure nobody drowns in work!
Unlock her as a new playable character along with the following items:
Her own 6 flirt chapters
6 H-scenes unlocked through the flirt chapters
Deploy her in your cafe!

title: FreshBallFall
description: Colourful 3D-platformer where you help your Ball-friend in his adventures through different levels and obsticles.

title: Mystical Riddles: Ghostly Park - Collector's Edition
description: What is the price of eternal life? Stop the atrocious ritual! Don't let evil prevail! The soul hunter will spare no one. Can you master the willpower to win?

title: Backrooms Invasion
description: BACKROOMS INVASION is an exciting horror game that will give you a unique experience. Prepare for a challenge that will test your teamwork, wits and endurance! Multiplayer for up to 8 people!

title: Finsternis Kreuz
description: A high-speed barrage-absorbing 2D action movie in which a girl who wields a magic sword that devours everything confronts vampires with two swords. Turn your enemy's power into a sword and devour vampires.

title: BattleTanks: Animal Wars
description: Welcome to BattleTanks! Join friends to defend animals from moles in co-op game. Explore 5 worlds with 80+ missions. Face bosses, gather tank parts, and craft your machine. Play with up to 4 friends. Ready to save the world?

title: Human Souvenir
description: You just visited the earth and got a famous 'Human Souvenir'. Would you be able to keep your human alive enough time to see them through their whole life cycle?

title: Creature Match
description: Creature Hunt Is A point-and-click Matching Game. With 111 unique, hand-drawn creatures, three difficulty levels, and an endless mode, it offers endless fun for all ages. Players can level up by catching numerous creatures, enhancing their gaming experience.

title: Distant Oceanic Getaway
description: Distant Oceanic Getaway - A Dating Adventure for WLW. You take on the role of Maeve, a heartbroken woman determined to move on from her cheating ex by embarking on this cruise alone. Will Maeve open her heart to new romance and the possibility of finding her soulmate at sea?​​

title: Ninjam!
description: "Ninjam! is a multiplayer action game for up to 4 players where cute ninja characters move freely and compete against each other on a 3D map."

title: Mega Mosaic
description: Mega Mosaic is a meditative game about completing a single enormous puzzle

title: Ruby Dreams: Immortal Promise
description: As a maid in the elegance of a vampire household, use clues from your dreams to earn the love of your masters.

title: Maze Pursuit
description: A Roguelike survival science fiction game, easy to operate, quickly get started

title: Anime Girl Puzzles: Misuzu
description: Misuzu is trained in many forms of combat. Students come from far away, eager to learn from her. Sometimes, her lessons can be painful.

title: Anime Girl Puzzles: Rin
description: Rin always manages to make her patients feel better. Come lie down on the bed, relax, and show her where it hurts.

title: A Difficult Game About Jumping
description: One Small Mistake Will Cost Your Lot Of Progress

title: Morgman
description: MORGMAN is a first-person horror game, a hybrid of classic survival horror and puzzle. You find yourself deep in the forest, in an abandoned mansion with a dark past. You'll need to explore its dark corridors and rooms while staying alive.

title: Yoru ga Kuru!: Square of the Moon - Remastered
description: Ryou lives a dull life in Otsuna until a red-eyed girl named Izumi invites him to join her fight against the Light Hunters. When the True Moon rises, the Light Hunters descend upon the city, leaving chaos in their wake. Cloaked in the shadows of the night, this story of supernatural suspense begins.

title: Jötunn's Greed
description: Jötunn's Greed is a fast-paced extraction-looter where you raid villages and grow your clan with the loot you acquire. Build up enough power to take on the giant that wronged your people!

title: Lovebugz: An Anthro Insect Dating Sim
description: A point and click visual novel about bug girls.

title: Mini Micro Racing
description: Race through varied environments and master your vehicle to achieve victory. Annihilate your opponents with fun weapons, like the firework or the wasp!

title: BossCrafter
description: Challenge various bosses designed by the director using characters with distinct traits. Study classic boss mechanics, hone your combat skills, unlock hundreds of boss abilities, unleash your creativity, and craft a boss that's uniquely yours!

title: Aquarist: Japanese Garden
description: Japanese Garden DLC is all that you love Aquarist for and so much more. The largest and most beautiful location comes with a plethora of new fish, decorations️, plants, and other interesting additions. Get it and start your aquarist relax in Japanese style.

title: Deathtroopers: The Outpost
description: The story is very simple, but it connects directly with the original: a fleeing soldier ends up crashing into Endor. Here he will find death and a deadly virus, already widespread throughout much of the Outer Rim of the known galaxy. Seeking help, he finds an old resistance outpost, seemingly abandoned. In an attempt to find a means of communication to call for help, he enlists the help of his faithful but damaged droid DD5. Having learned of the events that are happening on the planets around his own, he decides to embark on a fight for survival without any other choice.

title: RGB Rush 2
description: Can you adjust these raw images for a client? Advance your dream of becoming a colour grading professional. Beat the clock, impress your crush again! Practice today! The long awaited sequel.

title: Politician Simulator
description: A short, 5 minute funny game about politicians

title: Ninja Slayer: Neo-Saitama In Flames
description: A fast-paced action platformer based on the world of Ninja Slayer, a hit manga that sold 4.44 million copies! In the fictional cyberpunk city of Neo-Saitama, take control of Ninja Slayer as he does battle with numerous evil ninjas, all to avenge the death of his wife and child.

title: Fear Tape
description: You are a police officer who needs to investigate an abandoned hospital to remove some invaders, survive the frightening and terrifying environment with your gun and flashlight! Good luck!

title: GrannyHop
description: The game "GrannyHop" is an arcade game where grandma jumps on a graveyard, passes difficult levels, collects bonuses and defeats obstacles. Addictive gameplay and colorful graphics.

title: Innocent Grape
description: Humour and hentai - what could go better together than these!? Become a promiscuous Ann in this 2D visual novel. Help her realize all her crazy sexual fantasies and fulfill her dream! What could go wrong...?

title: Recycling Center Simulator
description: Step into 'Recycling Center Simulator,' a first-person job simulator where you spearhead a recycling operation. Navigate through neighborhoods, workshops, and factories, collecting and sorting a wide variety of materials. Transform waste into wealth by recycling and manufacturing products.

title: Melting Encyclopedia
description: Interactive 3d encyclopedia of alien dimensions

title: Bubble Dogs
description: Reunite the dog families of each breed and try to conjure up hearts, kibbles, golden paws and bones to score maximum points !

title: Cat Got Your Tongue
description: Cat Got Your Tongue is a vertical platformer where you play a mischievous black cat, jumping and attacking across a tongue to stop the protagonist from speaking, with quirky art, playful interactions, and fast-paced, challenging yet casual gameplay.

title: Free Trader
description: You are a merchant trading in the vastness of space.

title: Ushuaïa, Le Jeu: À la Poursuite des Biotrafiquants
description:
A 3rd action-adventure game about saving nature and the animals.
You play as Lena Green, a member of the Ushuaïa Sentinels nature protection organization.
Your mission: to put an end to the activities of biotraffickers.
Run, jump, infiltrate, investigate, coach your teammates... to complete your extreme mission!

title: Onibi
description: Dash, possess, and explore your way through different areas as you accompany a child on their adventures as their fledgling guardian spirit.

title: NudGirls
description: NudGirls is a big collection of riddles and puzzles. You are going to explore various worlds and meet incredibly beautiful girls. Pass the test using your intelligence. Undressed charming bodies and no clothes on. Would you like to receive your reward?

title: Cat Meoir: Feline Detective
description: Cat Meoir: Feline Detective is an open world exploration game based in the heart of New York City during the early 1950's. The player must use their cat-like skills to solve puzzles, string together clues, and navigate the city to solve the case of their owners murder.

title: Retrozen
description: Enter the realm of RetroZen, where neon glows amidst palm trees, synthwave tunes echo, and '80s supercars race endlessly on highways. Welcome to RetroZen's world!

title: Oh My God! Crush!
description: What is the most heart wrenching moment for you? Is it a warm smile from the person you like? Or was it a sudden surprise waiting for him? Is it the sweet expectation of ordinary life? Or a sudden look back after a thousand twists and turns—— Oh my goodness! It's a heartwarming feeling.

title: Radiosol
description: RADIOSOL is a journey through a desolate world burned by a planetary cataclysm. In search of answers, you will have to navigate through the ruins of megastructures and abandoned cities, avoiding the scorching rays of the Sun.

title: Truth Seekers
description: Truth Seekers is a horror multiplayer cooperative shooter game centered around hunting urban legends and folklore monsters. Find and craft items to aid in your attack, all while strategizing with others to learn the monsters' behaviors before they learn yours...

title: Shopping Benfica
description: Shopping Benfica is a game about me and my best friend from high school beating the shit out of Totally Not Monica and Friends in Fortaleza.

title: Midgard Lava-a-Jato
description: A washing and dress-up game featuring Final Fantasy characters.

title: Two Fates
description: "Two Fates" is a cooperative MAP-pack for Serious Sam made for two players, where coordinated teamwork needed to successfully complete each level. It consists of 4 maps, different in style and difficulty.

title: Eternis: Death Match
description:
Eternis: Death Match, the ultimate arena where ancient legends and futuristic technology collide in heart-pounding battles!
Choose from a roster of iconic characters like Cleopatra and Isaac Newton, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Engage in intense one-on-one duels, thrilling tournaments, and epic guild wars as you climb the ranks to become a legend in your own right.

Explore dynamic environments, hone your skills, and discover new strategies in this ever-evolving battlefield. With regular updates, new features, and exciting events, there's always something new to experience in Eternis: Death Match.

But Eternis is more than just a game; it's a living, breathing world shaped by its passionate community.
Join our Discord community to unlock exclusive behind-the-scenes content, participate in lively discussions, and collaborate with developers to shape the game's future. Your feedback matters, and together, we'll continue to evolve Eternis into the ultimate gaming experience.

Are you ready to write your own legend? Join us in Eternis: Death Match and let the battles begin!

title: One Day Hike
description: ONE DAY HIKE is a brief interactive fiction where you revisit an old, familiar hiking trail and recount the memories that you've tried-- and failed-- to leave behind.

title: The Ruby Court
description: The Ruby Court is an interactive fiction game that takes inspiration from 90s and 2000s vampire fiction, with themes about conformity/the queer experience. And blood. Lots of blood.

title: Supermarket Shopping Simulator
description: Shopping Strategies: Beyond the Cart

title: Aetherise
description: You are created as a new soul directly from the Aether, you don't know why you're here or what you're supposed to do. As you start exploring the world, you start making up choices for yourself, and eventually decide how the world around you will evolve with you.

title: 22 Minutes
description: In 22 Minutes, players must conquer barriers and fight opponents to progress through the story under a time constraint of 22 minutes.

title: Critical Upload
description: Embark on a fast-paced action journey through space, discovering new weapons and abilities through acquisition and research to better each run. Invite friends to experience it with you!

title: Capibara Lost Dream
description: Enjoy the story of Frank and his adventure to escape from an island dominated by a cult of humanoid Capybaras, fight, explore, have sex and meet lots of fun characters!

title: Blood Within
description: With the fall of the mighty Bloodstar, the universe plunged into chaos. Unleash your inner power alongside Captain Thorne, vanquish demons, and restore the order of light.

title: Blood Typers
description: TYPE TO KILL in this survival horror adventure. Alone or with friends, explore a sprawling cursed film studio as its horror movies bleed into reality. Choose from a roster of characters then plan your escape from this bloody homage to old school horror. But remember... death is just a typo away.

title: Anomaly Hotel
description: You start from the 10th floor in a hotel and must make your way to the exit. However, you must look for any potential anomalies on each floor to safely make it out.

title: Any Way Out
description: Explore a mysterious hotel's treacherous corridors to reach the bottom floor and escape. Use your wits to spot anomalies, avoiding traps to progress. Trust your intuition to overcome challenges and find freedom.

title: Boats N' Hoes
description: Boats N' Hoes is a combat game based around using boats as a player and hoes as a weapon type. Attack other boats with hoes and avoid their hoes to become the best at Boats N' Hoes.

title: Celebrity Hunter
description: The most ambitious indie adult VN with 70+ hours of gameplay! Live your hottest fantasies with 9 main characters (and dozens of others) in 3,500+ 4k scenes. Create your cinematic story with 2,100+ impactful choices and over 30 endings! After 3 mi downloads in Brazil, CH comes to seduce you!

title: Uberich: Advent Sinners
description: The elusive shadow, the horrifying tunnel, the assassin, the haunted ruin, the High-orbit Space Station, the Creators, the Power Words, the religious wars, and the organization that only exist in Annie's words. What kind of future will it create when these seemingly irrelevant pieces come together?

title: Wax Heads
description: A cosy-punk slice-of-life narrative sim about managing a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues – all to restore the groove!

title: Wild West Blast
description: Welcome to Wild West Blast – Your Ultimate Adventure in the Wild West and Your New Favorite Aim Trainer!Step into the boots of a fearless bounty hunter in the heart of the untamed prairie.

title: Scrollden
description: Home-building meets nurturing mythological creatures.

title: Scrap Collector
description: In Scrap Collector collect, combine, and automate card production. Make your robot empire and take on the enemies of the overgrown and mutated earth.

title: The Reeve
description: You are an Administrator serving your probationary period in a medieval town. Make decisions to affect the town's reputation, order, might and supplies. Choose wisely to deal with bandits, famines, cultists and plagues. The most difficult choices will decide the fate of your town!

title: The Mournmore Killings
description: The Mournmore Killings a story-driven, deduction based mystery game where you step into the shoes of a detective trying to solve the enigmatic riddles left behind by a serial killer.

title: The Math Challenge
description: Embark on a thrilling space adventure as an astronaut, where logic and math are your keys to survival. Navigate through challenges, unravel mysteries, and conquer the cosmos.

title: The Clown's Forest: Fear of a Survivor
description: Sarah Baines somehow survived the trap in that basement. She is trapped in the collapsed house of horrors in Hartown Amusement Park, and Chester is relentlessly pursuing her. But something dark is manifesting around her. Can she survive the horrors?

title: Terminal ESC
description: No docs. No tutorial. No escape. Inspired by a bad day with a package manager.

title: Horny Mage Chronicles
description: A succubus has attacked your home, leaving you the only one to have escaped. A mysterious witch has rescued you, and proposes that you defeat the succubus... with your body?

title: Love at The Milky Way Diner
description: A LGBT-friendly cozy sci-fi cooking/dating sim about making friends, finding love, and running a diner in deep space.

title: Medical Diagnostic Simulator
description: Play as a general practitioner in this text-based medical simulation game. Consult, examine, and diagnose your patients in your own medical practice.

title: Million Star Ship
description: This is a single player defense game for interstellar strategy. We have established 36 birth points. Players can freely switch birth points to control the size of the enemy. Set the moon as a base. Our fleet can conquer the universe and find legendary warships. Our journey is the sea of stars.

title: Néro & Sci ∫ Integral Edition
description: In Néro & Sci, players explore a poetic world inspired by mathematics, where shapes, colors, and symbols form the backdrop of a unique adventure. Through the original “White Dimension” mechanic, they uncover a simplified version of the world that reveals new solutions to puzzles.

title: Plane Starship2: Galactic Contender
description: This is a 4x turn-base strategy game which uses a fast-paced warchess system. You can develop your planet, expand your territory by colonizing and building space stations, research technology to unlock more ships, and ultimately discover and eliminate your enemies.

title: DunJaunt
description: A focused dungeon running romp through the fantasy world of Relaryia! The land is sliding into chaos, and it's up to you with the help of a party of 4 elemental avatars to bring balance back to the world. Pick your favorites from Fire, Water, Storm, Earth, Light, and Darkness and cleanse the world!

title: Elemental Novice
description: Embark on a thrilling journey in a world of elemental magic. Play as a young wizard mastering the elements to survive against dark forces. Explore haunting landscapes, hone your spells, and unravel mysteries while battling supernatural foes in this captivating adventure

title: Fairy Biography 6: Revenge
description: In the game, players need to use mouse clicks to control gunpowder props, and through careful aiming and calculation, continuously fire cannons to clear all the treasure boxes in front of them!

title: Fallen: Fatal Force
description: Description:This game is a psychic action game. Escape from the maze-like research facility by manipulating telekinesis, levitation, and teleportation.

title: Fantasy Quest: Errandsaga
description: Bin, has been brainwashed by the demon 'Basilisk'.Visit the mercenary agency 'Ninas Errand' on the continent of Mirgard.

title: Forest of Fear
