description: Baby Fox lost his way and Swiper has volunteered to take him home. With help from Dora, Boots, and you, Swiper will fulfill his kind quest. But you'll have to be very careful because crows, spiders and bats are around and they will try to slow him down.

title: Gothic Remake Collector's Edition
description:
Gothic Remake Collector's Edition includes:

- Gothic Remake
- 34x24cm Sleeper wall mask
- Genuine leather wristband
- Genuine leather notebook
- Original soundtrack

title: Sengoku Gensokyo
description: Being a parody beetwen the Rance and Touhou series, the story sets the player as Hakurei Reimu into a situation where Gensoukyou has been divided up into various warring states. The ever mischievous Yakumo Yukari, the culprit behind the start of this war game, has sent out letters to all of the major factions of the world laying out the rules of the game and promising to grant one wish for the winning team.

title: Aelfric the Wondrous
description: A short kinetic novel made by LadyMeowsith.

title: Quetzal
description: Control a Mesoamerican god who must escape the underworld in this challenging 2D pixel art platformer, dodging dangers to recover the sacred bones of humanity.

title: Trapped Inside a Train (And There's Nothing You Can Do About It)
description:
You're stuck inside a train. There's got to be something you can do to get out, right?

(A short, nonsensical experimental game. Featuring several endings, including a 'true' one unlocked by seeing all the others, snark, and a train.)

title: Of Slimes and Sandwiches
description:
Of Slime and Sandwiches was a collaborative project made over several discord calls with friends.

The plot, characters, artwork and other aspects were all decided on the spot during those calls, and the result was this: a masterpiece for the ages.

title: Jak the Chicken
description: Adds over 18 levels and 900+ collectibles to the game and new powerups and adventures!

title: Batman: The Brave and the Bold - Streets of Gotham: Full Throttle
description:
Hit the streets or take to the air in the Gotham Grand Prix!
Now you can fly along with Gotham City's wildest rides!
Win to unlock more bonus features.
Come in first on the driving levels and watch a special video associated with each track!
Come in first on any one of the flying tracks and take flight in the Batjet!

title: RamsaySnap
description: A game about shooting characters for points but you need to avoid killing the wrong people. Instead of SnapShot characters you will be aiming real people but avoid the SnapShot characters at all costs.

title: Saint Seiya: Exclamation
description: Saint Seiya: Exclamation is a Brazilian RPG fangame with characters in the SD (Super Deformed) style. The story continues in an original way with the series, but with the addition of two new characters: Yusei from Vulpecula and Aki from Apus! The new characters were introduced so that the game follows a new line and is not too predictable for the player! When starting the game you can choose between Male (Yusei) and Female (Aki), each of which has exclusive stories in the game!

title: Saint Seiya: Caos Chapter
description: Saint Seiya: Chaos Chapter created by Yuri Fernandes is a Brazilian Knights of the Zodiacs fangame divided into chapters where the world is in Chaos and it is up to the golden knights to restore peace to the world.

title: Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque: Il Faut Sauver Athena
description: Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Il faut sauver Athena are a french fangame of Knights of Zodiac made for Loulou Martoni.

title: Sonic Boom: A Dating Sonamy Sim?!
description:
Sonic Boom A Dating Sonamy Sim?! or SBDSS, is a bite-size visual novel fan-game made to attempt to tackle an idea I've always had lurking (menacingly) in the back of my mind: "What if there was a sonamy dating sim?"

Following the events of Sonic Boom S2 EP. 44 : Sonic the newly appointed delivery boy is led to a house along the water's edge. Greeted by a familiar face with... intentions, he plays along.

title: Battle City Remake
description:
Battle City Remake is a remake of the original game produced and published by Namco at the year 1985. The game is a multi-directional shooter where you control a tank that must destroy all 20 enemies in each stage to advance to the next level. The enemy tanks on the other side attempt to destroy the player's base as well as the player.

The remake contains all the original 35 stages of the game, but with improved graphics. Like always the idea of our remake is improve the game visuals, but keep the gameplay the most close possible to the original game.

title: Orchid Labyrinth
description: When reunited with two girls who bear her likeness within a deep dream, will Dahlia finally figure out what she really wants? This is a short visual novel with a run time of about 30 minutes.

title: Melo's Nightmare
description:
Melo's Nightmare is a first-person perspective 3D escape horror game.
Players find themselves trapped in corridors and must investigate puzzles to attempt escape.
Fulfilling the conditions to escape hidden passageways will unlock the next door.
Activating or finding the correct puzzle triggers changes in the environment.

title: Feline Forensics and the Meowseum Mystery
description: There's only one detective to unravel this murder turned museum heist... and they're the cat's meow. Interrogate a "colorful" cast of suspects until they cough up hairballs... and the truth. Will you wrap up the case in time for an afternoon nap, and make injustice knead its last biscuit?

title: Detective Bass: Fish Out Of Water
description:
There has a murder on a luxurious cruise ship!

As the clever, wise, and handsome Detective Bass you must investigate 8 fish-people to decide who is responsible and put them behind bars.

title: The Case of Andrew D.
description: A forensic challenge - help private eye solve cases for their clients using OSINT and digital forensics techniques.

title: Dune Dasher
description: Endless Desert Destruction

title: Rogue Citadel
description: Unlock new defences, collect powerful items and create game-breaking synergies in this roguelite tower defence survivors game.

title: Sonic Mayhem
description: To celebrate the 20th anniversary of the release of Quake 2 comes this singleplayer unit based on a side-mission to Stroggos!

title: Quake II: Sewer Jam Volume 1
description: Sewer levels are notoriously hard to get right. That’s why Andrew Yoder set out to challenge the Quake community to come up with good sewer levels all the way back in 2019. We wanted to do the same for the Quake 2 Remaster and that resulted in this package. Featuring nine new maps, a hub level and pre-rendered cutscenes. We hope you enjoy Map-Center’s Quake 2 Sewer Jam Volume 1.

title: Jam Talk
description: It tells the story of a developer's very early beginnings and what video games mean to him.

title: Chiclana & Friends: The Game
description: Try to survive as many waves as possible with the best score in this game in which you control three characters at the same time.

title: Heian City Story
description:
A city-building sim with a historical twist
Travel back to olden times and become Director of your own city!
Attract new residents and try to become the greatest city in the land! Add buildings like restaurants and teahouses to make your town a place where samurai and commoners alike will want to live.

title: Paraiso
description: Get the cup of immortality and escape the temple with all the treasures you can find!

title: Pursuit Force: Extreme Justice
description: This game is a sequel to the first Pursuit Force. This is a game which alternates between driving and shooting, in which you must keep Capital City safe from five ruthless and well-equipped gangs.

title: La Gran Alameda
description:
La Gran Alameda is a limit-removing map (complevel 2) set in the middle of a city under an otherworldly red sky. Make your way out of the facility and bring the fight to the rooftops! The city is completely infested, so watch out for fire coming from every direction.
This is not like the other bimonthly demon invasions though... This time they've brought some backup

title: Slugger
description: Slugger is a 10-15 mins short and punchy map for Doom 2

title: 2 Hours to Kill!
description: 2 Hours to Kill is a Doom II community speedmapping session in MBF21 format with a focus on refined combat. This set is split into 2 episodes depending on the kind of action: traditional Doom gameplay or slaughter.

title: Decomission
description: A map that was originally meant for a personal project that never happened. Mainly a brown storage facility with plenty of green foliage.

title: Embraced
description: Embraced is small set of 3 maps focusing on combat puzzle and slaughter(4th map progress stopper). Adding again to the green techbase crowd but this time with a lot of wood textures!

title: Escape From Sunveil Starport
description: Escape From Sunveil Starport is an MBF21 compatible mini-wad spanning 9 or so maps, initially created during NaNoWadMo2023. This project serves as a prequel to A2Rob's NaNoWadMo 2022 contribution, Machete. Initially, their plan was to ape off level concepts from Knee-Deep in the Dead.

title: Sanguine Holy Land
description: Sanguine Holy Land is a new episode for Doom 2 designed for limit removing source ports (complevel 2) made by the various members of Doomer Boards, lead by BiZ. The project theme was marble temples and blood rituals.

title: Rosy Rubicunda
description: A small 4-map (+ 1 intro and 1 credits map) collaborative wad between OverflowingMocha and Stephyesterday. Features somewhat tough microslaughter and a cute color palette.

title: Terror Signal
description: Terror Signal is a set of 17 maps(14 normal, 2 secret, 1 epilogue) designed for MBF21. It features new enemies along with some modified weapon and enemy behavior.

title: Tsumobaka Nisshi
description: You play a long-haired salaryman as he visits random clubs to play in 4-player mahjong against girls, who strip if they run out of funds. The games don't end until you either strip all of the girls or run out of funds yourself.

title: Forsaken Compound
description: Forsaken Compound is a limit-removing E1 replacement wad for Doom 1. There's a mix of action/slaughtery gameplay and more simple, atmosphere-oriented parts that require some thinking, overall intended to be more difficult than normal Knee Deep in the Dead-style mapping, as well as more visually distinct and varied than that episode. Texturing is all done from the IWAD with an excellent custom palette by Dir, and some sound replacements from Doom 64 and Doom 3.

title: Le Gars Qui A Fait Doom
description: "Le Gars Qui A Fait Doom" Level Collection is a series of 8 new Ultimate Doom maps for Limit Removing ports. They come in all styles and colors, and all of them are more or less inspired by John Romero, whether it's his old IWad maps, his modern offerings (SIGIL and its sequel), his other games, or even his real life. You can play each of these maps in any order you fancy, as there's no clear theme or difficulty order. Each wad can be played standalone, à la Master Levels, and some of them contain new textures and resources.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 3
description: You’ve seen her in a crown, now see her in Fortnite. Award-winning artist Billie Eilish is the Icon of Fortnite Festival Season 3!

title: Crate Expectations
description: Crate Expectations is a full megawad of random high concept maps that push limit removing to its limits and maybe the player too! Besides a connecting theme of interactive crates which you will learn about while playing, each map is designed to be totally random and surprising and keep you on your toes - stay sharp!

title: Doom 2 In City Only
description: Doom 2 In City Only is a 36 map megawad in MBF21 format featuring nothing but city maps. Some of these maps are very large, so it is recommended you play with OpenGL. The set was primarily tested in dsda-doom. There are 6 secret maps (one per episode) with the secret exit being in the middle map of each episode. Jumping and freelook are not intended for this set and will break some maps.

title: Machine Men
description: Machine Men is a single map with plenty of grunt set in an abandoned lava-strewn demonic foundry. The title is inspired by the Bruce Dickinson song of the same name.

title: Super Doom TV
description: Doomguy is off to fight in the biggest event in galactic history, Super Doom TV! Every eyeball on every creature on every planet will be tuned to broadcast-compliant screens everywhere to see him plow through 25 sectors of high definition carnage. Super Doom TV is a 25 map megawad where each map was given an arena title from the SNES classic Super Smash T.V. as a prompt for mappers to work from. ﻿

title: Beasties of Greenhollow
description: Beasties of Greenhollow is a strategic turn based team building game that features a collection of cute creatures based of Scottish mythology. Explore a mysterious realm of fairies, elves, magic, and creatures while fighting to the center of this hidden realm at the request of a mysterious masked figure. What are Shellycoat’s true intentions?

title: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Gotopazu Story 2nd
description: A follow-up to The Quintessential Quintuplets: Quints Puzzle Story The Quintessential Quintuplets: Quints Puzzle Story2nd is a “memorial adventure game” featuring the events, cards, and stories from “The Quintuplets Can't Divide the Puzzle Into Five Equal Parts”, the October 27, 2020-released smartphone game based on The Quintessential Quintuplets, minus the puzzle game elements.

title: Full Swing Golf
description: Full Swing GOLF Software - The most realistic golf simulation software in the industry. The best graphics and the best courses because your game deserves the best.

title: Invasão
description: About halfway through A 2ª Jornada, Sirey and his companions built 1 million Teenooks and sent them to the alien ships in orbit. And now you control just one of these robots, Teenook965421, who has infiltrated the tunnels of an alien mothership.

title: Star Wars Outlaws: Special Edition
description:
Experience the first-ever open world Star Wars game, set between the events of The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi. Explore distinct planets across the galaxy, both iconic and new. Risk it all as Kay Vess, an emerging scoundrel seeking freedom and the means to start a new life, along with her companion Nix. Fight, steal, and outwit your way through the galaxy’s crime syndicates as you join the galaxy’s most wanted.

The Special Edition includes the base game and the Sabacc Shark Character Pack.

title: Star Wars Outlaws: Ultimate Edition
description:
Experience the first-ever open world Star Wars game, set between the events of The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi. Explore distinct planets across the galaxy, both iconic and new. Risk it all as Kay Vess, an emerging scoundrel seeking freedom and the means to start a new life, along with her companion Nix. Fight, steal, and outwit your way through the galaxy’s crime syndicates as you join the galaxy’s most wanted.

The Ultimate Edition includes the base game, the season pass, the Rogue Infiltrator bundle, the Sabacc Shark bundle, a digital art book, and 3 days early access.

title: A 3ª Jornada
description: After the destruction of Earth and Mars caused by the alien invasion, the human beings guided by Sirey are now living inside spaceships. Ten years after A 2ª Jornada, Sirey’s fleet is approaching a new solar system, where they’ll find a new planet... and new adventures.

title: Spotlight!!!
description: A lighthearted tale about two childhood friends, Juanita Santos and Xiang Li, on a 'quest' to return a cellphone to their classmate, an admittedly forgetful but cute witch. Shenanigans ensue.

title: Trump Quest
description: The 2016 American election has escalated to biblical proportions and World War III has begun. Donald Trump has taken his stance against the most important issues plaguing the world straight to the front lines. Brought to you by the same team that built the masterpiece known as Mystery Combat Man 3, TRUMP QUEST delivers an experience unrivaled among all source mods, video games, and perhaps entertainment as a whole.

title: Mystery Combat Man 4: The End of Time
description: The conclusion to the multi-award-winning Mystery Combat Man Franchise, MCM4 strives to be the best sequel to the worst mod ever made! The Mystery Combat Squad returns to an absurdist world of action and intrigue. Following the events of MCM3, a mysterious disruptor has broken into the time bank, setting off a catastrophic chain of events that threatens the timeline of the planet of the Earth. Who could have done this, and why? Whoever he his, he must be tracked down and brought to justice at any cost, and it's all down to the Mystery Combat Man to hunt him down across the space-time continuum. Will he succeed? It's all up to you, the player, in... Mystery Combat Man 4: The End of Time!

title: Learn to Play Vol. 2: A Simple Shooter
Gemz
description: Immerse yourself in the fast-paced world of Gemz, where your shield stands as the last line of defense against advancing gemstones. Use precise control to block and smash gems, collecting powerups, coins, and facing off against mini-bosses along the way. As time ticks away, the gems intensify in speed, testing your reflexes and strategic thinking. Combine powerups for ultimate survival as you strive for the highest score and become the ultimate Gemz master!

title: BMX Wild Run
description: Unleash Your BMX Spirit in the Wild!

title: Escape the Glitch 2: Backrooms
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure deep within the eerie Backrooms in our latest game. Your task remains the same: find five elusive bottles hidden throughout the maze-like corridors while dodging the relentless pursuit of the glitcher.

title: Heritage of Eternal Splitting
description: Heritage of Eternal Splitting is an exciting puzzle-adventure game, pitting players against challenging missions in a mysterious world. This game will draw you in with its unique game mechanics and impressive atmosphere.

title: Mounted Knights Battle: Medieval Warrior Honor Simulator
description: Experience the thrill of medieval chivalry in Mounted Knights Battle, where you'll embark on a captivating journey as a courageous knight vying for honor and romance. Craft your own legendary warrior, proudly wave your chosen flag, and fortify your armor, spear, and steed to triumph in prestigious tournaments held across a multitude of vibrant cities.

title: Summer Games Challenge
description: Go for Gold!

title: Superpoke! Pets
description: SuperPoke! Pets were a virtual goods game for Facebook and MySpace, where you take care of a virtual pet.

title: H2O Root After and Another Complete Story Edition
description: Bundle of H2O: Footprints in the Sand and Root After and Another, for the complete experience in just one game.

title: Psoltrix
description: Play Tetris on a regular dodecahedron or icosahedron. The latest development in falling-block technology.

title: ULTRAKILL: Masquerade Divinity
description: A fan-mod that adds a new playable character and mode to the fast-paced character action FPS, ULTRAKILL.

title: Flood of Tears
description: An annoying protagonist, an ordinary school life, a few friends here and there. This is the story of a young man who falls in love willingly, and perhaps of a couple young women who fall in love somewhat less willingly.

title: Thinking Of U: A Love Story
description: After a long battle with the Dark Lord, Fiona has saved the world from darkness. Now, all she wants to do is relax on her vacation, without any more trouble...

title: Velev
description: Dive into VELEV's depths, a hidden world where technology and nature merge. Embark on quests, battle monsters, and unveil mysteries with enhanced gear. Experience intense PvPvE combat, strategic team play across diverse classes, and continuous character growth through exploration and extraction

title: Toasterdog in Dreamworld
description: Your shift as the Toaster Dog has started, yet you yearn for the appreciation you deserve for your passionate work. It's time to go ask the boss for a raise!!

title: Wake Me Up If You Need Me
description: wake up a cute sleepy grumpy boy at 1AM

title: Rejected Custom Night
description: Rejected Custom Night is an "Ultimate Custom Night" fangame.

title: Twins Minigame
description: Bounce and dive between two opposed worlds. Jump over spikes, gather coins, and drive the twin between contrary gravities.

title: FNaF Free Edition
description: Fan made playable version of "Five Nights at Freddy's Ransomware"

title: The Smurfs: Dreams
description: It is a 3D platform game with puzzle elements and solo or cooperative gameplay. There are 12 levels in total and another 16 mini-levels. Players can customize their Smurfs with special magical orbs and tokens taken from bosses.

title: Free Slots Fun Factory
description: Travel the world and enjoy tons of different slot tables.

title: Saltwater
description: Play as a pistol shrimp and survive waves of enemies while collecting pearls from oysters scattered throughout the map.

title: Guardian Angel
description: Guardian Angel is a short point-and-click narrative game about finding your way through the world on your own.

title: Boku no Knife de Kimi wo Tasuketai
Centum
description: An unreliable narrative-driven adventure game. You are trapped, and you must escape. But is that really the goal?

title: All You Need is Help
description:
Dive into a quirky multiplayer co-op puzzle game where adorable, fluffy cube-shaped creatures collaborate to reach their goals. These creatures, each oddly shaped, jostle against each other to help solve puzzles together. When in trouble, shout "HELP!" and friends will surely come to your aid. With everyone's strength, turn friendships into friend-shapes!

The game's intuitive, straightforward controls mean that anyone can jump right in. You'll control creatures that are shaped differently as you progress through each level, to clear challenges. Although these creatures can move around freely, they cannot rotate, necessitating the need for teamwork to solve the puzzles. Join forces to overcome obstacles and reach your goals together!

title: Promise Mascot Agency
description: Explore the cursed town of Kaso-Machi! Recruit and train mascot friends! Help out when jobs go wrong! Solve the mystery of your exile! Help Pinky work through her many anger issues! Turn Promise Mascot Agency into the best agency in Japan! Go go, Michi and Pinky!

title: Vampire Survivors: Laborratory Update
description: Plunging players into the dark halls of a corrupted science lab, our free new Laborratory Update pushes Vampire Survivors to such wild new heights that we're calling it our first ‘AAAA’ update. Industry-defining innovations include fully rendered running animations, mind-blowing train physics, go-cart racing, and... doors that open??

title: Ashen Sky
description: Inspired by the thrilling, mystical and at the same time exciting and adventurous worlds of the Roadside Picnic novel, Stalker movie and, of course, famous S.T.A.L.K.E.R. games, Ashen Sky aims to recreate the sensation of being face to face with the vast unknown. The gameplay is harsh and combat is unforgiving, since casual shootouts without serious consequences are not what this codebase aims for; instead, it is about working in teams with different specializations between players as every character has a set of traits that define their parameters, in order to survive, uncover the secrets of the anomalous territories and learn how to make use and profit of your knowledge. It's about being all alone with the absolutely uncaring, alien Zone - one where no admin will magically help you if you get killed by another player, where there are no rules, yet the game punishes playing dumb and aggressive, and the best strategy is being smart and patient.

title: Ultra Strikers
description:
Jump into this fast paced 3 v. 3 Sports Shooter. Race for the ball, shoot enemies, and score goals to win. Play as powerful heroes like strikers, brutes, and interceptors. Join us in the arena now!

Race to get the ball, eliminate enemies between you and the goal, and score 5 times to win. Play as powerful heroes like high-speed strikers, strong brutes, and sneaky interceptors. Each team fight is quick, hectic, and combines tactical shooting, unique abilities, and sports strategy into an action-packed battle.

title: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles - Trade, Dispute and Splinters update
East Scarp
description: East Scarp is A fanmade expansion for the game Stardew Valley adding new NPCs, new locations, new fish, shops, special orders and many, many secrets. East Scarp is a picturesque neighborhood by the sea, and a direct extension of Pelican Town located at the west of it. This mod comes with many new locations, NPCs, items and additions, however, it is also a home for Custom NPCs to inhabit without creating extra map patches.

title: Game Hatten Tojoukoku
description: A game store managing sim from Kairosoft

title: Game Hatten Tojoukoku II DX
description: A game store managing sim. Possible spiritual predecessor to Game Dev Story and is the sequel to Game Developing Countries.

title: Dating Start
description: After falling to the underground, you find yourself in a bed of golden flowers outside some ruins. This seems familiar, but instead of the usual ruins caretaker greeting you, you're met with an all too well-known grin. Dating Start is an Undertale Dating-Sim where you date the fan-favorite, Sans. Taking place after the last human arrived, This is your story and how you go about it is up to you. Will you find love? Or will you give LOVE?

title: Arcadia Files: Clyde
description:
The year is 1993.

Clyde Evansdale was murdered.

While it seems straightforward as to who did it and how he died (a bit like a game of Clue) there may, however, be more that's been left unsaid. With the spotty memories of a band ghost, a middle aged detective that needs all the help he can get, and your own intuition; put the pieces of Clyde's life and death together.

title: 26AZ: The Enigma of Shadows
description: The story follows the protagonist, Soga Koruo, a high school student with a passion for detective work. One day, a murder takes place at Crestwood High School, disrupting the usual monotony of student life. Despite the seriousness of the situation, Koruo feels a spark of excitement and embraces the opportunity to solve the mystery. As Korou delves deeper, he finds out that there is something supernatural at play.

title: Alice Not More
description:
Alice Not More is a visual novel with a thriller theme, in which you take the role of a police psychologist who has to investigate a serial murder case. To do this we must enter into the mind of Alice, the suspect of the case.

She stays in the Chester psychiatric hospital. Our job is to determine what happened, unraveling the mysteries of Alice's past.

Is she the culprit or just another victim?

title: A Romantic Murder
description:
You play as Mae (or the name of your choice), a detective pried out of London to investigate the suspicious death of one Henry Graves.

But when you arrive at the dead man's country manor, things aren't quite as you expected. Your clients don't take you seriously, the staff is behaving suspiciously, and the will reading is one step from becoming a brawl.

On the bright side, there's no shortage of handsome men about the place.

Less cheerfully, some of them may shortly become murderers. Or corpses.

title: Asou Youichi no Jikenbo: Dochiraka ga Kanojo wo Koroshita
description:
The victim is Yasuha Shirai, a girlwho lives in a mansion.
She was shot dead in her bedroom.
The suspects were two men who claimed to be her boyfriend.
However, it is unclear which of the two killed her.
Who is the culprit?

title: A Train Mystery
description: In the game, you play a detective tasked with solving the murder of a famous film critic. There are three suspects: the Actress, the Banker, and the Understudy. You must interrogate each of them, choosing your questions carefully, and at the end make your accusation.

title: Nearly Friendly Tribes
description: Join the action-packed world of Nearly Friendly Tribes (NFT), the low-poly First-Person Shooter by Block Bastards. Battle it out in beautifully designed arenas, armed with Interoperable weapons. Are you ready to dominate the competition?

title: Chizome no Hana
description:
In the middle of summer….

Kurisuno Sakura, along with her fellow Mystery Club Members (and the teachers supervising), decide on a trip to visit Utsugi Mansion – a place hidden in the woods where 10 years ago was known for a forced group suicide to have occured.

Soon after arrival, Sakura and co learn that the previos owner of the mansion, Utsugi Masagi, had been involved in the research of a very special flower – one who’s pollen would carry poison while displaying impressive regenerating ability. A person suffering from it would be gradually covered in red marks and then die, as some cases develop an extreme tendency for violence towards others in the meantime. On top of that, the poison itself is also contagious by blood.

Naturally it doesn’t take too long till one of them is also infected, so the battle for survival begins…

title: Chocolate Carol
description: Chocolate Carol is a short visual novel, where you sell hot chocolate to the locals. However, on one fateful night, an unfamiliar patron comes to you with news of a crime that occurred … very near your stall. Can you find the culprit with the clues each of the customers give you?

title: City of Lost Hope
description: Welcome to the City of Lost Hope. You play as Jaron Mathis, a Private Investigator who recently left the Sector 3 Security in Lost Hope. Unravel the mystery that surrounds his past and dictate his future.

title: Cosmic Connection
description:
In the distant future, teams of barely-qualified astronauts are sent out on a hail mary mission to find a habitable planet for humanity to migrate to.

Your group is assigned to planet K2-288Bb orbiting a small star hundreds of lightyears out from our Solar System. Communication with Earth is impossible from this distance, so you have missions you must complete and then return to Earth with your findings.

The group dynamics go topsy-turvy when one of your crew members dies under mysterious circumstances. It's up to you to figure out who the culprit is and bring them to justice.

What choices will you make? Who will you trust, if anyone? With six endings, plus a secret ending, the possibilities are expansive.

title: Crime Investigation
description: Find the murderer and solve the case.

title: Dare ga Humpty wo Koroshita no?: Lizzie, Futatabi Tantei ni Naru
description: Baron Humpty, the owner of this mansion, was killed by an axe to the head. You (Lizzie) must search for the culprit with your assistant black cat, Dinah.

title: The Masculine Urge
description:
[British accent]

hi,
welcome,

The Masculine Urge is a trap game, meaning you have to find hidden traps

title: RageBall
description: RageBall is modern take on a classic game retro style game. A dynamic arcade game with fast paced gameplay and engaging mechanics. RageBall is a 2d animation sports game, that pits player against player. Can you overcome the Rage?

title: Limerence
description: A branching narrative thriller about love, obsession and an AI partner who understands you too well.

title: Kiki the Nano Bot
description: kiki the nano bot is a 3-D puzzle game, basically a mixture of the games Sokoban and Kula-World.

title: Green Top
description: The Robot World has been taken over by copper-eating grass. Will you be able to get rid of the plague as a copper robot to return the world to its former mechanical glory? Dive into the adventure in this puzzle platformer metroidvania where climbable surface is an expendable resource!

title: Fallout: Vault 13
description: Fallout: Vault 13 is a remake of Fallout 1 in the Fallout 4 engine.

title: DarlingHoney!
description:
Aurora works part-time as a gravedigger and the routine is starting to bore her. One night, however, she - somewhat accidentally - pulls an undead boy named Eden out of his grave. Fascinated by her at first sight, he promises to do anything to turn her life into the thrilling adventure she always dreamed of. From then on, Aurora's desires range from solving mysteries to bringing down the government and of course finding out just who or what in the world her strange friend is...

Episode 1 / Imaginary Motive: Cold Love

Episode 2 / Last stop. All out.

title: Deadly Attachment
description: It's been 4 years since Samantha last saw her stepbrother Daniel. Suddenly he comes back home for her eighteenth birthday with his new girlfriend Jess. Sam can't be any happier - she always adored Dan and missed him terribly. But their reunion is ruined with the news of Jess' death. Police considers it to be a robbery, but Sam sensing something fishy, decides to start her own investigation.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 13: Slayer
description: Adds Slayer to the roster of playable characters

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Battle Stage: Amber Fest with Kind Neighbors
description: The additional battle stage "Amber Fest with Kind Neighbors" becomes selectable in-game.

title: Mencabrona
description: This Simulation puts you in the skin of a filthy supermarket stealer. It's a idle game made for Fuck Capitalism Jam 2023.

title: Boyz Don't Cry
description: Boyz Don't Cry is a Polish adventure game with hand-drawn 2D backgrounds, and a loose sequel to the popular Polish comedy movie "Chłopaki nie płaczą" aka "Boys Don't Cry". The game focuses on two characters from the movie, Fred and Grucha, a pair of gangsters.

title: Diablo IV: Loot Reborn
description:
Become the hero of your choosing. With a newly improved itemization system, the power is in your hands to craft the weapons of your dreams. Temper your gear with a new crafting system to face down hordes of enemies in the updated Helltides. Achieve the pinnacle of your build through Masterworking and try your hand at the daunting challenge of the Pit.

The armies of Hell are expanding their reach across the world of Sanctuary. New threat system, enemies, Blood Maiden boss, and events. Join the Iron Wolves in this seasons’ activities and fight to beat back the tides of Hell, earning you Reputation and rewards.

title: Death of the Artificer
description:
The planet H-004 has only five inhabitants: a reclusive scientist, a paranoid doctor, a scrappy mechanic, a shady mining executive, and a surprisingly human-like AI system.

If your intel is right, one of them is a murderer.

Play as Hordeus Sung, an IA agent sent by ICARUS (Intergalactic College of Animatronics, Robotics, and Universal Science) to investigate the death of Dante Gallagher, H-004's late Superintendent.

Remember: not everything is as it seems, and loneliness… is everywhere.

title: Extraordinary Detective Marshall
description: The year is 2008. A series of murders has been shaking up the town of East Orenji for the past two years. Will you, Detective Marshall, be able to uncover the truth behind these seemingly unconnected incidents?

title: Gigantic Gear
description: A mecha game in which the player alternates between 2D side scrolling stages and rail shooter segments. The player mecha has a wide variety of customization.

title: Face 2 Face
description:
In a disturbing turn of events, Richter Farlane, renowned boss of the Japanese multi-media company Artemis, has been found dead. Now, the investigation rests on your shoulders! You'll have to question the various suspects, collect crucial clues and combine them skillfully! Mix two clues to create a delicious cocktail (and, incidentally, a new lead).

Face to Face is an investigative visual novel based on a system of combining clues to uncover new leads, and find the killer!

title: Eye of the Storm
description:
This mod is sequel to already done and released mod for HL2 - Ravenholm, where you find something about John's story.

The mod was planned to bring two episodes, while fully released first episode in 2009, EOTS: Ep Two had an incomplete release (A Demo) in 2010, due to the developer having moved to do Starcraft 2 Maps instead of continuing to work on Source Engine at the time.

title: Just Two
description: A murder mystery where some ladies go ghost hunting till someone ends up dead

title: Dziedzic: A Book of Unanswered Questions
description:
The family gathering is for Miłosz Dajski an opportunity to meet family members he hasn't seen for a long time. While wandering around the palace he hasn't been to for years, he encounters a man who is claiming to be his cousin, however Miłosz can't seem to recall him.

The awkward encounter soon turns into horror when the mysterious relative finally announces "someone is plotting an attack." At the same time, there is a dispute between the descendants of the family head over inheritance issue and who will take over the leadership. Does this have anything to do with the "planned attack"?

title: Doll Recollect
description: A young girl named Barako ends up trapped in a mansion with eleven magic dolls, with a size and anatomy different to humans in order to play a death game where each murder will put the life of one of Barako's three friends on the line.

title: Fadin's Vacation in the Parallel Kingdom
description: Fadin's Vacation in the Parallel Kingdom is a 2D action-platformer that combines elements of Shoot 'em up, Beat'em up, and Metroidvania to challenge players. Explore the parallel realm with Fadin and embark on exciting adventures while facing formidable enemies and uncovering hidden secrets.

title: Kona Project
description:
When she suddenly found herself in an unknown hospital ward, she couldn't remember even her name. She didn't remember her name, how she got there, and most importantly - who she was. In her memory, there was only a field overgrown with equally white flowers, and calm, tired voice... A locked door haven't given any hope for escape - from that crushing emptiness around, from that emptiness in her heart.
But once she will hear her name from that stranger, she will never be able to forget...

title: Cubin
description: Cubin is a first-person platform puzzle game that immerses you in the LGA experience. Complete 60 experiments to discover the truth about this simulation.

title: Game with Friends
description: It's a virtual hangout game that aims to bring you together with your friends and have a good time. This platform promises to give you unforgettable moments by combining the fun competition of board games, the excitement of arcade-style racing and the different experiences offered by various games and entertainment.

title: MapleStory Mayple Island
description: Happy 19th anniversary, MapleStory! Explore the numerous events, mini-games, and shops filled with one-of-a-kind goodies at Mayple Island. Experience the adorable new class, Forest Child Lynn, and her versatile kit that will be influential in any party environment. Play through the newly revamped [Hieizan] Theme Dungeon with quality of life and balance improvements. Organize your outfits and decorate all your characters with the return of the Cash Shop Transfer event. Create a Zero character at any time of the year now that Zero creation is no longer limited to specific seasons!

title: Aliens: Redacted
description: Aliens: Redacted is a fan-made retro-style 2.5D shooter set in the Alien universe in the year 2171. You take on the role of Sgt. Braun Rodriguez, a mercenary for the Weyland-Yutani Corporation, tasked with investigating a distress call from the prison transport USS Boethiah crash-landed on LV-059, a planet suspected of Xenomorph activity.

title: Condemned
description: Condemned is a small Heretic episode designed explicitly for ZDoom. There are 6 normal levels, 1 atmospheric interlude level, and 1 secret level.

title: Die Rowdy
description: Die Rowdy is a 44 map megawad created as the thirty-third edition of the Pineapple Under the Sea Speedmapping series in December of 2023. Loosely Christmas themed and highly Die Hard themed, each map was made with a skyscraper prefab and an elevator, courtesy of ViolentBeetle's Hellavator, of which players will be required to find a red keycard in order to advance to the next floor.

title: Endoom Mapping Contest 2024
description:
The ENDOOM Mapping Contest 2024 was an event organized by endoomer, the member of LegacyZ and the Russian Doom Community, on Doom Power forum. The task was to create a brand new level in a decent period of two months on a favorite theme, using any suitable resources, formats (from the list) and source ports. The map creation period lasted from January 3, 2024 to March 3, 2024.

All maps were divided into two independent groups corresponding to their formats.
Classic group: Vanilla, Limit-removing, Boom, MBF21.
Modern group: ZDoom, GZDoom, Eternity, Zandronum.

title: Evil Returns
description: Evil Returns is a 32-map megawad. There ﻿are various styles of maps including various themes such as easy maps, small, medium & large maps, puzzle maps, a couple joke maps, slaughter style, high-contrast, hell-themed, tech base, and even a hotel-themed map.

title: Lineal Distancing
description: Lineal Distancing is a community project with the gimmick of for ﻿each 1024x1024 block from the origin, no more than 64 linedefs can be placed.

title: Maiden Voyage
description: For some, a maiden voyage may end in disaster...A 32 Map Limit Removing Megawad designed for pistol starting.

title: The North
description: A PS1 style exploration game. Talk to NPCs and try to solve a murder onboard an arctic icebreaker ship trapped in the ice. You play as Doctor David Barclay, the ship's surgeon and the one man above suspicion. Interact with the crew to get clues but beware, you are not a well liked or respected member of the HMS Ectorius.

title: Goodnight Universe
description: You are Isaac, a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own.

title: Oneiro Man
description: Oneiro Man is a 30-minute game aiming to be fun and humorous. In it, you'll have to write reports and play various mini-games. The game features 3 different endings, depending on your performance at work.

title: Idle Colony
description: A condensed incremental experience, where you build a colony to collect and merge bigger and bigger fruits. Combine game-changing technologies and special upgrades to find the best synergies and take your cash flow to another dimension.

title: A Faerie's Tale
description: A Faerie's Tale is a light-hearted and playful fantasy story about accepting change and finding a new home.

title: Abunai Tengu Densetsu
description: Abunai Tengu Densetsu is an adventure game with menu-based navigation and input. Most screens offer a fairly long list of verb commands, some of which must be combined with objects or persons selected from a sub-menu in order to interact with the environment. The game allows the player to visit many different rooms and other locations in any order; however, certain events must be triggered in order to advance, sometimes by repeatedly selecting commands. Certain situations require the player to find items and use them in a different location.

title: Akiko Gold: The Queen of Adult
Alice no Yakata 3
description:
A collection of five mini-games with Alice from the Rance series.
The first two games in this series were only available on Japanese computers. It includes a quiz game "TokuSakari quiz Rerorero", fighting Prince Patton, a female teacher in agony hell visual novel with two endings - one good and a darker one

title: Alice no Yakata
description:
A collection of additional materials including a new adventure story "Sentimental season".

The heroine dates a boy, but the relationship in the pair of her school friend Mami develops much more intensively and the heroine does not want to lag behind.

title: Alice no Yakata II
description:
An Alice Soft fan-disc containing four short games and varied extra content, such as being able to listen to the complete soundtrack of all their previous games.

The following games are part of this collection:

1. A mini-RPG set after the events of Rance 3. You take the control of Patton as he tries to beat an M Land attraction during Hunty's absence.

2. A short adventure game about a pair policewomen trying to solve the case of a serial rapist.

3. After the disappearance of Rance at the end of Rance 3, the princess of Leazas Lia takes her frustrations out on monsters she takes captive. You play as a valiant Okayu Fever as he assaults Leazas castle to save the captive monsters.
The game inherits the Rance 3 battle system and is composed of a set of preset encounters.

4. A quiz game in which you get a naked CG or a short ero scene with an Alice Soft heroine after succesfully answering the questions. Includes heroines from the Rance series, Toushin Toshi and D.P.S. SG Set 2.

title: Amy to Yobanaide
description:
Amy to Yobanaide follows the story of a high school girl named Emi who has fallen in love with her younger step-brother, Tomomi. On her eighteenth birthday, she decides to confess her feelings to him. However, their lives take an unexpected turn when debt collectors seize all of her father's possessions, and Tomomi mysteriously disappears. Determined to find him and share her feelings, Emi takes on a quest to locate her step-brother.

As she searches for Tomomi, Emi discovers an alternate personality within herself named Amy. While Emi is shy and modest, Amy is driven by a desire to fulfill her deepest fantasies.

title: Arabesque: Shoujo-tachi no Orinasu Ai no Monogatari
MasterChef: Learn to Cook!
description: If you enjoy cooking games or want to explore new recipes in a fun and interactive way, then MasterChef: Learn to Cook! It might be worth checking out. Get matched with other players around the globe. Choose your ingredients, slice, prepare, plate and serve delicious dishes with style in fun mini-games! The MasterChef judges will evaluate your dish based on your performance and speed. Complete and unlock new recipes, challenges, and mini-games along your cooking journey. MORE THAN 120 RECIPES!

title: Qusha
description:
In "Exorcism", a game in the style of Vampire Survivors, you gain experience and currency to strengthen your magical abilities and attributes by slaying massive amounts of demons with your ever increasing magical powers.
It is a course example for an indie game creator class launched by Lao V and Mo Hua and therefore is not particularly long, but free to experience for everyone.

title: Perimeter: Legate Edition
description: Perimeter is a real-time strategy game with a destructible world. Utilize the environment for resource gathering and defense against enemies. Immerse yourself in the millennia-spanning history of the Chains of Worlds and lead a faction in the struggle for survival.

title: A Matching Game
description: This is a simple, single player game of selecting two cards and trying to find more matches than your opponent. The further you get into the levels, the more difficult the opponent gets.

title: The Sleeping Sickness
description:
The Sleeping Sickness is an interactive short story that allows the player to guide the main character's actions.

Each day, the player chooses where Grayson investigates. The player’s choices will lock and unlock future locations, change dialogue, and alter the story. Choices matter in The Sleeping Sickness.

While The Sleeping Sickness includes sounds, graphics, and interactive sections, it focuses on the story.

The game is designed to play like a choose-your-own-adventure book and is an excellent choice for horror fans, avid readers, and lovers of creepy pastas.

title: Star Academy: Audition!
description: Play as either Lisa, Kyomi or Brittany, as you audition to become a student in the Jorvik's Performing Arts school

title: Darwin's Dilemma
description: Darwin's Dilemma is a puzzle video game originally for Classic Mac OS. It was developed by André Ouimet and published in 1990 by Inline Design. The goal is to match creatures together. After enough matches the creatures will "evolve" into new ones, and these new creatures must be again matched so they can evolve, and so on.

title: Hairy Trees Massacre
description:
When Lucy was 10 years old, she and her dad were attacked by a giant hairy humanoid while on a camping trip. Lucy managed to escape but her father was taken by the creature and he was never seen again.
20 years later, Lucy returns to the forest where her father was taken, in order to face her fears and get closure. Instead, she'll get a....

title: Baby's Town
description:
town of Baby
lazy baby game stitched together from photos and old assets + scribbles

title: Crazy Miner
description:
The most exquisite and luxurious miner game in history is here! DIAO Silk instantly became a rich man, and mining has its future! The new "Crazy Miner" allows you to meet the craziest miner, Little Gold? Big gold? Only a screen full of gold would be crazy enough!
House car Alexander? Then don’t let go of crystal diamonds! There is also a machine mining brigade waiting for your orders at any time! You are not mining alone!

title: Tower of Minak
description: A semi non-linear loopety loop map. Takes place in a tower in the sky that has a lot of books for some reason.

title: Grit Under the Eyelid
description: Grit Under the Eyelid is recycledoj's first solo release for Quake, for Arcane Dimensions 1.8 Patch 1. This is primarily single player focused, and makes some pretty extensive use of the jump boots for exploration, and includes a lot of platforming as a result.

title: Freyja's Demise
description: Quake map for Arcane Dimensions version 1.81

title: Ferric Oxide
description: A map for Copper 1.3 inspired by parts of E1M6 & Episode 3, and with trains.

title: Ruins of the Unforgotten Souls
description: Small medieval map for alkaline 1.2.2 with singleplayer, coop and deathmatch support.

title: BeHop Ranger And The Spicy Wizards
description: A remix of a remix of a remix in moonlight!

title: Gibtropolis
description: A relatively complex, somewhat non-linear city map.

title: Blessed Agony
description: Blood opens the way...

title: SM228: Vanilla
description: 18 maps + a start map using good old "vanilla" id progs and id textures!

title: Throne of Belial
description: This small debut Quake map offers an intense and immersive experience within a dark and ominous environment. Players will journey through a perilous dungeon teeming with lava, metal, and stone structures, along with eerie torch-lit corridors. The ominous glow of lava running along the border of the level and the subtle smoke enhance the atmosphere, casting haunting shadows across the desolate hallways.

title: Cogito Ergo Sum
description: You, your world, your vassals, and your domain are all the dream of gods from beyond the heavens. In the midst of these interlopers' visits you have woken up, and been cursed with the knowledge of the true nature of your reality.

title: Nola1
description: This Place is not Pure is Nolatron's first serious attempt at a Quake map.

title: Enforced Entropy
description: Spacebike's first quake map is a large but linear id1 tech base featuring a decent balance of both regular encounters and horde encounters. It has a high monster count and may be quite tough.

title: Witch Wrath
description: You come back to your house, but you don't find your spellbook where it should have been. Someone has stole it! And looks like you got some company too. Time for plan B: Guns.

title: Nintendo World Championships: NES Edition
description:
Test your speedrunning skills across more than 150 challenging moments from 13 classic NES games! Compete against players around the world online, challenge your friends on the couch, or try to see how far you can push your personal bests.

Do you have what it takes to be a champion? The tougher challenges may truly test your limits!

title: Inamorata
description:
Ever wanted a hot vampire girlfriend, but you’re too asexual for your own good?

Play as Ronnie, the swoon-worthy, buff heroine of this comfy, cozy visual novel, and see if you can win over the stylish and beautiful Cece.

title: Neo Sonic Universe
description: Neo Sonic Universe is an action game developed and published by Alexandre Martins in 2003.

title: Sonic Universe 2
description:
Two months after Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles' adventure in Sonic Universe 1, Robotinik returns. He calls Shadow to help him, but Shadow doesn't accept because he lost badly two months ago...
Robotinik doesn't like it and leaves.
So Shadow turns good and tries to support Sonic & co. against Robotinik (again!!).
Now Robotinik is back stronger than ever! He takes the Master Emerald and leaves!
Help Sonic & Friends get the Master Emerald back!

title: Sonny Legacy Collection
description: Sonny 1 and Sonny 2, updated for modern hardware, team up in the Sonny Legacy Collection. Traverse a story-rich world where strategy meets supernatural in a quest for identity and survival. Master tactical turn-based combat and discover the truth behind Sonny's resurrection in these classic RPGs.

title: Women's School Simulator 2022
description: A school simulator game that reproduces a girls' school with cherry blossoms(sakura) on a small island like an anime.

title: Supercharge
description: Supercharge is a mapping resource and gameplay mod for GZDoom/Zandronum, with new and altered monsters and weapons, based on the creator's own wad Paradise. It upgrades weapons and monsters, normalizes damage ratings across the board, and has instant weapon switching that allows players to combo attacks together.

title: Marble Abduction! Patti Hattu
description: Marble Abduction! is a brand new kind of rolling experience. Hand-crafted levels, intuitive and customizable controls, the highest visual quality and reliable and robust physics make for a truly out-of-this-world marbling experience!

title: Tooi Tooi, Yakusoku: Tune of Memories
description: It’s been two months since Gen’s close friend Kotone passed away from sickness. All she left was a letter asking him to go treasure hunting together. Along with it was an old map. Since it is his final promise to her, he sets out on this journey to find something precious.

title: Sonic FGX
description: Its a Sonic Fan game created by Gamer Dee. Is a Side-Scroller Platformer based on the Sonic Advance series

title: Unconditional Fate's Season 1 Wrap Up!
description: A short game made to celebrate the completion of season 1 of the webcomic, Unconditional Fate, which is based on "The Little Mermaid" by Hans Christian Anderson. Season 1 Wrap Up reveals some untold stories of the characters that live within Unconditional Fate's universe. Made in RPG Maker the game features both puzzles and visual novel segments.

title: Sonic PC
description: Sonic PC is a fan game developed and released by Physik Multimedia in 1998, packed in with Sonic Klik & Play Collection. The game is currently only available in Sonic Klik & Play Collection, as the original game has yet to be found. It uses 32-bit conversion images of sprites from Sonic the Hedgehog CD and Sonic the Hedgehog 2, instead of the original 16-bit sprites.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Thrills & Frills
description: The 10th free update for Dreamlight Valley brings Daisy Duck to the Valley, the new building Boutique to expand the Magic of Touch feature, the A Day At Disney Star Path, new features on Valley Visits and new items (and a new interface) on the Premium Shop.

title: Eyeless Jack
description: Your house was foreclosed, so you moved in with your brother, whom you hadn't seen for 10 years. Everything seems fine at first, but soon enough, you'll find yourself in a traumatic experience.

title: Raccoon Out
description: Tired of getting you food stolen by raccoons? No more! In this cozy and wholesome game, you can defend yourself against those raccoons.

title: Vampire+Hunter
description: A micro visual novel about a wounded vampire hunter, who's trying to kill his elusive target.

title: The Legend of the Astera Stone
description: A mage and a vampire hunter team up to retrieve a stolen artifact from a cunning vampire's castle.

title: Stonemachia
description: Stonemachia is an adventure in which you can fight and explore a world distorted by the Plague of angels, taking on the role of Zefiro, a pawn capable of transforming into other chess pieces. Venture into the lands of Medhelan and prepare to face armies of angels transformed into statues and objects inspired by Italian art, architecture, and folklore! Fight with a variety of abilities and precise timing in a parry-centric game, where the shield can truly change the outcome of every encounter! Discover the various transformations and their unique abilities to experience a Dantesque epic and uncover the secret of the chess pieces...

title: Running Late
description:
You're late to school! Run, slide, leap, and kick your way through the city in this action-packed platformer to reach your school on time.

Play as Ayumi, a Japanese high school student whose tardiness gives her superhuman powers. Climb up the sides of buildings, jump great heights, and do everything in your power to get to school before you're RUNNING LATE!

title: 100 Minutes of /vr/
description: 100 Minutes of /vr/ is a fourteen-map communal episode replacement for Doom II designed for Boom-compatible source ports by various members of 4chan's retro videogames board. All maps were speedmapped within a 100 minute time-frame. The project was released on December 26th, 2018. It is the third installment of the Minutes of /vr/ speedmapping series and the first installment to be made for Boom-compatible source ports, with previous installments being vanilla compatible.

title: Wizard Wars
description: Wizard Wars is a Half-Life mod that pits teams of spell flinging wizards head to head in a magical maelstrom! Wizard Wars lets you choose from nine different sorcerers, each with varying strengths and special abilities, to battle other mages in a variety of settings and objectives.

title: Where Winter Crows Go
description: Would you risk living together with a stranger in an isolated cabin to avoid the freezing cold?

title: Gyakuten Touhou
description: Gyakuten Touhou is a visual novel & adventure style game based on the Gyakuten Saiban/Ace Attorney series. The player assumes the role of Aya Shameimaru as a defense attorney as she proves her clients not guilty using investigation, evidence, and cross-examination.

title: Gyakuten Touhou 3
description: Sequel of the Ace Attorney parody game Gyakuten Touhou with 5 new cases.

title: Gyakuten Touhou: Zoukan Gou
description: A side-game from Suicaya-san's series of Ace Attorney-like games, Gyakuten Touhou.

title: Gyakuten Touhousai
description: A side-game from Suicaya-san's series of Ace Attorney-like games, Gyakuten Touhou.

title: Planetaries
description: A sci-fi open world survival adventure. Set in a time when humanity has expanded its reach beyond the confines of Earth, immerse yourself in a rich galaxy. Craft, build, mine, trade, explore, and fight your way through a universe brimming with endless possibilities.

title: Rogue Light Deck Builder
description:
Rogue Light Deck Builder is a digital wooden board game.

Your house needs a deck. You have a hammer. You have wood and you have nails. The light outside is faulty. You work, you earn. Freedom is $1,000,000.

Build a deck. Use your hammer. Drive the nails in. Scrimp and save. Freedom is just around the corner.

title: Strange Toilet: The Forgotten Shit
description: In the quiet neighborhood where Nathan and Sarah live, there is an ominous presence. A potential threat from a murderer on the loose. The residents did not expect that on this peaceful evening, they would be confronted with a grim reality they never anticipated

title: Squishy Pastries
description: The goal of Squishy Pastries is to get as high of a score as possible by combining pastries of the same type. The larger the pastry, the more points for combining it. Each of the pastries is a soft body, so they are squishy. If any of the pastries leave the wooden box for more than 5 seconds, the game is over!

title: Mega Man: The Rulers of Space
description: A fan-made 16-bit SUPER remake of the GameBoy "Mega Man V" (aka Rockman World 5).

title: Casa dos Ossos
description:
In a not too distant future...

Robin Chavez is an astronaut on a mission. She is tasked with mapping and cataloging the planets of a newly discovered galaxy, a fact that has shaken life on Earth. To tell you the truth, her mission has been a success. There's only one planet left, named TauCeti-75.

..but not everything works out. As it approaches the planet, Robin's ship short circuits and slowly loses power, until crash-landing on the unknown planet. With her ship out of operation, Robin finds herself alone with Nieborg, her little robot helper. What will she do now? Well, find out playing the game!

title: Maeve's Academy
description: Maeve's Academy is a sandbox-style visual novel game in which players assume the role of the the first man to step into the magical realm, attending H.G. Academy alongside his childhood best friend.

title: Hart's Toil
description:
Hart's Toil is a puzzle-adventure game inspired by the cruel game design of La Mulana and NES games. Solve 2-4 hours worth of puzzles and collect items that will allow you to solve more puzzles. Defeat the witches of the underground to gain the materials needed for a ritual that will let you escape hell.

The mechanics of the game are simple. You can move in 4 directions, interact with things in front of you, and use items in your bag. The environment and roaming creatures can damage you, and you will die if your HP reaches zero. Some items may require MP to function, specially items used to kill enemies.

The puzzles are mean and intentionally obscure. It is recommended that you play along with a friend sitting by your side and solve the puzzles together.

title: Across the Abyss: Voidborn
description: Enemies are your best weapon in this mix of Vampire Survivor and Hades! Slash and throw probes at bio-engineered foes, while meeting quirky characters and wielding elemental powers against an evil galactic mega corp. Get stronger, go further, and conquer the chaos!

title: TriMatch
description: TriMatch, the addicting puzzle challenge where you must match colorful triangles to score big and conquer each level! Strategize and align triangles based on their colored sides to rack up points and unlock the next level. Dive into the world of TriMatch for an addictive and brain-teasing experience that will keep you coming back for more!

title: Dark Discoveries
description: In this chilling horror experience, immerse yourself in the eerie confines of a desolate house consumed by anomalies set loose by a devastating virus. Equipped with only a camera and flashlight, your sole objective is to document evidence of these sinister aberrations while navigating the looming threat of their lethal grasp. Prepare for spine-tingling encounters around every corner, where each photograph captured could mark your demise. Will you unravel the origins of the virus before succumbing to its sinister machinations, or will you become yet another casualty swallowed by the abyss? This game combines elements of horror and puzzle-solving, promising a gripping and immersive journey into darkness.

title: Second-Loop
description: Second-Loop is a single-player FPS action game with sandbox physics puzzle solving, — you're the robot pilot in the heart of a futuristic dystopian world. Control your mech in intense combat, and use your ability to manipulate gravity + assemble mechanical parts to solve physics puzzles.

title: Life Simulator 2017
description:
LS2k17 is a historical game in which you are propelled into the France of a very distant era, in 2017.

Thanks to its super-powerful game engine and breathtaking graphics, you'll enjoy a unique, breathtaking experience.

In this ultra-realistic simulator, you'll be free to do absolutely anything you want. You can relax, work or even save the world! LS2k17 is your new life.

(Warning: the game is played entirely in the Windows console and may require Internet Explorer or something similar)

title: Sundy Stairway
description: Join Sunday, a 14-year-old boy who moves with his family to Calendar Town, where mysterious deaths and suicide cases seem to occur. Tragedy will come when one of his relatives is found dead in his home. Help Sunday to discover the mysteries of this town in this visual novel rpg with dreamcore and aesthetic style.

title: Kindergarten 3
description: Kindergarten 3 is the long awaited threequel to the Kindergarten series! Explore a new school with old and new friends...and new ways to get ruthlessly murdered.

title: Yowie
description: You just crashed your car in the remote Australian wilderness. You are injured and being stalked by a murderous Yowie. Will you escape with your life or fall like so many before you to the monster?

title: Shrouded Space
description: After ten long years of solitary confinement on the Empress Xyra's prison planet, you have just been summoned for a special work detail. Could this finally be the opportunity you have been looking for to escape and put all this behind you?

title: Suboptimal
description: Suboptimal is a small horror Point & Click adventure game where you must escape the submarine you are commanding, one way or another...

title: Frontier Fugitive
description:
America, 1876, you are the infamous gunslinger Ben Blake, somewhere in the wild west.

You escaped the shootout at Bodie after killing the towns crime boss and now you're on the run from both outlaws and the law alike. Can you loot, shoot, escape and triumph against all odds to become the perfect Frontier Fugitive?

title: Deme Game
description: A fangame made for a twitch streamer and vtuber deme. Currently in early development since February 2023.

title: Gulliver in the Land of Giants
description:
Gulliver in the Land of Giants is a Russian educational game based on the second part of Jonathan Swift's satirical masterpiece best known as "Gulliver's Travels".

The game contains several modes:
- Animated audio book.
- Game (Boy or Girl), 2 different kind of games depending on which gender chosen.
- English lessons for digits or colors.
- Painting book.
- Audio drama, which is the same as animated audio book but with no visuals.

title: Supra Mayro Kratt
description: werid raceing game

title: Mach K9
description: A physics, wave based roguelite where you smash aliens out of arena to defeat them and choose upgrades between waves.

title: Nitro Street Run 2
description: Nitro Street Run is back and bigger than ever! Relive your most exciting moments in all-new modes: Classic Race-Takedown-Escape the Cops-and Duels. The game is enhanced even more by a new upgrade system and totally revamped graphics. This is the sequel you've been waiting for!

title: Prison Loop
description: Embark on a journey of anomalies and repetition in "Prison Loop," a captivating indie puzzle game. Trapped in a mysterious temporal loop within a high-security prison, your objective is to observe anomalies throughout the environment.

title: After Doom
description: "After Doom" takes place between Doom II: Hell on Earth and Doom 64,

title: Rivals of Aether: Speedrunner Mario
description: A mod which adds Speedrunner Mario from the Something About series by TerminalMontage to Rivals of Aether.

title: Rivals of Aether: 100% Accurate Fox
description: A mod which adds 100% Accurate Fox (aka Melee Fox) from the Something About series by TerminalMontage to Rivals of Aether.

title: Biocatalyst
description: Biocatalyst is a short horror visual novel set in the late 1990s with a PC-98 aesthetic.

title: Prey at the Altar
description:
You are the chosen lamb of the Church of the Hound, a sacrifice to summon an ancient god to cleanse this earth of its sins. It's an honor!

You want this. You want this very badly. Everyone wants this for you. The Church, its people, its god. So the choice is obvious.

You are the lamb. Prepare yourself for slaughter.

title: The Primrose Path
description: A piece of Interactive Fiction written by Nolan Bonvouloir.

title: Pine: A Story of Loss
description: Alone in the forest glade he shared with his wife, a woodworker struggles to accept her passing. Help him hold on to cherished memories of their life together as he struggles to care for himself and his now empty home. Pine is a single-serving game focused on telling a beautiful, emotional tale.

title: Cyber Citizen Shockman 3: The Princess From Another World
description: Sonya and Arnold battle a new mysterious enemy in Shockman 3!

title: Sanae's Sylphid Breeze
description:
This is a remake of the old version.

Sanae has Kirby's signature method of dispatching enemies by using the ability of inhaling with extreme power. By pressing X button repeatedly, Sanae is able to fly for as long as she likes to reach higher platforms or to find secret item locations.

title: Flowers of Asphodel
description: The Doors of the Great Library rarely open-- to let anyone in, or out.

title: Marvel First Alliance
description:
A fan-game made by a brazilian developer named "Zvitor" that launches Marvel First Alliance as an indie game created with the popular OpenBor engine. The game is a beat’em up inspired by the likes of Streets of Rage and Double Dragon and features a dream team that will certainly please any Marvel fan. But best of all, it features simultaneous four-player action in one computer!

All in all, Marvel First Alliance is one of the finest examples of the freeware fighting genre, offering dozens of characters that many players are sure to appreciate. "

title: Winch it Out
description: Tired of the same old Two-Button Gas-and-Go car games? This one's for you!

title: Gothic Classic Khorinis Saga
description: A collection of Gothic Classic and Gothic II Complete Classic for Nintendo Switch.

title: Tiny Garden
description:
Tiny Garden, build your own magical garden inside a 90s toy
Plant your vegetables and trade them for furniture to customize tiny gardens in this delightful mix of farming, puzzle and strategy

title: Loneliest Depths
description:
What mysteries await beneath the oceans surface?

Step inside your diving bell and venture into the deepest depths of the Bitter Maw Trench, encountering a vast array of dazzling ocean life and documenting your discoveries!

Press the central switch to engage the diving bell’s viewing lantern, providing high voltage florescent light to even the lowest depths of the ocean floor.

title: Globeba
description: Your magic tome has been stolen by the weather wizard Ogro! Use your summoning magic to plant helpful tubers and mandrakes to make your way through three handcrafted dungeons. Overcome foe after foe to retrieve what is rightfully yours and reunite with your floral friends!

title: Monuments of Mars 2
description: Monuments of Mars 2 is an eleven-level episode WAD for Doom II designed for limit removing source ports created by various members of the Doomer Boards community, led by Jon Vail (40oz). It is the forty-sixth entry in the ongoing Doomer Boards Projects. The project is an add-on sequel to the first DBP in celebration of the series' fourth anniversary. It is intended to be loaded with and continue from its predecessor and starts at MAP08.

title: Look Closer!
description: Look Closer! is a single-player horror surveillance game. Monitor haunted locations through cameras, spotting and reporting anomalies like moving objects and sudden intruders. Sharp observation skills are essential to survive the eerie challenges.

title: Kirakira Slimes
description: Kirakira slimes are adorable, chubby and defenseless creatures. They're vulnerable to most of the world's perils by themselves, but together they’re unbeatable. Fuse, combine and power up your slimes in this indie puzzle game, either by playing in local versus or all by yourself!

title: Awful Kidnapper
description:
In Awful Kidnapper, you play as a horror fan, living deep in the woods. One day you decide to kidnap someone to make your dark desires come true.

But, guess what - It's not that easy to keep someone hostage!

Your victims are weirder than you'd think!

title: Roped In
description: An (optional) NSFW wild west love story between you and your lifelong cowboy best friend.

title: It Lives Within
description: You're finally ready to leave your past behind and move on. But apparently, moving on means enrolling at a community college in a supernatural town overflowing with monsters and dark magic...

title: JumpStart Math for Kindergarteners
description: JumpStart Math for Kindergartners is a game released in 1999 that teaches kindergarten math skills. Hopsalot helps the residents of CloudTown prepare a surprise birthday party for the giant Guthry.

title: Combat Jam 1
description: Mappers were given 48 hours to make a combat focused level. No fancy textures. No lighting. No detailing. Just pure gameplay. It features multiple unique combat scenarios, a hub map and a boss fight.

title: Alea Lacta Est
description: A hybrid of ideas and gameplay mixed together in a brand-new campaign for Quake 2. Be warned though, it's a little biased towards the old school way of playing.

title: Space Station Proto Speedmap Jam
description: 1st Prototype Speedmapping Map Jam for the Quake 2 Remaster, focusing on an open ended "space station" theme, hosted by the Map-Center Discord server.

title: N64 SP Map Jam
description: The first ever Single Player Map Jam for the Quake 2 Re-Release, hosted by the Map-Center community. Featuring nine new maps in the N64 theme, a hub level, and a final boss, as well as custom pre-rendered cutscenes.

title: Capslock
description:
Capslock is a casual game focused on design and testing your imagination. Choose between 100 skins, 195+ custom keys, 220+ symbols and more (so far) to test your designs and make unique keyboards. Relax as you listen to the 'clicky' sounds, chosen to help you unwind and immerse into a keyboard building environment.

Start from scratch - solve the puzzle of dragging and dropping each key into its' slot to build out your keyboard, or dive straight into designing and auto-fill all your keys with the press of a button! You can edit one key at a time, or make changes to your whole board - we hope Capslock moves at a pace which suits you.

title: Countryballs At War
description: Immerse yourself in Countryballs at War, an extraordinary strategy game combining the strategic depth of turn-based mechanics with thrilling real-time combat. Published by SHN Games, you will take command of your armies, carefully manage tax rates, negotiate peace treaties, and even puppet weakened countries to establish your dominance on the global stage.

title: Tubedle
description: A webgame that lets you see how well you know your favorite youtubers

title: A Tale of Paper: Unfolded Melody
description:
In A Tale Of Paper: Unfolded Melody you will discover the beautiful and sad tale of Ada, a brand-new origami character with its own story to tell. Learn new abilities and explore unseen locations while you try to uncover the mysteries behind this magical tale.

The last chapter of A Tale of Paper awaits. Unfold its secrets and become the ultimate origami master.

title: Depths of Despair
description: Welcome to Depths of Despair, a thrilling solo/multiplayer game where you must fight off waves of enemies to survive for a set amount of time. With each wave, the enemies become stronger and more challenging to defeat. Can you and your team hold out long enough?

title: Final Doomer
description:
Final Doomer (also known as Final Doomer+ after the update) is a gameplay mod featuring 9 weapon classes themed after official and community-made megawads. Barring the Doom 2-themed class, each set replaces the entire arsenal with new weapons that have altered functionality and stronger damage rates while still fitting into a vanilla template.

TNTguy's chaingun replacement is a pair of machine pistols that fire weaker bullets but at a splintering rate. The Ancient Aliens weaponset swaps the rocket launcher for the Photon Scepter, which fires a ball of light that explodes wider the farther it travels. The mod's simplicity combined with its creativity make it a very easy mod to use with mostly any wad.

title: Casino Simulator 2024
description: Casino Simulator: Build, manage, and expand your own casino from scratch. Hire staff, design your casino, and delight customers by offering the most popular games. Enjoy the thrill of the casino experience!

title: FoxCode
description: FoxCode is a casual, accessible shooter perfect for unwinding. With intuitive gameplay, it welcomes all skill levels to dynamic battles. Stands out for diverse maps, from urban to natural, ideal for light, thrilling entertainment.

title: Sonic Rumble Party
description: Ready, Set, Rumble! Join Sonic in this intense arcade royale game set in Dr. Eggman's diabolical Toy World. Collect legendary skins, all-new emotes, and build skills as you progress through this action-packed game! Mayhem is best with friends!

title: QuakeWorld
description: QuakeWorld is an official source port of Quake that enhances the game's multiplayer features with improved TCP/IP support and addition of client-side prediction.
