title: SkateLab
description: A 100% physics-driven skateboarding sandbox. Experiment in a world with unconstrained physics, create spots, record clips, and skate online with your friends.

title: Apex Legends: Upheaval
description:
When Alter emerged from her dimension into another (with her past held close to the chest), she had only two things: her interdimensional traveling Void tech, and a desire to have fun. She stole the fanciest of foods, learned to fight through dicey situations, and took on odd jobs for personal favors–though she didn’t have a problem double-crossing her clients if it was more beneficial or amusing. Never needing to stick around for the consequences of her actions eroded any sense of morality or responsibility she had. She could focus on what was important: making sure life was never mundane.

Alter was drawn to worlds on the edge of complete destruction. Whether something devastating was already happening or she helped usher in the apocalypse herself, she was there to watch whatever catastrophe ensued. It was only in those moments, after all, that people took off the masks they always wore and she could see their true selves.

Finding these world-ending events was a toss up. Sometimes she’d find what she was looking for, and on others, she’d have missed the main event in worlds already ruined. But in some of these ruined worlds, Alter began to notice an interesting commonality…

Many of these worlds hadn’t met their end by some random event; they had been destroyed by the same person.

[Redacted]

title: Forgotten Skies
description: Discover the mysteries of Forgotten Skies, a fun platforming adventure where ancient secrets and hidden dangers await in this captivating adventure game. Forgotten Skies is a hilarious 3D Platform-Adventure developed and published by Chrysalis Interactive.

title: Gigantosaurus Dino Sports
description: On your marks for a roar-some sports party for one to four dinos. These eight chomp-sized games are enormous fun – but watch out for Giganto!

title: The Oregon Trail: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Oregon Trail Digital Deluxe bundle includes the full experience :
• "THE OREGON TRAIL" BASE GAME
• THE "COWBOYS AND CRITTERS" DLC

Physical additionally comes with:
- Reversible coversheet
- 3 Postcards

title: Celestia: Chain of Fate
description: A romance-fantasy visual novel that delivers a captivating player driven narrative. Enrol at Celestia Academy and uncover your heritage. Delve into a fantastical realm and unearth your magical potential as a hybrid. Forge new friendships and build affections based on your love interests.

title: Harvest Moon: One World Complete
description: The complete Version includes the original full game & ALL THE DLC: The new area of Wagashi, two new marriage candidates, new decorations, new pets & wild animals, and more!

title: Metaphor: ReFantazio - Launch Edition
description:

title: Potionomics: Masterwork Edition
description:
Assume the role of a penniless witch named Sylvia who must transform her debt-ridden potion shop into a thriving business.

Potionomics: Masterwork Edition will offer new features, including voice-overs, Endless Mode, “Cozy” and “Capitalism” difficulty levels, and additional languages.

title: Akimbot
description: In the action-adventure platformer, Akimbot, blast your way through armies of robots, pilot spaceships and forge your own path to save the universe from impending doom! Set in a sci-fi world where only robots exist, travel the galaxy and experience non-stop robot mayhem and explosive action!

title: Nerobi
description:
This indie game is a 2D scrolling platformer with several elements typical of a graphic adventure, featuring some cinematic sequences. It is all hand-drawn.
The gameplay is definitely challenging. It requires coordination and timing, and you have to use your wits. Different powers are unlocked as you go along, expanding the gameplay experience.
In addition, scattered around the world, there are several hidden cards to collect.

title: Wanderer's Guide to Ocean and Islands
description: Wanderer's Guide to Ocean and Islands is a game that combines elements of a walking simulator and a visual novel.

title: Clothing Store Simulator
description: Manage your own clothing store. Arrange displays and help your customers. Expand your store as your business grows!

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Rakarth
description:
Since taming the infamous black dragon Bracchus as a youth, Rakarth has long held a reputation as the most cruelly talented of Naggaroth’s Beastmasters. It is a claim none dispute, as he soars high over the battlefield on the mighty beast before diving into the fray in a murderous blur of talons and teeth.

Voiced by actor Iwan Rheon, Rakarth begins play on the Isle of Albion and leads the Thousand Maws faction. As he claims victory in battle and captures key settlements, new monsters of all kinds are added to his Beast Pens where they may be recruited into his armies.

title: Ninkyo Dantai
description: Ninkyo Dantai is a 3D top-down, role-playing video game developed by TeamCS1. It is the first mainline title in the Ninkyo Dantai franchise developed as a turn-based RPG.

title: Control Monger
description: Control Monger is a freeware team-based vehicular FPS.

title: Talon
description: Talon is a 6DoF multiplayer sci-fi flight combat game blending elements from FPS, flight sim, and space combat for adrenaline-fueled high-speed action in a team-based tactical shooter with colorful weapons and plentiful explosions. It became freeware on November 24th of 2023.

title: Veins Like Tapeworms
description: Who needs a moral compass when you have a god in the gutter?

title: FreeWorld
description: FreeWorld is a defunct MMORPG developed from 2002 to 2008.

title: Dark Roast Cafe
description: Summon demons to help you run your business, and work yourself to boost their performance. Decorate the interior, keep the place tidy and pick the best employees to fulfill your customers' needs!

title: Zwift
description: Where fitness meets adventure. There’s never a dull day of indoor training in the amazing worlds of Zwift. Explore endless roads and unlock your fitness goals.

title: Senran Kagura: Peach Beach Splash - Sexy Soaker Edition
description: The digital "Sexy Soaker" edition includes the same DLC pack as the physical LE containing the Soaking Wet High School Uniform costume, a set of colorful bikini costumes, the Futomaki Roll Bazooka special weapon, a Bebeby pet card, and a special set of skill cards, and a downloadable soundtrack containing the same 47 music tracks included in the soundtrack CD of the physical version.

title: Crawlspace Multiplayer
description: A nightmarish playground awaits beneath the floorboards. Join forces with your friends to conquer the crawlspace and retrieve the baby dolls that are trapped in its depths. But watch your back... killer dolls thirst for your fear. In this suffocating battle for survival, teamwork is your only lifeline. Can you mend the ventilation system and escape, or will the crawlspace become your eternal tomb?

title: Blast Monkeys
description: Blast Monkeys is a physics based puzzle game where the player must reach a floating bunch of bananas marked 'GOAL' to finish each level. The monkey is blasted out a cannon at a direction based on the players choosing. The game was developed by American studio Yobonja and was released for iOS in January 2011 and Android in February 2011.

title: One Hell of a Maid
description:
'One Hell of a Maid' is a short game, where you play as a maid cleaning one's apartment.

Submission to Ludum Dare 55.

title: Corgi's Travel
description:
A scientist is conducting experiments with a machine that can shrink objects. To ensure safety, he decides to do the experiments a bit away from his house, but he makes the mistake of bringing his dog along.

Without the scientist noticing, the dog accidentally presses the machine's button, getting shrunk and gaining superpowers. Thus begins the dog's journey back home, trying to find a way to reverse the effect and return to normal size, while facing various challenges, including giant insects.

title: LocoSoccer 2
description: LOCOSOCCER 2 is a crazy fast-paced physics-based casual football game that you can play everywhere with anybody or against anybody.

title: Without a Voice: Blooming Edition
description: DLC for Without a Voice that builds upon a free April 2024 update with full voice acting, an extra full completion bonus, and unlockable achievements. The DLC includes: four new epilogues, two new illustrations, and a built-in artbook viewer.

title: Hell's On Hold
description:
Become The No. 1 Summoner Support in Hell!

Hell's On Hold is a short (yet technically endless) game.

Take calls from disgruntled demons as you try and fix their summoning rituals! Use the book generously provided to you by our partners at SCRYN to assist demons put together their summoning rituals.

Try to beat your friends, or to earn your keep to stay another week in hell.*

*NOTE: You are not paid for your time as a Summoning Support Employee

**NOTE: You're here forever.

title: Dynamite Joe
description: Dynamite Joe is a game where you avoid cops and monsters as you dash to escape prison by collecting keys to get on the next level.

title: Garten of Banban 8: Anti Devil
description: Explore the most obscure levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the new deceives and mysteries that await you. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

title: Graveyard Shift at Freddy's
description:
"Graveyard Shift at Freddy's" is a small Re-Imagining of the original Five Nights at Freddy's, with new twists and turns! Featuring brand new mechanics, visuals, characters, and an entirely new story for you to unravel.

Venture into "Freddybear's Eatery and Fun", watch feeds, and ensure nothing gets damaged.

title: Shootrush
description: A runner where you have to avoid obstacles while defending yourself from robots who want to kill you.

title: Escape Academy: Tournament of Puzzles
description:
Hit the road with Coach Yoach and experience all new arenas, game modes, power-ups, and PUZZLES! Solve your way through giant, replayable arenas filled with secret passages, alternate routes and randomized puzzles.

Journey to Egypt’s Tomb of the First Escapist, the rain soaked and tech-infused Hackannery, or everyone’s favorite Escape theater The Showman’s Studio!

Face off against fellow Escapists in three new competitive modes Escape Race, Tic-Tac-Toe, and Scavenger Hunt, featuring all different mechanics!

And if you thought things couldn’t get wackier, Tournament of Puzzles features exciting new Power-Ups! Deploy distracting traps against your opponents or or gain an advantage by utilizing assists and secure the win.

More of a solo solver? Not a problem! Coach Yoach is happy to let any Escapist puzzle their way through the arenas in single player mode. See how fast you can conquer each course and compete for your best time!

title: Super Gran
description:
Super Gran is a game using the character from the 80s TV Show of the same name. You play as Super Gran and you must play eight levels with four different styles of games, as you attempt to thwart Scunner Campbell and his goons Tub and Rent-a-muscle.

The first level sees you in a flying machine viewed from the side with the whole level shown on the screen. You must avoid and bomb the other flying machines and you complete the level when the timer reaches zero. The second level sees you with the ability to fly as yourself but with limited fuel which is viewed from the side but the game scrolls left or right when you move. You must avoid balloons and planes while you can collect any car or cat on the ground. There are fuel depots which will increase your fuel meter.

The third level has you driving on a vertical scrolling road viewed from above as you must avoid the other car on the road and touching the sides. You can speed up or slow down. The fourth level is a platform game with the whole level shown on the screen. You must get to the top by jumping from various platforms while avoiding the bombs from a helicopter. Hitting a platform at the wrong angle also kills you and the tide slowly rises at the bottom.

Once you have completed the four levels you then repeat them again. You have five lives and once they have gone it is game over. The joystick is used to control your hero with just one player playing the game.

The C16 version has just three levels and misses out the second level where Super Gran flies.

title: EA Sports College Football 25: Deluxe Edition
description: In EA SPORTS College Football 25 experience explosive gameplay variety across 134 FBS schools and immerse yourself in the iconic atmospheres of college football as you chase college greatness.

title: Classic Marathon
description:
From the team that brought you Aleph One, the classic sci-fi FPS Marathon from Bungie on Mac revived for modern hardware by the fan community.

Alien forces have boarded the colony ship UESC Marathon in the Tau Ceti system, in orbit around humanity’s first interstellar colony. The situation is dire, and as a security officer assigned to the Marathon, your duty is to defend the ship and its crew from the alien threat.

This classic 1994 Bungie FPS had a foundational influence on the genre, and is now maintained by the fan community. Experience authentic game play using the original data files, with achievements, optional widescreen HUD support, 3D filtering/perspective, positional audio, and 60+ fps interpolation, just in case the original is too authentic.

title: Our Souls Never Sleep
description: Player will face choices that determine their fate and the fates of the friends they make along the way in this psychological horror game.

title: Forgotten Playland
description:
Forgotten Playland is a free-to-play, social party game that takes place in the quiet solitude of a long-forgotten and abandoned house, where a whimsical world unfolds.

Within the dusty rooms and forgotten corners of time, an enchanting realm comes to life as the once-discarded toys left by their owners embark on a magical journey of their own.

Welcome to Forgotten Playland, a realm where the PlushKyns breathe life into a world of games and adventures.

title: Classic Marathon 2
description:
From the team that brought you Aleph One, the classic sci-fi FPS Marathon 2: Durandal from Bungie on Mac revived for modern hardware by the fan community.

Fresh from your triumph on the colony ship Marathon, you are seized by the rogue AI Durandal to do his bidding in a distant part of the galaxy. Within the ruins of an ancient civilization, you must seek the remnants of a lost clan and uncover their long-buried secrets. Battle opponents ancient and terrible, with sophisticated weapons and devious strategies, all the while struggling to escape the alien nightmare…

This classic 1995 Bungie FPS is now maintained by the fan community. Experience authentic game play using the original data files, with achievements, optional widescreen HUD support, 3D filtering/perspective, positional audio, and 60+ fps interpolation, just in case the original is too authentic.

title: Classic Marathon Infinity
description:
From the team that brought you Aleph One, the classic sci-fi FPS Marathon Infinity from Bungie on Mac revived for modern hardware by the fan community.

Marathon Infinity takes the closed universe of the Marathon series and blows it wide open. The solo/co-op campaign, “Blood Tides of Lh’owon,” is a 20-level scenario sporting new textures, weapons, and enemies. More than that, the scenario sheds a surprising new light on the story’s characters and the meaning of events. Having defeated the Pfhor and reawakened the ancient remnants of the S’pht, the player now faces a world where friends become enemies and all is not what it seems…

This classic 1996 Bungie FPS is now maintained by the fan community. Experience authentic game play using the original data files, with achievements, optional widescreen HUD support, 3D filtering/perspective, positional audio, and 60+ fps interpolation, just in case the original is too authentic.

title: PainKeep Arena
description: PainKeep Arena is a "Mission-Pack" designed for use with the registered version of Quake III Arena. PainKeep Arena not only offers brand new weapons, but also rich environments packed with tons of new sounds, new special effects, great new features, and lots of surprises.

title: Rocket Arena 3
description: All the goodness of Rocket Arena 2 and much much more. Rocket Arena 3 will redefine what a mod can and should be, going beyond simple gameplay and map additions and adding to the core engine itself. Thanks to the power of client side code in Quake 3, a huge number of features never before thought possible will now take Rocket Arena 3 to that next level. Welcome to the next generation of Rocket Arena, and the next evolution of Quake.

title: PainKeep
description: PainKeep is a DeathMatch-only “mission-pack” designed for use with registered Quake. PainKeep not only offers brand new weapons (with new pickup and view models), but also a new rich environment with tons of new sounds, new special effects, great new features, and lots of surprises.

title: Rocket Arena 2
description: Rocket Arena 2 is one of the most popular Quake 2 mods of all time. It's innovative "multi-arena" maps allows players to choose from up to 10 arenas on a single level, and have matches going on in all of them simulatnously. The refined "pickup" mode introduces players to the fast-paced teamplay style of Clan Arena.

title: Endless Crimes of the Future
description:
Do not fear falling, you have cybernetic limbs. Use the scrolling coloured button on your ship to direct its course. Find the scrolling coloured buttons on the ground and use them to call your ship to pick you up.

Humanity has been enslaved by unknown forces. You are a time traveller and a rebel outsider living high above the city. What can you even do in the face of such a situation?

title: Abstract Ritual
description:
You are searching for the entrance to the secret world.
You are just a natural explorer I guess. It's cool.

Please excuse the spirit monsters being a bit mean, they are just stressed out.

title: The Pyramid Gate
description: The Pyramid Gate is a short but very atmospheric little adventure created by developer Strangethink for the "lowrezjam". Players will explore a very obtuse and surreal environment to see if they can unravel the mysteries of the various pyramids around.

title: Maria-sama ga Gyakuten: Etape de l'hiver
description: This sequel contains a double parody, featuring a courtroom showdown that is being released here in digital format for the first time.

title: Cubed and Dangerous
description: Cubed and Dangerous is a charming stylized twin-stick shooter that seamlessly merges action roguelike mechanics and action RPG mechanics into an exciting run-based experience.

title: Valkyrie: The Magical Odyssey
description: A fantasy sidescroller for DOS based in norse mythology.

title: Bighead
description: Everything seems fine on a Saturday night, you're about to watch a horror movie with your partner, when suddenly something happens. Dive into this nightmarish story about big heads

title: Gensou Sekai: Eastland Saga
description:
Reimu travels alone at first, but new heroines can be obtained as the player progresses through the game's story by exploring the game world and defeating opponents.
The battle system is turn-based with the protagonists and antagonists on different sides of the battlefield, using various commands such as: attack, magic, heal, defend and run.

title: Castlevania Chronicles III: Dracula's Curse
description:
A fanmade remake of Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse by studio WarMachine.

Experience Castlevania III like never before!
Enhanced visuals, mechanics, and new abilities such as item crashes, updated spells and forms, fully remastered OST, and much more!!!

"Do you have what it takes to face me?!"

It's always better to play with friends, and this time you get to keep ALL your partners along the way!

title: Zeta Wolf: First Bite
description: Explore the budding friendship between Carly and Siona — two girls whose personalities couldn't be more different! Will their friendship blossom into something more? Or will their selfish desires drive a wedge between them? Find out in this lighthearted prequel to Zeta Wolf Chronicles!

title: Airships: Lost Flotilla
description: Airships: Lost Flotilla is a steampunk autoshooter where you fight your way through waves of enemies on your way to a safe harbour. Destroy your foes, harvest wreckage, and upgrade your ship.

title: Bloodrails
description: Bloodrails is a fast paced Instagib capture-the-flag mod for Quake which features unique movement mechanics such as axe-dashing, skiing and grappling hooks.

title: Nunna
description: Nunna is a turn-based combat game with rogue-lite and deck-building elements. Defeat the enemies in front of Nunna and end her journey.

title: Ridgeside Village
description: An expansive mod for Stardew Valley, Ridgeside Village adds over 50 new NPCs, a new location, new items, new shops, new festivals, custom music, custom quests, and more!

title: Blissful Acres
description: Blissful Acres: Immersive Farming RPG! Slay monsters in a vibrant world with quests & secrets. Cultivate crops, automate tasks. Invest riches to expand farm & upgrade gear. Wield powerful weapons against foes. Unique blend of farming & action-packed adventures for epic odyssey!

title: Make Ten
description: Select numbers that add to ten, to remove them from the board. How high can you score in just 2 minutes?

title: Sonic Riders X
description: A re-imagining of the Sonic Riders games with the creators' own ideas to put a new spin on it.

title: Kokodi
description:
In a world without adults, kids fight each other for power and sweets!
Kokodi is a third-person extraction shooter set in a fantasy environment.

title: Zelda 64: Recompiled - Majora's Mask
description: A static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask for PC and Linux, with many enhancements like widescreen support, auto saving and higher resolution. It works through Zelda 64: Recompiled.

title: DinoLauncher
description: A mod launcher for Dinosaur Planet which applied the latest patches for the game, which is otherwise unplayable in its original form, and has a high quality models feature.

title: Relaxing Simulator
description: Discover the calm and serenity. Immerse yourself in a world full of natural beauty, relaxing and soothing activities. Explore places and find your inner balance. Escape the everyday stress and find peace in this digital sanctuary of relaxation.

title: Qdoom
description: QDOOM reimagines the legendary first episode of DOOM (1993), Knee-Deep in the Dead, in the Quake engine. Go toe-to-toe with a deadly tag team of both Quake and DOOM foes in this double-dosed love letter to id Software’s genre-pushing franchises.

title: Half-Life: The World Machine
description: You are Flynn Weißhaupt, a computer engineer of Black Mesa who worked on the Gibson, a powerful supercomputer. Now with the Resonance Cascade, it is your mission to retrieve the data of the Gibson and destroy it. Because The Gibson is too powerful to fall into the hands of alien forces or the military.

title: Comfy Maps
description: Ever wanted a relaxing Half-Life map just to chill in? Here are 2 meditative-type maps (sunset and night settings) allowing just that. There’s a bit to explore and you can sit on the chair or couch if you like.

title: Tuca Quest
description: Tuca Quest follows the titular Tuca (Lactuca Optima) as he gets sent on an adventure against United States President Joe Biden. Tuca constantly finds himself in new and bizarre locations throughout his quest. You'll have to make many decisions which will alter your playthrough. Can you get the true Tuca ending?

title: My Little Life
description: A desktop companion that lives on the bottom of your screen. Expand and decorate their home to keep them happy. Help them live their best life while you focus on yours.

title: Dynamite Duchess 3: Carnival of Souls
description: Explore Heaven, Hell, and Purgatory (and invade a few of your friends' heavenly suites) on a quest to save your mother's soul. Fight weird monsters, talk to annoying NPCs, and solve a few vexing puzzles.

title: Stardust Kids
description:
Deputy head of the UFO study club wasn’t prepared for what the inspection of club’s property will bring. The long-awaited summer break has to be postponed until Kurt finds the lost item — a home planetarium.
A story about friendship and bonding under starry sky.

title: Dawn Chorus
description: Dawn Chorus is a wholesome, non-linear romance furry visual novel set in cold and snow-clad Norway.

title: Star Chef Simulator
description:
Welcome to Star Chef Simulator, where your dream of running your own restaurant is about to become a reality! Immerse yourself in the exciting world of culinary entrepreneurship as you build and manage your restaurant from the ground up. Unleash your inner chef and dive in the art of cooking with more than 10 delicious dishes from around the world. Cook with a variety of different ingredients, techniques and recipes to create culinary masterpieces that will delight your customers. Use various kitchen appliances such as the deep fryer, oven, stove or mixer and create unique dishes!

Hire, train, and manage your employees to keep your restaurant running smoothly. Build a strong team to handle the hustle and bustle of a busy kitchen. Customize your restaurant, from the walls to the floors, from the decor to the equipment. Create a unique dining experience and watch customers flock to your establishment.
Keep an eye on your finances as you make decisions to grow your business. Manage employee costs and invest in upgrades to attract more customers and increase profits. Provide top-notch service to your guests to earn rave reviews. Listen to feedback and strive to deliver a memorable dining experience that keeps guests coming back for more.

Are you ready to take the helm of your own restaurant and become the ultimate culinary star chef? The world of gastronomy awaits you!

title: Return of the Quack
description: Matt Furie and Chevy Ray Johnson Team up for this side scrolling shooter featuring Matt Furie's whimsical characters.

title: The Quizard's Domain
description:
Pub quiz meets pub brawl in this fast-paced, hero-based Battle Quiz!
Show off your brains AND brawn with up to 4 players locally, in a fusion of classic trivia/quiz elements, social deduction games, and fast-paced 2D action brawlers.
Crash, smash, and dash your way to the right answer, take a slower and more deceptive approach to fool your opponents, or forge completely new strategies across the varied playable characters and arenas.

title: The Whale Island
description:
"It's just a legend, isn't it?"

A legend of an ancient whale island, one no one believes in after so many years. Is there really lost magic there? Tisha makes Fran a promise.

"I'll take you to the whale island."

title: KeeperFX
description:
KeeperFX is an open-source remake and fan expansion of Dungeon Keeper.

The main goal of KeeperFX is to preserve and expand upon the original Dungeon Keeper experience, offering many new features, improvements, and much more while staying true to the original feeling of the game. You can delve into the original campaign and deeper dungeons, or enjoy levels and campaigns created by the community. There are an additional 13 bundled campaigns and 2 bundled map packs and many more to download from the Workshop.

title: Hotel Hustle
description: Take a very hands-on approach to managing a bustling hotel and make sure your guests leave with a smile on their face.

title: Akiko Hard
description: Akiko is a special agent who arrives to a suspicious school as a new teacher to investigate rumors about its dark secrets.

title: Threat Assessment
description: Small metal/base Coagula-type void level with a high enemy density.

title: The Bonehoard
description: Large blue/metal level with caverns, blood, bones and otherworldy parts.

title: The Frater Fracas
description: Medium sized IKbase map.

title: Coven of Ebony
description: Blue medieval episode with 4 levels (+start/end map), some new monsters and fairly tough gameplay.

title: Clériga
description: After 82 years of Xyvran's defeat, Clériga must venture herself into her palace to repair the seal she put on the demon that prevented her infinite regeneration. This surreal horror experience puts you on edge as you need to find your way to the top of the castle while enemies slow you down, making you die slowly but surely, as your blood is being absorbed by the second.

title: FuryDough
description:
FuryDough is an action roguelite where donuts are everywhere, and you will hate them. Break through mazes, fight with a crowd of zany doughy adversaries, find and destroy Dough Mixers.
This is not a sweet dream, but a real nightmare.

title: When I Said "It's Ok To Be Cringe" I Didn't Mean Like That
description: A freeform exploration game about walking around and talking to people and interacting with things and nothing interesting happening.

title: Sverigespelet
description: The band Tripple & Touch is without a drummer and it is up to you to find them one somewhere in Sweden. Use Flight, Train, Bus, or Boat. In order to buy the ticket, you must either win it or earn it (by answering questions, with three answer options). At the beginning of the game, you receive a mission, and through it, you might figure out in which city the Drummer is located. But there are also clues that you can win or earn. There are plenty of video clips with the Tripplets, and you'll see them as encouragement when things go well - or not so well... You can have up to five real players taking turns, or if you're playing alone, up to five opponents who are in the game. This game was released to promote and train for the Swedish edition of "Who Wants to be a Millionaire?"

title: Where Are They?
description: Where Are They? is a game of Where's Waldo? Are you able to find all the hidden things?

title: Cyber Russia
description:
Welcome to the gritty world of CyberRussia, an online game set in a futuristic, cyberpunk version of Russia where players navigate through a complex web of crime, corruption, and power. In this virtual world, players can choose diverse roles such as law enforcement officers tasked with upholding order, prosecutors fighting against corruption, judges arbitrating cases, ambitious deputies shaping policies, and governors wielding influence over regions.

However, the allure of the dark side is equally tempting. You can venture into the underworld, joining criminal syndicates to become a notorious bandit or mastermind. Engage in illicit activities, from bribery to smuggling, but beware—the watchful eye of the federal security service is always present, ready to pounce on any misstep.

For those seeking alternative paths, there's a chance to invest in land, cultivate crops, and engage in trade, all within the cybernetic landscapes of future Russia. Become a miner, extracting precious resources, or rise as an influential entrepreneur amidst the neon-lit chaos of this immersive, cyberpunk universe. The choices are yours to make, but the consequences are as real as the digital world around you.

title: Gooba Ball
description: A physics-based puzzle game where you combine colorful balls to achieve the ultimate form -- Goober! Combine two of a kind until, like I said, Goober… What more to do you freakin’ want?

title: Dragon Quest: Legacy of the Lost
description: Dragon Quest: Legacy of the Lost is a fangame highly inspired by Dragon Warrior 7. The game will feature the shard system and time travel aspect found in Dragon Warrior 7. The underlying story, however, is not the same and besides the time travelling portion, no plot sequence will be taken from Dragon Warrior 7.

title: TerrariaCraft
description: TerrariaCraft is a mod for Minecraft: Java Edition that adds content from Terraria, a 2D game by Re-Logic, by completely changing how newly created worlds look with custom terrain generation, bigger and deeper caves to explore, and many more new features and mechanics than just that! Explore a finite island to find resources and biomes, fight against mobs to survive, and progress through the mod!

title: The Call of the Rats
description: jimmy wakes up in the middle of nature and he can’t find his pa. help him find his pa.

title: Prototype Textures II
description: 23 small to medium-sized maps using khreathor's Prototype texture wad and Dumptruck's SMP progs

title: Progs_dump
description: SM188 is a speedmap pack themed around the new progs_dump tools.

title: Project Homecoming Haven
description:
Play as a Trauma Cleaner; a housecleaning service that receives requests from bereaving families to clean up rooms and houses left by the deceased.

In your job, you will learn about those who left the world of their own volition or others. Learn about the life they lived, choose belongings of the deceased to be given to their families, or keep them for yourself to grow your Trauma Cleaning business.

title: Evernight
description: A romantic tale about a human raised among faeries.

title: Freddi Fish Collection
description:
5 of the most popular Freddi Fish games in one epic collection!

These games will provide limitless hours of fun and replay-ability with full animation, professional voice acting, award-winning music and tons of mysteries to solve!

title: Sweetest Monster
description: A middle-aged man has an encounter with a cute catgirl in the dead of night - but all is not as it seems.

title: Master Detective Archives: Rain Code Plus
description: A brand new dark fantasy detective action game from the minds behind the Danganronpa series! Yuma, an amnesiac detective-in-training, and Shinigami, the spirit haunting him, tackle unsolved mysteries in a strange city caged by unending rain.

title: Ice Crush 10.000 BC
description: Crush ice blocks!

title: Gallop Glory: Obstacle Racing & Horse Simulator
description: Ride, Bond, Conquer Your equestrian adventure awaits.

title: 1-2-Word Search!
description:
1-2-Word Search is a classic word search puzzle game with a TreeFall twist! As you complete and solve each word search puzzle you unlock new background music to change up the mood of each puzzle.

description: This game may contain content that is not appropriate for all ages or for viewing in the workplace: general adult content. Contains content that is not suitable for all ages, sexual themes.

title: Breaking Bricks
description: Get ready to experience the thrill of BREAKING BRICKS, an addictive arcade game that will captivate players of all ages. With 40 challenging levels, you’ll have a blast breaking bricks and progressing to new stages. The goal of BREAKING BRICKS is simple: use your skill and quick reflexes to destroy all the blocks on the screen. But it won’t be as easy as it sounds! As you advance through the levels, the blocks become tougher, requiring smart strategies to overcome each challenge. What truly sets BREAKING BRICKS apart are the exciting power-ups you’ll discover throughout the game. These power-ups range from extra balls to multiply your score, to powerful weapons that destroy multiple blocks at once. Each power-up adds an extra layer of excitement and strategy, keeping you on your toes and eager for more. With its fast-paced action and intuitive controls, BREAKING BRICKS delivers an engaging experience from start to finish. Every level provides a sense of achievement as you progress.

title: Mayonaka 10 Chome

If there are no abnormalities, please turn right. Will you be able to safely navigate through the eternal road of terror?

Neverdaunt:8Bit (N8) was an online massively multiplayer virtual sandbox created by Robot Loves Kitty. In the game, players would explore a "dreamlike world of floating islands and fallen stars where nearly anything can happen." Players could fight, build, socialize, and shop. The game also included a visual programming language called Tronics that allowed players to program devices within the game.
N8's servers were shut down in May 2012.

Commander, welcome aboard the DarkStar One – Nintendo Switch Edition to be released on June 20, 2024

and the tactics and play style of your party will be determined by your choices.

description: A 3D, comedic, character-driven, action-RPG where everyone in Cleanland is a personification of a cleaning product! As the town janitor you'll befriend the residents of Cleanland and team up with them to fight germs!

title: Fully Dogomatic
description: An auto shooter where you create a ring of guns around you to mow down thousands of enemies! You may be an adorable corgi, but that won't stop you from designing the ultimate arsenal of fully customizable, realistic weaponry.

title: Scorching Earth
description: Scorching Earth is a 32-map vanilla megawad for Doom 2. Inspired by Hellbound by Z86, Scorching Earth features highly detailed maps that are connected to each other to give the wad continuity.

title: Silhouettes
description: You see them in your dreams, only you can solve the riddle. Immerse yourself in crime, fantasy, horror events.

title: DGGWare
description: DGGWare is a collection of meme based micro games in the vein of WarioWare. The game centers around streamer Destiny's community and covers topics from gaming, politics, philosophy, debate, art, culture and drama.

title: Eldritch Tactics: Lichtmond
description: Eldritch Tactics: Lichtmond is a turn-based strategy game based on german folklore. After her untimely demise, the Burgund queen Kriemhild and her allied troops find themselves trapped in the Anderswelt where they face an onslaught of undead creatures as well as their own steadily declining sanity.

title: Rune Seeker
description: Rune Seeker is a strategy card game with a turn-based format, developed to become a tactical universe.

title: Let's Café
description: Let's Café is a cafe business simulator game with a quirky and cozy atmosphere. Manage your menu as you experiment and discover new recipes, keep your ingredient budget balanced while shopping to soup up your store, cook quickly and creatively, and serve up smiles to an array of characters!

title: It Started With Hairs
description:
A 5-10 minute visual novel about the horror of having a body.

Content Warnings for descriptions of body horror and self harm.

title: Subaru no Kishi
description: A fantasy SRPG.

title: SuKuBus-Mission
description: SuKuBus-Mission is an erotic role-playing game about a group of perverts trying to avoid the extermination of all lust.

title: Ninja Stealth 5
description: Ninja Stealth 5 is the new game in the series with a new challenge for you. Be stealth, evade from lasers, cameras, motion detectors and security guards. Collect all computers to beat the game.

title: The Great Conclovince of Mithrithnogg
description:
Enter the realm of Agrippa, where ancient gods and nightmare-inducing creatures rule supreme! This action-adventure game blends psychological horror with an intense story, which challenges players to survive in a reality distorted by malevolent forces.

In a realm where the line between reality and madness blurs, the face of the ancient god Agrippa lies atop a mountain, commanding legions of grotesque and contorted creatures. Once an artificial humanoid, now wields god-like powers and harbors a deep resentment towards his creators.

Agrippa's torment is relentless; he creates an alternate reality where every living being is a twisted reflection of Mongol, designed to break his spirit and mind.
You are the shadow of Agrippa, tasked with finding a suitable replacement for Mongol now that he is no longer of any use to him!

title: Ghost Dance
description:
David Lynch, filmmaker, artist, and musician, has not made a video game. He certainly did not make this video game. If he were to make one, however, maybe it would be something like this complete conceptual and artistic mess.

In this game you traverse a series of horror scenes directly indebted to Lynch films and artworks cobbled together in an incoherent fever dream. In this world, 'Lynch' is struggling to rebuild his creative world / abstract psychological state and he needs your help. Only you can traverse the inane dreamscape of Lynch's creations and make some sense of the terrible things that are about to be unleashed. But beware: not all is as it seems.

title: Connie and the Essence of Chaos
description: Connie and the Essence of Chaos is a cute 2D adventure inspired by past platforming classics. JUMP and PUNCH your way through 6 distinct and colorful worlds on your quest to defeat the evil overlord Lucilate and free the island of Cuisinia from his reign of terror!

title: They Grew Lungs and Drowned
description:
Explore the wreckage.

Speak with the survivors.

The Permanent Food Source has run dry.

Time to move on.

title: Serial World
description: "SerialWorld" is a comedic yet serious RPG. Whether you've played deck-building games before or not, everyone can enjoy this adventurous tale. Embark on a journey into the mysterious world to solve the city's disturbances!

title: Food Devils
description: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Strategy-RPG Roguelike.

title: Dwellink: War of the Nine
description: Dwellink is a dark fantasy creature collector RPG, set in a universe under siege. The Great Link opened portals connecting the Nine Worlds of Kohara, allowing ferocious Dwellers to spread chaos and destruction. It's up to you to discover the source of the cataclysm and end it once and for all!

title: Cities: Skylines Remastered - Campus
description: Back to school! In Cities: Skylines - Campus, university life abounds with new area types for any sort of student - Trade School, Liberal Arts and University. Increase the reputation of your campus by attracting students and creating Academic Works to unlock new buildings. Build five types of varsity sports arenas and nine unique faculties, employ seven new policies, earn seven new achievements and take on five new maps! Campus takes higher education to new heights with everything you need to graduate magna cum laude.

title: Waffle House
description: Waffle House is a set of 9 MBF21 maps by a small group of people who decided to get together and answer a simple question: "What is bro waffling about?". Maps are balanced for pistol start, target port is DSDA, and difficulties are implemented.

title: Orca
description: Orca is a very short, single map-long WAD visually influenced by rd's Eden, and otherwise inspired by the song scp2.mid.

title: Farlands Journey
description: Farlands Journey is a colorful classic adventure platformer game where you play as a little witch fighting the evil forces. Embark on an adventure to recover the stolen heart of your Magical Academy. Discover various magic spells and hats with unique effects. Defeat monsters and their bosses. Solve puzzles by combining platforming skills and magical spells. Collect gems and spend them on upgrades in Magical Academy.

title: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods
description: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods is a new kind of combo RPG where you and your pup piece together flashy combos to dismantle a plethora of enemies! Discover your hidden powers as you find yourself hurtled into a conflict amongst the gods.

title: Skyblock Chaos
description: A skyblock sandbox crafting and building adventure

title: My Adaptation In(to) Human
description: It's a visual novel horror game that's published on Steam.

title: Make It Stop!
description: A 3D shooter that places the player in the cockpit of a ship traveling through the bloodstream, fighting off viruses.

title: Club Penguin Avalanche
description: Club Penguin Avalanche is an unofficial revival of the beloved Club Penguin made by fans, specifically crafted for and by Brazilian players. Featuring a dedicated launcher, this nostalgic virtual world offers a unique and immersive experience reminiscent of the original game. Players can waddle around as penguins, explore various places, and participate in fun activities and minigames, just like in the old Club Penguin.

title: Mugengikyou: First Disaster
description:
A Touhou Project doujin bullet-hell action RPG with Reimu as the protagonist.

The game is split into two parts, action and battle.
If you run into enemies or traps during the action stage, you'll start the battle portion.

title: Leaf's Odyssey
description: Leaf's Odyssey is a turn-based game where you fight various monsters in order to solve each puzzle. Every move can be predicted and anticipated. Failure is not punished; you can undo and try a different approach as many times as you want.

title: Mugengikyou: Second Departure
description: Mugengikyou: Second Departure is an Touhou fangame and one of the Mugengikyou series.

description: The player manages a rock band and must secure funds to producing music videos and become successful by managing the budget efficiently. This is achieved by completing objectives like keeping on schedule and ensuring the van does not run out of fuel.

title: Kebab Simulator

title: Sacred Earth: Reverie
description: Sacred Earth - Reverie is a fantasy RPG with visual novel elements, inspired by both classic and modern JRPGs. Explore dungeons, interact with your allies and the townsfolk, build your characters with equipment, abilities, and perks, and test your might against foes in thrilling turn-based combat.

title: Hyakusen no Jou ni Kawatareshi Toki
description: Hyakusen no Jou ni Kawataresi Toki is a Japanese RPG, released by Eushry on PC in 2024.

title: FaithEater
description: In a world where humans hunt the Gods for a chance at hope, you have betrayed the Faith Eaters. Given the highest punishment, you've been thrown into the Cathedral at the End of the World, where the God of Death Muerte has been imprisoned. You expect it to devour you without mercy. Instead, it offers you hope. The very same hope the Faith Eaters have taken away.

title: Favor
description: Survive Z's obsessive intrigue in 'Favor'; a yandere horror VN

title: Happiness Inc.
description: Inspired by Shark Tank, this short romcom visual novel lets you present yourself and answer your prospect client's questions to convince him to marry you. Good luck, and show off your flirting skills in a business manner.

title: Social Democracy: An Alternate History
description: Play as the Social Democratic Party of Germany in 1928, and try to stop the NSDAP from taking power. Guide the party through elections and parliamentary politics, and deal with the Great Depression and the spiraling political violence that characterized the late "Weimar Republic".

title: The Knight Dance
description:
Gather 'round, young and old.
Listen as I regale you with the tale of two lovers: one as sure as the other is stubborn.
Dancing shoes, a few stolen hours each night, and an important decision to be made.
Does love truly conquer...or is love never enough?

title: Werewolf Party
description: Test your deception skills in this thrilling first-person multiplayer game. Play with 4-11 people, taking on diverse roles—from a cunning werewolf to an observant villager, each equipped with unique powers. Pay attention to detail, listen for vocal cues, and use your perception to win.

title: Death in Unison
description: Survive the world's deadliest psychopaths. Experience a unique 2-player co-op experience that puts your teamwork and communication to the test. Complete your duties alone or with a partner in a prison like no other.

title: Solarys The Witch of Fire
description: Take control of the witch, Solarys, and fight your way through beat-'em-up styled levels, using kicks, punches, and fire magic.

title: Businessmen
description:
a group of businessman just arrived in delfino square, and they want to make sure they own all the coins around here.

traditional laws of physics don't apply for business.

description: Final Frog is a platform game in which a cute frog traverses levels to collect treasures (and flies)!

title: Kaetram
description: Adventure through a large world, unlock secret areas, complete quests, and collaborate with others to defeat bosses and become the best!

title: Jurassic Tower Defense
description: Welcome to Jurassic Tower Defense! Command your defenses and fend off waves of dinosaurs in this thrilling tower defense game. Strategically build turrets and manage resources to protect your base. Are you ready to rewrite history and bring about the extinction of the dinosaurs?

title: Our Winding Road
description: Former heroes try to save their relationship.

title: Curse of the Juniper Tree
description: A story about two siblings and a cursed tree. Wishes come with a price.

title: Swiped! Double Shots of Love
description:
"Swiped!: Double Shots of Love" is a romantic visual novel featuring a slightly older cast of 4 main love interests. You can customise your MC's name and pronouns.

This game features cussing, I'd usually recommend for a slightly older audience due to the cast of dateables.

title: Casual Desktop Game
description: Casual Desktop Game is a fanmade revival of the old Desktop Destroyer game featuring community content. Relieve stress by smashing your desktop or unleashing war. Create mods and share them with the community.

title: Temple of Shadows
description:
Embark on an epic adventure as Sabastian Harrington, a passionate archeology grad student turned explorer, in search of his missing professor. Six weeks ago, Dr. Albert J. Montgomery III announced the discovery of a hidden temple, but he never returned. Now, Sabastian must dive into ancient temple ruins, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets. Will you reveal the mysteries within the Temple of Shadows?

Navigate the enigmatic Temple Ruins and unlock the secrets of the Temple Gate. Venture into the labyrinthine caves beyond, a realm filled with ancient mysteries and hidden dangers. Your mission: uncover the truth and track down the elusive Dr. Montgomery. Embark on this thrilling adventure and face challenges that will test your courage and wits at every turn. Can you reveal the secrets that lie within?

title: Cell of Empireo: RTC - Interlude
description: An interlude between Cell of Empireo: Isoi Sanemitsu no Records and Cell of Mirage.

title: Somnium Tenebris
description: Somnium Tenebris is a 5-player, investigative horror game set in a Lovecraftian world. Explore the depths of the ocean with your team as you uncover evidence in your efforts to identify the megalithic creature... and escape before it's too late.

title: Skyblivion
description:
Skyblivion is the ultimate fan-made experience for the Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion, bringing the game into the newer engine of the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. This process combines Oblivion’s impressive award-winning open-world that is renowned for its incredible gameplay, memorable quests, and expansive world space with the advancements in gaming that have been made in the last two decades. Set in the Elder Scroll’s Third Era, during the cataclysmic Oblivion Crisis, you must help to restore the Imperial throne and repel the demonic Daedric invasion.

Skyblivion will feature the remastered entirety of Oblivion’s mainland, Cyrodiil, from the wintery slopes of the Valus and Jerall Mountains to the swamps of Blackwood and warm-beachy shores of the Gold Coast. Skyblivion will bring the return of many classic Oblivion mechanics like spell crafting, a complete class and attributes system, underwater combat, and NPC disposition.

In addition to recreating Oblivion’s systems and porting them into the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim’s engine the project has taken great care in providing new improvements and additions. Skyblivion offers fans remastered graphics, weather, and lighting, an expanded soundtrack, new gameplay mechanics, and even a limited selection of bespoke minor quests with original voice acting to further flesh out barren areas of Oblivion—all for free!

Once Skyblivion is released in 2025, fans will have access to the entirety of Oblivion’s pre-DLC world space, systems, and quests available for play. But that’s not the end of the project! Following a period of bug-fixing and community-supported updates the project development team will move on to working on Oblivion’s nine additional content releases plus the Shivering Isles expansion.

With Skyblivion you experience the best of both worlds: The complex and detailed RPG experience of Oblivion paired with Skyrim’s newer systems, graphics, and quality of life improvements. Will you close shut the jaws of Oblivion once more in 2025?

title: Chi
description:
Chi is a horror game that (poorly) facades as a cute story in which you play as a six year old girl who lives in a small village in Japan with her family and her small dog. Your father is the priest of the small shrine you live in, and you have to follow several important rules that he has set up to keep the village safe. These are the rules: you know what is best for the villagers, so they have to do whatever you and your family say, you cannot go upstairs, you must give blood every Sunday, and you cannot go into the forest.

This specific Sunday, you play as Chi as she goes on a quest with her puppy, Mitsuru, to get markers so that she can draw some pictures. You complete some minor favors, and get your blood drawn so you're able to get said markers. However, as you're walking home, the evening goes terribly wrong as Mitsuru runs into the forest. With this, in order to save your dog, you have no choice but to run in after her...

Run after her into a forest that no one returns from.

title: CaseCracker2
description: Jia huasheng ,the policeman of Chicheng police station, got disappeared without any trace after leaving a letter which illustrates the police station to start the CaseCracker system version 2.0.

title: Crime Simulator
description: You’re out of jail, but the debt isn’t gone. Sneak, steal, and break into houses solo or in 4-player co-op. Use lockpicks, sleeping gas, and brute force to complete jobs, outsmart security, and make enough money before time runs out. Will you pay back what you owe, or lose everything?

title: Deck Defense
description: Deck Defense is a deck building tower defense game, where the player controls both their defenses and the expansion of the map. Expand your deck after each wave with one of over 65 cards to choose from, and try to keep the enemy blobs from reaching the portal.

title: Wakusei
description:
Wakusei is a relaxing physics puzzle game about dropping and merging planets.

Drop planets around an eclipse to merge same planets into new ones. This might cause the extinction of some civilisations but it's okay, we asked them first.

The 360° gameplay makes for an interesting new experience and new strategies.

Unlock upgrades, new events and additional game modes.

Put the universe into a jar in Classic Mode or experience how the game must've felt like before gravity got invented in the Anti Gravity Mode.

title: Reader Rabbit Kindergarten
description: Reader Rabbit and Mat the Mouse collect resources for a large campfire party at Camp Happy Tales.

title: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Thrown to the Dogs
description: Thrown to the Dogs is a downloadable content pre-order expansion package for Assassin's Creed: Shadows that is expected to release alongside the main game. It will involve helping a loyal dog avenge his late master.

title: GigaBash: Godzilla - Nemesis DLC
description:
The Nemeses of Godzilla have invaded!
This DLC adds King Ghidorah and Hedorah from the Godzilla universe to the playable roster. Each character features a unique skillset and playstyle inspired by iconic moments seen in their respective films.

title: Playback Loop
description: Carefully capture tracks of your actions, then play them back to solve puzzles with the aid of your recorded ghosts. Immerse yourself in an intriguing first-person puzzle platformer game set within an enigmatic virtual facility, where strategically thinking several steps ahead is the key to success.

title: Loftlock
description:
Loftlock is a point-and-click fantasy puzzle game. You are Runi: a young wizard who is eager to set off for their new apprenticeship. Your beloved grandmother has bequeathed a tome to you that will undoubtedly serve you well in the coming days, but there’s a catch – she’s forgotten the combination to its lock!

Thankfully, she’s left some clues in the attic – all you need to do is find them.

title: A Trench Tale
description:
A misterious dead man. A castle where dark rituals are performed. A cosmic horror that is corrupting the world as it is. Even the Spanish Inquisition is involved. Would you be able to defeat the evil?

A Trench Tale is a narrative card game where you have to combine two cards at a time to generate new cards that represent steps in your investigation. You will have to relationate concepts to undercover the mistery.

title: Mystery of the Sleeping Castle
description: The Mystery of the Sleeping Castle is a narrative detective game in the style of Case of the Golden Idol and Return of the Obra Dinn, but pinker, more fairytale, and EVERYBODY LIVES! (well, mostly) Make your way through the castle, observe clues and make deductions to solve puzzles, identify the residents, and ultimately release the castle from slumber

title: Petty Officer
description: You are a Compliance Officer for SPACEFLEET. Search for clues on your Compliance Console. Open your dossier to assemble your investigation, check your work, and bring Captain Braxton to justice. Click and Drag until the truth is revealed.

title: Beneath the Waves
description:
I loved you once, split-toed dirt-swimmer. These idols are the bones of wonders. Why should the sun claim the land any more than the sea?

A story-based exploration platformer that takes you to dizzying mountaintops and deep beneath the waves.

title: Asha Empire: Exodus
description: Asha Empire: Exodus is an exhilarating action shooter set in the expansive Asha Galaxy. Experience the intense final hours before the fall of Sirina, a critical imperial industrial military base, as Commander Rexis or Commander Kyra. Your mission is to infiltrate the enemy-occupied base, retrieve vital information, and escape before the Empire commences bombardment from space.

title: Dear Murder Diary
description: Dear Murder Diary is a text-based murder mystery type game, where the player tries to piece together who died and how by reading newspaper articles. Built from a simple gameplay loop where even the finest of detail can bring you closer to the truth.

title: Quiller's Code
description: Solve ciphers to uncover the identity of the Quiller.

title: Detective.exe
description:
Welcome to the SQLPD. You, as the rookie on the force, are tasked with solving the only case not corrupted on our computer systems. Using our "latest" program: detective.exe.

Bring the murderer to justice.

title: R.R.S Cape
description:
You wake up confused inside the R.R.S Cape, a research submersible on an expedition to survey a newly discovered archipelago. As you come to your senses, you realise that you are stranded *somewhere* at the bottom of the sea & oxygen is quickly running out...

With limited air, a map & any clues you can gather from inside your soon-to-become coffin, can you deduce your precise location to call for a rescue mission before it is too late?

title: I Love My Goblin Girlfriend
description: I Love My Goblin Girlfriend is a one-player point-and-click adventure game designed to explore the age-old question: what does your girlfriend want to eat? It’s all about the snacks in this three-part mystery to figure out how to satisfy your goblin gal and unlock the smooch of your dreams. After all, a goblin girl’s gotta eat!

title: Gatherings
description: Gatherings is a 4 player party game heavily focused on the quality of the minigames. Create a Lobby, gather your friends and just play ! No board, no overly long gamemodes, just pure fun, excitement and friendship destroying.

description: This game is a fan game created by Michael Genaro. It is a FNAF (Five Nights At Freddys) remix/remake, click and point horror game, very difficult but very fun! Completely recommend! Also, This game is not mine however the actual developer has not added it to this site, and since it was made 2~3 months ago, i thought i would add it myself for him, the rest of the info is on the official (gamejolt) release site, i could not find any other.

description: Based on the manga with the same name, it follows a new storyline that sees Futaro trapped with the girls on a tropical island as a brief summer getaway is stretched out over weeks. There, Futaro will interact with the sisters, Ichika, Nino, Miku, Yotsuba, and Itsuki, as well as Futaro's younger sister, Raiha. Players can unlock new artwork, costumes, and up to 14 endings. The gameplay promises a "heart-pounding desert island life" and a "five-girl tutoring adventure experience."

This platform makes this game available to DOS, Windows, Linux, MacOSX, PSP (CFW), and Wii (Homebrew Channel) users, and has allowed a significant amount of mechanical evolution from the game's earlier incarnations.

title: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Gold Edition
description:
Assassin's Creed Shadows takes players on an epic historical action adventure set in feudal Japan. Step into the roles of both a deadly shinobi assassin and a legendary samurai as you navigate a stunning open world during tumultuous times. Seamlessly switch between two interconnected characters to uncover their entwined destinies while mastering unique playstyles.
Build your own shinobi league, customize your lair, and influence the future of Japan as you embrace the chaos of this immersive journey.

The Assassin's Creed Shadows Gold Edition includes:

- Up to three days early access to the game
- The Season Pass with a bonus quest at launch and two later expansions.

Slapstick parody of Key's Visual Novel Kanon

You play as 17-year-old Yuuichi Aizawa. Having trained in this madder-red city and left on a ascetic travel, you return to your hometown to determine who is the strongest...

Or by yourself in singleplayer...

description: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 4 Golden Persona Set contains additional content that allows you to use Personas from Persona 4 Golden.

description:
With 'Multi Sports II', Dinamic squeezed everything they could out of their products, getting the ultimate performance at a time when the difficulties were already insurmountable.

For the occasion they had three of the games that had been included in Multi Sports, the previous pack, to which they added the three games from Opera Soft that had the same theme (despite what it may seem, the pack was edited by Dinamic alone)

title: Bombball
description: Bombball is an explosive abstract sports game, available for PC, Mac, and OUYA. Bombball is designed to be spectator-friendly and easy to learn, while still requiring serious skill to master. Grab some buddies, crank the volume up, and prepare to use boosts, blasters, and bombs to get that tiebreaking goal right before the buzzer!

description: Robot Trivia Funtime is a multiplayer trivia game for PC, with a built-in question pack editor and Workshop support. It supports up to 6 other players on Steam and includes optional AI bots to play against.

title: 6th Floor
description: Explore a seemingly endless hotel floor where each identical corridor challenges your perception. This horror walking simulator tests your observation skills as you seek the emergency exit.

Once upon a time, in the woods near the sleepy town of Wolkendorf, Germany, there lived a healer named Catrin Rosenberg. On her way to her relatives' house for Heiligabend dinner, she crosses paths with the frosted behemoth known as the Silver Devil. But is he truly as fearsome as the tales claim?

What new and wondrous legends will be spun from this chance encounter between angel and devil? ...Well, that's up for you to decide, isn't it?

title: Dashlab
description: A 2D time attack game where you dash around rooms and collect buffs and debuffs to complete levels as fast as possible. Featuring an endless mode where you can use your own songs!

title: Cardian
description: Cardian is the prototype of a fast-paced micro dungeon crawler, set in a colorful tabletop world of adventuring animals.

title: Block Pieces
description: Block Pieces is a 3D jigsaw puzzle, minimalist and relaxing experience. Exercise your skill in reassembling 3D models back to their original form, while listening to a relaxing soundtrack.

title: DCS World: F/A-18C Operation Green Line by BADGER633
description: This campaign is based on fictitious events and follows on from ‘Ford' and ‘Matrix's' exploits in the Straits of Hormuz on board the USS Abraham Lincoln in the “Rise of the Persian Lion II” Campaign.

title: The Method of Hiding a Body
description: A story-driven horror puzzle game where the player takes on the role of a resentful ghost, possessing others in order to search for her own corpse.

title: Myth Matrix
description: A Turn-based strategic card battle game. Collect cards, develop your unique deck and strategy, and have a fun PvP match with players all over the world!

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends - 2024 AMA Pro Motocross Championship
description: Compete like the pros on 12 official tracks from the 2024 AMA Pro Motocross Championship, including the legendary Loretta Lynn's!

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends - Track Pass 2024
description: Get all upcoming 2024 Track expansions for MX vs ATV Legends at a special price!

title: Rail Route: Happy Passengers
description: This expansion focuses on the art of keeping passengers happy in your rail network. Introducing a completely new angle of gameplay, adding passenger demands in your cycles.

title: Rita
description: Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

title: The Lost Penguin
description: The lost penguins need help to find their way home. You move the penguins on 2D tiles, strategically plan the route, connect with friends, interact with eggs, blockers, teleports, sharks, and solve unique problems on each level.

title: Dust: Undefined
description: Protect the core as long as you can from infinite undefined threats.

title: Fleeting Iris: Alansya Chronicles Ren'Py Edition
description: Ayame travels to Heaven City, USA to be with her fiancée but all is not what it seems. How will Ayame's life unfold in this updated release now built in Ren'Py!

title: Hero vs. 1000
description: Experience the adrenaline of facing countless hordes of enemies in an unparalleled challenge! Command a knight, a pirate and a soldier in epic battles, each with 1000 opponents waiting to test your courage and skill.

title: Maka Dash
description: "Maka Dash" is a unique parkour game where you'll take on the role of an agile young girl, embarking on an adventurous journey!

title: Infinite Innocence
description: Infinite Innocence is a game about finding anomalies, but it is very easy to see them with lighting. What if we give it a little more difficulty and tension? Will you be able to remember everything until the end?

title: Unfeigned Depths
description: Unfeigned Depths is a narrative focused first-person psychological thriller. Through the eyes of Adam, understand the true nature of your dreams with fully voiced dialogue and dynamic events. As the lines between trust and deception are blurred, can you uncover where reality ends and dreams begin?

title: Deepest World
description: DeepestWorld is a coding sandbox MMORPG where you can automate your character with JavaScript. Explore an endless open world. Hunt rare monsters and bosses. Craft deep builds and items. Acquire programming skills. Grind 24/7.

title: Skyward Extraction
description: A light horror adventure through a post apocalyptic world, with airships.

title: Casino Heist: Escape Room
description: You've just planned your next heist, the casino owned by the ruthless man who betrayed your mentor. As an experienced thief, solve puzzles and find clues to crack the advanced security systems. Will you be able to open the vault?

title: Ells Tales: Egg
description: Welcome to the survival horror clicker! Try to save a chicken egg and at the same time your life.

title: Paths of Valour
description: It is a 2D pixel role-playing game, players will play a hero, gather friends on the adventure journey to defeat the Demon King. Game content includes classic RPG elements such as turn based gameplay, random enemies, side quests, etc.

title: Unclogged
description: Unclogged is a puzzle horror escape game. Collect items, solve puzzles, unclog the toilet, and hopefully make an escape.

title: Pelican Harbor
description: Dive into a cozy village-building adventure with friends, reminiscent of Animal Crossing. Customize your Pelican, Home-Isle, and Harbor, then sail to diverse isles to harvest resources and fish. Sell your catch to NPCs, and attract specific ones to stay. Test your Rythm-Game skills by harvesting...

title: Illegal Simulator
description: "Illegal Simulator" puts you in the midst of two different lives. While running a legal market during the day, you'll manage illegal casinos and harvest banned substances at night. Collaborate with mafia gangs, have fun at strip clubs, and become the most famous figure in the underworld!

title: TV Show Tycoon
description: Get in charge of your own TV Show Company in this text-based tycoon game! Have you ever thought of your own TV Show? Design your dream shows down to the small details. Release your shows and witness your audience comment on your design choices! Make money and release more shows and seasons!

title: The Trashcan Games
description: Time for a brain break? Over 25 mini games to cleanse the mind and not think! Glorious Waste Of Your Time Games has a loaded Trash Can waiting for you. Click, reset, done.

title: They Remain
description: In this massively multiplayer online game They Remain, band together with other survivors to scavenge for resources across the wildlands. Will you thrive amidst the chaos or succumb to those who remain?

title: Hidden Old House Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Warno: Northag
description: Warno: Northag brings World War III to the North German Plains, where the attacking Warsaw Pact needs to overcome NATO’s NORTHAG. Play 2 massive new Army General campaigns and 4 Operations as you command 10 new Divisions and units, including new nations Belgium, the Netherlands, and Poland.

title: Warno: Southag
description: Warno: Southag takes the action to southern West Germany, as NATO’s reconstituted SOUTHAG counter-attacks against Warsaw Pact forces. Play 2 massive new Army General campaigns and 4 Operations as you command 10 new Divisions and units, including new nations Canada, Spain, and Czechoslovakia.

title: Controlled Death
description: Multiplayer fps game. With many features, and maps.

title: Vanakatu
description: A surreal story-driven game that uses puzzle-solving, turn based battling, and open world navigation to help Van Cat track down his evil uncle and put an end to his nefarious plans!

title: Depth Diver
description: Depth Diver is a co-op game where you go on an underwater trip with your friends to gather resources and repair underwater facilities in dangerous waters.

title: Immortal's Way
description: One small rabbit. Twelve ancient guardians. A boss-focused action game rooted in Chinese mythology. Study their patterns, strike with precision, and explore Penglai, the Isle of Immortals.

title: Death by Deduction
description: Death by Deduction is a unique blend of logic puzzle and classic murder mystery set in an old English manor during the 1970s. Explore the manor, examine evidence, and question suspects to deduce who the murderer is in "Death by Deduction".

title: Beaked Buccaneer
description: Beaked Buccaneer is a 2D mini metroidvania full of treasures and pirates that tells the story of a parrot who wants to become a pirate legend!

title: Sunset Solitaire
description: Classic Solitaire with pixel perfect graphics and soothing chip tunes. Four variants with separate difficulty modes and an addicting scoring mechanism for unlocking card backs.

title: Catch of the day
description: Catch of the day follows Eric, a young guy working on a commercial fishing boat with his boss Louis. The two of them are having a fairly normal day, when something catches on their net.
